strings: Collateral Factor

Yadda ake lissafa Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwar Avana daga factors na Aave V4 Core Hub na tokens ɗinta da ma'aunin haɗarin pool, yadda Collateral Risk ke tsayar da ƙimar ribar aro, da waɗanne iyakoki ke takaita aro.
Bayani
Tsarin Lissafi
Factors na Tokens
Pool Abubuwan Hadari
Saitin Aave
Misali da Aka Warware
Collateral Risk da Ƙimar Riba
Iyakoki
Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa yana farawa daga mafi rauni cikin factors na Aave V4 Core Hub na tokens ɗinta, sannan ma'aunin haɗarin pool wanda bai wuce 40% ba yana rage shi.

Ana lissafa ƙimantawa da iyakokin aro daban. LPOracle yana ba da rahoton ƙimar ruwan kuɗin da kowane vault token ke wakilta, ba tare da ragi ba. Sannan Collateral Factor na reserve na vault-token yana tsayar da yawan wannan ƙimar da zai iya tallafa wa bashi. Aave V4 yana amfani da Collateral Factor guda ɗaya don aro da liquidation, kuma yana lissafa lafiya ga kowane asusu. A Avana, asusu ɗaya PositionProxy ne guda ɗaya da ke riƙe da kasuwa ɗaya, don haka kowace kasuwa tana da nata Collateral Factor da ma'aunin lafiya.
CF_LP = floor(min(CF₁, …, CFₙ) × poolRiskFactor / 10⁴)
Ƙarfin aro = ƙimar matsayin LP × CF_LP

Dukkan ƙimomi suna cikin basis points. CFᵢ shi ne Collateral Factor na kowane token na pool, kuma ana tsayar da ma'aunin haɗarin pool ga kowane pool. Sakamakon yana zagayawa ƙasa, don haka ba ya taɓa wuce tsarin lissafin kuma bai wuce 1 bps ƙasa da shi ba, kuma Aave ba ya taɓa ba da rance fiye da abin da factor ɗin da aka lissafa ya ba da dama.

Matsayin LP yana da ƙarfi ne kawai gwargwadon token ɗinsa mafi rauni, don haka factor mafi ƙanƙanta na token ne ke iyakance shi. Sannan ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana rage ƙimar saboda abin da matsayin LP ke ƙarawa a kan tokens ɗinsa: asarar hanyar farashi a cikin pool, sarrafa pool ba bisa ka'ida ba da kuɗin warware ruwan kuɗi yayin liquidation. Ana amfani da shi a nan kaɗai; LPOracle yana ba da rahoton ƙimar da ba a yi wa ragi ba.

Factor na kowane token shi ne Collateral Factor ɗinsa na Aave V4 Core Hub, wanda mai bitar haɗari ke karantawa lokacin jera kasuwa, kuma ana adana shi a ParameterStore na Avana (iyakoki 1 zuwa 9,999 bps). Ana rubuta tushen a fayil ɗin jeri. Babu haɗi na atomatik da Core Hub: ana sake daidaita factors da hannu ta hanyar timelock.

Ƙafar GHO tana amfani da factor na musamman da aka tsayar a cikin payload na jeri, ba ƙimar GHO ta Core Hub ba, domin Core Hub bai jera GHO a matsayin jingina a ƙimar da za a iya amfani da ita ba. Tokens da ba su da jeri a Core Hub suma suna amfani da ƙima ta musamman da aka tsayar lokacin jeri.

Masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4 suna tsayar da ma'aunin haɗarin kowane pool a cikin payload na jerin kasuwa, tsakanin 1 zuwa 4,000 bps, don haka ma'aunin haɗarin pool bai wuce 40% ba. Yana nuna kewayon matsayin, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani.

Avana yana amfani da binciken Gauntlet kan jinginar LP, wanda ke ba da shawarar factors na farawa masu taka-tsantsan. Idan kadarar da aka aro ba ɗaya daga cikin tokens na pool ba ce, kamar GHO da aka aro a kan WETH/USDC, yana ba da shawarar farawa ƙasa har zuwa sau 0.25 na factor mafi ƙanƙanta na ƙasa. Ana daidaita factors na ƙarshe ga kowace kasuwa tare da masu ba da sabis.

A iyakar sama ta 40%, pool na tokens biyu masu factors na 78% yana da Collateral Factor na 31.2%. Aro har zuwa shawarar Lens ta ma'aunin lafiya 1.10 yana ba da loan-to-value na buɗewa na kusan 28.4% (31.2% raba da 1.10).

Aave DAO yana tsayar da Collateral Factor a kan kowane dynamic key na reserve na vault-token, sama da 0 kuma bai wuce ƙimar tsarin lissafi ba. Key da ya wuce ta shi ne drift: RiskModule yana dakatar da jinginarwa na sababbin asusu, aro da cirewa tare da bashi a waccan kasuwa, yayin da biyan bashi da liquidation ke ci gaba a kan ƙimomin Aave na yanzu.

Don rage factor, Avana yana fara rage ma'aunin haɗarin pool a gajeren jinkiri, wanda ke dakatar da sabon aro a kan kasuwar ta hanyar binciken drift. Sannan payload na Aave yana gyara kowane key da ke akwai na reserve ɗin.
Don ƙara factor, canjin Avana a jinkiri na yau da kullum yana aiwatarwa da farko, sannan payload na Aave ya biyo baya.

Tazarar jeri: ga kowace hanyar farashi ta kowane token (primary, alternate da standby), 10,000 cire CF_LP dole ne ya wuce karkatar feed da aka wallafa ta hanyar tare da drift ɗinta cikin heartbeat ɗaya. Da CF_LP na 2,812, sarari shi ne 7,188 bps, sama sosai da hanyar alternate ta 350 bps.

Iyakar kari: mafi girman kari na liquidation sau CF_LP, an zagaye sama, dole ne ya kasance ƙasa da 10,000 bps, don haka asusun da ya fara cancantar liquidation koyaushe yana riƙe da isasshen jingina don biyan bashin da karin. Da mafi girman kari na 105% da CF_LP na 3,000, sakamakon ninkawa shi ne 3,150.
Babu key na reserve na vault-token da zai iya samun Collateral Factor 0. Offboarding yana amfani da matakan Collateral Factor masu kyau maimakon haka.

Kasuwa ta 3 kasuwar USDC/USDT ce ta Aerodrome Slipstream a kan CDP Spoke "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" a Base. Cikakken vault token ɗaya (raka'a 10⁶) yana da ƙimar $2.00, CF_LP shi ne 3,120 bps, kuma farashin USDC $0.9999 ne.

Misalin ARFC

ARFC yana amfani da matsayin USDC/USDT na $100,000 tare da factor na token mafi ƙanƙanta na 75.00% da ma'aunin haɗarin pool na 37.50%, wanda ke ba da 28.12% bayan zagayawa ƙasa. Waɗannan alkaluman ba sigogin ƙaddamarwa da aka gabatar ba ne.

Kowane reserve na vault-token yana kuma da ƙimar Collateral Risk a bps, wanda mai bitar haɗari ke tsayarwa a jerin Aave. Ba ragi ba ne a kan ƙimar jingina: yana tsayar da ƙarin ribar haɗari na mai aro. Domin kowane asusu yana riƙe da kasuwa ɗaya, ƙarin ribar asusun shi ne Collateral Risk na waccan kasuwa.
Ƙimar ribar aro = baseRate × (1 + riskPremium)

Dabarar GHO a kwance take, don haka ƙimar riba ba ta dogara da amfani ba. Aave DAO yana kiyaye ƙimar ribar tushe ta GHO a daidai ko sama da ƙimar ribar tushe ta GHO ta Aave V4 Core Hub. Ba a tilasta wannan a on-chain ba; sa idon Avana yana faɗakarwa idan ta faɗi ƙasa.
Ƙarin riba yana taruwa a kan bashin da aka ciro kuma ba ya haɗuwa a kan kansa.

Misali: rancen da jingina mai ƙarin ribar haɗari na 50% ke tallafawa yana biyan 6.75% a ƙimar ribar tushe ta 4.5%. Da ƙimar ribar tushe ta 5.50% da ƙarin riba na 15%, ingantacciyar ƙimar riba ita ce 6.325%.

Matakin ƙarin ribar haɗari na CDP Spoke dole ne ya kasance aƙalla mafi girman Collateral Risk a kan Spoke ɗin da 1 bps, kuma ba a taɓa rage shi yayin da bashi a waccan kadara ke akwai. In ba haka ba, binciken ƙarin riba na Aave zai iya sa biyan bashi, aro, cirewa da liquidation su revert.
Avana ba ya ƙara kuɗin riba a kan kowace kadara; duk riba tana zuwa ga mai ba da rance.
Ƙarfin aro na asusu kuma ya dogara da bashin da yake da shi, binciken oracle da ruwan kuɗin da ake da shi. Waɗannan iyakoki suna takaita yawan jingina da bashin da zai iya kasancewa:

meta.title: Tsarewa da Vault Tokens
meta.description: Yadda Avana ke riƙe da matsayin LP, yake rubuta abin da ke tallafa musu da kuma wakiltar su a kan Aave V4: LPVault, Collateralization, vault tokens, PositionProxy, ProxyManager da Lock.

strings: Tsarewa da Vault Tokens
Yadda Avana ke riƙe da matsayin LP, yake rubuta abin da ke tallafa musu da kuma wakiltar su a kan Aave V4: LPVault, Collateralization, vault tokens, PositionProxy, ProxyManager da Lock.
Bayani
LPVault
Collateralization
Vault Tokens
VaultTokenFactory
PositionProxy
ProxyManager
Lock
Invariant na Tallafi
Misalin Daidaitawa
Aave V4 yana karɓar jingina ne kawai a matsayin reserves na ERC-20, yayin da matsayin AMM NFT ne ko kason pool. Avana yana raba tsarewar matsayin da rikodin jinginar da Aave ke gani.

Nau'o'in kwangila bakwai marasa canzawa a kowace chain suna riƙe da matsayin da aka jinginar kuma suna mayar da shi jinginar Aave. Kowace yarjejeniyar AMM tana da LPVault ɗaya da ke riƙe da matsayinta. Rajistar Collateralization ɗaya mai zaman kanta daga AMM tana rubuta yawan raka'o'in da kowane matsayi ke tallafawa. Vault token ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa yana wakiltar waɗannan raka'o'in ɗaya da ɗaya. AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens zuwa PositionProxy na mai aro na waccan CDP Spoke da kasuwa, kuma proxy ɗin yana ba da su ga CDP Spoke. ProxyManager yana ƙirƙirar proxies, kuma Lock yana hana kiran Avana ɗaya sake shiga wani.
Kwangila
Misalai
Ɗaya ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM a kowace chain
Yana riƙe da kowane matsayin da aka jinginar na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗinsa kuma ya san kowane mai ajiya na rikodi
Ɗaya a kowace chain
Rikodin tallafi, raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige, tsarin ƙwacewa, ma'aunan fallasa da ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira
Vault token
Ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa
ERC-20 mai takaitaccen canja wuri, don jingina kawai; raka'ar tushe ɗaya ga kowace raka'a da aka ƙididdige
Yana tura vault tokens da CREATE3 kuma yana kiyaye rajistar token da ta LPVault

Asusun Aave na mai aro na kasuwa ɗaya; ba shi da logic
Yana ƙirƙirar proxies da CREATE2 a adiresoshin da za a iya hasashe
Makullin reentrancy na tarayya mai mambobi biyu, AaveAdapter da LPVaultSwap

Babu ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan kwangilolin da za a iya haɓakawa. Tsarewar matsayi, da ƙa'idar cewa matsayi yana komawa ne kawai ga mai ajiyarsa na rikodi, suna cikin LPVaults da Collateralization marasa canzawa, don haka babu haɓakawar AaveAdapter, RiskModule ko LPVaultSwap da za ta iya canza su.

LPVault shi ne mai tsaron da ba ya canzawa na kowane matsayin da aka jinginar na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya a chain ɗaya. A ƙaddamarwa akwai guda biyu: LPVault na Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da LPVault na Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. Yarjejeniyar AMM ta gaba, ko sabon ƙarni na kwangilolin matsayi da LPVault da ke akwai bai ambata ba, za ta sami sabon LPVault mai sabon ID na haɗin kai. Ba a sake tura LPVaults da ke akwai, Collateralization da Lock ba.

LPVault ba shi da proxy, mai shi, rawar admin, dakatarwa ko aikin ceto. Yana ɗaukar kowane adireshin da yake kira daga immutables na constructor ɗinsa, ciki har da position manager da factory na yarjejeniyar AMM, don haka ana ƙin forks da wasu ƙarnonin factory. Ba ya karanta yanayin dakatarwa, breaker, daskarar adireshi ko farashi, don haka ƙwacewa, karɓar kuɗaɗe da fita marasa bashi suna isa gare shi a kowane yanayi.

Aiki
Hali

Yana jawo matsayin daga mai shi, yana bincika cewa pool da siffarsa sun yi daidai da na kasuwar sosai, yana rubuta mai shi a matsayin mai ajiya na rikodi kuma yana mayar da raka'o'insa.

Taswirar tsarewa da aka tsara ta position key. Ba sifili ba ne kawai yayin da matsayin ke tallafa wa rikodi a buɗe.

Yawan tokens ga kowace raka'a a wani vector na farashin oracle. LPOracle yana haɗa ɗakin karatu na farashi iri ɗaya.
unwind
Yana cire daidai raka'o'in da Collateralization ke cirewa daga rikodi kuma yana aika babban kuɗinsu kawai zuwa LPVaultSwap ko Collateralization, ba taɓa kuɗin da ake bin matsayin ba.
releaseToDepositor
Yana cire raka'o'in cirewa ta ɓangare kuma yana aika babban kuɗinsu zuwa mai ajiya na rikodi, tare da mafi ƙanƙantar adadin mai ajiyar ga kowane token.
returnPosition
Yana goge shigarwar tsarewa, sannan yana aika dukkan matsayin, tare da kowace raka'a mai rai da kowane kuɗin da ake bin sa, zuwa mai ajiya na rikodi. Ba ya ɗaukar mai karɓa.
collectFees
Yana biyan kowane kuɗin da aka raba na matsayin da ake tsarewa ga mai ajiyarsa na rikodi. Raka'o'i, supply, iyakoki da bashi ba sa canzawa.
returnStray
Yana aika matsayin da ya isa LPVault ba tare da rikodi ba zuwa ga mai shi da gudanarwa ta tabbatar, ta hanyar aikin timelock mai jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Tabbatar da ainihin siffa

Ga ruwan kuɗi mai tattarawa, ana karɓar matsayi ne kawai idan ticks ɗinsa na ƙasa da na sama sun yi daidai da kewayon kasuwar sosai. Ana ƙin matsayi mai kowane kewayo daban ko da ya haɗu da shi, domin kunkuntar kewayo da aka ƙimanta a farashin kowace raka'a na kasuwar zai sami ƙima fiye da kima. Misali, kasuwar da aka jera a [−10, 10] tana karɓar matsayi a [−10, 10] kuma tana ƙin wanda ke [−9, 10]. A Base, ana ƙin matsayin Slipstream da aka stake a gauge.
Kuɗaɗe da ƙarin ruwan kuɗi

Kuɗaɗen ciniki na mai ajiya na rikodi ne. Inda yarjejeniyar AMM ke ajiye kuɗaɗe daban da matsayin (Uniswap v3, Aerodrome Slipstream), mai ajiyar yana karɓar su a kowane lokaci, a kowane yanayin dakatarwa, yanayin farashi da yanayin breaker, kuma liquidation ba ta taɓa ɗaukar su. Inda yarjejeniyar AMM ke haɗa kuɗaɗe cikin matsayin, suna zama cikin ƙimar kowace raka'a kuma suna komawa tare da matsayin. Ruwan kuɗin da kowa ya ƙara wa matsayin da ake tsarewa ba a ƙididdige shi har sai mai ajiyar ya kira aikin sake ƙididdigewa, kuma ƙwacewa ba ta taɓa cire shi; yana komawa ga mai ajiyar tare da matsayin.

Collateralization kaɗai ne zai iya kiran ayyukan da ke motsa matsayi, raka'o'i, babban kuɗi ko kuɗaɗe, kuma kawai yayin da AaveAdapter ko LPVaultSwap ke riƙe da Lock. Mayar da matsayin da ya ɓata ita ce kaɗai hanyar dawo da shi. Tana gudana a jinkirin timelock na yau da kullum, tana buƙatar Lock ya kasance a kwance, tana bincika yanayin ɓatan a lokacin aiwatarwa kuma kowane mai sokewa zai iya soke ta.

Collateralization rajistar tallafi ce mara canzawa, mai zaman kanta daga AMM, ta kowane matsayin da aka jinginar a chain ɗaya. Misali ɗaya yana hidimar kowane Hub, CDP Spoke, kasuwa da haɗin AMM a chain ɗin. Yana isa kowace yarjejeniyar AMM ne kawai ta LPVault na waccan yarjejeniyar, kuma AaveAdapter da LPVaultSwap kaɗai ne za su iya kiran sa.
Alhaki
Yadda yake aiki
Rikodin tallafi

Rikodi ɗaya ga kowane matsayin da aka jinginar, an tsara shi ta ID na haɗin kai da position key: mai ajiya, proxy, kasuwa, raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige, caji na asali da matsayi. Rikodi ba ya taɓa komawa ga wani mai ajiya, proxy ko kasuwa.
Raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige

Raka'o'in da LPVault ke ba da rahoto bayan ya karɓi tsarewa, ban da raka'o'in da ƙwacewa da cirewa ta ɓangare suka cire, tare da raka'o'in da sake ƙididdigewa ya ƙara. AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar daidai wannan adadin raka'o'in tushe na vault-token.
Iyakar rikodi
Aƙalla rikodi 16 a buɗe ga kowane asusu da kasuwa. Jinginarwa ta 17 tana revert, har da ƙarin jingina na ceto; mai aron yana ƙara wa rikodin da ke akwai da sake ƙididdigewa maimakon haka.
Jerin ƙwacewa daga mafi girma

Kowane asusu yana tsara rikodinsa bisa raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige, mafi girma da farko. Ƙwacewa tana bin jerin daga kai kuma tana tsayawa idan raka'o'in da aka ƙwace sun cika, don haka tana taɓa rikodin da take cirewa daga gare su kaɗai.
Ma'aunan fallasa
Ma'aunan kasuwa ga kowane vault token, da ma'aunan token da na mai ajiya da aka tsara ta Hub. Ƙara CDP Spoke ko kasuwa ba ya taɓa ninka iyakar duk Hub.
Ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira
Yawan tokens da aka cire don vault tokens da Aave ya ƙwace amma ba a taɓa sasantawa ba. Suna kiyaye tallafin waɗannan vault tokens har sai wani ya kira sasantawar da ke jira.
Raka'o'in ceto
Raka'o'in da ƙarin jingina na ceto ya ƙara. Ana ƙirga su gaba ɗaya a ma'aunin lafiya da liquidation na Aave, kuma ana ƙimanta su a sifili lokacin da Avana ke bincika sabon aro.
Ma'aunan iyaka ga kowane Hub

Ana cajin kowace jinginarwa a USD a farashin da bai gaza stress floor na kasuwar ba ($1.00 ga kowane cikakken vault token ta asali). Ana ƙara cajin a ma'aunin kasuwa, a ma'aunin kowane token na pool a waccan Hub da kuma a ma'aunin mai ajiyar a waccan Hub. Misali daga ƙayyadaddun bayanai: da iyakar token na Stable LP Hub ta $5,000,000 ga USDC, jinginarwa ta $3,000,000 a CDP Spoke ɗaya da jinginarwa ta $2,500,000 a wani duka suna rubuta a kan ma'auni ɗaya, don haka ana ƙin ta biyun ($5,500,000 ya wuce $5,000,000).

Kowace fita tana sakin daidai cajin da raka'o'inta ke ɗauke da shi, daga yankin ceto da farko sannan daga kasafin na yau da kullum. Ma'aunan fita suna tsayawa a sifili kuma ba sa taɓa revert, kuma fita ba ta taɓa kiran RiskModule, MarketRegistry ko ParameterStore, don haka kuskuren manufa ba zai taɓa hana cirewa ko liquidation ba.
Binciken ƙwacewa

Kafin liquidation, LPVaultSwap yana neman Collateralization ya ɗauki hoton hannayen jarin da proxy ya bayar da jimillar supply na vault token. Bayan Aave ya ƙwace kuma AaveAdapter ya ƙone raka'o'in da aka ƙwace, Collateralization yana buƙatar raguwar hannayen jari da raguwar supply kowanne ya yi daidai da raka'o'in da aka ƙwace. Sannan yana cirewa daga rikodin daga mafi girma kuma yana sa LPVault ya warware daidai waɗannan raka'o'in zuwa LPVaultSwap. Rikodin da aka cire har sifili yana ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe, don haka mai ajiyar zai iya karɓar kuɗaɗensa kuma ya cire matsayin.
Daidaitawa a fita

LPVaultSwap mai kuskure zai iya ɗaukar vault tokens da aka ƙwace ba tare da sasanta su ba. Hannayen jarin da proxy ya bayar za su kasance ƙasa da raka'o'insa da aka ƙididdige. A cirewa ta gaba, cirewa ta ɓangare, sake ƙididdigewa, biyan bashi da jingina, sakin ba tare da ƙididdigewa ba ko ƙwacewar waccan asusun, Collateralization yana ɗaukar raka'o'in da suka ɓace a matsayin waɗanda aka ƙwace: yana cire su daga mafi girma, yana motsa yawan tokens ɗinsu zuwa ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira na kasuwar kuma yana sakin sauran. Kowane adireshi zai iya kiran sasantawar da ke jira a LPVaultSwap daga baya, wanda ke ƙone vault tokens da suka makale, yana musanya tokens zuwa kadarar bashi kuma yana ƙara kuɗin da aka samu ga Coverage Spoke na reserve na bashin kasuwar. Mai kiran ba ya karɓar komai.
Saki ta ɓangare

Mai ajiya zai iya cire wani ɓangare na raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na matsayin da aka jinginar yayin da matsayin ke ci gaba da kasancewa a jingine. Collateralization yana cirewa daga rikodin, yana sakin cajin da waɗannan raka'o'in ke ɗauke da shi kuma yana sa LPVault ya biya babban kuɗinsu ga mai ajiya na rikodi, kowane token aƙalla mafi ƙanƙantar adadin mai kiran. Cire dukkan matsayi yana buƙatar raka'o'in su yi daidai da raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na rikodin; manhajar tana karanta su daga hasashen saki.

Vault token shi ne ERC-20 na jingina kawai da ke wakiltar raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na kasuwa ɗaya a cikin Aave V4. Akwai daidai vault token ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa, kuma shi reserve ɗaya ne na jingina na waccan Spoke a Hub na gida na Spoke ɗin. Ba shi da mai shi, admin, rawa, setter, dakatarwa, blocklist, permit, transfer hook, rebasing, kuɗi a kan canja wuri ko emissions. Haɗe-haɗensa (haɗin kai, LPVault, market key, Hub, Spoke, ID na kasuwa, LPOracle, AaveAdapter, LPVaultSwap da Collateralization) immutables ne, kuma Collateralization yana karanta asalin kasuwar daga gare su kaɗai.
Raka'o'i da decimals

Raka'ar tushe ɗaya daidai take da raka'a ɗaya da aka ƙididdige ta kasuwar. Ga Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream, raka'a ɗaya raka'a ce ta ruwan kuɗin matsayin a kan ainihin kewayon. Babu ma'aunin juyawa a ko'ina a ƙirƙira, ƙonewa ko canja wuri.

Ana tsayar da decimals lokacin jeri: mafi ƙanƙantar ƙima daga 6 zuwa 18 wadda a cikinta cikakken token ɗaya ke da ƙimar aƙalla $1 a farashin tunani na jerin. Don haka cikakken token yana da ƙima tsakanin $1 da $10 lokacin jeri, kuma kunnawa tana buƙatar farashin cikakken token na oracle ya kasance tsakanin $0.50 da $20.00.
Misali: matsayin USDC/USDT mai ruwan kuɗi 5,000,000,000 yana ƙirƙirar raka'o'in tushe 5,000,000,000, wato cikakkun tokens 5,000 a decimals 6.
Ƙirƙira da ƙonewa

AaveAdapter kaɗai ke ƙirƙira da ƙonewa. Yana ƙirƙira ne kawai zuwa proxy da aka yi wa rajista na kasuwar, a cikin jinginarwa (daidai raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige) ko sake ƙididdigewa (daidai raka'o'in da aka ƙara). Yana ƙonewa daga proxy da aka yi wa rajista bayan cirewa, cirewa ta ɓangare ko biyan bashi da jingina, kuma daga LPVaultSwap bayan ƙwacewa. Ƙonewa ba ta buƙatar allowance, kuma token ɗin yana ƙin ƙonewa daga Hub. Rajistar proxies masu inganci tana cikin token ɗin, AaveAdapter kaɗai ke rubuta ta a jinginarwar farko ta proxy a kasuwar, kuma ba ta da cirewa.
Ƙa'idar canja wuri
Kowane canjin ma'auni yana kan ɗaya daga cikin hanyoyi biyar. Kowane wani canja wuri yana revert, ciki har da canja wurin adadin sifili da canja wurin da mai kashewa mai allowance ya yi.

Bayan cirewa ko ƙwacewa

Canja wuri daga proxy zuwa proxy, canja wuri daga LPVaultSwap zuwa Hub da canja wuri zuwa ko daga AaveAdapter duk suna revert. Domin jinginar da aka ƙwace na iya isa LPVaultSwap kaɗai, kowane mai kiran liquidation na Aave yana revert idan Hub ya yi ƙoƙarin aika masa da tokens da aka ƙwace. Saitunan Spoke da ke rufe sauran hanyoyin an bayyana su a
Hubs da Spokes
Iyakar supply

Jimillar supply ba ta wuce raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na kasuwar tare da raka'o'inta na sasantawa da ke jira ba, kuma tana daidai da su yayin da kowace ƙwacewa ke sasantuwa a cikin kira ɗaya. Tsakanin ma'amaloli, vault tokens suna zama a Hub kaɗai, sai dai raka'o'in da aka ƙwace waɗanda LPVaultSwap ke riƙe da su bayan ƙwacewar da ba a taɓa sasantawa ba.

VaultTokenFactory ba ya canzawa kuma yana tura kowane vault token na chain ɗinsa. AvanaTimelock kaɗai ne zai iya kiran sa, a cikin rukuni ɗaya da aikin jerin kasuwar, a jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5. Yana turawa da CREATE3, tare da salt na CDP Spoke da market key, don haka ana iya hasashen adireshin kowane token kuma a bincika shi a cikin bayanin turawa kafin jerin ya aiwatar.
Ana samun market key daga ID na chain, ID na haɗin kai, pool da ainihin siffa. Pool ɗaya da aka jera da kewayo biyu kasuwanni biyu ne da tokens biyu.
Rajistar token tana haɗa kowane CDP Spoke da market key da token ɗaya har abada kuma ba a taɓa share ta. Kasuwar da aka sake jerawa a wani Spoke tana samun sabon token a sabon adireshi.
Rajistar LPVault tana haɗa kowane ID na haɗin kai da LPVault ɗaya, wanda aikin timelock ke rubutawa sau ɗaya bayan bincika cewa LPVault ɗin ya ambaci Collateralization da Lock na wannan chain.
Turawa tana revert sai dai idan decimals suna tsakanin 6 da 18 kuma an yi wa haɗin kai rajista.

PositionProxy shi ne asusun Aave V4 na mai aro na kasuwa ɗaya a CDP Spoke ɗaya. Yana riƙe da vault tokens da aka bayar na waccan kasuwa da bashin kowane reserve na bashi da asusun ke aro a waccan Spoke, ƙarƙashin ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya. Wallet da ke amfani da kasuwanni biyu yana da proxies biyu, don haka babu jinginar wata kasuwa da ke tallafa wa bashin wata kasuwa.

Ba shi da logic kuma ba ya canzawa: babu implementation pointer, initializer, hanyar haɓakawa, delegatecall, aikin receive ko rawa. Ba a taɓa maye gurbinsa, kuma babu asusun da ke motsawa tsakanin proxies.
ProxyManager ne ke ƙirƙira shi da CREATE2, ɗaya ga kowane wallet, CDP Spoke da kasuwa, a jinginarwar farko ta wallet a waccan kasuwa.
Immutables ɗinsa guda huɗu su ne AaveAdapter, wallet, Spoke da ID na kasuwa. Ba sa taɓa canzawa.
Aikinsa guda ɗaya mai canza yanayi, execute, yana karɓar kira daga AaveAdapter na chain kaɗai, har ma ga wallet ɗin da aka haɗa shi da shi. Wallet ba ya taɓa kiran proxy kai tsaye.

Ba ya karanta yanayi kuma ba ya kiran kowace kwangilar Avana ko tushen farashi. Duk logic na asusu yana cikin AaveAdapter, wanda ke haɓakawa ta timelock kaɗai, don haka gyara yana isa kowane proxy lokaci ɗaya kuma babu fita da ta dogara da code a cikin proxy.
Mai aron da ya rasa key na wallet ɗinsa ba zai taɓa iya cire matsayinsa ba. Kowane mai biya zai iya biyan bashinsa, ko liquidation ta share shi.

ProxyManager shi ne kaɗai mai ƙirƙirar PositionProxies a chain ɗinsa. Ba ya canzawa, ba shi da mai shi, rawa, dakatarwa ko setter. AaveAdapter kaɗai ne zai iya neman sa ya tura, kuma yana ƙin wallet da MarketRegistry ya daskarar. Ba ya kiyaye taswirar wallet zuwa proxy: AaveAdapter yana kiyaye haɗin, kuma kowane vault token yana kiyaye rajistarsa ta proxies masu inganci.
salt = keccak256(abi.encode(wallet, spoke, marketId))

View na hasashe yana mayar da adireshin proxy kafin turawa. Domin haɗin wani ɓangare ne na salt da na hujjojin constructor, duk wanda ya jawo ƙirƙirar, proxy a wannan adireshin yana haɗe da waccan wallet, Spoke da kasuwa. Turawa ta biyu ga rukuni ɗaya na uku tana revert.

Makullin reentrancy ɗaya mara canzawa a kowace chain ana raba shi tsakanin kowace kwangilar Avana da ke motsa kadarori ko canza lissafi. Yana da mambobi biyu daidai, AaveAdapter da LPVaultSwap. Kowace hanyar shiga ta waje ta su tana samun Lock da farko kuma tana sakin sa a ƙarshe. Yayin da ake riƙe da shi, Collateralization da LPVaults suna karɓar kira daga mai kiran da aka ambata kaɗai, kuma duk ƙoƙarin fara hanyar shiga ta waje ta biyu a cikin bishiyar kira ɗaya yana revert.
Hanyoyin shiga na AaveAdapter: pledge, recredit, borrow, repay, withdraw, removeLiquidity, repayAllAndWithdraw, repayWithCollateral, collectFees da releaseZeroCredit.
Hanyoyin shiga na LPVaultSwap: liquidate, liquidatePermissionless da settlePending.
Sabon CDP Spoke, kasuwa ko LPVault yana amfani da Lock ɗaya ba tare da sake turawa ko canjin mamba ba.
Lock ba dakatarwa ba ne. Ba ya taɓa hana aikin yarjejeniya a farkon ma'amala.
Ga kowace kasuwa, a ƙarshen kowace ma'amala:
vaultToken.totalSupply ≤ totalCredited + pendingUnits

Kowace jinginarwa, cirewa, cirewa ta ɓangare, sake ƙididdigewa, biyan bashi da jingina da sasantawa tana barin gibin (da aka ƙididdige tare da masu jira, cire supply) ba tare da canji ba, kuma AaveAdapter yana bincika wannan bayan kowane kira. Daidaito yana tabbata yayin da kowace ƙwacewa ke sasantuwa a cikin kira ɗaya. Siffar gefe ɗaya tana sa kasuwa ta ci gaba da aiki idan hanyar sasantawa mai kuskure ta taɓa ƙone raka'o'in da ba ta sasanta ba: ruwan kuɗin da ke bayan irin wannan ƙonewa yana ci gaba da kasancewa a tsare, don haka vault tokens da ke yawo suna da tallafi fiye da cikakke.

Kowane rikodi kuma yana kiyaye raka'o'insa masu rai a daidai ko sama da raka'o'insa da aka ƙididdige. Jinginarwa tana tsayar da da aka ƙididdige daidai da raka'o'i masu rai, ƙarin da kowa ya yi yana ɗaga raka'o'i masu rai kaɗai, kuma kowace cirewa tana rage duka biyun da daidai raka'o'in da aka cire. Lens yana ba da rahoton supply na vault-token kusa da ruwan kuɗin da ake riƙe da shi, don haka kowa zai iya bincika tallafin kowace kasuwa.
Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jera ta.

Wannan misali daga ƙayyadaddun bayanai yana nuna yadda ake sarrafa ƙwacewar da ba a sasanta ba. Alice tana jinginar da matsayin USDC/USDT guda biyu: rikodi 1 mai raka'o'i 5,000,000,000 da rikodi 2 mai raka'o'i 4,000,000,000. Bayan depeg, LPVaultSwap mai kuskure yana ɗaukar raka'o'i 1,575,000,000 da aka ƙwace ba tare da sasanta su ba.

A mataki na uku, gibin shi ne raka'o'i 1,575,000,000. Collateralization yana cire shi daga rikodi 1 a kan jerin, yana motsa yawan tokens masu daidaito zuwa ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira kuma yana mayar da sauran matsayin ga Alice tare da duk kuɗaɗensa. Vault tokens 1,575,000,000 da ke yawo suna ci gaba da samun tallafi har sai sasantawar ta ƙone su kuma ta aika kadarar bashin da aka dawo da ita zuwa Coverage Spoke.

Aave V4 yana lissafa ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya ga kowane asusu. A Avana, asusu ɗaya PositionProxy ne guda ɗaya da ke riƙe da kasuwa ɗaya, don haka kowace kasuwa da wallet ke amfani da ita tana da nata ma'aunin lafiya.

Ma'aunin lafiya yana kwatanta jinginar asusu, wadda aka auna da Collateral Factor ɗinta, da jimillar bashinsa a kan kowane reserve na bashi. Aave V4 yana lissafa shi a CDP Spoke da daidaitaccen lissafi. Asusun da ke ƙasa da 1.00 za a iya yi masa liquidation, ta ɓangare, ta hanyar LPVaultSwap.

Kowane wallet yana da PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa, kuma kowane proxy asusun Aave ne daban. Gazawar farashi, breaker ko liquidation a kasuwa ɗaya ba ta taɓa canza asusun wata kasuwa. Farashin token da kasuwanni biyu ke tarayya a ciki yana motsa duka biyun bisa ƙira; iyakokin token na kowane Hub suna takaita wannan fallasa ta tarayya.
healthFactor = (ƙimar jingina × CF) / Σ ƙimar bashin kowane reserve na bashi
Ƙimar jingina ita ce vault tokens da asusun ya bayar a farashin LPOracle na kasuwar, ba tare da ragi ba.

Ana ƙimanta kowane reserve na bashi a farashinsa na Aave: GHO a tsayayyen $1 na Aave, kowace sauran kadarar bashi ta DebtOracle ɗinta. Hauhawar farashin kadarar bashi yana rage ma'aunin lafiya ba tare da motsin jingina ba.
Kowace zagayawa tana kan asusun: ana zagaye sakamakon ƙasa, kuma bashi yana zagayawa sama.
Idan babu bashi, ma'aunin lafiya shi ne ƙima mafi girma. Rashin bashi yana nufin asusun yana da bashin sifili a kowane reserve na bashi.

Ƙa'idar Aave kanta ita ce kaɗai iyakar on-chain da Avana ke dogara da ita: Aave yana ƙin kowane aro ko cirewa da zai bar ma'aunin lafiya ƙasa da 1.00. Avana ba ya tsayar da nasa matakin lafiya na buɗewa. Mai aro yana zaɓar sararinsa da mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiya da yake bayarwa ga kowane aro, cirewa tare da bashi ko cirewa ta ɓangare tare da bashi.

Ana ɗaga ko kunna matakin ƙasa mai tsauri a gajeren jinkiri na awanni 12 kuma ana rage shi a jinkiri na yau da kullum, da aƙalla 0.03 a kowane mataki; kashe shi yana tsayar da shi a 0 a mataki ɗaya.

Daga asusun matsayi biyu ɗin (HF 1.5602), Carol tana cire cikakkun tokens 2,000 (kusan 2,000 USDC da 2,000 USDT) daga matsayinta na farko kuma tana barin sa a jingine. Rikodin yana faɗuwa zuwa raka'o'i 8,000,000,000, jingina tana faɗuwa zuwa $21,000 kuma jinginar da aka auna da CF zuwa $6,552, don haka ma'aunin lafiya shi ne 6,552 / 4,999.50 = 1.3105, sama da mafi ƙanƙantarta na 1.20. Rikodin da ya rage dole ne ya ci gaba da kasancewa da ƙimar aƙalla mafi ƙanƙantar jinginarwa ta $10.

Ƙara jingina ita ce hanya mafi arha ga mai aro don fita daga liquidation, don haka takaitawa ba ta taɓa ƙin ta. Ƙarin jingina na ceto jinginarwa ce zuwa asusu mai bashi wanda ma'aunin lafiyarsa ke ƙasa da
rescueHealthFactor
, wanda aka tsayar a 1.10. An iyakance cajinsa a adadin da ke dawo da asusun zuwa 1.10.

Yana wucewa Hub a yanayin Frozen ko Paused (General), circuit breaker da ya tashi, iyakar kason pool da daskarar adireshi. Hub da aka dakatar saboda zargin amfani da kuskure a hanyar ƙirƙira yana ƙin sa.

Yana buƙatar $10 kawai ko mafi ƙanƙantar jinginarwa na kasuwar, wanda ya fi ƙanƙanta, kuma zai iya amfani da yankin ƙarin jingina da aka keɓe na kasuwar (10% na iyakar kasuwa) idan kasafin na yau da kullum ya cika.
Iyakar rikodi tana ci gaba da aiki.

Raka'o'in da yake ƙarawa raka'o'in ceto ne. Aave yana ƙirga su gaba ɗaya don lafiya da liquidation, amma Avana yana ƙimanta su a sifili lokacin da yake bincika sabon aro, cirewa tare da bashi ko cirewa ta ɓangare tare da bashi, don haka ba sa taɓa tallafa wa sabon bashi.

Misali: asusu a ma'aunin lafiya 1.2000 mai bashin $10,000 yana riƙe da raka'o'in ceto na $1,000 a Collateral Factor na 3,120 bps. Cire su yana cire $312 na jinginar da aka auna da CF, don haka ma'aunin lafiya da Avana ke bincikawa don sabon bashi shi ne 1.1688.
Kasuwar jingina ɗaya ga kowane asusu: kasuwar proxy.

Aƙalla rikodi 16 a buɗe (matsayi) ga kowane asusu da kasuwa. Jinginarwa ta 17 tana revert da TooManyRecords; mai aron yana ƙara wa matsayin da ke akwai da sake ƙididdigewa maimakon haka. Iyakar tana kiyaye ƙwacewar dukkan asusu a cikin ma'amala ɗaya: rikodi 16 suna cin aƙalla gas 5.15M, ƙasa da 31% na iyakar 16.78M ga kowace ma'amala.
Adadin reserves na bashi ga kowane asusu yana da iyaka ta iyakar reserve na kowane asusu na CDP Spoke, wadda Aave DAO ke tsayarwa.

Babu mafi ƙanƙantar bashi. Ana karɓar kowane aro sama da 0 da ya wuce sauran binciken. Keepers na Avana kansa suna yi wa kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da 1.00 liquidation ko mene ne girmansa kuma suna biyan gas.

Aave yana ƙimanta kowane reserve a farashin da tushensa ke bayarwa. Ƙarƙashin farashi mai gazawa, oracles suna ba da farashi masu taka-tsantsan, don haka ma'aunin lafiya zai iya motsawa ne kawai a kan mai aro, yayin da ba a taɓa ƙwace ko biyan komai a waɗannan farashin ba.

Bashin da ba GHO ba a Aave

Hanyoyi ba su yarda ba
An gina shi daga amsoshin hanya mafi ƙasa
Amsar hanya mafi girma
Cached (har zuwa awa 1)
Farashin da aka karɓa na ƙarshe
Expired

Farashin da aka karɓa na ƙarshe da aka ɗaga da hauhawar matsi na kadarar

Aro da cirewa tare da bashi suna buƙatar sabbin farashi masu yarjejeniya ga kasuwar da kowane reserve na bashi na asusun. Bayan farashin Expired ya murmure, da kuma na awa ɗaya bayan sake farawar sequencer na Base, asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95 kaɗai ne za a iya yi musu liquidation, wanda ke ba masu aro lokaci su ɗauki mataki.
Ƙarin aro yana rage ma'aunin lafiya.
Biyan bashi yana ɗaga shi nan take. Kowa zai iya biyan bashin kowane asusu, kuma babu dakatarwa, breaker, daskarewa ko yanayin farashi na Avana da ke hana biyan bashi.
Jinginar da wani matsayi, ƙarin jingina na ceto ko sake ƙididdige ruwan kuɗin da aka ƙara yana ɗaga shi.

Biyan bashi da jingina yana biyan bashi daga wani ɓangare na matsayin da aka jinginar a kira ɗaya da aka ɗauki nauyinsa da flash, kuma ma'aunin lafiya bayan kiran ba zai iya zama ƙasa da na kafin sa ba.
Cirewa ko cire ruwan kuɗi tare da bashi dole ne ya bar ma'aunin lafiya a daidai ko sama da mafi ƙanƙantar mai kiran da 1.00.
Don yadda ake tsayar da Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa, duba
Collateral Factor
Yadda Aave V4 ke auna ma'aunin lafiya na kowane asusun Avana, iyakokin da Avana ke ƙarawa a kai, ƙarin jingina na ceto da lambobin misali na aro, cirewa da cirewa ta ɓangare.

meta.title: Karfafawa
meta.description: Wanda ake biya me a Avana: ladar keeper daga ribar oracle ta kowace liquidation, rarar mai aro, kuɗin keepers da kariya na Avana, da riba ga masu ba da rance.

strings: Karfafawa
Wanda ake biya me a Avana: ladar keeper daga ribar oracle ta kowace liquidation, rarar mai aro, kuɗin keepers da kariya na Avana, da riba ga masu ba da rance.
Bayani
Ladar Keeper
Rarar Mai Aro
Keepers na Avana
Kuɗin Kariya
Masu Ba da Rance
Ba a haɗa ba
Biyan kuɗaɗen da kwangilolin Avana ke yi, wanda ke karɓar kowanne, da abin da Avana Labs ke biya da kansa.

Kwangilolin Avana suna biyan kuɗi a wuri ɗaya: sasantawar liquidation. Bayan an biya bashin da flash loan, LPVaultSwap yana raba rarar da aka samu tsakanin mai karɓar kuɗin Avana, mai kira da mai aro, duka a kadarar bashin da aka biya. Riba tana zuwa ga masu ba da rance, kuma Avana Labs yana biyan keepers ɗinsa kuma yana ɗaukar nauyin First-Loss Reserves.
Mahalarci
Yana karɓa
Yana biya ko yana bayarwa
Mai kiran liquidation
Ladar keeper daga ribar oracle
Gas, sakamakon musanya da kowane ƙarin gibi
Mai aro
Duk wani abin da aka dawo da shi sama da ƙimar oracle ta ƙwacewar; dukkan kuɗaɗen LP
Riba da karin liquidation a kan jinginar da aka ƙwace
Avana Labs
20% na ribar oracle; kuɗin manhaja a wajen kwangiloli
Gas na keeper ɗinsa; jarin First-Loss Reserve
Aave DAO
Dukkan riba a kan layukan lamuninsa
Ruwan kuɗin layin lamuni

Aave yana auna girman kowace ƙwacewa a farashin oracle, don haka karin da yake biya shi ne ribar oracle: ƙimar oracle ta raka'o'in da aka ƙwace, ban da bashin da aka biya da flash premium. Ladar mai kiran ita ce wannan ribar bayan kason Avana na 20%, har zuwa abin da musanyar suka samu a zahiri.
ladar keeper = min(S, G) − A
Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jera ta.

A misalin Ethereum na 1,950 USDC da aka biya a kan vault token a $2.10, ribar oracle ita ce 96.525 USDC, rarar da aka samu 89.325 USDC kuma kuɗin Avana 19.305 USDC, don haka keeper yana karɓar 70.02 USDC.

Lada iri ɗaya tana aiki ga keepers da aka amince da su da kuma kowane adireshi da ke amfani da hanyar shiga ba tare da izini ba. Mai kiran da ya cike gibi daga kuɗinsa ana riƙe shi da iyakar kashe kuɗinsa da mafi ƙanƙantar biyansa. Ladar da token ya ƙi isarwa ana riƙe ta a escrow na biya don mai kiran ya karɓa.

Ƙimar da jinginar da aka ƙwace ke samarwa sama da ƙimarta ta oracle, misali saboda hanyar musanya ta biya fiye da farashin oracle, ta mai aro ce wanda jinginarsa ta samar da ita. LPVaultSwap yana aika ta zuwa wallet na mai aro a cikin ma'amala ɗaya.
rarar mai aro = max(0, S − G)

A misali ɗaya, musanya da ke mayar da 2,052 USDC maimakon 2,040.30 zai ba da rarar 101.025 USDC: kuɗin Avana yana nan 19.305, keeper yana karɓar 77.22 kuma mai aro 4.5 USDC. Mai aron kuma yana riƙe da sauran matsayin da dukkan kuɗaɗensa da aka raba.

Liquidation ba ta taɓa dogara da keeper ya sami riba. Avana yana gudanar da nasa keeper da aka amince da shi a kowace chain kuma yana yi wa kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1 liquidation, ko mene ne girmansa, yana biyan gas a matsayin kuɗin aiki daga kasafin keeper ɗinsa. Ana tsayar da kasafin tare da masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4 a yarjejeniyar keeper, kuma sa ido yana gargaɗi a 50% kuma yana kiran ma'aikata a 25% da ya rage.
Liquidation ɗaya ta rikodi guda tana amfani da kusan gas 1,550,000; ta asusu mafi girma (rikodi 16) aƙalla 5,150,000.

Kowace chain tana buƙatar aƙalla keeper ɗaya mai aiki. Har zuwa keepers 32 za a iya amincewa da su a kowace chain ta hanyar timelock, ciki har da keeper na jiran aiki a kan wani kayan more rayuwa daban.
Masu kira ba tare da izini ba suna biyan gas ɗinsu kuma ba sa karɓar maida kuɗi.

Avana Labs yana ɗaukar nauyin Coverage Spoke (Avana Umbrella) na kowane Hub da kadarar bashi, a waccan kadara, kafin kowace iyakar cirowa a kan biyun ta tashi sama da 0. Aave DAO ke sarrafa shi. Yana rufe gibin da aka rubuta cikin awanni 72 kuma shi ne kaɗai matakin asara na on-chain na Avana. Ana tsayar da rabon kariya da mafi ƙanƙantarsa a ARFC na kuɗi tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave.

Ƙimar da aka dawo da ita daga ƙwacewar da ba a sasanta ba ita ma tana zuwa Coverage Spoke, ba ga Avana ko mai kira ba: sasantawar da ke jira ba ta biyan mai kiranta komai, kuma ana riƙe juyawarta da matakin ƙasa bisa oracle, don haka babu wanda ke cin riba daga ƙwacewar da ba a sasanta ba.
Dukkan riba a kan layin lamuni tana zuwa ga mai ba da rancensa, Aave DAO ga GHO. Avana ba ya ɗaukar kaso daga ciki. Cikakkun bayanan kuɗaɗe suna cikin
Kuɗin dandamali

Vault tokens ba su da emissions kuma ba su da jadawalin fitarwa. Ana ƙirƙirar su ne kawai a kan raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige kuma ana ƙone su a cirewa, cirewa ta ɓangare, biyan bashi da jingina ko ƙwacewa.
Ba za a iya cinikin vault tokens ba: suna motsawa ne kawai tsakanin proxy da aka yi wa rajista, Hub da LPVaultSwap.
Babu kuɗi a kan ribar aro kuma babu kuɗin Avana a kan biyan bashi da jingina.
Babu kasafin sasantawa: mai kiran da ke buƙatar cike gibin zagayawa a sasantawa ta ƙarshe yana biyan sa ta ƙarin gibinsa.
Ladar keeper daga ribar oracle ta kowace liquidation, rarar mai aro, keepers na Avana kansa da kuɗin First-Loss Reserve, da riba ga masu ba da rance.

meta.title: Lend Spoke
meta.description: Spoke na Aave V4 na bayarwa kawai wanda ta cikinsa baitulmalin Aave DAO ke ba da kowane layin lamuni ga Avana Hubs, da yadda iyakokin cirowa ke raba kowane layi.

strings: Lend Spoke
Spoke na Aave V4 na bayarwa kawai wanda ta cikinsa baitulmalin Aave DAO ke ba da kowane layin lamuni ga Avana Hubs, da yadda iyakokin cirowa ke raba kowane layi.
Bayani
Layukan Lamuni
Girman Layuka
Iyakokin Cirowa
Tsarin Ɗaukar Nauyi
Riba
Janyewa da Haɓaka
Ajiyar Jama'a
Spoke na Aave V4 na bayarwa kawai, mallakar Aave DAO, wanda ta cikinsa baitulmalin DAO ke ba da kowane layin lamuni da masu aron Avana ke cirowa daga gare shi.

Kowace chain tana da Lend Spoke ɗaya. Daidaitaccen Spoke ne na Aave V4 mallakar Aave DAO, kuma yana bayarwa ne kawai: iyakar cirowarsa 0 ce a kowace kadarar Hub. Reserves ɗinsa suna nuni ga biyu-biyun Hub da kadara kuma za su iya jera kowace kadara. Mai ba da rancen kowane layi, GHO Reserve da Aave DAO ga GHO, yana ba da adadin layin ta cikinsa kai tsaye, kuma matsayin da ya biyo baya da ribarsa na waccan mai ba da rance ne.

CDP Spokes na Avana kaɗai ke da iyakokin cirowa a kan kadarar layin lamuni. Sauran Spokes da aka yi wa rajista a kanta (Lend Spoke, Coverage Spoke na waccan kadara da mai karɓar kuɗin kadarar) suna da iyakar cirowa 0.
Babu kwangilar Avana ko rawa da ke da iko a kan kowace supply cap, iyakar cirowa, ƙimar riba ko matsayin Lend Spoke. Waɗannan hukunce-hukuncen Aave DAO ne.

Layin lamuni iyakar cirowa ce ga kowane Hub, kadara da CDP Spoke. Supply cap na Lend Spoke a kan Hub da kadara daidai yake da layin, kuma iyakokin cirowa na kowane CDP Spoke da ke cirowa daga waccan biyun jimillarsu ba ta wuce layin ba.
LendSpoke.addCap(hub, asset) = creditLine(hub, asset)
Σ a kan CDP Spokes na drawCap(hub, asset, spoke) ≤ creditLine(hub, asset)
Da CDP Spoke ɗaya ga kowace chain da yarjejeniyar AMM a ƙaddamarwa, iyakar cirowa ta kowane Spoke a kan kadarar bashi ita ce dukkan layin waccan kadara a chain ɗin.
Girman layukan lamuni yana zuwa daga gudanarwar Aave. Avana yana gabatar da ƙimomi, kuma ARFC na kuɗi, wanda aka shirya tare da masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4, yana tsayar da na ƙarshe.
Chain
Layin GHO na ƙaddamarwa
Ethereum
Avana Stable LP Hub
2,000,000 GHO; ana tsayar da ƙimar ƙarshe a ARFC na kuɗi
Base
Ana tsayar da shi a ARFC na kuɗi, cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na GHO na Base Aave V3 Pool da zurfin hanyoyin musanya na Base
Sauran kadarorin bashi suna samun layukansu a lokacin jerinsu, ta hanyar aikin enable-debt-reserve, da zarar Aave DAO ya amince da layin lamuninsu, iyakoki, tushen farashi da hanyoyin musanya.

Iyakar cirowa ta kowane reserve na bashi ba ta wuce ruwan kuɗin flash na kadararsa a Aave V3 Pool na chain da zurfin hanyoyin musanyarta ba, wanda aka auna lokacin jeri, don haka kowane adadin da aka aro za a iya aron sa ta flash kuma a musanya shi baya a liquidation ɗaya.

Hub yana karɓar cirowa ne kawai idan bashin da Spoke ya ciro, premium, gibin da ba a rufe ba da sabon adadin sun dace ƙarƙashin iyakar cirowarsa. Ribar da ta taru da gibin da aka rubuta suna cin ƙarfi har sai an biya su ko an rufe su.
MarketRegistry na Avana yana bincika jimillar lokacin da aka kunna reserve na bashi da a kowane canjin iyaka, kuma binciken drift ma yana bincika su.
Sa ido yana faɗakarwa idan bashin da aka ciro a kan reserve, ciki har da riba da premium, ya kai 90% na iyakar cirowarsa. Aron waccan kadara kaɗai ne ke gazawa a iyakar.
Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jera ta.

A Ethereum da layin 2,000,000 GHO, supply cap na Lend Spoke shi ne 2,000,000 kuma CDP Spoke "Uniswap v3 Stable" yana da iyakar cirowa ta 2,000,000. Da GHO 1,900,000 da aka ciro, GHO 3,000 na premium da gibin da ba a rufe ba na GHO 475, aron GHO 100,000 zai kawo jimillar zuwa 2,003,475 kuma yana revert. Aro mafi girma da ke wucewa shi ne GHO 96,525.
Kafin kowace iyakar cirowa ta CDP Spoke a kan Hub da kadara ta tashi sama da 0, abubuwa biyu dole ne su tabbata:
Mai ba da rancen ya cika supply cap na Lend Spoke da cikakken layin, don haka babu bayarwa daga waje da ke dacewa ƙarƙashin iyakar.
Avana Labs ya ɗauki nauyin Coverage Spoke (Avana Umbrella) na waccan Hub da kadara har zuwa aƙalla mafi ƙanƙantarsa, kuma ma'auninsa ya cika rabon kariya.
fundedBalance × 10⁴ ≥ coverageRatioBps × Σ drawCap

Ana tsayar da rabon da mafi ƙanƙanta a ARFC na kuɗi tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave. A matsayin jagora na misali kawai, rabon 20% yana buƙatar GHO 400,000 na reserve da aka ɗauki nauyinsa ga iyakar cirowa ta GHO 2,000,000. Binciken yana gudana lokacin da aka kunna reserve na bashi, a kowane ɗaga iyakar cirowa da aka rubuta da a kowane aro.

Dukkan riba a kan layin lamuni tana zuwa ga mai ba da rancensa. Ga GHO, wannan shi ne Aave DAO. Mai karɓar kuɗin kowace kadarar bashi adireshin baitulmalin Aave DAO ne kuma DAO ne ke tsayar da kuɗin ruwan kuɗinsa. Avana ba ya cajin kuɗi a kan ribar aro a kowace kadara, kuma babu sigar kuɗin riba.

Ƙimar ribar GHO a kwance take: ba ta dogara da amfani ba. Aave DAO yana tsayar da ƙimar ribar tushe a daidai ko sama da ƙimar ribar tushe ta GHO ta Aave V4 Core Hub lokacin da kowace shawara ta aiwatar, kuma kowane mai aro yana biyan ƙarin ribar haɗarinsa a kai. Dabarar ƙimar riba ta kowace sauran kadarar bashi Aave DAO ne ke tsayar da ita a shawarar da ke jera ta. An bayyana yadda ake tsayar da ƙarin ribar a
Collateral Factor

Don janye layi, Aave DAO yana rage iyakokin cirowa na CDP Spoke a kan waccan Hub da kadara zuwa 0 kuma zai iya canza ƙimomin riba. Kadarar tana komawa ruwan kuɗin Hub yayin da masu aro ke biya ko ake yi musu liquidation, kuma Lend Spoke zai iya cire kuɗaɗen da ba a aro ba kaɗai. Babu tilasta biyan bashi, kuma biyan bashi, cirewa da liquidation suna ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe.

Ɗaga layi yana buƙatar shawarar Aave DAO a waccan chain da ke ɗaga supply cap na Lend Spoke da iyakokin cirowa na CDP Spoke tare, tana kiyaye kowace iyakar cirowa cikin ruwan kuɗin flash da zurfin hanya. Timelock na Avana ba shi da iko a kan ko ɗaya daga cikinsu. ARFC yana bayyana waɗannan matakai ga GHO:
Mataki
Ƙarfi
Sharuɗɗan faɗaɗawa
Ƙaddamarwa
2M GHO a Ethereum; ana tsayar da layin Base a ARFC na kuɗi
An cika buƙatun bincike da ƙaddamarwa, tare da samuwar oracle, ayyukan aro da aikin hanyoyin liquidation da aka ba da rahotonsu ga gudanarwa
Manufa ta farko
Buƙatar aro da aka nuna, tattarawa da kuɗin aiwatarwa masu karɓuwa, da shawara daga masu bitar haɗari
Faɗaɗawa
Ci gaba da aiki cikin iyakokin da aka amince da su, rahoton haɗari mai gamsarwa da ƙarin amincewar gudanarwa

Shawarar kuɗi tana bayyana lokutan aunawa da matakai na waɗannan sharuɗɗa, ikon daidaita ƙarfi, sharuɗɗan biyan bashi da rabon riba. A kowane mataki, iyakokin cirowa na kowace chain suna kasancewa cikin ruwan kuɗin flash ɗinta kuma rabon kariya yana tabbata.

Ba a bayar da ajiyar masu ba da rance na jama'a a ƙaddamarwa ba. Domin mai ba da rancen yana cika supply cap da dukkan layin kafin aro ya buɗe, babu bayarwa daga waje da ke dacewa ƙarƙashinta. Ƙira tana tallafa wa ba da rance na jama'a ta Lend Spoke kuma za a iya kunna shi daga baya ta gudanarwar Aave.
Yadda Aave DAO ke ba da kowane layin lamuni ta Lend Spoke na bayarwa kawai, yadda iyakokin cirowa na CDP Spoke ke raba shi, da yadda ake ɗaukar nauyin layuka, janye su da haɓaka su.

Avana yana aiki a kan daidaitattun Hubs da Spokes na Aave V4 marasa gyara waɗanda Aave DAO ke mallaka kuma yake saitawa. Kwangilolin Avana kansa suna sarrafa tsarewa, ƙimantawa da liquidation a kewayensu.

Kowane Hub, Spoke, AaveOracle da configurator da Avana ke amfani da shi Aave V4 ne mara gyara a sakin da aka ƙayyade, wanda Aave DAO ya tura kuma yake mallaka. Avana yana gabatar da saitinsu kuma yana bincika shi on-chain, amma ba shi da rawa a kansu kuma ba mai ba da rance ba ne. Kowace chain da Avana ke aiki a kai tana da rukuni ɗaya na kwangilolin ɓangaren Aave:
Kwangila
Adadi
Rawa

Yana riƙe da vault tokens na kasuwanninsa da ruwan kuɗin kadarar bashi na layukan lamuninsa

Yana jera kasuwanni da dama a matsayin reserves na jingina da reserves na bashi da aka amince da su

Coverage Spoke (Avana Umbrella)

Spoke na bayarwa kawai da ke riƙe da First-Loss Reserve wanda ke rufe gibin da aka rubuta
Mai karɓar kuɗin vault-token
Ɗaya ga kowace kadarar vault-token
Spoke na baitulmalin Aave da aka yi wa rajista da iyakoki sifili

Avana Hub yana riƙe da kadarar vault-token ɗaya kawai ga kowace kasuwa ta CDP Spokes ɗinsa da kowace kadarar layin lamuni da Lend Spoke ke ba shi. An tsara ruwan kuɗi zuwa matakan Hub uku domin matsayin LP masu daidaito, masu alaƙa da masu canjin farashi suna da haɗari daban-daban. Chain za ta iya ɗaukar kowane ɗaya daga cikin ukun.

Ƙaddamarwa, a Ethereum da a Base

Za a ƙara daga baya a kowace chain

Pools na manyan kadarorin DeFi da tokens na gudanarwa masu faɗin kewayo, ƙarƙashin tsauraran iyakokin fallasa

Kowane Hub yana da nasa yanayin dakatarwa na manhaja a MarketRegistry na Avana, kuma ana ƙirga iyakokin token da na mai ajiya ga kowane Hub a duk CDP Spokes da kasuwanninsa. Kasuwa ta Hub ɗaya ce har abada; Hub na gaba yana samun sababbin kasuwanni, kuma masu amfani suna motsawa ta hanyar biyan bashi, cirewa da sake jinginarwa.

CDP Spoke daidaitaccen Spoke ne ɗaya na Aave V4 ga kowace chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari, mai Hub na gida ɗaya daidai. Yana jera kasuwanni da dama. Kasuwa pool ɗaya ce mai ainihin kewayon matsayi ɗaya, kuma kowace kasuwa reserve ɗaya ne na vault-token na Spoke ɗinta wanda ba a iya aro. Spoke ɗin yana kuma jera reserves na bashi da aka rubuta masa, GHO da farko. Kowane asusu (PositionProxy ɗaya) yana riƙe da kasuwa ɗaya daidai, don haka kowace kasuwa tana da nata ma'aunin lafiya.

Matsayin Uniswap v3 daga canonical position manager, ainihin kewayon tick

Matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream da ba a stake ba, ainihin kewayon tick
Saiti

Saitin liquidation ɗaya ga kowane Spoke, wanda dukkan kasuwanninsa ke tarayya a ciki. Avana yana ba da shawarar ma'aunin lafiya na manufa na 1.10 da mafi ƙanƙantar karin liquidation na aƙalla 2%; Aave DAO yana yanke hukunci kan duka biyun a AIP na jeri. Kasuwar da ke buƙatar manufa ko lanƙwasar kari daban tana samun nata Spoke.

Ana jera reserve na GHO kafin kowane reserve na vault-token, don haka shi ne reserve 0. Sauran kadarorin bashi (USDC, USDT ko WETH) suna zama masu yiwuwar aro a Spoke ne kawai ta hanyar aikin enable-debt-reserve, da zarar Aave DAO ya amince da layin lamuninsu, iyakoki, tushen farashi da hanyoyin musanya.
Reserves na bashi ana iya aron su tare da Collateral Factor 0, kuma Spoke ba shi da supply cap a kansu, don haka bayarwar kadarar bashi daga waje ba za ta iya zama jingina ba.
AaveOracle na Spoke yana karanta LPOracle na kowace kasuwa, tushen tsayayyen $1 na Aave ga GHO, da DebtOracle ga kowace sauran kadarar bashi.
Aave DAO ne ke tsayar da iyakar reserve ga kowane asusu, kuma tana takaita yawan reserves na bashi da asusu ɗaya zai iya riƙewa.
Ba a amfani da nau'in Spoke na liquidation-manager: guda ɗaya da ake da shi yana ba da dama ga reserve ɗaya na jingina ga kowane Spoke, wanda ba zai iya riƙe kasuwanni da dama ba.
Ayyukan turawa

Avana yana ƙara CDP Spoke, kasuwa ko reserve na bashi ne kawai ta ayyukan AvanaTimelock guda uku a jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5, kowanne an haɗa shi da payload na Aave DAO na jeri ɗaya kuma kunnawa ta awanni 12 tana biyo baya wadda ke sake bincika saitin Aave na yanzu.
Aiki
Abin da yake yi
deployCdpSpoke

Yana yi wa daidaitaccen Spoke da AaveOracle ɗinsa rajista, waɗanda payload na Aave DAO ya ƙirƙira, ƙarƙashin Hub mai haɗin AMM ɗaya, bayan bincika saituna uku da ake buƙata da implementation na Spoke.
listCollateralMarket
Yana tura vault token da LPOracle na kasuwar, yana rubuta ainihin kewayon, yana haɗa LPVault na haɗin AMM kuma yana haɗa reserve na Spoke.
enableDebtReserve
Yana rubuta Hub da kadarar ɗaukar nauyi, yana bincika jimillar layukan lamuni, iyakokin ruwan kuɗin flash da zurfin hanya, kuɗin Coverage Spoke da hanyoyin musanya, kuma yana kunna aro.

Kowace chain tana da Lend Spoke ɗaya na bayarwa kawai, mallakar Aave DAO. Reserves ɗinsa suna nuni ga biyu-biyun Hub da kadara kuma za su iya jera kowace kadara. Baitulmalin DAO yana ba da kowane layin lamuni ta cikinsa, kuma supply cap ɗinsa a kan kowace biyu daidai yake da layin. Iyakar cirowarsa 0 ce a kowace kadara. Ba a bayar da ajiyar masu ba da rance na jama'a a ƙaddamarwa ba.
An bayyana girman layukan lamuni, janyewa da haɓaka a

Kowane Hub da kadarar bashi a kowace chain yana da Coverage Spoke ɗaya, Avana Umbrella na waccan biyun. Avana Umbrella shi ne tsarin tsaron yarjejeniya na Avana, wanda aka sanya wa suna bisa Umbrella na Aave, wanda ƙirarsa ta zama abin koyi gare shi. Spoke ne na bayarwa kawai mai iyakar cirowa 0, Aave DAO ke sarrafa shi kuma Avana Labs ke ɗaukar nauyinsa a kadararsa. Bayarwarsa ita ce First-Loss Reserve na waccan biyun.

Coverage Spokes ne kaɗai masu riƙe da rawar deficit-eliminator na Hub. Coverage Spoke yana ƙone hannayen jarinsa don rufe gibin da aka rubuta a kadararsa daga kowane CDP Spoke da ke cirowa waccan kadara daga waccan Hub. Ba a taɓa rufe gibi da reserve na wata kadara, Hub ko chain ba.

Ana ɗaukar nauyinsa kafin kowace iyakar cirowa a kan biyunsa ta tashi sama da 0, kuma dole ne ya riƙe aƙalla rabon kariya sau jimillar iyakokin cirowa a kan waccan biyun. Ana tsayar da rabon da mafi ƙanƙanta a ARFC na kuɗi tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave; 20% jagora ne na misali kawai.
Dakatarwar Hub ta CDP Spoke ba ta hana rufe gibin waccan Spoke.
fundedBalance × 10⁴ ≥ coverageRatioBps × Σ drawCap

Lokacin da Aave DAO ya ƙara vault token a matsayin kadarar Hub, Aave yana yi wa mai karɓar kuɗin kadarar rajista a matsayin Spoke na biyu a kanta mai supply cap marar iyaka. Payload na jeri yana tsayar da supply cap da iyakar cirowa na waccan mai karɓar kuɗi zuwa 0, kuma kadarar vault-token tana da kuɗin ruwan kuɗi na 0 da dabarar ƙimar riba mai inganci, don haka mai karɓar kuɗin ba ya taɓa riƙe vault tokens.

Don haka kowace kadarar vault-token tana da Spokes biyu daidai da aka yi wa rajista: CDP Spoke ɗinta, kaɗai mai iyakoki marasa sifili, da mai karɓar kuɗin. Duka biyun suna da iyakar cirowa 0, kuma hannayen jarin da aka ciro na kadarar 0 ne. Spoke na biyu mai iyakoki a kan kadarar zai iya cirowa vault tokens daga Hub kuma ya bar cirewa da ƙwacewa ba za su iya sasantuwa ba, don haka ana ɗaukar sa a matsayin drift.

Liquidation ta asusun Avana tana yiwuwa ne kawai ta LPVaultSwap, domin vault token yana karɓar jinginar da aka ƙwace zuwa LPVaultSwap kaɗai. AIP na jeri yana tsayar da ƙimomi uku a kowane reserve na vault-token waɗanda ke kiyaye wannan ƙa'idar canja wuri a matsayin ƙofa ɗaya tilo:
Saita

Hanyar da take rufewa

liquidationFee

Binciken drift

RiskModule yana kwatanta saitin Aave na yanzu da ƙimomin da girman Avana ke ɗauka a kowace jinginarwa ta sabon asusu, aro, cirewa tare da bashi da kunnawar kasuwa. Sa ido yana bincika ƙimomi iri ɗaya ba tare da tsayawa ba. Binciken sun haɗa da:
Saituna uku da ake buƙata, da cewa reserve na vault-token ba a iya aron sa.
Iyakar cirowa 0 ga kowane Spoke a kan kadarar vault-token, Spokes biyu daidai a kanta, kuma babu mai sarrafa sake saka jari a kowace kadarar Avana Hub.
Tushen farashin kowane reserve: LPOracle na kasuwar, tsayayyen tushen GHO, ko DebtOracle na kadarar.
Collateral Risk ƙasa da matakin ƙarin ribar haɗari na Spoke.
Implementation na CDP Spoke shi ne daidaitaccen Spoke da aka amince da shi, kuma reserves ɗinsa da ake iya aro daidai suke da reserves na bashi da Avana ya rubuta.
Collateral Factor bai wuce factor da Avana ke tsammani ba, iyakar kari tana tabbata, kuma ma'aunin lafiya na manufa daidai yake da ƙimar da aka rubuta.

Idan bincike ya gaza, jinginarwa ta sababbin asusu, aro da cirewa tare da bashi a kasuwar da abin ya shafa suna tsayawa. Ƙarin jingina ga asusun da ke da bashi, biyan bashi, karɓar kuɗaɗe, cirewa marar bashi da liquidation suna ci gaba, kuma sa ido yana ɗaga ƙararrawa. Canjin da Aave DAO ya yi wanda zai ba wani mai liquidation dama drift ne: tsarin aiki yana neman DAO ya mayar da shi.

Kowace kadara da ake iya aro tana zuwa daga layin lamuni mai iyaka da Aave DAO ya amince da shi. Layin lamuni iyakar cirowa ce ga kowane Hub, kadara da CDP Spoke. Ga kowace kadarar bashi a kowane Hub na ɗaukar nauyi:
LendSpoke.addCap(hub, asset) = creditLine(hub, asset); Σ drawCap(hub, asset, spoke) ≤ creditLine(hub, asset)

Iyakar cirowa ta kowane reserve na bashi ba ta wuce ruwan kuɗin flash na kadararsa a Aave V3 Pool na chain da zurfin hanyoyin musanyarta ba, wanda aka auna lokacin jeri, don haka kowane adadin da aka aro za a iya yi masa liquidation a ma'amala ɗaya.
CDP Spokes suna da supply cap 0 a kan kadarorin bashi; Lend Spoke da Coverage Spokes suna da iyakar cirowa 0.
Hub yana karɓar cirowa ne kawai idan bashin da aka ciro, premium, gibin da ba a rufe ba da sabon adadin sun dace ƙarƙashin iyakar cirowa, don haka riba da gibi suna cin ƙarfi.
Babu kwangilar Avana ko rawa da ke da iko a kan kowace iyakar Hub, ƙimar riba ko matsayin Lend Spoke. Ana ɗaga kowace iyaka ne kawai ta shawarar Aave DAO.
Sa ido yana faɗakarwa idan bashin da aka ciro a kan reserve, ciki har da ribar da ta taru da premium, ya kai 90% na iyakar cirowarsa.
Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jera ta.

A Ethereum, layin 2,000,000 GHO yana ba Lend Spoke supply cap na 2,000,000 kuma CDP Spoke guda ɗaya iyakar cirowa ta 2,000,000. Idan waccan Spoke yana da GHO 1,900,000 da aka ciro, GHO 3,000 na premium da gibin da ba a rufe ba na GHO 475, aron GHO 100,000 yana buƙatar 2,003,475 kuma yana revert. Aro mafi girma da ke wucewa shi ne GHO 96,525.

Kowane CDP Spoke yana da Hub na gida don jinginarsa, kuma kowane reserve na bashi yana rubuta Hub ɗinsa na ɗaukar nauyi. Reserve na bashi da Hub na gida na Spoke ɗinsa ke ɗaukar nauyinsa shi ne yanayin da aka saba. Layin lamuni tsakanin Hubs, inda Hub na ɗaukar nauyi ya bambanta da Hub na gida, an ƙayyade shi gaba ɗaya kuma a kashe yake a ƙaddamarwa a kowace chain. Yayin da yake a kashe, ana ƙin reserve na bashi wanda Hub ɗinsa na ɗaukar nauyi ba Hub na gida na Spoke ɗinsa ba ne.

Idan an kunna, Hub na ɗaukar nauyi ne ke mallakar iyakar: rajista ɗaya a MarketRegistry na chain tana tara kowace iyakar cirowa a kan waccan Hub da kadara, ko mene ne Hub na gida na Spoke da ke cirowa. Kowace iyakar cirowa ta waje tana da iyaka ta layinta tsakanin Hubs, jimillar layukan tsakanin Hubs ba ta wuce ma'aunin da aka ɗauki nauyinsa na Coverage Spoke na waccan biyun ba, dakatarwar Hub na ɗaukar nauyi tana hana kowane aro na layin, kuma layin da aka tsayar a 0 yana rufewa nan take yayin da bashin da ke akwai za a iya biyan sa ko a yi masa liquidation.
Kowane wanda ake kira yana karɓar kira ne kawai daga mai kiran da aka nuna. Wallets suna isa Aave ne kawai ta AaveAdapter, kuma liquidations suna isa Aave ne kawai ta LPVaultSwap.
Kwarara
Wane ne ke kiran wane
Jinginarwa

Wallet yana amincewa da LPVault ga matsayi ɗaya, sannan yana kiran AaveAdapter. AaveAdapter yana sa ProxyManager ya tura proxy a jinginarwa ta farko kuma yana yi masa rajista a vault token. Collateralization yana sa LPVault ya karɓi tsarewa, yana poke LPOracle kuma yana neman RiskModule ya bincika jinginarwar. AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar vault tokens zuwa proxy, wanda ke ba da su ga CDP Spoke; Spoke ɗin yana motsa su zuwa Hub.
Aro

Wallet yana kiran AaveAdapter. RiskModule yana gudanar da binciken aro kuma yana poke oracles. Proxy yana kiran aron Spoke; Hub na ɗaukar nauyi yana aika kadarar bashi zuwa proxy, wanda ke tura ta ga mai karɓa. Sannan RiskModule yana bincika ma'aunin lafiya.
Biyan bashi
Kowane mai biya yana kiran AaveAdapter, wanda ke motsa adadin zuwa proxy; proxy yana biyan Spoke kuma yana mayar da duk adadin da ba a yi amfani da shi ba ga mai biyan.
Cirewa
Wallet yana kiran AaveAdapter. Proxy yana cirewa daga Spoke, AaveAdapter yana ƙone vault tokens, kuma Collateralization yana sa LPVault ya mayar da matsayin ga mai ajiya na rikodi.
Karɓar kuɗaɗe
Mai ajiya yana kiran AaveAdapter, wanda ke kiran Collateralization, wanda ke sa LPVault ya karɓi kuɗaɗe zuwa ga mai ajiyar.
Farashi
Spoke yana karanta AaveOracle ɗinsa, wanda ke karanta LPOracle, tsayayyen tushen GHO ko DebtOracle. Kowa zai iya poke oracles.
Rufi

Keeper ko kowane adireshi yana kiran LPVaultSwap. LPVaultSwap yana aron kadarar bashi ta flash ta tushen flash, yana sa Collateralization ya ɗauki hoton asusun kuma yana kiran liquidation na Spoke. Hub yana aika vault tokens da aka ƙwace zuwa LPVaultSwap, AaveAdapter yana ƙone su, Collateralization yana cirewa daga rikodin kuma LPVault yana warware raka'o'in zuwa LPVaultSwap, wanda ke musanya ta hanyoyin musanya kuma yana biyan kuɗaɗe.
Ɗaukar nauyi da kariya
Baitulmalin DAO yana bayarwa ta Lend Spoke. Avana Labs ko LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar nauyin Coverage Spoke, wanda ke kawar da gibi a Hub ɗinsa.
Gudanarwa

Multisig na gudanarwa ko executor na gudanarwar Aave yana tsara aiki a AvanaTimelock; kowa yana aiwatarwa da zarar ya shirya. Guardians suna kiran MarketRegistry don dakatarwa, daskarewa, tayar da breaker da sauyawa zuwa standby.

Matsayin da aka jinginar yana zama a LPVault ɗinsa kaɗai. Vault tokens suna zama a Hub na gida na kasuwarsu kaɗai. Babu kwangilar Avana da ke riƙe da kadarar bashi tsakanin ma'amaloli sai escrow na biya, don biyan kuɗaɗen da token ya ƙi, kuma babu wanda ke riƙe da tokens na pool sai Collateralization, don ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira.
Hubs da Spokes na Aave V4 da Avana ke aiki a kai, saituna uku da ke sa LPVaultSwap ya zama mai liquidation ɗaya tilo, yadda ake iyakance layukan lamuni, da yadda kira da kadarori ke motsawa.

Kuɗin shiga ɗaya tilo na on-chain na Avana kaso ne na ribar kowace liquidation da aka bi ta hanyarsa, wanda ake biya a kadarar bashin da aka biya. Dukkan ribar aro tana zuwa ga masu ba da rance: ga layukan lamuni na GHO, Aave DAO. Avana Labs kuma yana samun kuɗin manhaja da manhajarsa ke caji a wajen kwangiloli.

Ana lissafa kason Avana daga ƙimar oracle ta raka'o'in da aka ƙwace, ba daga abin da musanyar mai kira suka mayar ba, kuma ba ya taɓa wuce rarar da aka samu:

V ita ce ƙimar oracle ta raka'o'in da aka ƙwace a kadarar bashi, D bashin da aka biya kuma φ premium na flash loan.
R′ shi ne adadin da warwarewa da musanya suka dawo da shi, tare da duk wani ƙarin gibi daga mai kira.
G ita ce ribar oracle, karin da Aave ya biya. S ita ce rarar da aka samu.

Domin ana auna kuɗin a kan ribar oracle, mai kiran da ya bi da musanyarsa ba daidai ba ko ya yi musu sandwich ba zai iya rage shi ba yayin da rarar ke rufe shi. Domin an iyakance shi a rarar, kuɗin ba ya taɓa sa liquidation ta revert, kuma ana biyan bashin da farko koyaushe.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jera ta.

Kasuwar Uniswap v3 USDC/USDT a Ethereum, farashin vault token $2.10. Bob ya aro USDC kuma ma'aunin lafiyarsa yana ƙasa da 1. Keeper na Avana yana yin liquidation da flash loan na 1,950 USDC a premium na 0.05%.

Da musanyar sun mayar da 2,027 USDC kawai, S zai zama 76.025 kuma kuɗin Avana zai ci gaba da zama 19.305.
Da musanyar sun mayar da 2,052 USDC, S zai zama 101.025: keeper zai karɓi 77.22 (96.525 − 19.305) kuma wallet na Bob 4.5 USDC.
A Base, kwararar iri ɗaya a misalin ARFC tana biyan 2,000 USDC tare da premium na 1 USDC kuma tana dawo da 2,038.50 USDC: kuɗin Avana 7.80 ne kuma keeper yana karɓar 29.70.
Riba: Avana ba ya cajin kuɗi a kan ribar aro a kowace kadara. Mai karɓar kuɗin kowace kadarar bashi adireshin baitulmalin Aave DAO ne.
Biyan bashi da jingina: mai aron da ya biya daga wani ɓangare na matsayinsa ba ya biyan karin liquidation ko kuɗin Avana. Yana biyan kuɗin musanya da flash premium kaɗai.
Sasantawar da ke jira: ƙimar da aka dawo da ita daga ƙwacewar da ba a sasanta ba tana zuwa ne kawai ga Coverage Spoke na reserve na bashin kasuwar, kuma mai kiran ba ya karɓar komai.
Kuɗaɗen LP: kuɗaɗen ciniki a kan matsayin da aka jinginar na mai ajiya na rikodi ne. Liquidation tana cire babban kuɗi kaɗai kuma ba ta taɓa ɗaukar kuɗaɗen da aka raba ba.
Jinginarwa, aro, biyan bashi, cirewa da karɓar kuɗaɗe ba su da kuɗin kwangilar Avana.
Avana Labs yana cajin kuɗin manhaja a manhajarsa, a wajen kwangiloli. Babu kwangilar da ke lissafa shi, riƙe shi ko tilasta shi. Mai aron da ke kiran kwangiloli kai tsaye ba ya biyan sa.

Avana Labs yana wallafa rahotannin amfani na mako-mako da rahotannin kuɗin shiga na wata-wata. Suna ɗauke da alkaluma ga kowace chain, bashi da jingina ta kasuwa, tattarawa, rarrabuwar ma'aunin lafiya, liquidations da suka yi nasara, suka gaza da aka sake gwadawa, amfani da Avana Umbrella, mummunan bashi, abubuwan da suka faru na oracle, dakatarwa, daskarewa, tayar da breaker da faɗakarwa, amfani da layin lamuni da kuɗaɗen da aka samu.

Avana yana samun 20% na ribar oracle ta kowace liquidation, wanda rarar da aka samu ta iyakance, tare da kuɗin manhaja a wajen kwangiloli. Riba tana zuwa ga masu ba da rance, kuma kuɗaɗen LP suna zama tare da mai ajiya.

Yadda Ask AI ke haɗa Aave MCP, RAG na Avana, da ƙididdigar samfura don bayyana kasuwanni da matsayin da LP ke tallafawa.

Aave bayanan tsarin, Avana ilimi, da lissafin matsayi a cikin ɗaya keɓaɓɓen haɗin gwiwar tattaunawa.

Ask AI ita ce hanyar tattaunawa ta Avana don tambayoyi game da kasuwanni da matsayi. Buƙata tana ambaton kasuwa, kadara, ko matsayin da za a bincika. Tambayoyin bibiya na iya fayyace bayanan shigarwa da zato. Amsar tana bayyana bayanan da ake da su. Binciken protocol ne har yanzu ke tantance ko ma'amalar da aka nema za ta iya ci gaba.
Avana yana tallafa wa aron GHO da sauran kadarorin bashi da aka kunna a kan matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base.

Tambayoyin da suka shafi walat sun dogara ne da walat da network da aka zaɓa. Bayanan kasuwa na jama'a suna bayyana kasuwar. Ragowar kuɗi da matsayi na wani asusu ne a kan wani network na musamman. Ragowar kuɗi, farashi, ko hanya da ta ɓace tana barin lissafin da ke da alaƙa da ita bai cika ba.

Ask AI yana amfani da Aave MCP tare da tsarin dawo da bayanai da aiwatar da samfur na Avana. Model Context Protocol yana ba da tsarin haɗin kai ga kayan aiki na waje. Uwar garken Aave yana bayyana bayanai na kasuwa v3 da v4, ciki har da ajiyoyi, ƙimar, samun kuɗi, da tsarin yarjejeniya. Wannan yana ba Ask AI mahallin Aave na musamman don tambayoyi waɗanda kuma ke da alaƙa da kasuwannin Avana ko matsayi. Duba
Aave don Wakilai
da
Aave MCP takardu

Bayanan Aave suna riƙe da mahallin cibiyar sadarwarsu, sigar yarjejeniya da reserve. Ba sa nuna cewa kadara tana samuwa a kasuwar Avana. CDP Spokes na Avana suna karɓar vault tokens ne kawai na matsayin Uniswap v3 da aka amince da su a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base a matsayin jingina, kuma suna ba da rancen GHO da kadarorin bashi da aka kunna ga kowane Spoke. Avana yana ci gaba da amfani da nasa jerin kasuwa, ƙimantawar LP da binciken asusu. Ƙarfin MCP server na sama ba aiki ne kai tsaye a Ask AI ba. Ayyukan da ake da su sun dogara da haɗin kan Avana da kwararar samfurin da ake tallafawa.

Tsarin samar da amsa mai taimakon nemo bayanai (RAG) na Avana yana bincika ilimin protocol na Avana don nemo bayanan da suka shafi tambaya. Yana samar da waɗannan bayanai a matsayin mahalli ga amsar. Sassan da aka nemo suna bayyana tsarin gine-gine, ƙa'idojin jingina, tsarin liquidation, da ayyukan samfur. Kowane sashe ya ƙunshi bayanan tushe, don haka ana iya bibiyar bayanin zuwa takardunsa. RAG yana samar da ilimin protocol, ba farashi kai tsaye ba. Ƙimar riba da ragowar kuɗi suna fitowa daga tushen bayanai da suka dace.

Bayanan matsayi da hanyoyin lissafi na Avana na kansa ne ke samar da mahallin da ya keɓanta ga samfur. Tambayar aro na iya haɗa bayanan kasuwar Aave, bayanan da aka nemo game da jinginar LP, da lissafin bashin GHO da ƙarfin aron matsayin da aka zaɓa. Kowane bayanin shigarwa yana da rawar daban. Sashen takardu yana bayyana ƙa'ida. Amsar kasuwa tana ba da rahoton yanayin da aka lura. Lissafin matsayi yana amfani da bayanan shigarwa da suka dace a kan asusu ko yanayi.

Kwatancen kasuwa na iya haɗawa da ƙimar ribar aro (BaseRate × (1 + UserRiskPremium)), kadarar bashi da ake da ita ga kowane CDP Spoke, da Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa. Ribar kuɗin da aka nuna shigarwa ɗaya ce kawai. Ribar bashi da canje-canje a matsayin LP suma suna shafar sakamakon. Masu aro suna ci gaba da ɗaukar impermanent loss, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation. Tushen shigarwa, lokuta da zato na yanayi suna ba da mahallin da ake buƙata don fassara kwatancen.

Bincike da aiwatar da ma'amala matakai ne daban-daban. Ga mataki da ake tallafawa, tsarin samfur da ya dace yana nuna asusu, network, kadarori, adadi, da kuɗaɗen kashewa don bita. Sannan yana neman duk wata amincewar walat da ake buƙata. Bayan gabatarwa, ana tabbatar da ma'amalar kuma matsayin yana sabuntawa. A cikin sandbox a app.avana.cc, sakamako na kwaikwayo ne kuma ba a gabatar da wata ma'amala onchain ba.

meta.description: Rubuta buƙatu da ke bayyana kasuwa, matsayi da sakamakon da ake so.

strings: Misalan buƙatu
Rubuta buƙatu da ke bayyana kasuwa, matsayi da sakamakon da ake so.
Yi takamaiman tambaya
Bincika yanayin misali
Cika bayanan da suka ɓace
Kwatanta farashin rance da yanayin kiwon lafiya don rancen 1,000 GHO akan matsayina na LP da aka zaɓa.

Wannan buƙatar tana gano aron da ake nufi kuma tana haɗa shi da matsayin jingina da aka zaɓa. Kadarar da adadin suna ayyana bashin da ake tantancewa. Matsayin yana samar da mahallin jingina. Neman zato da kuɗaɗen da aka haɗa yana sauƙaƙa bibiyar sakamakon zuwa bayanan shigarwarsa.
Me zai faru da ma'aunin lafiyar wannan matsayi idan darajar jinginarsa ta faɗi da 20% amma bashin bai canza ba?

Wannan yanayi yana canza ƙimar jingina kuma yana barin bashi a tsaye. Hakan yana keɓe tasirin ƙimar jingina a kan ma'aunin lafiya. Misali, GHO 25,000 da aka aro a kan matsayin $100,000 tare da Collateral Factor na 35% yana da ma'aunin lafiya na 1.40. Faɗuwar ƙimar jingina da 20% tana rage shi zuwa 1.12. Babban bashi ko wani kewayon LP daban wani yanayi ne daban mai bayanan shigarwa daban. Sakamakon yana misalta zaton da aka bayyana. Ba farashin aiwatarwa ba ne ko hasashen riba.
Wace cibiyar sadarwa da lokacin bayanai aka yi amfani da su a wannan ƙiyasi, kuma waɗanne kuɗaɗe aka cire?

Network, lokacin rikodi, da kuɗaɗen da aka haɗa suna tantance abin da ƙiyasi ke wakilta. Buƙatar bibiya na iya warware mahallin da ya ɓace kafin a yi amfani da sakamakon don shirya mataki. Sannan tsarin samfur da ya dace yana samar da sharuɗɗan ma'amala na yanzu don bita. Ƙiyasi a cikin sandbox a app.avana.cc suna amfani da kadarorin kwaikwayo.

strings: Tsarin aikin wakili
Bi buƙata daga mahallin farko zuwa dubawa da tabbatarwa.

Buƙata tana ƙayyade kadarar, network, adadin, da matsayin da ake la'akari da shi. Tana kuma bayyana ko mai amfani yana son bayani ko kwaikwayo, ko kuma yana son a shirya wani mataki. Dole ne a warware bayanan da suka ɓace ko marasa tabbas kafin a iya amfani da buƙatar a cikin tsarin aiwatarwa.

Buƙatar ce ke tantance mahallin da ake buƙata. RAG na Avana yana samar da bayanan protocol. Aave MCP yana samar da bayanan kasuwar Aave da suka dace. Hanyoyin lissafin samfur na Avana suna kula da lissafin matsayi. Ƙimar riba ta kasuwa tana canzawa, farashin da aka bayar (quotes) suna ƙarewa, kuma ragowar kuɗi sun bambanta tsakanin networks. Saboda haka asusun da aka zaɓa, lokutan rikodin tushe, bayanan shigarwa da suka ɓace, da zaton yanayi suna shafar yadda ake karanta sakamakon. Wannan ya fi muhimmanci lokacin da kuke kwatanta kwaikwayo da matsayi na gaske.

Ma'amala da ake tallafawa tana bi ta matakai uku: shiri, gabatarwa, da tabbatarwa. Tsarin samfur yana samar da bitar ma'amala da duk wata amincewar walat da ake buƙata. Bayan tabbatarwa, sabbin ragowar kuɗi da bashi suna nuna tasirin a kan matsayin. Sandbox a app.avana.cc yana nuna sakamakon kwaikwayo kuma ba ya yin ma'amaloli onchain.

Kowane wallet yana da PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa, don haka kowace kasuwa asusun Aave ne nata mai nasa ma'aunin lafiya kuma babu abin da aka haɗa jinginarsa. Aro yana tafiya wallet → AaveAdapter → proxy na wallet na waccan kasuwa → CDP Spoke. Proxy ba shi da logic kuma yana aiwatar da kiran Adapter kaɗai; kowane bincike yana cikin AaveAdapter da RiskModule.

Ana cirowa kadarar da aka aro daga Hub na ɗaukar nauyin reserve zuwa proxy, kuma proxy yana tura daidai wannan adadin ga mai karɓa a kira ɗaya. Aro ba ya canza vault token, rikodi ko ma'aunin iyaka. Babu kiran haɗa jinginarwa da aro, babu aro a rukuni kuma babu multicall: jinginarwa da aro kira ne daban-daban, kuma kowane aro yana ambaton reserve na bashi ɗaya kuma yana ɗauke da nasa nonce.

Avana ba ya tilasta matakin lafiya na buɗewa sama da 1.00 na Aave. Lens yana ba da shawarar aro har zuwa ma'aunin lafiya na 1.10 kuma yana nuna matsakaicin yarjejeniya a 1.00 a gefensa. Riba tana ɗaga bashi a hankali, don haka ma'aunin lafiya zai iya faɗuwa ko da ƙimar jingina ba ta canza ba.

Kowace kadara da CDP Spoke ya jera a matsayin reserve na bashi za a iya aron ta. Gudanarwa tana kunna reserve na bashi ga kowane CDP Spoke da enableDebtReserve ta Timelock na chain. Matsayin da aka jinginar yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗen ciniki ga mai ajiyarsa. Mai ajiyar yana karɓar su a kowane lokaci; ba sa taɓa zama jingina kuma ba a taɓa ƙwace su.

Yayin da LPVault ke riƙe da matsayin da aka jinginar, ruwan kuɗinsa yana nan a cikin pool kuma yana samun kuɗaɗen ciniki. Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream suna ajiye kuɗaɗe daban da ruwan kuɗin matsayin, a matsayin adadin da ake bi ga kowane token. Mai ajiya na rikodi yana karɓar su ta AaveAdapter, kuma pool yana biyan su kai tsaye zuwa wallet na mai ajiyar.

Kiran yana tafiya wallet → AaveAdapter → Collateralization → LPVault → position manager. Ba ya taɓa canza ruwan kuɗin matsayin, supply na vault-token, raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na rikodin, bashin asusun ko ma'aunin lafiyarsa. PositionProxy ba ya da hannu: kuɗaɗe ba sa taɓa wucewa ta asusun Aave.
collectFees(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, uint256 deadline) returns (uint256[] fees)
Mai ajiya na rikodi kaɗai ne zai iya kiran sa. Ba a buƙatar rawa.
Babu hujjar mai karɓa: kuɗaɗe koyaushe suna zuwa ga mai ajiya na rikodi, don haka babu mai kira ko Adapter mai kuskure da zai iya karkatar da su.
Yana mayar da adadi ɗaya ga kowane token na pool, a tsarin tokens na kasuwar; kowane adadi zai iya zama 0.

Ga Uniswap v3 da Slipstream, LPVault yana kiran collect na position manager tare da mai ajiyar a matsayin mai karɓa da matsakaicin adadin kowane token. Pool yana sabunta kuɗaɗen matsayin da farko, sannan yana biyan kowane adadin da ake bi; babu abin da ke zama a LPVault.
Kuɗaɗen matsayin Slipstream da ba a stake ba sun riga sun cire kason kuɗin unstaked na pool, wanda pool ke aika wa gauge. Avana ba ya ƙara ko cire komai.
Manhajar za ta iya kwaikwayon kiran don nuna adadin kafin mai ajiyar ya sa hannu.

Hanyar kuɗaɗe ba ta karanta yanayin dakatarwa ko dalili, circuit breaker, daskarar adireshi, yanayin farashi, ƙofar sequencer, RiskModule, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore, LPOracle, PositionProxy ko yanayin Aave. Babu ɗaya daga cikinsu da zai iya riƙe kuɗaɗen mai ajiya. Karɓa tana samuwa daga ƙarshen jinginarwa har sai an mayar da matsayin, ciki har da lokacin da rikodin ke da raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige 0 bayan cikakkiyar ƙwacewa.
Yayin katsewar sequencer na Base, mai ajiyar zai iya aika collectFees ta hanyar forced-inclusion ta L1 ta OP Stack; yana aiwatarwa idan an haɗa shi, domin hanyar kuɗaɗe ba ta karanta ƙofar sequencer.

Karɓar kuɗaɗe
Kuɗaɗe ba jingina ba ne. LPOracle yana ƙimanta raka'o'in ruwan kuɗi na matsayi kaɗai kuma ba ya taɓa ƙirga adadin da ake bin sa, don haka karɓar kuɗaɗe ba zai iya motsa ma'aunin lafiya ba.

Ba a taɓa ƙwace kuɗaɗe. Liquidation, daidaitawa a fita, cirewa ta ɓangare ko biyan bashi da jingina tana cire daidai raka'o'inta kuma tana biyan babban kuɗin da cirewar ta mayar kaɗai. Karɓa ba za ta iya gudana tsakanin cirewa da biyanta ba, domin duka biyun suna gudana ƙarƙashin makullin yarjejeniya ɗaya.

Babban kuɗin da ake bi a lokacin jinginarwa yana ci gaba da zama na mai ajiya. Idan an jinginar da matsayi da adadin da aka riga aka bi shi (kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba, ko babban kuɗin da aka cire a baya ba tare da collect ba), ba a ƙididdige waɗannan adadin ba, kuma collectFees yana biyan su ga mai ajiyar tare da kuɗaɗen baya.
Kuɗaɗen da ake bi lokacin da aka mayar da matsayi suna tafiya tare da NFT; sannan mai ajiyar yana karɓar su kai tsaye daga yarjejeniyar AMM.

Wasu yarjejeniyoyin AMM suna haɗa kuɗaɗe cikin matsayin maimakon ajiye su daban. Ga kasuwa a irin wannan yarjejeniya, collectFees yana revert da FeesRolledIn kafin kowane canjin yanayi. Kuɗaɗen suna nan a cikin matsayin: adadin raka'o'insa bai canza ba, kowace raka'a tana da ƙima fiye, composition na LPOracle yana ƙimanta hakan, kuma mai ajiyar yana karɓar kuɗaɗen tare da raka'o'in a cirewa. Duka yarjejeniyoyin AMM biyu da aka jera a ƙaddamarwa, Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream, suna ajiye kuɗaɗe daban.

Carol tana kiran removeLiquidity(3, (I, key1), 2,000,000,000, [1,990e6, 1,990e6], now + 600, 1.20e18).
Asusun yana da bashi, don haka binciken dakatarwa, daskarewa da na RiskModule kafin cirewa suna gudana: sequencer Up, oracles Live, babu breaker.
Proxy yana cire raka'o'i 2,000,000,000 daga Spoke kuma Adapter yana ƙone su.

Collateralization yana cire rikodi key1 zuwa raka'o'i 8,000,000,000 kuma yana sakin caji na $20,000 × 2 / 10 = $4,000. LPVault yana cire ruwan kuɗin kuma yana biyan Carol kusan 2,000 USDC da 2,000 USDT, kowanne aƙalla 1,990.
Rikodin da ya rage yana da ƙimar $16,000, sama da mafi ƙanƙanta na $10. Jingina yanzu $21,000 ce kuma wadda aka auna da CF $6,552, don haka HF = 6,552 / 4,999.50 = 1.3105, sama da 1.20.
Events: RecordReduced, UnitsReleased, CollateralReduced.
V yana hasashe da previewRepayWithCollateral(V, m_A, key31, 1,500,000,000, r_USDC): yana biyan 2,968.505747 USDC, yana mayar da 29.41 USDC ga V, kuma yana barin HF 1.5735.
V yana kiran repayWithCollateral da units 1,500,000,000, minAmounts [1,490e6, 1,490e6], minDebtRepaid 2,950e6 da minHealthFactor 1.30e18.

LPVaultSwap yana ƙimanta cikakkun tokens 1,500 a vector na farashin oracle: 1,500 USDC + 1,500 USDT = 3,000 USDC. Bayan izinin slippage na 100 bps da izinin zagayawa na 0.01 USDC wannan shi ne 2,969.99 USDC.
x = min(10,000, ⌊2,969.99 × 10^4 / 10,005⌋) = 2,968.505747 USDC. LPVaultSwap yana aron x ta flash ta tushen flash na chain; premium shi ne ⌈x × 5 / 10^4⌉ = 1.484253 USDC.
Proxy yana biyan 2,968.505747 USDC: bashin yana faɗuwa zuwa 7,031.494253 USDC kafin kowace jingina ta fita.
Proxy yana cire raka'o'in, Adapter yana ƙone su, kuma LPVault yana warware 1,500 USDC + 1,500 USDT zuwa LPVaultSwap.
Ƙafar USDT tana musanya zuwa 1,499.40 USDC (mafi ƙanƙanta 1,485). 2,999.40 USDC da aka dawo da su suna rufe rancen da premium; 29.41 USDC suna zuwa ga V.
Binciken lafiya: 11,064 / 7,031.494253 = 1.5735, aƙalla max(1.20, 1.30). Events: Deleveraged, RepaidWithCollateral.

Karɓar kuɗaɗe
Sa ido kan rance a buɗe da canza jinginarsa: ƙara jingina, sake ƙididdige ruwan kuɗin da ka ƙara, cire wani ɓangare na matsayi, ko biyan bashi da jinginarka.

Asusu PositionProxy ɗaya ne na wallet ɗaya da kasuwa, mai ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya. Ma'aunin lafiyarsa yana canzawa idan farashin LPOracle na vault token na kasuwar ya motsa, idan farashin bashi ya motsa, da yayin da riba ke taruwa. Ƙasa da 1.00, za a iya yi wa asusun liquidation.

Don ɗaga ma'aunin lafiya, mai aro zai iya biyan kowane adadi, jinginar da wani matsayi a matsayin ƙarin jingina, sake ƙididdige ruwan kuɗin da aka ƙara wa matsayin da aka jinginar, ko biyan bashi da jingina. Don fitar da jingina yayin da bashi ke nan, mai aro zai iya cire dukkan rikodi ko cire wani ɓangarensa, muddin asusun ya kasance sama da matakin lafiya.

Ma'aunin lafiya 1.10 jagora ne, ba iyaka ba: Lens yana ba da shawarar aro har zuwa 1.10, kuma asusun da ke da bashi ƙasa da 1.10 zai iya amfani da ƙarin jingina na ceto. Liquidation tana farawa ƙasa da 1.00.

Lens kwangila ce ta karantawa kawai, ɗaya ga kowace chain, don manhajoji, keepers da sa ido. Views ɗinsa ba sa taɓa revert a kan yanayin farashi; suna revert ne kawai yayin da kiran Avana ke gudana a cikin ma'amala ɗaya.

LPOracle na kowace kasuwa yana ba da rahoton yanayin farashi, kuma DebtOracle na kowane reserve na bashi da ba GHO ba yana ba da rahoton nasa. Yanayin yana yanke hukuncin waɗanne ayyuka za su iya gudana. Ƙimomin misali: feed na stablecoin na awanni 24 sabo ne na daƙiƙoƙi 88,200, tagar cached awa 1 ce kuma tagar alheri mintuna 30 ce.
