Ƙarin jingina jinginarwa ce zuwa asusun da ke da bashi. Yana amfani da kiran jinginarwa ɗaya da na ajiya ta farko da ƙa'idojin matsayi iri ɗaya (ainihin kewayo, aƙalla rikodi 16). Domin ƙarin jingina yana rage haɗari kawai, ƙarin jingina yana wucewa Hub da ke Frozen, katsewar sequencer na Base ko tagar alheri, da drift na saitin Aave.
Ma'aunin lafiya na ceto da yanki

Ma'aunin lafiya na ceto shi ne 1.10. Yayin da asusun da ke da bashi ke ƙasa da shi, ƙarin jingina zai iya rubuta cajinsa daga yankin ƙarin jingina na kasuwar (10% na iyakar kasuwa) idan kasafin na yau da kullum ya cika, amma har zuwa ƙimar USD da ke dawo da asusun zuwa 1.10 kawai. Ƙarin jingina na ceto ƙarin jingina ne ƙasa da 1.10 wanda cajinsa bai wuce wannan adadin maidowa ba kuma ƙimarsa aƙalla ƙaramin cikin minPledgeUsd da $10. Ita ce jinginarwa ɗaya tilo da ake karɓa ƙarƙashin Paused da dalili General, daga wallet da aka daskarar, ƙarƙashin breaker na kasuwa na ceto kawai, sama da iyakar kason pool ko ƙasa da minPledgeUsd.
Raka'o'in ceto

Raka'o'in da aka karɓa ta yankin ko keɓewar ceto raka'o'in ceto ne. Aave yana ƙirga su a matsayin jingina, don haka suna kare asusun daga liquidation, amma ana ƙirga su a sifili don sabon aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi: waɗannan binciken suna amfani da ma'aunin lafiya tare da raka'o'in ceto da aka ƙimanta a sifili.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Asusu yana bin GHO 15,000 a kan jingina ta $50,000 a Collateral Factor na 31.20%, don haka HF ɗinsa 1.04 ne. Kasafin na yau da kullum ya cika. Ƙarin jingina na $2,000 yana rubutawa daga yankin (adadin maidowa $2,884.62 ne), dukkan raka'o'insa raka'o'in ceto ne, kuma HF ya zama 1.0816. Ƙarƙashin Paused da dalili General, ƙarin jingina na ceto na $800 (adadin maidowa $884.62) yana ɗaga HF zuwa 1.0982, yayin da jinginarwa ta $1,000 ke revert da NotRescueTopUp.
An jera kowane bincike da jinginarwa ke gudanarwa a
Ajiye LP

Ruwan kuɗin da aka ƙara wa NFT da aka jinginar da increaseLiquidity na yarjejeniyar AMM ba jingina ba ne har sai mai ajiya na rikodi ya kira recredit. Raka'o'in da aka ƙara suna gudanar da kowane bincike na ƙarin jingina na wannan girma, Adapter yana ƙirƙira kuma yana bayar da daidai waɗannan raka'o'in, kuma ana sake tsara tushen cajin rikodin. Asusun da ke da rikodi 16 yana ƙara jingina ta wannan hanya.
recredit(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, bytes topUp, uint256 deadline) returns (uint128 added)
Ga matsayin NFT, hujjar topUp babu komai a ciki. Karanta raka'o'in, cajin da ko ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai ne zai iya rubuta su da previewRecredit kafin kira.

removeLiquidity yana fitar da wani ɓangare na raka'o'in rikodi ɗaya daga pool kuma yana biyan tokens ga mai ajiya na rikodi. Matsayin yana ci gaba da kasancewa a jingine tare da sauran raka'o'insa da kuɗaɗensa da ba a karɓa ba.
removeLiquidity(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, uint128 units, uint256[] minAmounts, uint256 deadline, uint256 minHealthFactor) returns (uint256[] amounts)
Raka'o'in dole ne su wuce 0 kuma su kasance ƙasa da raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na rikodin; cire kowace raka'a cirewa ce.
Mafi ƙanƙantar adadin suna riƙe da shigarwa ɗaya ga kowane token na pool, a tsarin tokens na kasuwar; kowane token da aka biya dole ne ya kasance aƙalla mafi ƙanƙantarsa.
Babban kuɗin raka'o'in da aka cire kaɗai ake biya. Ana ci gaba da bin matsayin kuɗaɗen kuma ana karɓar su daban.
Ba tare da bashi ba, kiran ba ya karanta yanayin dakatarwa, daskarewa, breaker, ƙofar sequencer ko farashi, kuma ana ba da dama ga kowane saura.

Tare da bashi, yana gudanar da binciken cirewa tare da bashi: Hub da ke Paused yana ƙin sa, wallet da aka daskarar ba zai iya yin sa ba, binciken RiskModule na farko suna aiki (sequencer, farashi Live, tushe na biyu, keepers, drift, breakers), rikodin da aka bari dole ne ya kasance da ƙimar aƙalla minPledgeUsd, kuma ma'aunin lafiya ba tare da raka'o'in ceto ba bayan kiran dole ne ya kasance aƙalla mafi girma cikin 1.00, minHealthFactor da matakin ƙasa mai tsauri.
Gazawa:
PartialRemovalTooLarge
ga raka'o'i a daidai ko sama da raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige,
AmountBelowMinimum
idan token ya faɗi ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantarsa,
RecordBelowMinPledge
idan rikodin da ya rage yana da ƙima ƙasa da minPledgeUsd, da
HealthFactorTooLow

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Carol tana riƙe da rikodi key1 (raka'o'i 10,000,000,000, $20,000) da ƙarin jingina keyB (raka'o'i 2,500,000,000, $5,000) a kasuwa ta 3 a Base: jingina $25,000, wadda aka auna da CF $7,800, bashi 5,000 USDC wanda aka ƙimanta a $4,999.50, HF 1.5602. Tana cire cikakkun tokens 2,000 daga key1 kuma tana barin NFT a jingine.

repayWithCollateral yana biyan reserve na bashi ɗaya da ruwan kuɗi daga ɗaya daga cikin matsayin mai kiran da aka jinginar, a kira ɗaya. LPVaultSwap yana aron kadarar bashi ta flash ta tushen flash na chain, proxy yana biya, ana cire raka'o'in kuma a ƙone su, LPVault yana warware su, LPVaultSwap yana musanya kowane token da ba kadarar bashi ba a farashin da oracle ya iyakance, yana biyan flash loan da premium ɗinsa, kuma yana aika sauran ga mai kiran a kadarar bashi.
repayWithCollateral(RepayWithCollateralParams p) returns (uint256 debtRepaid, uint256 debtAssetToWallet)

Sigogin su ne kasuwa, matsayi, raka'o'in da za a saki, reserve na bashi, mafi ƙanƙantar adadi ga kowane token na pool don warwarewa, mafi ƙanƙantar biyan bashi da ake karɓa, ƙarshen lokaci da mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiya bayan kiran yayin da bashi ke nan. Ba a buƙatar amincewa da kadarar bashi.
Babu karin liquidation, babu kuɗin Avana a cikin kwangiloli kuma babu cirowa daga kasafin yarjejeniya. Mai aro yana biyan flash premium da kuɗin musanya.

Farashin oracle ne ke tsayar da girman biyan bashi: x = min(debt, ⌊Vnet × 10^4 / (10^4 + maxFlashFeeBps)⌋), inda Vnet ita ce ƙimar oracle ta raka'o'in a kadarar bashi ban da izinin slippage na kasuwar (100 bps a ƙaddamarwa) da izinin zagayawa. Cinikin pool ba zai iya canza shi ba; sandwich zai iya sa musanya kawai ta gaza mafi ƙanƙantarta.

Flash premium dole ne ya cika premium × 10^4 ≤ maxFlashFeeBps × x. maxFlashFeeBps shi ne 10 a ƙaddamarwa; Aave V3 Pool yana cajin 5 bps, da 0 da zarar tushen flash na Avana ya riƙe rawar FLASH_BORROWER.
Bashin yana faɗuwa kafin kowace jingina ta fita. Yayin da bashi ke nan, ma'aunin lafiya na Aave bayan kiran dole ne ya kasance aƙalla mafi girma cikin ƙimarsa kafin kiran da minHealthFactor.

Yana gudana ƙarƙashin Hub da ke Frozen, ƙarƙashin Paused da dalili General, ga wallet da aka daskarar da ƙarƙashin kowane circuit breaker, domin yana rage bashi kaɗai. Ana ƙin sa ƙarƙashin Paused da dalili MintPathSuspect, yayin da kasuwar ko reserve da aka biya ke Cached ko Expired, da yayin da sequencer na Base ba ya aiki. Idan tushen flash bai isa ba ko an dakatar da shi, biya da kuɗi maimakon haka.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. A Ethereum, wallet V yana bin 10,000 USDC tare da jinginar da aka auna da CF ta $12,000 (HF 1.20). Rikodi #31 matsayin Uniswap v3 USDC/USDT ne a $2.00 ga kowane cikakken token. Farashin USDC $1.0000 ne kuma flash premium 5 bps ne.
Da mafi ƙanƙantar biyan bashi na 3,000 USDC, kira ɗaya yana revert da DeleverageTooSmall(2,968,505,747, 3,000,000,000). Da flash premium sifili, x shi ne 2,969.99 USDC.

Emergency Guardian ko timelock ne ke tsayar da yanayin dakatarwa ga kowane Hub. Frozen yana dakatar da sababbin asusu da sabon aro; Paused yana dakatar da fiye da haka. Circuit breakers suna dakatar da sabon fallasa kaɗai. Biyan bashi, fita marasa bashi, karɓar kuɗaɗe da liquidations masu cancanta suna ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe a kowane yanayi da ke ƙasa.

Misali da Aka Warware
Matsayi daga canonical position manager na Uniswap v3 a pool da aka jera, tare da ticks daidai da kewayon kasuwar.
Aerodrome Slipstream

Matsayin da ba a stake ba kaɗai, daga ƙarni na position manager da kasuwar ta ƙayyade. IDs na token suna maimaituwa tsakanin position managers na Slipstream, don haka key yana ɗauke da ƙarnin a babban byte ɗinsa.
Jinginarwa ta sabon asusu
Wallet ba shi da proxy ga kasuwar tukuna, ko proxy ɗinsa yana da bashin sifili a kowane reserve na bashi. Wannan ya haɗa da jinginarwa ta farko da ƙarin jingina ga asusu marar bashi.

Ana ƙin sa yayin da Hub ke Frozen, yayin da ƙofar sequencer ke Down ko a Grace, da yayin da saitin Aave ya yi drift. Yana buƙatar farashi Live (ko Drifting da keta ƙungiyar USD kaɗai ta haifar) da sarari a kasafin Regular na kasuwar.
Proxy yana da bashi marar sifili a aƙalla reserve na bashi ɗaya.

Ana ba da dama yayin da Hub ke Frozen, yayin katsewar sequencer ko tagar alheri, da yayin drift na saitin Aave, domin ƙarin jingina yana rage haɗari kaɗai. Yana buƙatar farashi Live ko Drifting. Yayin da ma'aunin lafiya na asusun ke ƙasa da 1.10 zai iya amfani da yankin ƙarin jingina.
Ƙarin jingina na ceto
Ƙarin jingina zuwa asusun da ma'aunin lafiyarsa ke ƙasa da manufar ceto ta 1.10, wanda cajinsa bai wuce USD da ke dawo da 1.10 ba, kuma ƙimarsa aƙalla ƙaramin cikin minPledgeUsd da $10.

Jinginarwa ɗaya tilo da ake karɓa ƙarƙashin Paused da dalili General, daga wallet da aka daskarar, yayin da breaker na kasuwa na ceto kawai ya tashi, sama da iyakar kason pool, ko ƙasa da minPledgeUsd. Dukkan raka'o'insa raka'o'in ceto ne, waɗanda ba sa taɓa tallafa wa sabon bashi.
Yanayin kasuwa
Kasuwar Active ce a MarketRegistry, ba Offboarding ko Closed ba.
MarketNotActive / MarketOffboarding

Jinginarwa ta sabon asusu tana buƙatar Live, ko Drifting da keta ƙungiyar USD kaɗai ta haifar. Ƙarin jingina yana buƙatar Live ko Drifting. Ana ƙin Cached da Expired. Kowane feed sabo ne yayin da shekarunsa ba su wuce heartbeat ɗinsa tare da daƙiƙoƙi 1,800 ba (daƙiƙoƙi 88,200 ga feed na stablecoin na awanni 24).
Ƙofar sequencer (Base)
Ana ƙin jinginarwa ta sabon asusu yayin da sequencer na Base ba ya aiki da kuma na daƙiƙoƙi 3,600 bayan ya sake farawa. Ƙarin jingina ba ya shafuwa. Ƙofar Ethereum koyaushe Up ce.
SequencerDown / SequencerGrace
Mafi ƙanƙantar ƙima

Ƙimar jinginarwar a farashin LPOracle da aka bayar, an zagaye ƙasa, aƙalla minPledgeUsd ce ($10 ga kowace kasuwa a ƙaddamarwa). Ƙarin jingina na ceto yana buƙatar aƙalla ƙaramin cikin minPledgeUsd da $10.

Ɓangaren yau da kullum na cajin ya dace da kasafin Regular na kasuwar, wanda marketUsdCap ya iyakance. Ana ƙimanta cajin a farashin da bai gaza stressFloorUsd ba ($1.00 ga kowane cikakken vault token), an zagaye sama.
Iyakokin token da na mai ajiya
Ɓangaren yau da kullum ya dace da tokenUsdCap ga kowane token na pool da depositorUsdCap ga wallet. Ana ƙirga duka iyakokin biyu sau ɗaya ga kowane Hub a duk CDP Spoke da kasuwa.
Yankin ƙarin jingina

Jinginarwa ta sabon asusu dole ne ta dace da kasafin Regular. Ƙarin jingina zai iya rubuta wani ɓangare na cajinsa daga topUpSliceUsd (10% na marketUsdCap) ne kawai yayin da ma'aunin lafiya na asusun ke ƙasa da 1.10, kuma har zuwa USD da ke dawo da 1.10 kawai. Raka'o'in da aka rubuta ta wannan hanya raka'o'in ceto ne.

Jimillar ruwan kuɗin da aka ƙididdige na Avana a cikin pool, a duk masu aro, Spokes da kasuwanni a chain, yana kasancewa a daidai ko ƙasa da poolShareMaxBps na ruwan kuɗin pool da aka auna da lokaci. Asalin chain shi ne 10,000 bps (babu iyaka); iyakar kowane pool tana aiki ne kawai inda jeri ya tsayar da ita. Ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai ne zai iya wuce ta.
PoolShareExceeded / PoolShareUnavailable
Iyakar rikodi
Asusu yana riƙe da ba fiye da rikodi 16 ba a buɗe ga kowace kasuwa, don haka liquidation ta kowane asusu tana bin ba fiye da rikodi 16 ba. Asusun da ke da rikodi 16 yana ƙara jingina da recredit.

Reserve na vault-token ba a dakatar ko daskarar da shi ba, shigarwar Hub na gida ta Spoke tana aiki kuma ba a tsayar da ita ba, addCap na Hub yana da sarari ga raka'o'in, kuma ba a kai iyakar reserve ta kowane mai amfani ba. Ga sabon asusu, babu reserve na bashi da aka amince da shi da aka dakatar.
AaveReserveUnavailable / HubSpokeUnavailable / HubAddCapReached / UserReservesLimit / DebtReservePaused
Drift na saiti (sababbin asusu)

Saitin Aave ya yi daidai da abin da Avana ke tsammani, ciki har da saitunan daidaitaccen Spoke, kuma hannayen jarin Hub daidai suke da kadarori ga vault token. Drift ba ya taɓa dakatar da ƙarin jingina ko ƙarin jingina na ceto.

Dakatarwa, daskarewa da breakers

Paused da dalili MintPathSuspect yana ƙin kowace jinginarwa. Frozen yana ƙin jinginarwa ta sababbin asusu. Paused da dalili General, wallet da aka daskarar, ko breaker na kasuwa na ceto kawai da ya tashi suna karɓar ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai.

Ajiye LP

Jinginar da matsayin AMM mai ainihin kewayo cikin LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗinsa kuma yi amfani da shi a matsayin jingina a CDP Spoke na kasuwarsa. Ruwan kuɗin yana nan a cikin pool kuma yana ci gaba da samun maka kuɗaɗe.

Jinginarwa tana motsa tsarewar matsayin AMM ɗaya zuwa LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗinsa a chain. Ruwan kuɗin yana nan a cikin pool kuma yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗen ciniki ga mai ajiya. A ma'amala ɗaya, Collateralization yana rubuta raka'o'in matsayin a matsayin tallafi, AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar daidai wannan adadin raka'o'in vault-token zuwa PositionProxy na wallet, kuma proxy yana ba da su ga CDP Spoke na kasuwar kuma yana kunna su a matsayin jingina. Jinginarwa ba ta ƙirƙirar bashi; aro kira ne daban.

Kasuwa chain ɗaya ce, yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya, pool ɗaya da ainihin kewayon tick ɗaya. Kowace kasuwa reserve ɗaya ne na jingina a CDP Spoke ɗaya. AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane wallet da kasuwa a jinginarwa ta farko kuma yana sake amfani da shi daga baya, don haka kowace kasuwa asusun Aave ne nata mai nasa ma'aunin lafiya. Babu abin da aka haɗa jinginarsa: wallet da ke amfani da kasuwanni biyu yana da proxies biyu da ma'aunan lafiya biyu.

Kowane wallet da ya mallaki matsayin zai iya jinginar da shi, ciki har da Safe ko wani wallet na smart-contract. Babu binciken EOA kawai. Operator da aka amince da shi ba zai iya jinginarwa a madadin mai shi ba, domin LPVault yana ɗaukar matsayin ne kawai daga wallet da ke kira.
An jera yarjejeniyoyin AMM biyu a ƙaddamarwa, ɗaya ga kowace chain. Ana ambaton matsayi da ID na haɗin kai na kasuwar tare da position key.
Chain
Position key
Bayanai
Ainihin kewayo

Ticks na ƙasa da na sama na matsayin dole ne su yi daidai da kewayon kasuwar sosai. Kunkuntar kewayo yana riƙe da ƙasa sosai na kowane token ga kowace raka'ar ruwan kuɗi, don haka ƙididdige shi a ƙimar kowace raka'a ta kasuwar zai ƙara masa ƙima fiye da kima. Misali, matsayi na $10,000 a kewayon [−10, 10] a kasuwar USDC/USDT wadda kewayonta [−887,272, 887,272] ne yana da kusan sau 2,000 na raka'o'in ruwan kuɗi ga kowace dala, kuma za a ƙimanta shi a kusan $20,006,000. LPVault yana kwatanta ticks daidai kuma yana ƙin sa, kuma NFT yana zama tare da mai shi.
Ba a karɓa ba
Matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream da aka stake a gauge. Gauge ne ke mallakar NFT da aka stake, don haka mai stake ba zai iya jinginar da shi ba; cire stake ɗinsa da farko.
Matsayi a wani pool na biyu-biyun token iri ɗaya, ko a kowane kewayo ban da ainihin kewayon kasuwar.
Matsayi daga kowace kwangilar matsayi daban, ciki har da forks na Uniswap v3 ko Slipstream, da daga ƙarnonin position manager da kasuwar ba ta ƙayyade ba.
Pools da tokens ɗinsu ke cajin kuɗi a canja wuri, rebase, ko gudanar da transfer hooks. Jeri yana ware waɗannan tokens.
Matsayi marasa ruwan kuɗi.

Kafin jinginarwa, wallet yana amincewa da LPVault na kasuwar ga daidai wannan matsayi: approve na kowane token (ko permit) a position manager don waccan token ID. Manhajar ba ta taɓa neman amincewa da dukkan NFTs ba. LPVault ba ya canzawa, yana motsa matsayi ne kawai bisa umarnin Collateralization, kuma yana rubuta wallet da ke kira a matsayin mai ajiya, don haka matsayin zai iya komawa ga waccan wallet kaɗai.

LPVault yana jawo NFT da canja wuri na yau da kullum, ba tare da receiver hook ba, don haka wallets marasa ERC-721 receiver hook (kamar Safe) suna aiki. Ba a buƙatar amincewar vault-token, kadarar bashi ko wani ERC-20 don jinginarwa.
pledge(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, uint256 deadline) returns (address proxy, uint256 recordId, uint128 credited)

Nunin matsayi yana riƙe da ID na haɗin kai na kasuwar da position key. Ƙarshen lokaci shi ne timestamp na ƙarshe na block mai inganci, a daƙiƙoƙi a duka chains biyu: daƙiƙoƙi 600 blocks 50 ne na Ethereum ko blocks 300 na Base. Babu hujjar adadi, proxy ko mai karɓa. Ana warware proxy daga mai kira da kasuwar, ana karanta raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige daga haɗin AMM bayan tsarewa, kuma mai ajiya na rikodi shi ne mai kiran, don haka babu hujjar da za ta iya ƙara tallafi fiye da kima.
A tsari, kiran:
yana ɗaukar makullin yarjejeniya kuma yana bincika ƙarshen lokaci, kasuwar, ID na haɗin kai da yanayin dakatarwar Hub na gida;
a jinginarwa ta farko ta wallet a kasuwar, yana tura PositionProxy ɗinsa a adireshin da ProxyManager ya hasashe kuma yana yi masa rajista a vault token na kasuwar;
yana amfani da ƙofar Frozen kuma yana yanke hukunci ko ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai ne zai iya wucewa;
yana sa Collateralization ya nemi LPVault ya karɓi tsarewa, ya bincika pool da ainihin kewayo, kuma ya karanta ruwan kuɗin matsayin a matsayin raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige;
yana poke LPOracle na kasuwar kuma yana gudanar da binciken jinginarwa na RiskModule;
yana rubuta rikodin kuma yana rubuta cajinsa na USD;
yana ƙirƙirar daidai raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige zuwa proxy, yana ba da su ga CDP Spoke kuma yana kunna su a matsayin jingina;
yana bincika cewa proxy ba ya riƙe da ragowar tokens ko allowance kuma gibin tallafin kasuwar bai canza ba, sannan yana sakin makullin.
Duk wata gazawa tana revert dukkan ma'amalar: matsayin yana zama tare da wallet, kuma babu rikodi, ƙirƙira, bayarwa ko turawar proxy da ke ci gaba da kasancewa.
Dukkan nau'o'in jinginarwa uku suna amfani da hanyar shiga ɗaya. RiskModule yana rarraba jinginarwar daga adadin aron Aave na asusun a lokacin kiran.
Nau'i
Lokacin da yake aiki
Ƙa'idoji

Ma'aunin lafiya na manufar ceto na 1.10 shi ne matakin da Lens ke ba da shawarar aro har zuwa gare shi. Ba matakin ƙasa na buɗewa ba ne: Avana ba ya tilasta ma'aunin lafiya sama da 1.00 na Aave lokacin da kake aro. Paused da dalili MintPathSuspect yana ƙin kowace jinginarwa, har da ƙarin jingina na ceto, domin kowace jinginarwa tana ƙirƙirar vault tokens.

Kowa zai iya ƙara ruwan kuɗi ga matsayin Uniswap v3 ko Slipstream da aka jinginar da increaseLiquidity na yarjejeniyar AMM. Ruwan kuɗin da aka ƙara yana zama tare da matsayin amma ba jingina ba ne har sai mai ajiya na rikodi ya sake ƙididdige shi:
recredit(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, bytes topUp, uint256 deadline) returns (uint128 added)

Ga matsayin NFT, hujjar topUp babu komai a ciki. Collateralization yana karanta ruwan kuɗi na yanzu na matsayin kuma yana ƙididdige raka'o'in da suka wuce raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na rikodin. Raka'o'in da aka ƙara suna gudanar da kowane bincike na ƙarin jingina na wannan girma (ko na jinginarwa ta sabon asusu idan asusun ba shi da bashi), ciki har da ƙofar sequencer da ƙa'idar ceto. Sannan Adapter yana ƙirƙira kuma yana bayar da daidai raka'o'in da aka ƙara, kuma ana sake tsara tushen cajin rikodin don fita na baya su saki daidai abin da aka rubuta. Raka'o'in da aka karɓa ta yankin ko keɓewar ceto raka'o'in ceto ne.

Asusun da ya riga ya riƙe rikodi 16 yana ƙara jingina ta wannan hanya maimakon da sabon matsayi. Kafin kira, manhajar za ta iya karanta raka'o'in, caji da ko ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai ne zai iya rubuta su da view na Lens previewRecredit. Idan wani bincike ya gaza, ba a ƙirƙira ko rubuta komai ba kuma ruwan kuɗin da aka ƙara yana zama tare da matsayin ba tare da ƙididdigewa ba.

AaveAdapter yana amfani da iyakokin kira, yanayin dakatarwa da daskarar adireshi. RiskModule yana amfani da kowane sauran bincike kuma kuskurensa yana isa ga mai kira ba tare da canji ba. Ƙimomin misali da ke ƙasa asalin ƙaddamarwa ne; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri.
Bincike
Ƙa'ida

Ana rubuta cajin USD a mafi girma cikin farashin oracle da stress floor, don haka jinginarwar da aka yi yayin da pool ke ciniki a ƙasa tana ci gaba da cin iyaka a farashin da bai gaza $1.00 ga kowane cikakken token ba. An auna girman addCap na Hub ga vault token sama da kasafin Regular da na yanki na kasuwar a wannan matakin ƙasa, don haka jinginarwa a cikin kasafin Avana ta dace ƙarƙashinsa. Avana ba ya tsayar da iyaka a kan adadin kasuwanni ga kowane wallet.
Idan yanayi da dama na lokaci ɗaya, mafi takurawa ne ke aiki. Kowace kasuwa asusun ce nata, don haka sauran kasuwannin wallet ba sa taɓa hana jinginarwa.
Yanayi
Sabon asusu
Ƙarin jingina
Reserve na bashi da aka daskarar, layin lamuni da ya ƙare, tushen flash da bai isa ba ko aka dakatar da hanyar musanya da ba ta samuwa ba sa hana kowace jinginarwa.

Raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige su ne ruwan kuɗi mai tattarawa L na matsayin. AaveAdapter yana ƙirƙirar daidai wannan adadin raka'o'in tushe na vault token na kasuwar zuwa proxy, kuma proxy yana ba da su duka ga CDP Spoke kuma yana kunna reserve ɗin a matsayin jingina. Kowace kasuwa tana da nata vault token; cikakken vault token raka'o'in tushe 10^d ne, inda d shi ne decimals na token (6 a misalan da ke ƙasa). LPOracle yana ƙimanta raka'a ɗaya daga composition na haɗin AMM a farashin oracle, ba taɓa daga reserves na spot ba.

Ba a ƙididdige kuɗaɗen da ba a karɓa ba, da duk wani babban kuɗin da aka riga aka bi matsayin lokacin da aka jinginar da shi. Ana ci gaba da bin matsayin su kuma mai ajiyar yana karɓar su a kowane lokaci.

Rikodin yana adana mai ajiya, proxy, vault token, raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige, raka'o'in asali, cajin USD, lokacin jinginarwa da raka'o'in ceto. Mai ajiya, proxy da vault token ba sa canzawa yayin da rikodin ke a buɗe.
Rikodin yana shiga jerin ƙwacewa na asusun, wanda aka tsara bisa raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige, mafi girma da farko.
Cajin asusu marar bashi yana zama a kasafin Regular na kasuwar har sai ya cire. Babu kasafin da ke zaune banza kuma babu kiran da ke motsa shi.

A tsarin fitarwa. Indexers suna tsara matsayi ta ID na chain, ID na haɗin kai da position key, kuma suna danganta events na Spoke ne kawai ga proxies da UserProxyCreated ya sanar, ba ga mai aika ma'amala ba.
Event
Kwangila
Ma'ana
Kowace gazawa tana revert dukkan ma'amalar kuma matsayin yana zama tare da wallet. Kurakurai daga position manager, pool, Spoke da Hub suna wucewa ba tare da canji ba.
Dalili

Lens kwangila ce ta karantawa kawai, ɗaya ga kowace chain, wadda manhaja ke kira kafin sa hannu. Views ɗinsa ba sa taɓa revert a kan yanayin farashi, kuma jinginarwar kanta tana maimaita kowane bincike on-chain.
getPriceState
: yanayin farashin kasuwar, farashin da aka bayar da wanda aka karɓa, da shekarun feeds, ana karantawa da vault token na kasuwar.
getCapHeadroom
: sararin kasuwa, token da mai ajiya, minPledgeUsd da sararin iyakar Aave, ana karantawa da vault token na kasuwar da mai ajiyar.
predictProxy
: adireshin proxy na wallet ga kasuwar da ko an tura shi tukuna.
previewRecredit
: raka'o'in da sake ƙididdigewa zai ƙara, cajinsu, da ko ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai ne zai iya rubuta su.
getAccount
: bayan jinginarwa, jinginar asusun, ma'aunin lafiya na Aave da yanayin ƙofa.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Kasuwa ta 3 kasuwar USDC/USDT ce ta Aerodrome Slipstream a Base, a kan Aerodrome Slipstream Stable CDP Spoke na Base Stable LP Hub, mai tick spacing 1 da kewayo [−887,272, 887,272]. Cikakken vault token ɗaya (raka'a 10^6) yana da ƙimar $2.00. Collateral Factor shi ne 3,120 bps (31.20%), minPledgeUsd shi ne $10 kuma marketUsdCap shi ne $5,000,000 tare da $1,000,000 da aka rubuta. Pool yana da iyakar kowane pool ta misali ta 1,000 bps. Supply na kasuwa raka'o'i 400,000,000,000 ne kuma ruwan kuɗin pool a cikin kewayo 20,000,000,000,000 ne. Yanayin Hub None ne kuma ƙofar sequencer Up ce.
Carol ba ta da proxy a kasuwa ta 3. Tana riƙe da NFT na Slipstream da ba a stake ba mai L = 10,000,000,000 (kusan 10,000 USDC da 10,000 USDT).

Manhajarta tana karanta Lens: kasuwar Live ce (feed na USDC/USD ya wallafa na ƙarshe daƙiƙoƙi 72,000 da suka wuce, sabo har zuwa 88,200), sararin Regular $4,000,000 ne, mafi ƙanƙantar jinginarwa $10 ce, kuma predictProxy yana mayar da adireshin proxy ɗinta.
Tana amincewa da LPVault na Slipstream ga NFT ɗinta a position manager na Slipstream, sannan tana kiran pledge a kasuwa ta 3 da matsayinta da ƙarshen lokaci na now + 600.
ProxyManager yana tura proxy ɗinta P kuma vault token yana yi masa rajista. LPVault yana bincika byte na ƙarnin key, pool da ainihin ticks, yana ɗaukar NFT kuma yana karanta raka'o'i 10,000,000,000.

RiskModule yana bincika: ƙima ⌊10,000,000,000 × 200,000,000 / 10^6⌋ = $20,000 ≥ $10; cajin $20,000 ya dace da sararin $4,000,000; kason pool (400,000,000,000 + 10,000,000,000) × 10^4 = 4.1 × 10^15 ≤ 1,000 × 2 × 10^13, don haka Avana yana riƙe da 2.05% na pool; rikodi 1 cikin 16.

Collateralization yana rubuta $20,000 a Regular da a ma'aunan USDC, USDT da na mai ajiya. Adapter yana ƙirƙirar raka'o'i 10,000,000,000 zuwa P, wanda ke ba da su kuma yana kunna su a matsayin jingina.
Events: ProxyDeployed, UserProxyCreated, ProxyAdded, PositionReceived, CollateralPledged, CollateralSupplied, CollateralAdded.

Asusun yanzu yana nuna jingina $20,000 da jinginar da aka auna da CF $6,240. Lens yana ba da shawarar aro har zuwa ƙimar bashi ta $5,672.73 (HF 1.10) kuma yana nuna matsakaicin yarjejeniya na $6,240 (HF 1.00).
Nau'o'in da ke gazawa
NFT mai L = 4,000,000 yana da ƙimar $8 kuma yana revert da BelowMinPledge(800,000,000, 1,000,000,000).
Rikodi na 17 a kasuwa ɗaya yana revert da TooManyRecords.
NFT da aka stake a gauge yana revert da NotPositionOwner.
NFT a kewayon [−10, 10] yana revert da RangeMismatch.
Jinginarwa ta farko iri ɗaya daƙiƙoƙi 1,800 bayan sake farawar sequencer na Base tana revert da SequencerGrace.
A kowane yanayin gazawa, NFT yana zama tare da Carol.
Ƙarin jingina daga yanki da ƙarin jingina na ceto

A kasuwar Ethereum mai sigogi iri ɗaya, asusu yana bin GHO 15,000 a kan jingina ta $50,000, don haka ma'aunin lafiyarsa shi ne 15,600 / 15,000 = 1.04. Kasafin Regular na kasuwar ya cika kuma Hub yana Frozen. NFT na biyu mai ƙimar $2,000 ƙarin jingina ne, don haka ƙofar Frozen tana wucewa. Ƙimar da aka auna da CF da ta rage don kaiwa 1.10 ita ce (1.10 − 1.04) × 15,000 = $900, wadda ⌈900 / 0.3120⌉ = $2,884.61538462 na jingina ke maidowa. Dukkan $2,000 suna rubutawa daga yankin, dukkan raka'o'insa raka'o'in ceto ne, kuma ma'aunin lafiya ya zama $52,000 × 31.20% / 15,000 = 1.0816. Ƙarin jingina na $4,000 a yanayi ɗaya yana revert da SliceNotAvailable, domin ɓangaren yankinsa ya wuce $2,884.62.

Sannan guardian yana dakatar da Hub da dalili General. A HF 1.0816, ⌈276 / 0.3120⌉ = $884.62 yana dawo da 1.10. Jinginarwa ta $800 ƙarin jingina ne na ceto kuma tana ɗaga ma'aunin lafiya zuwa 1.0982. Jinginarwa ta $1,000 a yanayi ɗaya, da jinginarwa ta sabon asusu daga wani wallet, suna revert da NotRescueTopUp. Ƙarƙashin dalili MintPathSuspect kowace jinginarwa tana revert da ApplicationPaused.
Mataki na gaba shi ne aro a kan sabuwar jingina. Ci gaba zuwa
Aron Kadarori
Yadda ake jinginar da matsayin Uniswap v3 ko Aerodrome Slipstream mai ainihin kewayo cikin Avana a matsayin jingina, abin da ake bincikawa da abin da ake ƙirƙira.

Wallet da ake biyan asusunsa. Ba dole ne ya zama mai kiran ba.
Kasuwar asusun. Tare da mai aro tana ambaton asusun.
Reserve na bashi da aka biya (GHO, USDC, USDT, WETH ko wani reserve da Spoke ke ba da rance).
Mafi yawan abin da mai biya ya ba da dama a jawo a wannan kiran, a raka'o'in tushe na kadarar.
True yana share dukkan bashin yanzu na reserve ko yana revert; false yana biya har zuwa iyakar.

Auna girman jawowa: biyan bashi ta ɓangare yana jawo min(maxRepaySpend, D); biyan duka yana jawo dukkan iyakar, ko yana revert kafin kowane canja wuri idan D ya wuce ta.

Biyan bashi yana motsa kadarar bashi daga mai biya zuwa PositionProxy na mai aro, wanda ke biyan asusunsa a CDP Spoke; Aave yana mayar da kadarar zuwa Hub na ɗaukar nauyin reserve. Mai biya koyaushe shi ne mai kira. Kowane adireshi zai iya biyan kowane asusu: mai aro, wani wallet na mai aro, sabis na ceto ko yarjejeniyar. Mai biya ba zai taɓa iya aro ko motsa jingina ba, domin waɗannan kiran suna aiki ne kawai a kan asusun mai kira kansa.

Kowane kira yana biyan reserve na bashi ɗaya na asusu ɗaya kuma yana barin sauran reserves na asusun ba tare da taɓawa ba. Avana ba shi da mafi ƙanƙantar bashi, don haka biyan bashi ta ɓangare zai iya barin kowane saura. Biyan bashi ba ya canza vault token, matsayi, rikodi ko cajin da aka rubuta.
Mai aro kuma zai iya biyan bashi da ruwan kuɗi daga ɗaya daga cikin matsayinsa da aka jinginar, ba tare da kawo kuɗi ba. An bayyana wannan hanyar ƙarƙashin biyan bashi da jingina a shafin

Mai biya yana amincewa da AaveAdapter ga kadarar bashi tun da farko; babu hanyar permit. Kiran yana mayar da adadin da Aave ya ɗauka. A tsari, yana yin waɗannan:

Bashi yana ci gaba da taruwa tsakanin sa hannu da haɗawa, don haka iyakar da ta yi daidai da bashin da aka ambata lokacin sa hannu koyaushe za ta gaza. Maimakon haka, manhajar tana karanta iyakar da aka ambata zuwa ƙarshen lokaci daga Lens kuma tana tsayar da duka amincewa da maxRepaySpend a kanta:

Biyan duka yana jawo dukkan iyakar, Aave yana ɗaukar bashin yanzu lokacin haɗawa, kuma proxy yana mayar wa mai biya bambancin a kira ɗaya. Mai biya ba ya taɓa kashe fiye da abin da ya sa hannu a kai, kuma amincewa da daidai iyakar tana ƙarewa a 0, don haka babu allowance da ke ci gaba da kasancewa. Janye Jinginar

Riba ta Aave V4 ce kuma tana taruwa kowace daƙiƙa: ƙimar ribar da aka ciro ta reserve a Hub ɗinsa na ɗaukar nauyi tare da ƙarin ribar haɗari na asusun. Bashin yanzu da biyan bashi ke karantawa shi ne bashin da aka ciro tare da premium, wanda ya taru zuwa block kuma an zagaye sama. Biyan bashi yana maido premium da farko, sannan bashin da aka ciro; idan hannayen jarin da aka ciro sun kai 0, ba a ƙara yi wa reserve alama a matsayin wanda aka aro ba.
Avana ba ya ɗaukar kuɗi a kan riba kuma kiran biyan bashi ba ya cajin kuɗi. Avana Labs yana cajin kuɗin manhaja a manhajarsa, a wajen kwangiloli; kiran kwangiloli kai tsaye ba ya biyan sa.

Ƙimomin misali: 5,000 USDC da aka aro a 6.00% shi ne ⌈5,000,000,000 × (1 + 0.06 × 30 / 365)⌉ = raka'o'in tushe 5,024,657,535 (5,024.657535 USDC) bayan kwanaki 30. GHO 8,000 a 5.00% shi ne GHO 8,032.876712 bayan kwanaki 30.

Biyan bashi ba ya taɓa karanta yanayin dakatarwa, circuit breaker, daskarar adireshi, ƙofar sequencer ko kowane view na MarketRegistry, kuma ba ya taɓa kiran RiskModule, oracle ko ParameterStore. Haɗin asusun (Spoke, vault token, reserve) yana zuwa daga ma'ajiyar Adapter kansa da aka rubuta lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri proxy. Don haka babu dakatarwa, breaker, daskarewa, yanayin farashi ko kuskuren rajista na Avana da zai iya hana biyan bashi; Aave kaɗai ne zai iya.
Yanayi
Biyan bashi da kuɗi

Proxy ba shi da logic kuma ba shi da hanyar haɓakawa; yana tura kiran Adapter kaɗai. Yarjejeniyar jeri ta Aave tana amfani da daskarar reserve da drawCap na 0 don takaitawa, waɗanda ke barin biyan bashi a buɗe, kuma tana keɓe dakatar da reserve da tsayar da Spoke ga Spoke mai kuskure.

Kowane mai biya yana biya ta AaveAdapter da adireshin mai aro. Ana jawo kuɗaɗen daga mai biya, ba taɓa daga mai aro ba, kuma duk wani maida kuɗi yana komawa ga mai biya. Wannan yana ba sauran wallets na mai aro, sabis na ceto ko yarjejeniyar damar ceton asusu kusa da liquidation, ciki har da wanda key ɗinsa ya ɓace.

Kiran repay na Spoke kai tsaye ga proxy yana gazawa da Unauthorized, domin Aave yana karɓar biyan bashi ne kawai daga mai matsayi ko position manager da aka amince da shi, kuma proxies ba sa amincewa da ko ɗaya.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. A Ethereum, sabis na ceto R yana biyan GHO 3,000 na asusun kasuwa-A na wallet W yayin da Avana Stable LP Hub ke Paused da dalili MintPathSuspect, debt breaker na GHO ya tashi kuma W adireshi ne da aka daskarar. Kiran ba ya karanta ko ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan yanayi: ana jawo GHO 3,000 daga R, bashin W yana faɗuwa zuwa GHO 5,032.88, event ɗin shi ne Repaid tare da R a matsayin mai biya da W a matsayin mai aro, kuma jinginar W ba ta motsa ba. Idan biyan duka na W kansa tare da iyakar GHO 8,040 ya sauka daga baya a block ɗaya, Aave yana ɗaukar sauran GHO 5,032.876712 kaɗai kuma W yana samun GHO 3,007.123288 baya.

Biyan bashi a bashin sifili, ciki har da bashin da wani mai biya ko liquidation ya share da farko, ba gazawa ba ne: yana mayar da 0 ba tare da motsin token ba.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Asusun Carol a kasuwa ta 3 a Base, kwanaki 30 bayan ta aro 5,000 USDC a 6.00%: bashin yanzu raka'o'in tushe 5,024,657,535, HF 6,240 / (5,024.657535 × 0.9999) = 1.2420.
Biyan duka

Carol tana amincewa da AaveAdapter ga daidai raka'o'in tushe na USDC 5,029,687,935 kuma tana kiran repay(Carol, 3, r_USDC, 5,029,687,935, true, now + 600). Ba a karanta yanayin dakatarwa, breaker, daskarewa, farashi ko ƙofar sequencer ba.
An haɗa kiran daƙiƙoƙi 4 (blocks 2 na Base) daga baya, lokacin da bashin yanzu ya kai 5,024,657,573.
Adapter yana jawo 5,029,687,935 zuwa proxy na Carol; Aave yana ɗaukar 5,024,657,573; ana mayar wa Carol 5,030,362 a kira ɗaya.
Asusun ba shi da sauran bashi, don haka Collateralization yana yi masa alama a matsayin marar bashi. Event Repaid(Carol, Carol, 3, r_USDC, 5,024,657,573, 0, true). Allowance na Carol ga Adapter 0 ne.
Cajin $20,000 na Carol yana ci gaba da kasancewa a rubuce har sai ta cire; NFTs ɗinta yanzu za su iya fita ta cirewa marar bashi.
Nau'o'i
Biyan bashi ta ɓangare na 2,000 USDC yana barin 3,024,657,535; ana karɓar kowane saura domin babu mafi ƙanƙantar bashi.
Biyan duka tare da iyakar 5,020,000,000 yana revert da RepayExceedsMax(5,024,657,535, 5,020,000,000) kafin kowane canja wuri.
Biyan duka da ke barin bashi a reserve yana revert da DebtRemaining.
Yayin da sequencer na Base ba ya aiki, Carol za ta iya tilasta biyan bashi iri ɗaya daga L1 kuma yana yin nasara.
A Ethereum, ambaton iri ɗaya da aka haɗa daƙiƙoƙi 24 (blocks 2) daga baya yana samun bashin 5,024,657,765 kuma yana mayar da 5,030,170.
Biyan bashi bayan liquidation ta riga ta share bashin yana mayar da 0 ba tare da canja wuri, amincewa ko event ba.
Misalin ɓangare na uku da ke sama yana nuna sabis na ceto yana biya yayin da aka dakatar da Hub, breaker ya tashi kuma an daskarar da mai aro.
Yadda ake biyan wani ɓangare ko dukkan reserve na bashi a Avana, daga kowane mai biya, a kowane yanayin dakatarwa na Avana.

Karɓi dukkan matsayin da aka jinginar baya, tare da kuɗaɗensa. Asusu marar bashi koyaushe zai iya fita; asusu mai bashi zai iya fita yayin da yake da lafiya kuma binciken cirewa tare da bashi sun wuce.

Cirewa tana rufe rikodi ɗaya: proxy yana cire daidai raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na rikodin daga CDP Spoke, AaveAdapter yana ƙone su, Collateralization yana sakin rikodin da cajinsa na USD, kuma LPVault yana mayar da dukkan matsayin ga mai ajiya na rikodi. Wallet da proxy ɗinsa ke riƙe da rikodin kaɗai, wanda koyaushe shi ne mai ajiyarsa, ne zai iya cire shi. Babu wani, ciki har da gudanarwa da keepers, da zai iya motsa matsayin da ke da rikodi.
Kira
An bayyana cirewa ta ɓangare a
Sarrafa Lamuni

Nunin matsayi yana ambaton matsayin rikodin ta ID na haɗin kai da position key. Matsayi ɗaya ga kowane kira.

Raka'o'in dole ne su yi daidai da raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na rikodin bayan daidaitawa, wanda ake karantawa daga previewRelease na Collateralization. Ana sakin dukkan matsayin, ba taɓa wani ɓangarensa ba.
Ƙarshen lokaci timestamp ne: daƙiƙoƙi 600 blocks 300 ne na Base ko blocks 50 na Ethereum.
Mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiya yana aiki ne kawai idan bashi yana nan; 0 yana nufin babu ƙarin iyaka.

Vault token, Spoke da reserve na kasuwar suna zuwa daga haɗin Adapter kansa da immutables na vault token, ba tare da karanta MarketRegistry ba, don haka rajista mai kuskure ba za ta iya hana fitar ba ko maye gurbin wani token.

Asusun ba shi da bashi lokacin da Aave ya ba da rahoton adadin aro na 0 ga proxy. Ƙirgar Aave tana rufe kowane reserve da asusun ke bi, don haka rajistar da ba ta jera reserves na bashi ba ba za ta iya sa asusu mai bashi ya yi kama da marar bashi ba.
Marar bashi

Ba a karanta yanayin dakatarwa, circuit breaker, daskarar adireshi, ƙofar sequencer, farashi, view na MarketRegistry ko binciken RiskModule ba. Cirewa marar bashi tana aiki a kowane yanayin Avana da kowane yanayin farashi. Aave kaɗai ne zai iya dakatar da ita, ta hanyar dakatar da reserve na vault-token ko tsayar da CDP Spoke. Idan rikodi na ƙarshe ya fita, ana kashe reserve ɗin a matsayin jingina ga proxy.
Tare da bashi

Jinginar da ta fita daga asusu mai bashi ba za a iya ƙwace ta ba kuma, don haka cirewa tare da bashi tana rufe duk lokacin da liquidation ta asusun ba za ta iya gudana ba ko breaker ya dakatar da sabon fallasa. Binciken su ne binciken aro ba tare da ƙin Offboarding da daskarewar Aave ba:
Bincike
Ƙa'ida
Kuskure

Binciken lafiya yana gudana bayan an saki rikodin, tare da sauran raka'o'in ceto na asusun da aka ƙimanta a sifili. A kasuwar Offboarding, Aave yana amfani da matakin liquidation da ake ragewa a hankali, don haka cirewa tare da bashi tana buƙatar ƙarin sauran jingina yayin da ragewar ke ci gaba.
repayAllAndWithdraw(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, uint256 units, uint256[] debtReserveIds, uint256[] maxRepaySpends, uint256 deadline)

Ga kowane reserve na bashi da aka ambata, kiran yana gudanar da biyan duka tare da mai kiran a matsayin mai biya da mai aro, ƙarƙashin iyakar waccan reserve kanta, kuma yana mayar da ɓangaren da ba a yi amfani da shi ba a kira ɗaya. Manhajar tana tsayar da kowace iyaka, da amincewarta, zuwa ƙimar quoteRepayAll ta Lens. Idan Aave har yanzu yana ba da rahoton kowane bashi, kiran yana revert da DebtRemaining ga reserve na farko da aka aro. In ba haka ba, yana yin cirewa marar bashi.

Ba ya karanta yanayin dakatarwa, breaker, daskarewa, ƙofar sequencer, farashi ko view na MarketRegistry kuma ba ya kiran kowane aikin RiskModule. Don haka yana aiki ƙarƙashin Hub da ke Frozen ko Paused, ƙarƙashin kowane breaker, ga wallet da aka daskarar da yayin tagar alheri ta sequencer na Base. Duk wata gazawa tana revert dukkansa.
releaseZeroCredit(uint256 marketId, PositionRef position, uint256 deadline)

Idan rikodi ba shi da sauran raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige, yawanci bayan cikakkiyar ƙwacewa, mai ajiya na rikodi yana karɓar matsayin baya da wannan kiran. Ba ya ƙirƙira, ƙonewa ko bayar da komai, ba ya cirewa daga Spoke ko binciken bashi, kuma ba ya karanta yanayin dakatarwa, daskarewa, breaker ko farashi. Yana samuwa a kowane yanayin Avana da Aave, kowane yanayin sequencer da a kasuwar Closed. Matsayin yana komawa tare da kuɗaɗensa da ba a karɓa ba da duk wani ruwan kuɗin da aka ba shi kyauta.

A cikin kowace cirewa, sakin ba tare da ƙididdigewa ba da cirewa ta ɓangare, Collateralization yana kwatanta raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na asusun da bayarwarsa ta Aave. Bayarwa za ta iya faɗuwa ƙasa da ƙididdigewa ne kawai idan ba a taɓa sasanta ƙwacewa ba. A kowace fita ta yau da kullum, biyun sun yi daidai kuma ba a rubuta komai ba.

Idan raka'o'i sun ɓace, Collateralization yana cirewa daga rikodin asusun daga mafi girma da adadin da ya ɓace, yana warware waɗannan raka'o'in zuwa ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira na kasuwar kuma yana sakin cajinsu. Vault tokens da aka ƙwace da ke yawo suna ci gaba da samun tallafi daga tokens da ke cikin wannan ma'auni. Rikodin da aka cire har 0 yana ci gaba da kasancewa a buɗe, don haka mai ajiyarsa zai iya karɓar kuɗaɗe kuma ya yi amfani da releaseZeroCredit. Kowa zai iya kiran settlePending na LPVaultSwap daga baya, wanda ke ƙone vault tokens da suka makale, yana juya tokens masu jira zuwa kadarar bashi ta sasantawa na kasuwar kuma yana ɗaukar nauyin Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke) na waccan kadara. Mai aro da mai kira ba sa karɓar komai daga ciki.

Matsayin kansa: ga Uniswap v3 da Slipstream, NFT, wanda aka canja daga LPVault zuwa mai ajiya na rikodi ba tare da receiver hook ba. NFT na Slipstream yana komawa ba a stake ba, kamar yadda aka jinginar da shi.

Kuɗaɗensa da ba a karɓa ba da duk wani babban kuɗin da ake bin sa. Cirewar ba ta karɓa ko warwarewa, don haka waɗannan suna tafiya tare da NFT kuma mai ajiyar yana karɓar su kai tsaye daga yarjejeniyar AMM.
Duk wani ruwan kuɗin da aka ba matsayin kyauta kuma ba a taɓa sake ƙididdige shi ba.
Ana sakin cajin USD na rikodin daga kasafin kasuwar (ɓangaren yanki da farko, sannan Regular) da daga ma'aunan token da na mai ajiya.

Ga cirewa tare da bashi, yanayi mafi takurawa a kan kasuwar asusun da kowane reserve na bashi da yake bi ne ke aiki. Babu dakatarwa, breaker ko daskarewa na Avana da ke isa sasantawar da ke jira ko liquidation a kowane layi.
Yanayi
Cirewa marar bashi, cire ruwan kuɗi ko repayAllAndWithdraw
Cirewa ko cire ruwan kuɗi tare da bashi
Saki ba tare da ƙididdigewa ba
Tare da bashi: events na yanayin LPOracle da DebtOracle idan poke ya canza yanayin da aka adana.
Remove na Hub da Withdraw na Spoke; Transfer na vault token zuwa proxy da ƙonewarsa.
CollateralDisabled, idan rikodi na ƙarshe na asusu marar bashi ya fita daga reserve.
RecordDebited da SeizureReconciled, kawai idan daidaitawa a fita ta sami raka'o'in da suka ɓace.
Transfer na NFT zuwa mai ajiya, sannan PositionReturned na LPVault da CollateralReleased na Collateralization.
CollateralWithdrawn(wallet, marketId, vaultToken, positionKey, units, withDebt, healthFactorAfter)
Ma'aunin lafiya a CollateralWithdrawn shi ne mafi girman ƙimar uint256 a reshen marar bashi. repayAllAndWithdraw yana fara fitar da Repaid ɗaya ga kowane reserve da ya motsa kuɗaɗe.
Kowace gazawa tana revert dukkan ma'amalar; rikodi, ma'aunai, tokens da matsayi suna nan yadda suke.
Dalili

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Asusun Carol a kasuwa ta 3 (USDC/USDT, Aerodrome Slipstream a Base, $2.00 ga kowane cikakken vault token, Collateral Factor 31.20%) yana riƙe da rikodi biyu: key1 mai raka'o'i 10,000,000,000 ($20,000) da ƙarin jingina keyB mai raka'o'i 2,500,000,000 ($5,000). Jingina $25,000 ce, wadda aka auna da CF $7,800, bashi 5,000 USDC wanda aka ƙimanta a $4,999.50, don haka HF = 7,800 / 4,999.50 = 1.5602. Duka feeds biyu sun wallafa na ƙarshe daƙiƙoƙi 30,000 da suka wuce (sababbi har zuwa 88,200), Hub yana cikin yanayin None kuma ƙofar sequencer Up ce.
Manhajar tana karanta getAccount da getPriceState: kasuwa Live ce, kuma cire keyB yana barin ƙimar da aka auna da CF ta $6,240 da HF 1.2481.
Carol tana kiran withdraw(3, (I, keyB), 2,500,000,000, now + 600, 1.20e18). Raka'o'in sun fito ne daga previewRelease.

Asusun yana da bashi (adadin aro 1), don haka binciken ƙofofi yana gudana: Hub ba Paused ba ne, ba a daskarar da Carol ba, sannan binciken farko na RiskModule ya tarar sequencer yana Up, duka oracles biyu Live ne kuma babu breaker da ya tashi.
Proxy yana cire raka'a 2,500,000,000 daga Spoke kuma Adapter yana ƙona su.
Collateralization yana rufe rikodin keyB kuma yana sakin cajinsa na $5,000. LPVault yana mayar wa Carol da NFT tare da duk kuɗaɗen da ya tara.
Binciken lafiya: HF = 6,240 / 4,999.50 = 1.2481, sama da max(1.00, 1.20).
Abubuwan da suka faru PositionReturned, CollateralReleased da CollateralWithdrawn tare da HF 1,248,124,812,481,248,124. Yanzu Carol tana riƙe da rikodi ɗaya, jingina $20,000.
Yanayin da ya gaza da hanyar da babu bashi
Idan aka cire key1 maimakon haka, ƙimar da aka auna da CF tana zama $1,560 da HF 1,560 / 4,999.50 = 0.3120, don haka Aave yana revert da HealthFactorBelowThreshold.

Daƙiƙa 1,200 bayan sake farawar sequencer, withdraw yana revert da SequencerGrace. repayAllAndWithdraw(3, (I, keyB), 2,500,000,000, [r_USDC], [cap], now + 600) yana biyan bashin USDC kuma yana mayar da NFT nan take, saboda fita ba tare da bashi ba ba ta karanta kowace ƙofa.

Wannan cirewa ɗaya yayin da Hub ke Paused, yayin da aka daskarar da Carol, ko yayin da breaker na pool-share na kasuwa ya tashi tana revert da ApplicationPaused, AddressIsFrozen ko BreakerTripped; repayAllAndWithdraw yana yin nasara a kowane ɗayan waɗannan yanayi. A ƙarƙashin Hub da ke Frozen, cirewa tare da bashi tana yin nasara.
An bayyana yadda ake ƙididdige iyakar repay-all a
Biya Lamuni
Yadda ake karɓo matsayin da aka jinginar daga Avana, tare da bashi da ba tare da bashi ba, da abin da kuke karɓa.

toc.title: AMMs da Ba a Jera Su Ba Tukuna

strings: Pool ɗin LP da aka yarda

Waɗanne pools da kewayo Avana ke jerawa a matsayin jingina a farkon ƙaddamarwa, ƙa'idodin jeri da tokens da aka cire, hanyar haɗin AMM, takamaiman bayanan Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream, da kariyar AMMs da ba a jera su ba tukuna.
Bayani
Kasuwannin Ƙaddamarwa
Kasuwa = Pool + Takamaiman Kewayo
Ƙa'idodin Jeri

Tokens da Aka Cire
Hanyar Haɗin AMM
Takamaiman Bayanan Uniswap v3
Takamaiman Bayanan Aerodrome Slipstream
AMMs da Ba a Jera Su Ba Tukuna

Avana yana jera takamaiman pool ɗaya da kewayon tick ɗaya a lokaci guda. Kowace kasuwa tana wuce ƙa'idodin jeri na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗinta, bita ta jama'a ta kwanaki biyar da binciken daidaito a kan chain kafin ta karɓi jingina.

Avana yana ƙaddamarwa a Ethereum da Base, kowanne da Avana Stable LP Hub ɗaya. Ana karɓar matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. Ana iya ƙara Correlated LP da Volatile LP Hubs daga baya, kowanne da nasa CDP Spokes.

Ba a amincewa da pool gaba ɗaya. Kowace kasuwa pool ɗaya ce tare da takamaiman siffar matsayi ɗaya, da nata vault token, reserve na jingina, feed na farashi, iyakoki da hanyoyin musaya. Babban tsarin yana kuma tallafa wa Uniswap v2, Curve StableSwap-NG, Balancer da Uniswap v4, amma ba a jera kowannensu ba sai haɗinsa ya wuce kariyar da aka bayyana a ƙasa.
An bayyana yadda ake rajista, kunnawa, fitar da kuma rufe kasuwa a shafin zagayowar rayuwar kasuwa:
Zagayowar Rayuwar Kasuwa
Chain
CDP Spoke
Matsayi
Ethereum
Avana Stable LP Hub
Uniswap v3 Stable
Matsayin NFT na Uniswap v3 na canonical position manager
Base
Aerodrome Slipstream Stable
Matsayin NFT na Aerodrome Slipstream da ba a yi stake ba na ƙarni na position-manager da ke cikin allowlist

Pools na ƙaddamarwa pools ne na stablecoin da suka cika ƙa'idodin jeri, ciki har da USDC/USDT da pools da ke ɗauke da GHO. Kowane token na kasuwar Stable LP Hub stable ne da aka amince da shi wanda aka ɗaura da USD, don haka ana iyakance farashinsa a $1 don ƙimantawa kuma ƙungiyar USD tana aiki.
Pools na GHO: Collateral Factor na ƙafar GHO ƙima ce ta musamman,
ghoLegCollateralFactorBps
, da aka tsayar ga kowane token a cikin payload na jeri (tsakanin 1 da 9,999 bps), ana amfani da ita a madadin ƙimar Aave Core Hub.
Kasuwannin GHO suna kasancewa Live yayin da ake cinikin GHO sama da $1, saboda ƙimantawa da iyakar sama ta ƙungiyar suna amfani da farashin da aka iyakance.
GHO ita ce kadarar bashi ta farko ta kowane CDP Spoke. Ana iya kunna USDC, USDT ko WETH ga kowane Spoke a matsayin ƙarin reserves na bashi.

Ga ruwan kuɗi da aka tattara (concentrated liquidity), kasuwa tana tsayar da kewayon tick ɗaya, wanda zai iya zama cikakken kewayon da za a iya amfani da shi ko wanda aka iyakance. Ana karɓar jinginarwa ne kawai idan tick na ƙasa da na sama na matsayin sun yi daidai da na kasuwar daidai. Ba a taɓa ƙididdige matsayin da ya fi faɗi ko ya fi ƙunci da kowane adadin ticks ba. Ba tare da wannan ƙa'ida ba, matsayi mai ƙunƙuntaccen kewayo da ya kai $10,000 za a ƙididdige shi a ƙimar kasuwa ta kowace raka'a, wanda ya fi daidai da kusan sau 979.
Ana samun pool daga matsayin kansa ta hanyar factory da aka ɗaure na haɗin; ba a taɓa amfani da pool da mai kira ya bayar ba.

Dole ne duka ticks biyu su daidaita da tick spacing na pool ta amfani da lissafi mai alama (signed arithmetic). Bincike a kan unsigned cast zai karɓi ticks marasa kyau da ba su daidaita ba, kamar −516 ga spacing 10.
Dole ne duka ticks biyu su kasance a cikin kewayon da za a iya amfani da shi ga spacing ɗin, kuma tick na ƙasa dole ne ya kasance ƙasa da tick na sama.
Ba fiye da kasuwa ɗaya ce ke wanzuwa ga kowane CDP Spoke, pool da kewayo ba. Ana iya sake jera pool da kewayo ɗaya ne kawai a wani CDP Spoke.

Kafin a tsara jeri, masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4 suna wallafa kunshin jeri tare da iyakokin lambobi da shaida ga kowace ƙa'ida: shekarun pool, TVL, zurfi, heartbeat da karkacewar feed, slippage na damuwa, nazarin kuɗin magudi, gwajin baya na juriyar TWAP, teburin girgiza ga takamaiman kewayon kasuwar da gwajin damuwa na iyaka.
Fanni
Ƙa'ida
Pool
Factory da aka ɗaure na haɗin ne ya ƙirƙira shi, tare da daidaitaccen tick spacing da isasshen tarihin ruwan kuɗi
Feeds na farashi
Ga kowane token, feed na Chainlink TOKEN/USD kai tsaye na farko, wata hanya ta dabam mai zaman kanta da hanyar jiran aiki, kowace ƙafa tare da rubutaccen heartbeat ɗinta da aka wallafa
Tushe na biyu

Ga kowane token, tushe na biyu mai zaman kansa (wata hanyar sadarwar oracle, ko TWAP na wani zurfaffen pool ban da na kasuwar kanta) wanda tarihinsa a lokutan damuwa da suka gabata ya kasance cikin juriyarsa
Tarihin TWAP
Buffer na lura na pool yana rufe tagar daƙiƙa 1,800 a lokacin block na chain: lura 151 a Ethereum, 901 a Base. Avana yana biya don ƙara shi lokacin jeri.
Kuɗin magudi
Ruwan kuɗin pool a cikin ƙungiyar farashin da aka nazarta yana kai aƙalla mafi ƙarancin da nazarin kuɗin magudi na kowane pool ya tsayar
Rarar jeri
Ɗaya ban da Collateral Factor ya wuce iyakar karkacewar feed tare da drift na heartbeat
Hanyoyin musaya

Ga kowane token na pool da kowace kadarar bashi da Spoke ke bayarwa a aro, hanyar musaya ta farko da ta ajiya, kowacce an tabbatar tana da zurfi a girman damuwa tare da kewayon gaba ɗaya a gefe ɗaya. Babu hanyar da ke ciniki ta cikin pool na kasuwar kanta.
Binciken mai fitarwa
Kowane token yana rubuta bincike: alamar dakatarwa ga masu fitarwa da za su iya dakatar da canja wuri (USDC), ƙimar kuɗin USDT, babu wani abu in ba haka ba (GHO, DAI)
Iyakoki
Iyakokin USD na kasuwa, token da mai ajiya, iyakar pool-share (10% na pool a asali) da add cap na Hub, waɗanda masu ba da sabis na haɗari suka tsayar
Mafi ƙarancin jinginarwa
$10 ga kowace jinginarwa a ƙaddamarwa, don haka kowane rikodi yana da darajar gas ɗin liquidation ɗinsa
Rikodi
Ba fiye da rikodi 16 ga kowane asusu da kasuwa ba, don haka liquidation ɗaya ta asusu mafi girma tana dacewa a cikin ma'amala ɗaya
Ƙimar vault-token
Cikakken vault token ɗaya dole ne ya kasance yana da ƙima tsakanin $0.50 da $20.00 a lokacin kunnawa
Adadin tokens
Tsakanin tokens 2 da 8 ga kowane pool, iyakar da aka tsayar ta
MAX_POOL_TOKENS
LPOracle yana ƙimanta kowane matsayi ba tare da ragi ba. Duk daidaitawar haɗari tana cikin Collateral Factor na reserve, wanda aka lissafa a kan tokens na kasuwar:
CF = ⌊min(CFᵢ) × poolRiskFactor⌋

Factor na kowane token shi ne Collateral Factor ɗinsa na Aave V4 Core Hub, factor na musamman na ƙafar GHO, ko kuma ga token da ba shi da factor na Core Hub, ƙimar da masu ba da sabis na haɗari suka tsayar.
Ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana da iyaka ta sama ta 0.40.

Misali: factors na tokens na 78% da ma'aunin haɗarin pool na 0.40 suna ba da Collateral Factor na 31.2%. Wannan shi ne matsakaicin loan-to-value na 31.2% a ma'aunin lafiya na 1.00 da shawarar 28.4% a ma'aunin lafiya na Lens na 1.10.
LPVaults, Collateralization da LPVaultSwap suna lissafi ta hanyar ma'aunan da aka karɓa kuma suna tura kowane token a cikin kira ɗaya, don haka an cire tokens da ke canza ma'aunansu da kansu:
Tokens masu cajin kuɗi a canja wuri (fee-on-transfer)
Tokens masu rebasing
Tokens masu transfer hooks
Tokens waɗanda canja wurinsu ke mayar da false maimakon revert

Ana riƙe ETH na asali a matsayin WETH, kuma ana ƙimanta token na ƙima kamar liquid staking token ta hanyar feed na ƙimarsa da aka ninka da feed na kadarar ƙasa. USDC da USDT keɓantattu ne da aka karɓa waɗanda mai fitarwa zai iya haɓakawa, tare da sa ido da binciken mai fitarwa.

Ƙimar kuɗin USDT dole ne ta zama 0 lokacin jeri. Ana auna kowane adadin da Avana ke karɓa ta hanyar canjin ma'auni, don haka idan aka kunna kuɗin daga baya, sasantawa da biyan bashi suna kammaluwa a adadin da aka rage yayin da breaker na mai fitarwa ke dakatar da sabon fallasa ga token ɗin.

Haɗin AMM shi ne lambar Avana ga yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya a chain ɗaya: LPVault ɗaya mara canzawa da ke riƙe da kowane matsayin da aka jinginar na wannan yarjejeniya, tare da laburaren farashi da aka haɗa a cikin duka LPVault da aiwatarwar LPOracle ta yarjejeniyar. Babban tsarin (Collateralization, vault tokens, AaveAdapter, LPVaultSwap da tushen LPOracle) ya dogara ne kawai da wannan hanyar haɗi. Ƙara yarjejeniyar AMM yana ƙara LPVault ɗaya, laburaren farashi ɗaya da aiwatarwar LPOracle ɗaya; babu wani abu da ke canzawa.

Matsayin kewayo, kulle pool, pool share da zurfi da aka auna da lokaci ga RiskModule, LPOracle da Lens
Kowane rikodi, abin da ya faru da index ana ɗaura su da mai gano haɗin da maɓallin matsayi, ba a taɓa ɗaura su da ID na NFT token kawai ba.
Raka'ar tushe ɗaya ta vault-token tana da goyon bayan raka'a ɗaya da aka ƙididdige: ruwan kuɗi ga concentrated liquidity, raka'o'in tushe na LP-token ga hannayen jarin LP masu musanyawa.
checkReadSafe
yana revert yayin da pool ke cikin kulle na reentrancy na kansa; Collateralization yana kiran sa kafin kowane riƙo, karatu da cirewa, kuma LPOracle kafin kowane ƙididdiga.
LPVault yana karɓar matsayi na canonical NonfungiblePositionManager kaɗai, ba a taɓa karɓar fork ba. Maɓallin matsayinsa shi ne ID na token.

Pool na kasuwa dole ne ya fito daga canonical factory kuma ya yi daidai da adireshin da aka samu daga init code hash na factory. Tick spacing dole ne ya zama na daidaitaccen matakin kuɗi: kuɗi 100 → 1, 500 → 10, 3,000 → 60, 10,000 → 200.
Kowane riƙo, cirewa da karatun ruwan kuɗi a ƙarƙashin Lock yana bincika slot0 mai fili 7 na pool kuma yana revert da
PoolLocked

Mai aro yana amincewa da LPVault ga wannan ID na token ɗaya, ko ya sanya hannu a kan permit na position-manager. LPVault yana jawowa da canja wuri na yau da kullum, don haka wallets da ba su da receiver hook suna aiki.

Cirewa tana rage ruwan kuɗi kuma nan take tana tattara ainihin kuɗin da ta mayar kaɗai, don haka kuɗaɗe suna kasancewa bashi ga NFT. Tattara kuɗaɗe yana biyan duk adadin da ake bi ga mai ajiya da ke cikin rikodi, ciki har da ainihin kuɗin da aka bar ana bi kafin jinginarwa, wanda ba a taɓa ƙididdige shi ba.
NFT da aka aika zuwa LPVault ba ta hanyar jinginarwa ba ba a taɓa ƙididdige shi ba; timelock zai iya mayar da shi.

Slipstream yana sake amfani da lissafin tick da ruwan kuɗi na Uniswap v3, don haka kowace ƙa'idar Uniswap v3 tana aiki tare da position manager da factory na ƙarni da aka ɗaure na kasuwar a matsayinsu. Bambance-bambancen:

Maɓallin matsayi mai prefix na ƙarni: maɓallin matsayi yana ɗauke da ƙarni a cikin babban byte ɗinsa, don haka LPVault koyaushe yana kiran position manager da ya dace duk da cewa IDs na token suna haɗuwa tsakanin ƙarni. Jinginarwa daga wani ƙarni tana revert da

Matsayin da ba a yi stake ba kaɗai: jinginarwa tana revert da

idan mai shi gauge ne. LPVault ba ya taɓa yin stake ko amincewa da NFT da yake riƙe da shi, don haka matsayin da aka jinginar yana kasancewa ba a yi stake ba har sai ya koma ga mai ajiyarsa.
Binciken Lock: kowane riƙo, cirewa da ƙididdiga yana revert da

Kuɗaɗen matsayin da ba a yi stake ba ana rage su da hannun jarin pool da aka yi stake da kuɗinsa na unstaked. Kuɗaɗe ba jingina ba ne, don haka wannan yana canza ribar mai aro kaɗai, wadda Lens ke bayar da rahotonta ga kowace kasuwa.

Hanyar haɗin tana tallafa wa ƙarin yarjejeniyoyin AMM huɗu. Ba a jera kasuwar kowanne daga cikinsu ba har sai shafin haɗinsa, gwaje-gwajen fork na kowace kariya a chain ɗinsa da auna gas na ƙwacewarsa sun wanzu, sannan bitar haɗari da amincewar gudanarwa. Kowanne kuma yana buƙatar iyakar canjin ƙididdiga ta kowane block.
Farashi

meta.title: AppKit
meta.description: Yadda AppKit ke tura bayanan wallet da kasuwa daga manhajar abokin hulɗa zuwa cikin tsarin aron Avana, da abin da ke kasancewa a cikin kwangiloli.

strings: AppKit
Yadda AppKit ke tura bayanan wallet da kasuwa daga manhajar abokin hulɗa zuwa cikin tsarin aron Avana, da abin da ke kasancewa a cikin kwangiloli.
Bayani
Samfurin Haɗin Kai
Sarrafa Abokin Hulɗa
Bayanan Aiwatarwa
Kaddamar da Bayanan kula
Yadda abokan hulɗa ke haɗa masu amfani zuwa tsarin aron Avana daga nasu ra'ayoyin matsayi. Ƙa'idodin aro, haɗari da liquidation suna kasancewa a cikin kwangiloli.

AppKit yana haɗa DEXs, wallets da manhajojin portfolio zuwa tsarin aron Avana mai goyon bayan LP a Ethereum da Base. Manhajar abokin hulɗa tana zaɓar inda wurin shiga ke bayyana kuma tana tura bayanan wallet da kasuwa na mai amfani. Aron kansa yana gudana ta hanyar AaveAdapter da CDP Spoke na kasuwar a Aave V4: GHO da farko, da USDC, USDT ko WETH inda CDP Spoke ya kunna su.

AppKit haɗin frontend ne. Ba ya canza waɗanne pools ake jerawa, yadda ake ƙimanta matsayi ko yadda ake yi musu liquidation. Masu amfani kuma za su iya kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye, ba tare da AppKit ko frontend na Avana ba.
Kama niyya

Abokin hulɗa yana sanya wurin shigar aro kusa da matsayin LP, portfolio ko ra'ayin musaya. Wannan ra'ayi yana ba da bayanan matsayi da kasuwa don miƙawa. Matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream da ba a yi stake ba a Base waɗanda kewayon tick ɗinsu ya yi daidai da kasuwar da aka jera daidai kaɗai ne za a iya jinginarwa.
Hannun yarjejeniya

Abokin hulɗa yana tura wallet, chain da kasuwa zuwa Avana don tsarin aro ya buɗe da asusu da kasuwa da suka dace a zaɓe. Kowane wallet yana da asusu ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa, don haka kasuwar tana tsayar da asusun da mai amfani zai yi aro a kai.
Tattalin Arziki na Abokin Hulɗa

Duk wata yarjejeniyar abokin hulɗa a wajen chain take. Babu kwangilar da ke ɗauke da kuɗin aro, riba ko frontend, kuma yarjejeniyoyin abokan hulɗa ba sa canza sharuɗɗan aro na Aave V4, sigogin haɗari ko ƙa'idodin liquidation.

Abokan hulɗa suna sarrafa yadda ake gabatar da wurin shigar aro da jagorar da ke kewaye da shi. Waɗannan zaɓuɓɓuka suna shafar yadda masu amfani ke isa ga tsarin. Cancantar jingina, yanayin farashi da kowane binciken ma'amala suna kasancewa a cikin kwangilolin Avana da Aave V4.
Inda fuskar kiredit ta bayyana a cikin samfurin
Wanne sassan masu amfani suna ganin wurin shigar aro
Nawa ilimi ko bayani ya bayyana tare da handoff
Ko samfurin yana amfani da cikakken abin hannu ko wuri mai kiyaye mahallin wuta mai sauƙi.

Haɗin AppKit yana haɗa ra'ayin matsayi da ke akwai zuwa tsarin aron Avana da ya dace. Waɗannan bayanai suna bayani kan tura bayanai da iyaka tsakanin hanyar haɗin abokin hulɗa da ayyukan yarjejeniyar Avana.
Karanta bayanan asusu, yanayin farashi, iyaka da preview daga Lens maimakon sake lissafa ƙimar jingina ko ma'aunin lafiya a cikin hanyar haɗin abokin hulɗa.
Nuna aron da aka ba da shawara a ma'aunin lafiya na 1.10 kusa da matsakaicin yarjejeniyar a 1.00, kamar yadda Lens ke mayar da su.
Gina ma'amaloli da masu gina calldata a cikin
packages/protocol
daga tabbataccen deployment manifest. Kada a taɓa ɗaukar maƙasudin ma'amala ko calldata daga backend.

Nemi amincewa daidai kaɗai: matsayi ɗaya ga LPVault na kasuwar don jinginarwa, da ainihin adadin biyan bashi ga AaveAdapter don biyan bashi. Ba a taɓa neman amincewar operator ga duk tokens ko allowance mara iyaka ba.
Nuna lokacin da kasuwa ba Live ba ce, an dakatar ko daskarar da Hub, ko breaker ya tashi, don masu amfani su fahimci dalilin da jinginarwa ko aro za su revert.
Cikakken jagorar haɗi, tare da kwangiloli, amincewa da abubuwan da suka faru, yana kan bayanin haɗe-haɗe:
Haɗe-haɗe

Kafin kunna haɗin, tabbatar da cikakkiyar hanya daga ra'ayin matsayi na abokin hulɗa zuwa tsarin aron Avana a kowace chain. Hanyar haɗin dole ne ta bayyana asusun da aka zaɓa, kasuwa da sauyawa zuwa Avana a fili.

Haɗa wuraren shiga da aka ɓoye, hanyoyin haɗi kai tsaye, matsayin da kewayonsu bai yi daidai da kasuwar da aka jera ba, matsayin Slipstream da aka yi stake, da rashin bayanan wallet, kasuwa ko jingina a cikin wannan bita. Waɗannan yanayi ne ke yanke shawara ko tsarin zai buɗe da bayanan da ake buƙata don kimanta aro.
Jagorar haɗi ga masu haɓakawa don saka AppKit a cikin samfuran abokan hulɗa.

Kwangilar ra'ayi ta karatu kaɗai, ɗaya ga kowace chain, don manhaja, keepers, sa ido da shaidar goyon baya ta jama'a. Kowane sakamako shawara ne; kwangilar maƙasudi tana sake bincika shi.

Lens kwangilar periphery ce mara canzawa ta karatu kaɗai, ɗaya ga kowace chain. Tana tattara yanayi daga kowace kwangilar Avana, CDP Spokes, Hubs da oracles zuwa ra'ayoyin kira ɗaya, kuma tana mayar da previews da ke ɗauke da rarar da ake buƙata don su kasance masu inganci tsakanin block da aka karanta su da block da ya haɗa ma'amalar.

Lens yana wajen babban tsarin da aka yi wa audit. Babu babbar kwangilar da ke kiran sa, adana adireshinsa ko dogara da abin da yake mayarwa, kuma babu abin da yake mayarwa da ke ba da izinin wani aiki. Kuskure a Lens zai iya ruɗar da mai amfani ko keeper zuwa ma'amala da ke revert ko ke biyan ƙasa da abin da aka nuna; ba zai iya motsa ƙima ba. Ana bita da gwada shi a matsayin periphery.

Sabon Lens sabon deployment ne, wanda ake yi lokacin da hanyar haɗin wani abin dogaro ta canza. Maye gurbinsa ba ya buƙatar wani aikin gudanarwa; tabbataccen deployment manifest yana rubuta adireshin da masu amfani ke amfani da shi.
Kowane struct da aka mayar yana ɗauke da lambar block da timestamp da aka karanta shi a ciki. Lens ba ya fitar da abubuwan da suka faru kuma ba ya motsa tokens.

Kasuwa tana shiga Avana ne kawai bayan bita ta jama'a ta kwanaki biyar da binciken daidaito a kan chain idan aka kwatanta da saitin Aave, kuma tana fita ta hanyar rufewa a hankali ba tare da ikon tilasta rufewa a kan masu aro ba.

Kasuwa ita ce chain ɗaya, yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya, pool ɗaya da takamaiman siffar matsayi ɗaya. Tana da vault token ɗaya da reserve na jingina ɗaya a CDP Spoke ɗaya. CDP Spoke shi ne daidaitaccen Spoke na Aave V4 ɗaya da ba a gyara ba ga kowace chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari; a ƙaddamarwa waɗannan su ne "Uniswap v3 Stable" a Ethereum Stable LP Hub da "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" a Base Stable LP Hub.

Kowane aikin zagayowar rayuwa yana gudana a chain ɗaya ta hanyar AvanaTimelock na wannan chain. Ethereum da Base kowannensu yana da nasa timelock, multisig na gudanarwa, guardian, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore da keepers. Kasuwa ba ta taɓa ƙaura zuwa wani CDP Spoke ba.
An bayyana pools da ƙa'idodin jeri kansu a shafin pools da aka yarda da su:

a gajeren jinkiri, daga Registered kaɗai
Offboarding da Closed na ƙarshe ne. Babu aikin MarketRegistry da ke mayar da irin wannan kasuwa zuwa Active.
Ba a taɓa share kasuwa ba, saboda vault token ɗinta yana kasancewa a ɗaure da Spoke da pool ɗinta kuma matsayinta marasa bashi suna kasancewa masu iya cirewa.

Yanayin dakatarwar Hub yana aiki a saman yanayin kasuwar kanta, kuma a Base haka ma ƙofar sequencer. Circuit breakers ba yanayin zagayowar rayuwa ba ne: breaker da ya tashi yana dakatar da sabon aiki yayin da kasuwar ke kasancewa Active.
Ayyuka uku na timelock, kowanne a jinkiri na yau da kullum, suna kawo CDP Spoke, kasuwa da reserve na bashi cikin Avana.
Aiki
Abin da yake yi
deployCdpSpoke(p)

Bayan payload na Aave ya tura daidaitaccen Spoke da AaveOracle ɗinsa kuma ya yi masa rajista a Hub, yana rubuta Spoke tare da Hub na gidansa, haɗin AMM, matakin haɗari, AaveOracle da aiwatarwa, kuma yana tsayar da saitin liquidation da ake tsammani (ma'aunin lafiya na maƙasudi 1.10 da mafi ƙarancin kari 200 bps a matsayin jagorar Avana; Aave DAO ne ke yanke shawara). Yana revert sai dai idan an yi wa Spoke rajista a Avana Hub, babu CDP Spoke da ke wanzuwa tukuna ga wannan Hub, haɗi da mataki, kuma an tura LPVault na haɗin.
listCollateralMarket(def)

Yana tura vault token ta hanyar factory, yana ɗaure kasuwar zuwa LPVault na haɗin AMM tare da takamaiman kewayonta, kuma yana rubuta feeds, tushe na biyu, hanyoyin jiran aiki, binciken mai fitarwa, hanyoyin musaya zuwa kowace kadarar bashi, iyakoki da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jinginarwa. Kasuwar tana Registered.
enableDebtReserve(spoke, def)

Yana rubuta reserve na bashi tare da kadarorinsa da Hub da ke ba da kuɗi, yana bincika layin bashi idan aka kwatanta da rufewar Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke), yana bincika cewa kowace kasuwa a kan Spoke tana da hanyar musaya ta farko da ta ajiya zuwa cikin kadarar, yana bincika rayuwar liquidation da tushen flash, kuma yana kunna aro. Kadara da ba GHO ba tana fara samun nata DebtOracle.

Masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4 da Avana suna wallafa kunshin jeri: iyakoki da shaida ga kowace ƙa'idar jeri, iyakoki, mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jinginarwa, ma'aunin haɗarin pool, heartbeat da aka wallafa na kowane feed, hanyoyin jiran aiki da binciken mai fitarwa.
Masu aiki na Avana suna tura LPOracle na kasuwar, wanda dole ne ya shuka farashi Live a lokacin farawa, kuma suna ƙara buffer na lura na pool don rufe tagar TWAP a lokacin block na chain.

Multisig na gudanarwa yana tsara batch na timelock ɗaya a jinkiri na yau da kullum. A kasuwar farko ta Spoke yana haɗa rajistar Spoke, tsammanin liquidation da reserve na bashi na farko; sannan sababbin feeds, Collateral Factor na tokens, juriya da jerin tokens; turawar vault-token; rajistar kasuwa; sigogin kasuwar, iyakoki da mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jinginarwa; da hanyoyin musaya. Tsarawa a fili take kuma tana fara bitar kwanaki biyar; kowane mai soke zai iya soke batch ɗin.

Aave DAO yana aiwatar da payload na jeri: CDP Spoke da AaveOracle ɗinsa a kasuwar farko ta Spoke, reserves na bashi, matsayin flash-borrower, Coverage Spoke da aka ba da kuɗi, kadarar Hub tare da kuɗin ruwan kuɗi sifili, da reserve na vault-token tare da aro a kashe, karɓar hannun jari a kashe, kuɗin liquidation 0, babu reinvestment controller da LPOracle a matsayin tushen farashi.

Bayan jinkiri, kowa yana aiwatar da batch ɗin. MarketRegistry yana adana kasuwar a matsayin Registered kuma yana gudanar da kowane binciken jeri a kan chain. Masu aiki suna poke LPOracle kuma suna tabbatar da farashi Live.
Masu aiki suna gudanar da binciken saitin kai tsaye a wajen chain idan aka kwatanta da deployment manifest da aka amince da shi. Keepers suna ƙara kasuwar a yanayin lura kaɗai.
Multisig na gudanarwa yana tsara
a gajeren jinkiri; kowa yana aiwatar da shi.
Ana ƙirƙirar kasuwanni a kashe don kada wani aikin mai amfani ya isa ga kasuwar da ba a tabbatar da ɓangarenta na Aave ba.
activateMarket(marketId)
yana revert da
ActivationCheckFailed
Kasuwar tana Registered, kuma aiwatarwar CDP Spoke da reserves na bashi sun yi daidai da waɗanda aka rubuta.

Reserve na vault-token yana wanzuwa da decimals da suka dace, aro a kashe, karɓar hannun jari a kashe, ba a dakatar ko daskarar ba, kuɗin liquidation 0, da Collateral Factor sama da 0 kuma bai wuce ƙimar da ake tsammani ba.
Tushen farashin reserve shi ne LPOracle na kasuwar kuma LPOracle yana Live; tushen farashin kowane reserve na bashi ya yi daidai.
An jera kadarar vault-token ne kawai a CDP Spoke ɗinta, kowane draw cap a kanta 0 ne kuma hannayen jarin Hub daidai suke da kadarori.
Duka hanyoyin musaya biyu na kowane token na pool zuwa kowace kadarar bashi an yi musu rajista kuma suna aiki, kuma rashin daidaiton rayuwar liquidation yana riƙe.
Binciken drift na saiti bai sami komai ba.

Gajeren jinkiri ya isa saboda kowane filin kasuwa ban da masu gano reserve na Aave an tsayar da shi a lokacin rajista bayan cikakken bita, kuma kunnawa tana yin nasara ne kawai idan payload na Aave da aka aiwatar ya yi daidai da shi. Awanni 12 suna ba masu soke lokaci don dakatar da kunnawa da ke kama da ba daidai ba a wajen chain.
Aji
Jinkiri
Ayyukan zagayowar rayuwa
Na yau da kullum
Kwanaki 5 (iyakoki kwanaki 4 zuwa 5)

Rajistar Spoke, jeri na kasuwa, kunnawa da cire reserve na bashi, jeri na token, ma'anonin feed, sababbin tushen farashi da hanyoyin jiran aiki, sababbin hanyoyin musaya, kowane sassautawa, dawo da hanyar farashi, haɓakawa
Gajere
Awanni 12
Kunnawa, soke rajista, fara fitarwa, kowane tsaurarawa, kashewa ko dawo da hanyar musaya da aka amince da ita a baya, daskarewa, dakatarwa, tayar da breaker, sauya hanyar jiran aiki ta timelock
Nan take (guardians)
None

Daskarewa ko dakatar da application, daskarewar adireshi, tayar da breaker da sauya hanyar jiran aiki; kowanne yana dakatar da sabon aiki kawai ko yana maye gurbin hanya da wadda aka bita lokacin jeri
Gudanarwar Aave
Tsarin Aave na kansa
Collateral Factors, kari, collateral risk, add caps na Hub, draw caps na Spoke (layukan bashi), daskarewa da cire daskarewar reserve

Kowa zai iya aiwatar da aikin da ya shirya har zuwa kwanaki 14 bayan ya shirya; bayan haka yana ƙarewa kuma dole ne a sake gabatar da shi. Aiki yana ɗaukar gajeren jinkiri ne kawai idan kowane kira a cikinsa yana cikin jerin gajeren jinkiri, don haka sassautawa ɗaya tana sa duk batch ya jira jinkiri na yau da kullum.

Daskarar da kasuwa ita ce daskarewar Aave na reserve na vault-token ɗinta, wanda Aave Protocol Guardian (hanya ɗaya) ko Aave DAO ke tsayarwa. Tana mayar da kasuwa Active zuwa Frozen nan take; Aave DAO kaɗai ne ke cire daskarewar. RiskModule yana karanta alamar kuma yana ƙin jinginarwa cikin kasuwar da aro daga asusun da ke riƙe da ita, yayin da biyan bashi, cirewa da liquidation ke ci gaba. Avana ba shi da nasa daskarewar kasuwa; dakatar da sabon aiki a kasuwa ɗaya shi ne breaker na kasuwarta.
Fitarwa aikin timelock ne na awanni 12,
setMarketOffboarding(marketId)

, tare da daskarewar Aave na reserve na vault-token na kasuwar, wanda ke dakatar da sababbin jinginarwa da aro nan take. Biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe, cirewa tare da bashi da ba tare da bashi ba, da liquidation suna kasancewa a buɗe.
Sanarwa ta jama'a: aƙalla
offboardNoticeSeconds
, kwanaki 5, kafin mataki na farko na rufewa a hankali.
Mataki-mataki: bayan sanarwa, kowa zai iya kiran
stepWindDown(marketId)

ba fiye da sau ɗaya a rana ba. Kowane mataki yana rage liquidation threshold na reserve ta hanyar saitin mai canzawa na Aave, a madaidaiciyar hanya a cikin kwanaki 30, har zuwa 50% na ƙimar da aka jera. An riga an amince da matakan a cikin payload na Aave, don haka matakin ba ya buƙatar wata shawara.
Threshold na ƙarshe ba 0 ba ne, saboda 0 zai sa kowane mai aro ya cancanci liquidation a block ɗaya.

Ba a taɓa soke bashin da ke akwai ba kuma babu ikon tilasta rufewa. Matakin yana kawo ƙarshen rufewa a hankali ta hanyar sa kowane mai aro da ya rage ya biya bashi ko ya cancanci liquidation a threshold na ƙarshe.
Feeds na farashin kasuwar, hanyoyin musaya da aikin keeper suna ci gaba da aiki har zuwa rufewa.
LT(t) = LT₀ − ⌊(LT₀ − LT_final) × min(t, T) / T⌋

Misali: threshold da aka jera na 34% yana ƙarewa a 17%. A rana ta 12 threshold shi ne 34% − ⌊17% × 12 / 30⌋ = 27.2%. Asusu mai jingina $10,000 da bashi $2,000 yana da ma'aunin lafiya na 1.36 a rana ta 12 da 0.85 a ƙarshe, don haka yana biyan bashi ko a yi masa liquidation.
Idan jimillar bashin kowane asusu a kasuwar ta zama sifili, kowa yana kiran
closeMarket(marketId)
; yana revert da
MarketHasDebt
in ba haka ba. Kasuwar tana zama Closed kuma ayyukanta na oracle, hanyar musaya da keeper suna ƙarewa.

Matsayin da ba su da bashi suna kasancewa a riƙe har sai masu ajiyarsu sun cire su, ba tare da iyakar lokaci ba; cirewa ba tare da bashi ba ba ta karanta farashi. Rikodin da ba su da ƙididdiga suna kasancewa masu iya saki.

Kasuwar da aka rufe ba za ta iya sake buɗewa ba, kuma ba za a iya tura vault token na biyu ga Spoke, pool da kewayo ɗaya ba. Pool da kewayo ɗaya za su iya dawowa ne kawai a matsayin sabuwar kasuwa a wani CDP Spoke, ta hanyar cikakken bitar kwanaki biyar, tare da sabon vault token da ID na kasuwa.

Mayar da pool zuwa wani matakin haɗari haka yake: sabon jeri a CDP Spoke na matakin maƙasudi da fitar da tsohuwar kasuwa. Masu amfani suna ƙaura ta hanyar biyan bashi, cirewa da sake jinginarwa cikin sabon proxy.
Rajista da aka soke kafin kunnawa tana riƙe ID na kasuwarta a keɓe ga pool ɗinta. Jeri na gaba na wannan pool yana sake amfani da ID da vault token da ke akwai, wanda dole ne ya ambaci LPOracle ɗaya.
GHO shi ne reserve na bashi na farko na kowane CDP Spoke kuma yana riƙe tushen farashi tsayayye na $1 na Aave. Ana iya ƙara USDC, USDT ko WETH ga kowane Spoke da
enableDebtReserve
, kowanne ana ƙimanta shi da nasa DebtOracle.

Payload na Aave yana jera reserve kuma yana ba da kuɗi ga Coverage Spoke ɗinsa kafin batch na Avana ya aiwatar. Draw cap na CDP Spoke a kan kadarar yana tashi sama da 0 ne kawai bayan an ba da kuɗi ga Coverage Spoke kuma batch ɗin ya aiwatar.
Cire reserve na bashi (
removeDebtReserve

, jinkiri na yau da kullum) yana revert yayin da akwai wani bashi da aka ɗiba daga gare shi. Aave DAO yana fara sanya draw cap ɗinsa zuwa 0 kuma ya daskarar da shi, don haka masu aro suna biyan bashi a hankali yayin da biyan bashi da liquidation ke kasancewa a buɗe.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Base Stable LP Hub ba shi da CDP Spoke tukuna. Kasuwa 3 ita ce pool na USDC/USDT na Slipstream mai tick spacing 1 da takamaiman kewayon da aka tsayar a cikin kunshin jeri, tare da Collateral Factor na 31.2%. GHO shi ne reserve na bashi na farko, tare da GHO Coverage Spoke da aka ba da kuɗi zuwa GHO 24,000. Blocks na Base daƙiƙa 2 ne.
Masu aiki suna tura LPOracle na kasuwa 3, wanda ke shuka farashi Live na $2.00 ga kowane cikakken vault token, kuma suna ƙara buffer na lura na pool zuwa 901.

Rana ta 0: multisig na gudanarwa yana tsara batch ɗaya a jinkiri na yau da kullum na daƙiƙa 432,000 tare da rajistar Spoke, tsammanin liquidation (1.10 da 200 bps), reserve na bashi na GHO, turawar vault-token, jeri na kasuwa da sigoginta tare da mafi ƙarancin jinginarwa na $10. Calldata a fili take don bita.

Yayin jinkiri, mai aiwatarwa na Base na Aave DAO yana gudanar da payload na jeri: Spoke "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable", reserve na bashi na GHO, reserve na vault-token da GHO Coverage Spoke da aka ba da kuɗi.

Rana ta 5: kowa yana aiwatar da batch ɗin. Binciken rufewa yana wucewa ga draw cap na GHO 120,000 a rabon rufewa na 20% idan aka kwatanta da GHO 24,000. Vault token yana turuwa da decimals 6 kuma kasuwa 3 tana Registered; jinginarwa har yanzu tana revert.
Masu aiki suna poke LPOracle (Live) kuma suna gudanar da binciken saitin kai tsaye; keepers suna kallon kasuwa 3 a yanayin lura kaɗai.
Multisig yana tsara
activateMarket(3)
a gajeren jinkiri na daƙiƙa 43,200; kowa yana aiwatar da shi a rana ta 5.5 kuma kowane binciken daidaito yana wucewa.
Carol tana jinginar da matsayin Slipstream na $20,000: rikodi 1 cikin 16.

An kunna reserve na bashi na biyu, USDC, a jinkiri na yau da kullum tare da USDC Coverage Spoke da aka ba da kuɗi zuwa USDC 50,000. Draw cap na USDC 250,000 yana wucewa; 300,000 zai revert. Carol tana aron USDC 5,000; ma'aunin lafiyarta shi ne 20,000 × 0.312 / 5,000 = 1.248.
Fitarwa: multisig yana tsara
setMarketOffboarding(3)
a gajeren jinkiri kuma Aave Protocol Guardian yana daskarar da reserve. Sababbin jinginarwa da aro suna revert da
MarketOffboarding
; manhajar tana nuna ƙarshen sanarwa, daƙiƙa 432,000 daga baya.

Rufewa a hankali: bayan sanarwa, kowa yana tafiyar da matakin sau ɗaya a rana daga 31.2% zuwa 15.6%. A rana ta 11 threshold shi ne 25.48% kuma ma'aunin lafiyar Carol 1.0192; a rana ta 12 zai zama 24.96% da 0.9984. Tana biyan bashinta na USDC 5,000 a rana ta 11 kuma tana cire matsayinta ba tare da bashi ba.
Rufewa: yayin da kowane asusu ke bin bashi,
closeMarket(3)

yana revert. Da zarar kowane asusu ya biya bashi ko an yi masa liquidation, kowa yana kiran sa. Matsayin da ba su da bashi da aka bari a kasuwa 3 suna kasancewa masu iya cirewa ba tare da karanta farashi ba.

Sake jerawa: kasuwa 3 ba ta taɓa komawa Active. Idan pool ɗin dole ne ya dawo, ana yi wa sabon CDP Spoke rajista kuma ana jera pool da kewayo ɗaya a kansa ta hanyar cikakken bitar kwanaki biyar, wanda ke ba da sabon vault token da ID na kasuwa. Carol tana sake jinginarwa cikin sabon proxy.
Yanayin kasuwa, ayyukan turawa, jinkiri, matakin fitarwa, rufewa da sake jerawa.
