toc.title: Abubuwan da Suka Faru da Za a Yi wa Index

strings: Haɗe-haɗe

Yadda ake haɗawa da Avana: waɗanne kwangiloli za a kira a Ethereum da Base, daga ina adireshi ke fitowa, sassan da ke wajen chain, ƙa'idodin amincewa, ƙarshen lokaci da nonces, da abubuwan da suka faru da za a yi wa index.
Bayani
Kwangilolin da Za a Kira
Adireshi
Sassan da ke Wajen Chain
Asusu da Matsayi
Amincewa
Ƙarshen Lokaci da Nonces
Abubuwan da Suka Faru da Za a Yi wa Index
Shafukan Haɗi
Duk abin da wallet, manhaja, keeper ko indexer ke buƙata don yin aiki da kwangilolin Avana kai tsaye, ba tare da frontend na Avana ba.

Avana yana aiki a Ethereum da Base. Kowace chain tana da Avana Stable LP Hub da CDP Spoke ɗaya ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM: "Uniswap v3 Stable" ga matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" ga matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream da ba a yi stake ba a Base. Hubs da Spokes daidaitattun kwangilolin Aave V4 ne da ba a gyara ba waɗanda Aave DAO ke mallaka kuma ke saitawa; kwangilolin Avana suna kula da riƙo, ƙimantawa, ayyukan mai aro da liquidation a kewayensu.

Kowa zai iya kiran kwangilolin kai tsaye. Frontend na Avana da AppKit na zaɓi ne; biyan bashi, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, tattara kuɗaɗe da liquidation ba su taɓa dogara da su ba. Kwangilolin kowace chain daban suke: babu abin da ake rabawa tsakanin chains, kuma kowane aiki yana gudana ta hanyar timelock na wannan chain na kansa.
Kwangila
Wanda ke kiran sa
AaveAdapter
Masu aro, manhajoji, duk wanda ke biyan bashi a madadin mai aro

Kowane aikin mai aro: jinginarwa, sake ƙididdigewa, aro, biyan bashi, cirewa, cirewa na wani ɓangare, repay-all-and-withdraw, biyan bashi da jingina, tattara kuɗaɗe, sakin rikodi mara ƙididdiga. Ɗaya ga kowace chain.
LPVaultSwap
Keepers na Avana da aka amince da su; kowane adireshi da ba a daskarar ba ta hanyar wurin shiga mara izini
Liquidation da
liquidate
liquidatePermissionless
, tare da flash loan na kadarar bashi ko kuɗin mai kira
Lens
Manhajoji, keepers, sa ido
Ra'ayoyi da previews na karatu kaɗai; ba ya taɓa ba da izinin wani aiki
LPOracle, DebtOracle
Keepers, kowa
poke()
don adana yanayin farashi; ra'ayoyi don yanayi da shekaru
Position manager na Uniswap v3 ko Slipstream
Masu aro
Amincewar matsayi ga kowane token zuwa LPVault kafin jinginarwa, da ƙara ruwan kuɗi kafin sake ƙididdigewa

Kowace chain tana da nata turawa da nata tabbataccen deployment manifest. Kwangiloli masu iya haɓakawa suna riƙe adireshin proxy tsayayye ɗaya har abada, kuma ana tsayar da adireshin vault token da LPOracle na kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. Kada a taɓa ɗaukar adireshin kwangila daga tushe da ba a amince da shi ba; yi amfani da manifest ko jerin da aka wallafa.
An jera adireshin kwangiloli na kowace chain a shafin bayanin kwangiloli:
Kwangiloli
Sashi
Abin da yake yi
packages/protocol

Masu gina calldata ga kowane haɗin AMM da chain, waɗanda aka gina a cikin browser daga tabbataccen deployment manifest da aka haɗa. Yana rubuta adireshin Lens kuma yana zuwa da ABIs na kurakuran Aave na asali. Masu gina shi suna neman ainihin amincewar da aka jera a ƙasa kaɗai.
Keeper

Keepers na Avana suna poke kowane oracle bisa jadawali, suna rubuta keta breaker a kowane block, suna yin liquidation ga kowane asusu da ya cancanta ta amfani da preview na liquidation na Lens, suna biyan gas ɗinsu kuma suna rufe ƙananan giɓin sasantawa daga kuɗinsu.
Indexer
Ponder indexer yana adana abubuwan da suka faru kai tsaye a chain a cikin Postgres don manhajar: matsayi, bashi da ma'aunin lafiya.
Backend na manhaja
Yana adana bayanan manhaja, zaɓuɓɓuka da matsayin niyya. Ba ya taɓa bayar da maƙasudin ma'amala ko calldata, don haka backend da aka yi wa kutse ba zai iya karkatar da ma'amalar mai amfani ba.
Gwaje-gwaje sun rufe lambar wajen chain; kwangilolin da ke kan chain suna sake bincika kowane abin shigarwa, don haka babu wani sashe na wajen chain da zai iya ba da izinin wani aiki.
Kowane wallet yana samun PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa, wanda ake turawa a jinginarwarsa ta farko. Ana sanin adireshin proxy kafin turawa daga Lens ko ra'ayin
predictProxy
na Adapter.
Kowane proxy asusun Aave ne daban tare da nasa ma'aunin lafiya. Matsala a kasuwa ɗaya ba ta taɓa sa wata kasuwa ta wannan wallet ta cancanci liquidation ba.
Ana sanya wa matsayi suna ta mai gano haɗin AMM da maɓallin matsayi: ID na token ga Uniswap v3, da ID na token tare da ƙarnin position-manager a cikin babban byte ɗinsa ga Slipstream.
Kasuwa tana karɓar matsayin da kewayon tick ɗinsu ya yi daidai da na kasuwar daidai kaɗai.
Masu amfani suna ba da nau'ikan amincewa biyu kaɗai, kowanne don ainihin abin da ma'amala ɗaya ke buƙata:

Don jinginarwa, amincewar matsayi ɗaya daidai zuwa LPVault mara canzawa na wannan yarjejeniyar AMM: amincewar ERC-721 ko permit ga kowane token don Uniswap v3 da Slipstream, ko ainihin adadin LP-token ga yarjejeniyar hannun jari mai musanyawa.

Don biyan bashi, amincewa zuwa AaveAdapter na ainihin adadin biyan bashi a cikin kadarar bashi, ga asusun da ake biya. Ga repay-all ita ce ƙididdigar repay-all ta Lens; Adapter yana jawo ta gaba ɗaya kuma yana mayar da sauran a cikin kira ɗaya, yana barin allowance sifili.

Kada a taɓa amfani da amincewar operator ga duk tokens ko allowance mara iyaka. Kada a taɓa amincewa da RiskModule, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore, oracle, LPVaultSwap, hanyar musaya, tushen flash ko proxy. AaveAdapter shi ne kaɗai mai kashewa da mai amfani ke amincewa da shi ban da LPVaults marasa canzawa, kuma ainihin adadi yana iyakance abin da Adapter mai matsala zai iya jawowa zuwa wannan biyan bashi ɗaya.

Kowane wurin shiga na AaveAdapter da kowane liquidation suna ɗaukar ƙarshen lokaci kuma suna revert da zarar timestamp na block ya wuce shi. Previews na Lens suna ɗaukar ƙarshen lokaci ɗaya kuma suna ƙara rarar (tarin riba, ƙa'idar dust ta Aave) da ke kiyaye ma'amalar mai inganci har zuwa lokacin.
Kowane aro yana ambaton nonce na aro na yanzu na proxy. Adapter yana cinye shi, don haka ba za a iya maimaita ko sake tsara aro ba.

Aro, cirewa da cirewa na wani ɓangare suna ɗaukar mafi ƙarancin ma'aunin lafiya da mai kira ke zaɓa. Biyan bashi da jingina yana ɗaukar mafi ƙarancin adadi da mafi ƙarancin biyan bashi, kuma kowace ƙafar musaya tana kuma ɗauke da mafi ƙarancin fitarwa da aka samo daga oracle.
Babu mafi ƙarancin aro fiye da adadi da ba sifili ba kuma babu mafi ƙarancin bashi. Kowace jinginarwa dole ne ta kai aƙalla mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jinginarwa ta kasuwar ($10 a ƙaddamarwa).

Yadda LPOracle ke ƙimanta vault token ɗaya daga haɗuwar adalci ta matsayin a farashin Chainlink, yadda hanyoyi, tushe na biyu, binciken TWAP da ƙungiyar USD ke aiki, da yadda DebtOracle ke ƙimanta bashin da ba GHO ba.

LPOracle yana ƙimanta vault token na kasuwa ɗaya ga Aave; DebtOracle yana ƙimanta kowace kadarar bashi da ba GHO ba. Dukansu suna amfani da tabbatattun hanyoyin Chainlink kuma suna ba da rahoton yanayin farashi da kwangilolin Avana ke tilastawa.

Kasuwa ita ce chain ɗaya, yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya, pool ɗaya da takamaiman siffar matsayi ɗaya, tare da vault token ɗaya da reserve na jingina ɗaya a CDP Spoke ɗinta. Kowace kasuwa tana da nata proxy na LPOracle. Kowace yarjejeniyar AMM tana da aiwatarwar LPOracle ɗaya ga kowace chain, kuma kowace kasuwa ta wannan yarjejeniya a wannan chain proxy ne nata. A ƙaddamarwa wannan yana nufin aiwatarwa ɗaya ga Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da ɗaya ga Aerodrome Slipstream a Base.
LPOracle yana da matakai biyu:

Tushen yanayin farashi da bai dogara da AMM ba. Yana tabbatar da farashin Chainlink ga kowane token na kasuwar, yana zaɓar ƙididdiga ɗaya ga kowane token, yana gudanar da ƙa'idodin failover, yarjejeniya, sabuntuwa, tushe na biyu, sequencer da timer, kuma yana bayar da farashi mai taka tsantsan lokacin da ba za a iya amincewa da kasuwar ba.

Module na farashi ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM, wanda aka haɗa a cikin aiwatarwar wannan yarjejeniya. Yana ba da haɗuwar matsayin a jerin farashin oracle, binciken daidaiton AMM da binciken jeri. Haɗin AMM yana amfani da aikin haɗuwa ɗaya, don haka ƙimantawa da warwarewa sun yi daidai.

LPOracle yana yin ayyuka biyu. Ga Aave, yana mayar da ƙimar USD na cikakken vault token ɗaya da decimals 8, wanda AaveOracle na CDP Spoke ke karantawa don ma'aunin lafiya da girman ƙwacewa. Ga Avana, ra'ayoyinsa suna ba da rahoton yanayin farashi, timestamp na tushe da iyakokin shekaru na farashin da aka bayar, ko aro zai iya dogara da farashin, dakatarwar saɓani, tagar grace na murmurewa, farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa da checkpoint na kowace awa. RiskModule da LPVaultSwap suna tilasta ƙofofinsu daga waɗannan ra'ayoyi.

LPOracle ba ya amfani da ragi: duk daidaitawar haɗari tana cikin Collateral Factor na CDP Spoke. Ba ya ƙimanta bashi, tilasta ƙofofi, zaɓar feeds ko motsa tokens. Babu token, ETH ko amincewa da ke taɓa wucewa ta cikinsa.
An bayyana yanayin farashi huɗu da abin da kowannensu ke ba da dama a shafin yanayin farashi:
Yanayin Farashi

Farashin cikakken vault token ɗaya shi ne ƙimar tokens da matsayin zai riƙe idan farashin pool ya yi daidai da farashin da jerin farashin oracle ya nuna. Wannan ita ce haɗuwar adalci. Ita ce riƙo mafi arha da matsayin zai iya kaiwa: motsa farashin pool zai iya ƙara ƙimar abin da matsayin ke riƙe da shi a zahiri kaɗai, don haka magudin pool ba zai iya ƙara jingina ba kuma LPOracle ba ya taɓa buƙatar farashin spot na pool.
value = Σ amountᵢ(oracle price vector) × priceᵢ

Farashi su ne tabbatattun ƙididdigar Chainlink na kowane token, tare da kowane stable da aka ɗaura da USD an iyakance shi a $1.00 don ƙimantawa. Stable da ake ciniki sama da $1 ba ya sa jingina ta fi aminci, don haka ba a taɓa ƙididdige premium ɗin ba.
Ga concentrated liquidity, ana matse rabon farashin oracle zuwa kewayon tick na kasuwar kafin a lissafa adadin.
Kowane adadi ana zagaye shi ƙasa sannan a rage shi da raka'a ɗaya ta asali. Kowane rabo da tushen murabba'i suna zagaye ƙasa, a kan mai aro.

An cire kuɗaɗen da ba a tattara ba: tokens da ake bi, ƙaruwar kuɗi da duk wani kuɗin da AMM ke ajiye wa daban da matsayin ba su taɓa ƙirguwa ba, saboda mai wash trading zai iya ƙara su cikin ma'amala ɗaya.
Sakamakon yana da decimals 8 kuma aƙalla 1 ne. Farashin ba ya taɓa revert sai da kariyar out-of-gas kuma ba ya taɓa mayar da 0, saboda Aave yana ƙin farashi da ba tabbatacce ba.
Decimals na vault-token

Raka'ar tushe ɗaya ta vault-token raka'a ɗaya ce ta ma'aunin matsayi da haɗin AMM ke ƙididdigewa: ga Uniswap v3 da Slipstream, raka'a ɗaya ta ruwan kuɗi na takamaiman kewayon kasuwar. Ana tsayar da decimals lokacin jeri a matsayin ƙima mafi ƙanƙanta tsakanin 6 da 18 wadda cikakken token ɗaya ke da ƙimar aƙalla $1 a farashin jeri, don haka cikakken token yana da ƙima tsakanin $1 da $10. Jeri yana gazawa idan babu irin wannan ƙima.

Farashi

Module na farashin concentrated-liquidity yana hidimar kowace kasuwar Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da kowace kasuwar Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. Slipstream yana amfani da lissafin tick, farashin tushen murabba'i da ruwan kuɗi iri ɗaya, don haka ana raba module ɗin; karatun pool kaɗai ne ya bambanta, kuma module ɗin ba ya taɓa karanta yanayin spot na pool don ƙimantawa.

Ana mayar da farashin tokens biyu zuwa farashin tushen murabba'i na pool a lissafin 512-bit, ciki har da factor na decimals. Mayarwar ba ta taɓa revert; sakamako da ya wuce iyaka ana matse shi kuma ana ba da rahoton kasuwar a matsayin Drifting.

Ana matse farashin tushen murabba'i na oracle zuwa kewayo tsakanin tick na ƙasa da na sama na kasuwar. A wajen kewayonsa matsayi yana riƙe da token ɗaya kaɗai, kuma matsewar tana sa haɗuwar ta zama daidai wannan riƙon token ɗaya.
Adadin suna bin tsarin lissafin liquidity-amount na Uniswap a farashin da aka matse, suna zagaye ƙasa a kowane mataki.

Idan matsewar ta canza farashin, rabon oracle ya bar kewayon, wanda ga ma'auratan stable yana nufin token ya rasa ɗaurinsa (depeg). Kasuwar tana Drifting tare da dalilin price-clamped: sababbin jinginarwa da sabon bashi suna tsayawa, ƙarin jingina da liquidation suna ci gaba.

Misali: USDC/USDT a kewayon −100 zuwa 100 (kusan ±1%), decimals 9. USDT ya rasa ɗaurinsa zuwa $0.952 yayin da USDC ke $1. Rabon yana sama da kewayon, don haka cikakken token ɗaya yana riƙe da USDC 0 da USDT na asali 9,999,541 kuma ana ƙimanta shi a $9.52. Ba tare da matsewa ba, tsarin lissafi ɗaya zai ba da USDT na asali 29,887,349, wanda aka ƙimanta a $28.45, sau 2.99 na ainihin riƙo.

LPPriceMath laburare ne na ciki ba tare da kira na waje ba kuma ba tare da ma'aji ba. Yana riƙe da tsantsar lissafin hanyar farashi kuma an haɗa shi a cikin kowace aiwatarwar LPOracle da DebtOracle, don haka kowane tsarin lissafi yana daidai da aiki ɗaya da samfurin tabbatarwa ɗaya. Oracles suna kiran sa da ƙimomin da suka riga suka tabbatar.

Ƙafa ita ce karatun aggregator ɗaya na Chainlink ta hanyar daidaitaccen proxy ɗinsa. Hanya ƙafa ɗaya ce (TOKEN/USD) ko ƙafa biyu da aka ninka (TOKEN/X × X/USD). Kowane token da aka jera yana da hanyoyi uku, waɗanda aka rubuta a cikin MarketRegistry lokacin jeri a ƙarƙashin bincike iri ɗaya:
Hanya
Rawa
Ta farko
Feed na Chainlink TOKEN/USD kai tsaye na token. Ana amfani da shi duk lokacin da yake da inganci.
Ta dabam

Hanya mai zaman kanta da ba ta raba aggregator da ta farko. Ana amfani da ita kai tsaye lokacin da ta farko ba ta da inganci, ana sake kimanta ta a kowane karatu ba tare da ma'amala, matsayi ko alama da aka adana ba. Ba ta taɓa ɗauka ɗauri ba, kamar ƙimanta USDT a matsayin USDT/USDC × $1.
Ta jiran aiki

Hanya ta uku da guardian zai iya sanya ta a madadin ta farko ko ta dabam nan take. Ta wuce kowane binciken jeri na matsayin da take maye gurbinsa, don haka guardian zai iya zaɓa ne kawai daga cikin hanyoyin da aka bita.
Ingancin ƙafa

Ana karanta kowace ƙafa da static call a cikin try/catch da takamaiman adadin gas. Ƙafa tana da inganci ne kawai idan decimals ɗinta sun yi daidai da decimals da aka ɗaure lokacin jeri, amsarta tana tsakanin mafi ƙanƙanta da matsakaicin amsoshin da aka ɗaure, timestamp ɗinta ba sifili ba ne kuma ba na gaba ba ne, shekarunta suna cikin iyakar shekarun ƙafar, kuma amsarta da aka daidaita aƙalla 1 ce. Ƙafa da ta gaza gwajin shekaru kaɗai Stale ce; kowace gazawa ta daban Invalid ce ko Error. Hanya tana da inganci ne kawai idan duk ƙafafunta suna da inganci.
Binciken yarjejeniya
Idan duka hanyoyi biyu na token suna da inganci, dole ne su yarda a cikin juriyar token T, a basis points, ana kwatanta su a matsayin cikakkun lambobi ba tare da rabo ba:
|primary − alternate| × 10,000 ≤ T × min(primary, alternate)

Juriyar dole ne ta kai aƙalla iyakokin karkacewar kowace ƙafa a duka hanyoyi biyu tare da rarar 50 bps, don haka hanyoyi masu gaskiya ba sa taɓa saɓani. Idan binciken ya gaza, kasuwar tana Drifting kuma ƙididdigar tana kasancewa ta farko. Idan hanya ɗaya kaɗai ke da inganci, babu binciken yarjejeniya da ke gudana.
Misali: tare da T = 225 bps, ta farko ta $1.0001 da ta dabam ta $0.9990 sun yarda (1.1 × 10⁹ ≤ 2.248 × 10¹⁰). Tare da ta dabam a $0.9750 ba su yarda ba (2.51 × 10¹⁰ > 2.194 × 10¹⁰).
Ƙa'idodin zaman kai lokacin jeri
Hanyoyin farko da na dabam na token ba sa raba aggregator.
Babu tokens biyu na kasuwa da ke raba aggregator a hanyoyinsu na dabam, don haka feed na tsakiya ɗaya ba zai iya motsa kowane token lokaci guda ba.
Tushe na biyu na kowane token ba ya raba aggregator da kowace daga cikin hanyoyinsa.
Kowace hanya tana kasancewa cikin iyakokin amsarta da aka ɗaure da cikin $10,000 ga kowane token, iyakar overflow.

Feed na Chainlink yana wallafa sabon zagaye lokacin da amsarsa ta motsa da iyakar karkacewarsa ko lokacin da heartbeat ɗinsa ya wuce. Don haka feed da har yanzu ke aiki ba ya taɓa tsufa fiye da heartbeat ɗinsa tare da jinkirin wallafa. Iyakar shekarun kowace ƙafa ita ce heartbeat ɗinta da aka wallafa, wanda aka rubuta lokacin jeri, tare da rarar heartbeat na chain ta daƙiƙa 1,800 a Ethereum da a Base.
feedMaxAge = feedHeartbeat + heartbeatMargin

Feed na stablecoin mai natsuwa yana tsufa bisa doka har zuwa heartbeat ɗinsa na awanni 23 ko 24. Amsar USDC/USD mai shekarun awanni 20 sabuwa ce; aro a kanta kuma yana buƙatar tushe na biyu ya yarda. Babu wata iyakar heartbeat ta daban ga hanyoyin farko, saboda binciken yarjejeniya da tushe na biyu suna iyakance abin da shekarun feed za su iya ɓoyewa.

Yayin da ake ƙimanta token daga hanyarsa ta dabam, ana riƙe kowace ƙafa ta dabam zuwa shekarun aronta har ma ga liquidation. Bayan haka, ana toshe ƙwacewar kasuwar kamar tana Cached yayin da kasuwar ke kasancewa Live.

Oracle yana ba da rahoton ƙarshen lokacin farashin da aka bayar a matsayin shekaru dangane da abin shigarwarsa mafi tsufa, don haka ƙafar stablecoin mai jinkiri da ƙafar ETH/USD mai sauri a kasuwa ɗaya kowacce ana riƙe ta zuwa nata saurin.

Ana amincewa da feed da karkacewa ke tayarwa har zuwa rana ɗaya tsakanin zagaye, don haka aro bai kamata ya dogara da hanyar sadarwar oracle ɗaya kaɗai ba. Kowane token yana da tushe na biyu mai zaman kansa: aggregator na wata hanyar sadarwar oracle, ko farashin da aka auna da lokaci na zurfaffen pool wanda ba pool na kasuwar kanta ba, wanda aka ninka da tabbatacciyar ƙididdigar token na tunani. Ana tabbatar da token lokacin da tushe na biyu yake da inganci kuma ya yarda da ƙididdigar token a cikin juriyarsa, wadda ba ta wuce 500 bps ba.
borrowAllowed = (state == Live) ∧ sequencerReady ∧ every token confirmed ∧ (now − servedUpdatedAt ≤ borrowPriceMaxAge)
Aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi suna buƙatar wannan alama ga kasuwar asusun da ga DebtOracle na reserve na bashi da aka aro.

Tushe na biyu ba ya taɓa zama ƙofa ga liquidation kuma ba ya taɓa canza yanayi, farashin da aka bayar ko kowane timer, don haka tushe na biyu da ya lalace zai iya dakatar da aro amma ba ya taɓa kare asusu marar lafiya.
Kowane token zai iya rubuta tushe na biyu na jiran aiki. Kowane guardian zai iya sauyawa zuwa gare shi nan take; komawa baya yana bi ta timelock.
Misali: juriya 100 bps, ƙididdiga $1.0002. Tushe na biyu na $0.9940 yana tabbatar da token; $0.9890 ba ya tabbatarwa, kuma aro yana tsayawa yayin da kasuwar ke kasancewa Live.

Farashin pool da aka auna da lokaci bincike ne mai zaman kansa a kan Chainlink. Yana zama ƙofa ga farashin kuma ba ya taɓa ciyar da shi. Binciken yana karanta pool na kasuwar kansa kaɗai, wanda aka tsayar lokacin jeri, ta tarihin lurarsa a cikin taga W.
Ana lissafa tick na tunani daga ƙididdigar Chainlink da ba a iyakance ba. Ana zagaye matsakaicin tick a cikin tagar zuwa korau mara iyaka.

Binciken yana wucewa lokacin da ticks biyu suka bambanta da ba fiye da juriyar τ ba. Tick ɗaya matakin farashi ne na 1.0001, kusan 1 bp. Juriyar ƙaddamarwa ita ce ticks 50; ba za a taɓa sanya ta ƙasa da 10 ba.
Bincike da ya gaza, ko karatun lura da ke revert ko ba zai iya rufe tagar ba, yana sa kasuwar ta zama Drifting. Babu ra'ayin da ke revert saboda haka.
Buffer na lura ga kowace chain

Pool yana rubuta lura ba fiye da ɗaya ba a kowane block, don haka maharin da ke musayar dust a kowane block zai iya rage tsawon lokacin buffer. Dole ne pool ya riƙe isassun lura don rufe tagar a lokacin block na chain:

Avana yana ƙara observation cardinality na pool lokacin jeri kuma yana biyan kuɗinsa, a cikin ma'amaloli da yawa idan ana buƙata. Ƙimar Ethereum da aka yi amfani da ita a Base za ta rufe daƙiƙa 300 kaɗai.

Idan kowane token ya motsa tare, ta hanyar kuskuren feed na common-mode ko depeg mai alaƙa, rabon pool da binciken yarjejeniya na iya bayyana kamar na yau da kullum. Ƙungiyar USD tana kama matakin kai tsaye. Tana aiki ga kasuwannin da duk tokens ɗinsu stables ne da aka ɗaura da USD, wanda ya haɗa da kowace kasuwar Stable LP Hub; sauran kasuwanni suna amfani da 0 da matsakaicin ƙima, don haka gwajin koyaushe yana wucewa.
Ƙungiyar ita ce 0.90 zuwa 1.02 a ƙaddamarwa, ana gwada ta a kan matsakaicin geometric na farashin tokens.
Ana gwada iyaka ta ƙasa a kan ƙididdigar da ba a iyakance ba, saboda motsi na common-mode zuwa ƙasa shi ne dalilin wanzuwar ƙungiyar.
Ana gwada iyaka ta sama a kan farashin da aka iyakance a $1, don haka kasuwannin GHO suna kasancewa Live yayin da ake cinikin GHO a premium.

Keta tana sa kasuwar ta zama Drifting. Tana toshe sabon aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi; jinginarwa, biyan bashi da liquidation suna ci gaba, liquidation yayin da duka hanyoyi biyu na kowane token sababbi ne kuma sun yarda.

Misali: GHO a $1.047 da USDC a $1.00 suna cikin ƙungiya, saboda farashin da aka iyakance suna ba da 1.00 idan aka kwatanta da iyaka ta sama ta 1.0404; idan an gwada ba tare da iyakancewa ba, da sun keta. Duka tokens a $0.89 suna ba da 0.7921 idan aka kwatanta da iyaka ta ƙasa ta 0.81, don haka kasuwar tana Drifting.
Kowace yarjejeniyar AMM tana da iyakar canjin ƙididdiga ta kowane block,

, wadda aka tsayar ga kowace kasuwa (100 bps, 1%, a ƙaddamarwa). Idan poke ya lissafa farashi da ya bambanta da farashin da aka karɓa wanda aka adana a block ɗaya da fiye da iyakar, LPOracle ba ya karɓar sa. Yana fitar da abin da ya faru na capped kuma yana bayar da kasuwar a matsayin Cached ga wannan block; block na gaba da har yanzu ke lissafa sabon farashin yana karɓar sa.

Misali: farashin da aka karɓa $2.10. Ana ƙin ƙididdigar $2.13 a block ɗaya (3 × 10¹⁰ > 2.1 × 10¹⁰); ana karɓar $2.11. Motsi na block ɗaya ba ya taɓa kaiwa ga ƙarfin aro, kuma ana karɓar motsi na gaske block ɗaya daga baya.
Ra'ayoyi suna lissafa yanayi a kowane karatu.

Abin da poke ke adanawa
Farashin da aka karɓa, kawai lokacin da kasuwar ke Live kuma abubuwan shigarwarta sun fi sabuwa fiye da farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa. Sake karanta zagaye iri ɗaya ba ya taɓa sabunta timestamp.

Checkpoint: kwafin farashin da aka karɓa, wanda ake ɗauka ba fiye da sau ɗaya a kowace awa ba.
Waɗanda ke poke
Collateralization yana poke kasuwar da aka jinginar kafin kowane binciken jinginarwa.
RiskModule yana poke kasuwar asusun da kowane DebtOracle da ba na GHO ba na asusun kafin aro ko cirewa tare da bashi.
LPVaultSwap yana poke kasuwar jingina da debt oracles na asusun da yake yi wa liquidation.

Keepers suna poke kowane LPOracle da DebtOracle aƙalla sau ɗaya a kowace awa da sau ɗaya a kowane heartbeat na ƙafa mafi sauri da ke aiki, a kowane block yayin da kasuwa ba Live ba ce, da kuma a block da ke biye da sauyawa zuwa jiran aiki, dawowa ko canjin sequencer.
Biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba ba sa taɓa karantawa ko poke oracle.
Kariyar gas

Kowane karatu na waje yana samun takamaiman adadin gas: 50,000 ga feed, 100,000 ga karatun pool ko module na farashi, 40,000 ga kiran registry, store ko token. Kafin kowane karatu oracle yana bincika cewa isasshen gas ya rage don tura cikakken adadin kuma yana revert da
InsufficientGas
in ba haka ba. Don haka mai kira da ke zaɓar iyakar gas ta ma'amalar ba zai iya sa feed mai lafiya ya bayyana kamar ya gaza ba.

Sa ido yana kwatanta farashin da aka bayar da checkpoint daga awanni biyu na ƙarshe kuma yana faɗakarwa idan ya yi ƙasa da 3%. Faɗuwar farashi faɗakarwa ce ga guardians kaɗai, ba ta taɓa zama tayarwa a kan chain ba.
A Base, kowane LPOracle, DebtOracle da RiskModule suna karanta feed na Chainlink L2 sequencer-uptime
tare da lokacin grace na daƙiƙa 3,600. Ethereum ba shi da feed na sequencer, kuma a can ana ɗaukar sequencer a matsayin a shirye koyaushe.

Ana ƙimanta GHO da tushen tsayayye na $1 na Aave kuma ba shi da DebtOracle. Kowace wata kadarar bashi (USDC, USDT ko WETH, da aka kunna ga kowane CDP Spoke) tana da proxy na DebtOracle ɗaya kacal ga kowace chain, wanda ake amfani da shi a matsayin tushen farashin Aave na reserve na wannan kadara a kowane CDP Spoke na chain da ke ba da ita a aro. Yana amfani da ƙa'idodin ƙafa, hanya, failover, yarjejeniya, sabuntuwa, tushe na biyu, sequencer da timer iri ɗaya ga token ɗaya, ba tare da pool, binciken daidaito, ƙungiyar USD ko iyakar $1 ba: kadarar bashi da ke sama da $1 ana ƙimanta ta sama da $1.
Farashin bashi da ba za a iya amincewa da shi ba ba ya taɓa kasancewa ƙasa da farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa, don haka zai iya rage ma'aunin lafiya ne kawai:

Kowane LPOracle da DebtOracle UUPS proxy ne. Matsayin admin ɗinsa timelock na Avana na chain kaɗai ne zai iya riƙe su, kuma kowane haɓakawa yana jiran jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5 kuma ana iya soke shi yayin da yake cikin layi.

Adireshin LPOracle na kasuwa yana kasancewa tushen farashin Aave da oracle na vault token a tsawon rayuwar kasuwar. Sabon samfurin farashi ko gyara haɓakawa ne na wannan proxy, ba sabon adireshi ba. Idan tushen farashin Aave dole ne ya canza, payload na Aave yana aiwatarwa ne kawai tare da aikin timelock na Avana da ya dace, kuma liquidation tana ci gaba da gudana a kan yanayin LPOracle na kansa a halin yanzu.
Sababbin tushen farashi da kowane canji ga lissafin farashi suna ɗaukar jinkiri na yau da kullum. Tsaurara juriya ko rage shekarun aro yana ɗaukar gajeren jinkiri na awanni 12.
Canje-canjen hanya biyu kaɗai ne ke aiki ba tare da jinkiri ba: failover ta atomatik zuwa ta dabam, da sauyawar guardian zuwa hanyar jiran aiki da aka rubuta lokacin jeri.
Babu matsayin da zai iya tura farashi ko tsayar da timer. Farashin da aka karɓa da kowane timer suna canzawa ne kawai ta hanyar farawa da pokes.
Lokacin jeri, farawa tana buƙatar kowane binciken saiti ya wuce da farashi Live, wanda take shukawa a matsayin farashi na farko da aka karɓa.
Yadda LPOracle ke ƙimanta vault tokens da yadda DebtOracle ke ƙimanta bashin da ba GHO ba.

Misali: Ƙarewar Oracle

LPOracle na kowace kasuwa yana ba da rahoton ɗaya daga cikin yanayi huɗu a kowane karatu. Yanayin ne ke yanke abin da asusun kasuwar zai iya yi da ko za a iya ƙwace kasuwar; biyan bashi da fita ba tare da bashi ba suna aiki a kowane yanayi.

LPOracle yana ba da rahoton yanayi ɗaya kacal, a cikin ƙaruwar tsanani: Live, Drifting, Cached, Expired. Ana lissafa yanayin a kowane karatu daga bayanan feed da pool na yanzu tare da wasu timers da aka adana, ba tare da hysteresis ba. Ana ba da rahoton alamar aro, sakamakon tushe na biyu da matsayin sequencer kusa da yanayin kuma ba sa taɓa canza shi.

LPOracle yana ba da rahoto ne kawai. RiskModule yana tilasta ƙofofin ɓangaren aro da jinginarwa, kuma LPVaultSwap yana tilasta ƙofofin liquidation. Kowane wallet yana da PositionProxy ɗaya da asusun Aave ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa, don haka yanayin kasuwa yana yanke ko wannan asusu zai iya aro da ko za a iya ƙwace wannan kasuwa; sauran kasuwannin wannan wallet ba sa shafuwa.

Farashin da ba za a iya amincewa da shi ba yana sa asusu ya fi sauƙin liquidation ne kawai, ba ya taɓa sa ya fi wahala: ana bayar da jingina a mafi yawa a farashinta na ƙarshe da aka karɓa kuma bashi aƙalla a farashinsa na ƙarshe da aka karɓa. Kasuwar da ake shakkar farashinta ba a taɓa ƙwace ta a wannan farashi ba.
An bayyana ƙimantawa, hanyoyi da binciken da ke bayan kowane yanayi a shafin price oracles:
Oracle na Farashi

Kowane token yana da sabuwar hanyar Chainlink ta farko ko ta dabam mai inganci kuma babu yanayin Drifting da ke riƙe. Kasuwar da tokens ɗinta ke amfani da hanyoyinsu na dabam har yanzu Live ce; ana ba da rahoton ta dabam a matsayin dalili na bayani. Farashin da aka bayar shi ne sabon farashi.

Live kaɗai bai isa a yi aro ba. Aro yana kuma buƙatar tushe na biyu na kowane token ya yarda, sequencer ya kasance a shirye a Base kuma farashin da aka bayar ya kasance cikin shekarun aronsa. Idan tushe na biyu ya saɓa ko ba za a iya karanta shi ba, kasuwar tana kasancewa Live kuma jinginarwa da liquidation suna ci gaba, amma aro da cirewa tare da bashi suna tsayawa.
Kasuwar ba ta gaza ba, amma ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan yanayi yana riƙe:
Dalili
Dalili
Bayanai

Hanyoyin farko da na dabam na token duka sababbi ne kuma sun bambanta fiye da juriyar yarjejeniya
Yana fara dakatarwar saɓani; ƙwacewar wannan kasuwa tana jira

Matakin USD na kasuwar stable yana wajen 0.90 zuwa 1.02
Ba ya taɓa toshe jinginarwa kuma ba ya taɓa dakatar da liquidation

Yana toshe sababbin jinginarwa

PRICE_CLAMPED
Rabon farashin oracle yana wajen kewayon tick na kasuwar
Yana toshe sababbin jinginarwa; ana ƙimanta matsayin a matsayin riƙonsa na token ɗaya

Yayin Drifting, kasuwar tana bayar da mafi ƙanƙanta daga cikin sabon farashi da farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa; yayin saɓani tana bayar da farashin da aka gina daga ƙananan hanyoyin kowane token, wanda bai wuce farashin da aka karɓa ba. Aro da cirewa tare da bashi an toshe su; ƙarin jingina, biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna kasancewa a buɗe.
Kasuwar ta gaza: wani token ba shi da hanya mai inganci, ko karatun saiti, hanya, feed, module na farashi ko decimals na token ya gaza, ko ana riƙe da kulle na reentrancy na pool. Na
cachedWindow

(awa 1 a ƙaddamarwa) bayan karatu na farko da ya gaza, kasuwar tana bayar da farashinta na ƙarshe da aka karɓa tare da timestamp na tushensa na asali. Sake karanta zagaye iri ɗaya ba ya taɓa sabunta wannan timestamp.

Tagar tana farawa lokacin da karatu suka fara gazawa a zahiri, ba a zagaye na ƙarshe ba kuma ba a poke na farko bayan gazawar ba. Ga feed da ya tsufa, ana lissafa farkon daga timestamps na feed ɗin kansa: daƙiƙa ta farko bayan iyakar shekarun hanya ta ƙarshe daga cikin hanyoyinsa da ta tsufa.

Aro, cirewa tare da bashi, sababbin jinginarwa da ƙarin jingina suna tsayawa. Ba za a iya ƙwace kasuwar ba. Sauran reserves na asusun suna kasancewa masu iya liquidation, tare da wannan kasuwa a farashinta na ƙarshe da aka karɓa. Iyakar awa 1 a kan Cached tana hana zagaye ɗaya da ya yi jinkiri ya koma liquidation mai yawa yayin da har yanzu take iyakance tsawon lokacin da ake amfani da farashi da ya tsufa.
Bayan

na Cached kasuwar tana Expired. Tana bayar da 1: raka'a ɗaya ta 10⁻⁸ USD ga kowane cikakken vault token, farashi mafi ƙanƙanta tabbatacce, don haka Aave yana ƙirga jinginar a matsayin mai ƙima kusan sifili. Ƙimar ba ta taɓa revert kuma ba ta taɓa zama 0 ba, don haka Aave yana ci gaba da ƙimanta matsayi kuma biyan bashi da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna ci gaba da aiki.
Avana ba ya taɓa ƙwace kasuwar da ke Expired, don haka ƙimar 1 tana rage ma'aunin lafiya na asusun ne kawai kuma ba ta taɓa tsayar da girman ƙwacewa.
Ƙimantawar Avana na kansa suna ci gaba da amfani da farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa: iyakoki, mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jinginarwa, adadin dawowa na ƙarin jingina na ceto da previews na Lens.
Kadarar bashi da ba GHO ba wadda DebtOracle ɗinta ke Expired ana bayar da ita a farashinta na ƙarshe da aka karɓa da aka ƙara da
debtStressRiseBps
, don haka bashin da ya tsufa yana ƙirguwa sama, ba ƙasa ba.
Ana tsayar da latch na Expired ne kawai daga timestamps na tushen Chainlink, ba a taɓa tsayar da shi daga kuskure da aka kama, karatun saiti da ya gaza ko ƙarancin gas ba.

Farashin ƙaramar hanya shi ne $1.97483855, don haka kasuwar tana bayar da wannan. Idan kasuwar ta kasance Cached da za ta bayar da $1.99980000; da zarar Expired, 1. Biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, cirewa na wani ɓangare ba tare da bashi ba da sakin rikodi mara ƙididdiga suna buɗe a kowane yanayi, saboda babu ɗaya daga cikinsu da ke karantawa ko poke oracle. Cirewa tare da bashi ya haɗa da cirewa na wani ɓangare tare da bashi da biyan bashi da jingina. Cikakken matrix, tare da yanayin dakatarwa, breakers da alamun ɓangaren Aave, yana kan shafukan tsaro.
Poke na farko da ya ga hanyoyi biyu sababbi na token sun saɓa yana adana wannan lokaci kuma yana fitar da

Idan hanyoyi har yanzu sun saɓa bayan dakatarwar, hanya ɗaya ba daidai ba ce. Ana ɗaukar kasuwar a matsayin Expired don ƙwacewarta har sai poke ya ga kowane token ya yarda, guardian ya sauya matsayin da ke da matsala zuwa hanyarsa ta jiran aiki, ko gyara ya aiwatar ta hanyar timelock.
A halin yanzu kasuwar tana ƙirguwa a ƙananan hanyoyinta, don haka saɓanin zai iya sa asusun ya bayyana ba shi da lafiya sosai ne kawai, kuma biyan bashi da ƙarin jingina suna kasancewa a buɗe.
Babu tagar grace da ke biye da saɓani, saboda ƙarin jingina da biyan bashi sun kasance a buɗe a duk tsawon lokacin.

graceHealthFactor

(0.95 a ƙaddamarwa, ba ƙasa da 0.90 ba). Bayan tagar, kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da 1.00 yana sake cancantar liquidation. Masu aro suna samun lokaci don biyan bashi ko ƙara jingina a farashin da aka dawo da shi kafin liquidations na yau da kullum su ci gaba.
Kowace katsewa tana fara tagar grace ba fiye da ɗaya ba.

Ana sake gina lokacin murmurewa daga timestamps na zagayen Chainlink na kansa, don haka katsewar da ta fara kuma ta ƙare tsakanin pokes biyu har yanzu tana buɗe tagar grace, kuma babu mai kira da zai iya ƙirƙirar ta ta ƙarya.
Idan zagayen murmurewa shi ne na farko na sabon phase na aggregator na Chainlink, ana karanta zagayen da ya gabata daga aggregator na phase da ya gabata.
Tagar ba ta taɓa farawa kafin murmurewa: ba tare da shaidar zagaye mai amfani ba tana farawa a sabon abin shigarwa na sabon farashi, kuma bayan sauyawa zuwa jiran aiki a poke da ya lura da sauyawar.
A Base, feed na sequencer-uptime yana ƙara yanayi biyu da ke aiki a saman kowane yanayin farashi. Ethereum ba shi da ƙofar sequencer.

Down: ma'amalolin da aka tilasta daga L1 kaɗai ke aiwatarwa, a kan farashi da ka iya kasancewa sun tsufa da awanni. Aro, cirewa tare da bashi, biyan bashi da jingina, jinginarwa ta sabon asusu da liquidation suna tsayawa. Biyan bashi, ƙarin jingina tare da sabon farashi, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba da tattara kuɗaɗe suna ci gaba da aiki, ciki har da ta L1.
Grace: na daƙiƙa 3,600 bayan sequencer ya sake farawa, aro yana kasancewa a rufe kuma asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95 kaɗai ne za a iya yi musu liquidation.

Misali: sequencer ya tsaya a 09:40; aro da aka tilasta daga L1 yana revert, biyan bashi da aka tilasta daga L1 yana gudana. Ya sake farawa a 10:00:00 kuma ƙofar tana cikin grace har zuwa 11:00:00. A 10:20 asusu a ma'aunin lafiya 0.9997 ba za a iya yi masa liquidation ba; bayan 11:00:00 za a iya, kuma aro yana sake buɗewa.

Kowane token da aka jera yana rubuta hanyar jiran aiki da ta wuce, lokacin jeri, kowane binciken matsayin da za ta iya maye gurbinsa. Idan feed ya gaza ko hanyoyi biyu suka saɓa, ƙwacewar kasuwar tana jiran farashi mai amfani; gyara na jinkiri na yau da kullum zai ɗauki aƙalla kwanaki biyar, fiye da tagar awanni 48 da aka tsara iyakoki dominta. Hanyar jiran aiki tana ba guardian damar kawo ƙarshen katsewar cikin mintuna ba tare da zaɓar farashin da ba a bita ba.

Sauyawa ba ta rubuta yanayin oracle. Kowane oracle da ke karanta token yana ɗaukar sabuwar hanyar a kimantawarsa ta gaba, yana sake fara timer na saɓaninsa kuma yana riƙe timer na gazawarsa. Sauyawa ba ta taɓa tilasta Live: hanyar jiran aiki tana ƙarƙashin binciken sabuntuwa, inganci da yarjejeniya iri ɗaya, kuma hanyar jiran aiki da ta tsufa ko ta saɓa tana barin kasuwar inda take.
Tushen tsayayye na $1 na GHO ba ya taɓa gazawa. DebtOracle na kowace kadarar bashi da ba GHO ba yana da yanayi huɗu, timers, tagar grace da hanyar jiran aiki iri ɗaya da na kasuwa.

LPVaultSwap yana biyan wannan reserve na bashi ne kawai yayin da DebtOracle ɗinsa ke Live kuma cikin shekarun liquidation ɗinsa; sauran reserves na bashi na asusun har yanzu ana iya biyan su a kan sabuwar jingina.
Yayin tagar grace ta debt-oracle, LPVaultSwap yana amfani da ma'aunin lafiya na grace ga kowane asusu da ke da bashi a cikin wannan kadara.

P-02 yana rufe gazawar oracle, tsufa, saɓani da magudi. Sa ido yana kiran ma'aikacin da ke bakin aiki lokacin da kasuwa ke Cached ko Expired, lokacin da saɓani ya fara (da kuma mintuna 30 kafin dakatarwar ta ƙare), da kan shekarun ƙafa da feed na bashi.
Gano ƙafa da hanyar da ke gazawa daga yanayin farashin oracle.
Idan hanyar jiran aiki ta token sabuwa ce kuma ta yarda da hanya mai lafiya, guardian yana sauya matsayin da ke gazawa zuwa gare ta.
Idan hanyar jiran aiki ita ma ta gaza, guardian yana tayar da breaker na kasuwa. Ƙwacewar kasuwar kanta tana jira yayin da keepers ke ci gaba da yin liquidation ga sababbin reserves.
Ga feed na bashi da ke gazawa, matakai iri ɗaya suna aiki ga DebtOracle, tare da breaker na bashi idan hanyar jiran aiki ta gaza.

Idan tushe na biyu kaɗai ya gaza ko ya saɓa, don haka aro ya tsaya yayin da farashi ke kasancewa Live, guardian yana sauyawa zuwa tushe na biyu na jiran aiki da zarar ya yarda da farashin da aka bayar.
Multisig na gudanarwa yana shirya tushe na dindindin a matsayin aikin tushen farashi na jinkiri na yau da kullum.

Murmurewa: keepers suna poke har sai kasuwar ta zama Live, tagar grace tana aiki ga kowane asusu, ana dawo da hanyar da aka jera a jinkiri na yau da kullum da zarar ta sami lafiya, kuma ana sake saita breaker na hannu da zarar kasuwar ta kasance Live na tagar cached ɗaya.
Feed na stablecoin na awanni 24 da bai sabunta ba na awanni 20 abu ne na yau da kullum, ba lamari ba ne: yana kasancewa sabo na daƙiƙa 88,200, kuma aro yana kuma buƙatar tushe na biyu ya yarda.

Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jeri. USDT/USD yana da heartbeat na daƙiƙa 86,400 kuma yana kasancewa sabo na daƙiƙa 88,200. Tagar cached awa 1 ce, tsawon grace mintuna 30 kuma ma'aunin lafiya na grace 0.95. Cikakken vault token ɗaya yana da ƙimar $2.00.
Duka hanyoyin USDT sun daina wallafawa. Daƙiƙa 88,200 bayan zagaye na ƙarshe, poke ya tarar ƙafar ta tsufa. Kasuwar tana Cached kuma tana bayar da $2.00 da aka adana; oracle yana fitar da
FailureRecorded
RiskModule yana ƙin aro da cirewa tare da bashi da
PriceNotLive
. LPVaultSwap yana ƙin ƙwace kasuwar da
StalePrice
. Biyan bashi da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna ci gaba.
Bayan awa 1 na Cached kasuwar tana Expired kuma tana bayar da 1, don haka Aave yana ƙirga jinginar a matsayin marar ƙima yayin da biyan bashi da fita ke ci gaba da aiki; oracle yana fitar da
OutageExpiredLatched
. Masu aiki suna bin P-02 kuma za su iya sauyawa zuwa hanyar jiran aiki.
Feed ya sake wallafawa kuma poke na gaba ya karɓe shi, yana fitar da
tare da lokacin ƙarewa daƙiƙa 1,800 bayan murmurewa.
Na mintuna 30 LPVaultSwap yana ƙwace asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95 kaɗai; ana ƙin asusu a 0.97 da
GraceHealthFactor
. Bayan haka, kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da 1.00 za a iya yi masa liquidation. Ra'ayin yanayin farashi na Lens yana nuna yanayi da ƙarshen grace a duk tsawon lokacin.
Kadarar bashi tana aiki haka ta hanyar DebtOracle ɗinta, sai dai da zarar ta zama Expired tana bayar da farashin da aka karɓa da aka ƙara da hawan damuwa, don haka ba a taɓa rage ƙimar bashi ba.
Yanayin farashi huɗu, abin da kowannensu ke ba da dama, grace, ƙofar sequencer, sauya hanyar jiran aiki da jagorar aiki P-02.

AaveAdapter shi ne wurin shiga ɗaya tilo ga kowane aikin mai aro a kowane CDP Spoke na chain ɗinsa. Wannan shafi yana jera kowane aiki, abin da yake bincikawa da abin da yake fitarwa.

AaveAdapter ɗaya ke gudana ga kowace chain a bayan adireshi tsayayye ɗaya. Kira suna tafiya daga wallet zuwa AaveAdapter, sannan zuwa PositionProxy na wallet ga wannan kasuwa, sannan zuwa CDP Spoke. Adapter yana ƙirƙirar proxies ta hanyar ProxyManager mara canzawa, yana sa Collateralization ya karɓi riƙo kuma ya rubuta goyon baya, shi kaɗai ne mai mint da ƙona kowane vault token, yana gudanar da binciken RiskModule kuma yana mayar da kurakuransu ba tare da canji ba.

Kowane wurin shiga yana ɗaukar Lock na yarjejeniyar da farko kuma yana sakin sa a ƙarshe, don haka babu kiran Avana da zai iya sake shiga wani. Adapter ba ya riƙe da wani token a ƙarshen kowane kira kuma ba ya cajin kuɗi a kan aro ko riba.

Biyan bashi, cirewa da cirewa na wani ɓangare ba tare da bashi ba, repay-all-and-withdraw, sakin rikodi mara ƙididdiga da tattara kuɗaɗe ba sa karanta yanayin MarketRegistry, yanayin dakatarwa, daskarewar adireshi, breaker ko farashi. Mai aro koyaushe zai iya fita, ko mene ne yanayin yarjejeniyar.
Asusu PositionProxy ɗaya ne da aka ɗaure da wallet ɗaya, CDP Spoke ɗaya da kasuwa ɗaya. Adireshinsa adireshin CREATE2 ne da aka sani kafin turawa; jinginarwa ta farko zuwa kasuwa ce ke tura shi.
Kowane asusu yana da nasa ma'aunin lafiya na Aave. Babu abin da aka haɗa jinginarsa tsakanin kasuwannin wallet ɗaya.
Asusu yana riƙe da rikodi ba fiye da 16 ba (matsayin da aka jinginar) ga kowace kasuwa, don haka liquidation ɗaya koyaushe tana dacewa a cikin block ɗaya.

LPVaultSwap yana yin flash-borrow na kadarar bashi, yana biyan bashi, yana warware da musayar raka'o'in; duk abin da ya rage ana biyan mai kira a cikin kadarar bashi. AaveAdapter UUPS proxy ne. Matsayin admin ɗinsa timelock na Avana na chain kaɗai ne zai iya riƙe su; kowane haɓakawa yana jiran jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5 kuma multisig na gudanarwa, Emergency Guardian, Aave Protocol Guardian ko Aave governance executor za su iya soke shi. Ba shi da setters: kowane canjin adireshi haɓakawa ne.
PositionProxies da ProxyManager marasa canzawa ne kuma ba sa ɗauke da logic, don haka haɓaka Adapter yana canza halayen asusu ba tare da taɓa kowane proxy ba.

Abin da Adapter mai matsala zai iya yi yana da iyaka ta add caps na Hub da draw caps na Spoke na Aave DAO, ta ainihin amincewa, da ta jinkiri: mai aro da ya ga haɓakawa mai cutarwa a cikin layi zai iya biyan bashi da cirewa kafin ya aiwatar, saboda waɗannan hanyoyi ba sa karanta ƙofa.
Liquidation ba ta bi ta waɗannan wuraren shiga. LPVaultSwap ne ke gudanar da ita kuma yana neman Adapter ne kawai ya ƙona raka'o'in da aka ƙwace.
Kowane aikin mai aro na AaveAdapter, ƙofofinsa, iyakokin kira, abubuwan da suka faru da kurakurai.

Ba a Amfani da Su Yanzu
Sanarwa
AaveAdapter

Wurin shiga mai iya haɓakawa a kowace chain ga kowane aikin mai aro: jinginarwa, aro, biyan bashi, cirewa, cirewa na wani ɓangare, sake ƙididdigewa, biyan bashi da jingina da tattara kuɗaɗe. Yana ƙirƙirar proxies, yana mint da ƙona vault tokens, yana gudanar da binciken RiskModule kuma yana sa proxy ya kira Spoke.
Daskarar adireshi

Dakatar da sabon aikin wallet ɗaya a kowace chain, wanda guardian ke tsayarwa kuma ana cire shi ne kawai ta aikin timelock na jinkiri na yau da kullum. Wallet da aka daskarar yana riƙe biyan bashi, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, tattara kuɗaɗe da ƙarin jingina na ceto, kuma har yanzu ana iya yi wa matsayinsa liquidation.
Haɗin AMM

Lambar Avana ga yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya: LPVault ɗinta da laburaren farashi. Tana karɓar riƙon matsayi, tana karanta adadin tokens ɗinsu a wani farashi, tana cire ainihin raka'o'i, tana tattara kuɗaɗen da aka ware kuma tana ba da rahoton bayanan kewayo da pool-share.
Yarjejeniyar AMM

Rukunin DEX da Avana zai iya karɓar matsayinsu. A ƙaddamarwa: Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. Babban tsarin yana tallafa wa Uniswap v2, Curve, Balancer da Uniswap v4 kuma ana jera su ne kawai bayan binciken shirinsu ya wuce.
Yanayin dakatarwar application

Yanayin Hub ɗaya da MarketRegistry na chain ke riƙe da shi: None, Frozen ko Paused, tare da dalilin dakatarwa na General ko MintPathSuspect. Yana dakatar da sabon aiki kaɗai; biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba da liquidation suna kasancewa a buɗe.
Avana Hub

Daidaitaccen Hub na Aave V4 da Aave DAO ke mallaka wanda ke riƙe da vault tokens na kasuwanninsa da ruwan kuɗin layukan bashinsa. Akwai matakai uku, Stable LP, Correlated LP da Volatile LP; a ƙaddamarwa Ethereum da Base kowannensu yana da Avana Stable LP Hub.
Avana Umbrella

Module na tsaron yarjejeniyar Avana, wanda aka sanya wa suna bisa Umbrella na Aave, wanda ƙirarsa ta ba shi wahayi. Shi ne Coverage Spoke na Hub ɗaya da kadarar bashi ɗaya, Avana Labs ke ba shi kuɗi kuma Aave DAO ke sarrafa shi, kuma yana rufe giɓin da aka rubuta a cikin wannan kadara.
AvanaTimelock

Timelock mara canzawa mai gudanar da kansa a kowace chain wanda kowane canji na musamman na Avana ke aiwatarwa ta cikinsa. Jinkiri na yau da kullum kwanaki 5 (ba ƙasa da 4 ba), gajeren jinkiri awanni 12 ga takamaiman rukunin kira, tagar grace ta kwanaki 14, aiwatarwa ta jama'a da masu gabatarwa biyu.
Invariant na goyon baya

Ga kowace kasuwa, wadatar vault-token ba ta wuce raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige tare da raka'o'in sasantawa da ke jiran aiki ba, kuma daidai take yayin da kowace ƙwacewa ake sasanta ta a cikin kira ɗaya. Don haka kowane vault token da ke yawo yana da goyon bayan ruwan kuɗi da ake riƙe da shi.
Rikodin goyon baya

Shigarwar Collateralization ga matsayi ɗaya da aka jinginar: mai ajiya, proxy, kasuwa, maɓallin matsayi, raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige da matsayi. Asusu yana riƙe da rikodi a buɗe ba fiye da 16 ba ga kowace kasuwa.
Rarar mai aro
Ɓangaren dawowar liquidation da ke sama da ƙimar oracle na raka'o'in da aka ƙwace. Ana biyan sa ga wallet na mai aro a cikin kadarar bashi.
CDP Spoke

Daidaitaccen Spoke na Aave V4 ga kowace chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari, wanda Aave DAO ke mallaka. Yana jera kasuwanni da yawa a matsayin reserves na jingina da reserves na bashi da aka amince da su. Spokes na ƙaddamarwa: "Uniswap v3 Stable" a Ethereum da "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" a Base.
Circuit breaker

Dakatarwa ta atomatik ta sabon aiki a kasuwa ɗaya ko reserve na bashi ɗaya. Ƙofar wucin gadi tana buɗewa bayan mintuna 30 na lura masu lafiya; daskarewar tsaro tana sake buɗewa ne kawai bayan sake saitawa da aka ba da izini.
Collateral Factor (CF)

Factor na Aave V4 da ke tsayar da yawan ƙimar reserve da za ta iya tallafa wa bashi. Ga reserve na vault-token shi ne mafi ƙanƙanta daga cikin Collateral Factors na tokens ɗinsa wanda aka ninka da ma'aunin haɗarin pool, an zagaye ƙasa.
Hadarin jingina

Ƙima ga kowane reserve da aka tsayar a jerin Aave wadda ke tsayar da ƙarin ribar haɗari na mai aro. Ba ragi ba ne a kan ƙimar jingina. Ƙimar ribar aro ita ce ƙimar tushe da aka ninka da ɗaya tare da ƙarin ribar haɗari.
Collateralization

Littafin goyon baya mara canzawa, wanda bai karkata ga kowane AMM ba, a kowace chain. Yana adana kowane rikodin goyon baya, jerin ƙwacewa na mafi girma-da-farko, ma'aunan fallasa ga kowane Hub da ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jiran aiki.
Rabon rufewa

Girman da ake buƙata na First-Loss Reserve: ma'aunin da aka ba da kuɗi da aka ninka da 10⁴ dole ne ya kai aƙalla rabon rufewa a bps da aka ninka da jimillar draw caps a wannan Hub da kadara. Ana tsayar da shi a cikin ARFC na ba da kuɗi; 20% jagora ce ta misali.
Coverage Spoke

Spoke da DAO ke sarrafawa, na bayarwa kaɗai, da ke riƙe da wadata da Avana ya ba da kuɗinta ta kadara ɗaya a Hub ɗaya, First-Loss Reserve na wannan ma'aurata. Ɗaya ga kowane Hub da kadarar bashi a kowace chain; ana kuma kiran sa Avana Umbrella.
Layin bashi
Adadin kadara ɗaya da aka iyakance wanda baitulmalin Aave DAO ke bayarwa ta hanyar Lend Spoke. Draw cap ne ga kowane Hub, kadara da CDP Spoke; jimillar draw caps ba ta wuce layin ba.
Raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige

Raka'o'in da aka karanta daga haɗin AMM lokacin da aka jinginar da matsayi, ban da raka'o'in da liquidation da cirewa na wani ɓangare suka cire, tare da raka'o'in da sake ƙididdigewa ya ƙara. Vault tokens suna wanzuwa ne kawai a kansu.
Layin bashi tsakanin Hubs
Reserve na bashi wanda Hub da ke ba shi kuɗi ba Hub na gidan CDP Spoke ɗinsa ba ne. An bayyana shi gaba ɗaya kuma a kashe yake a ƙaddamarwa a kowace chain.
Reserve na bashi

Reserve na CDP Spoke da ake iya aro, wanda aka rubuta tare da kadarorinsa, Hub da ke ba da kuɗi, tushen farashi, Coverage Spoke da hanyoyin musaya. GHO shi ne na farko; ana iya kunna USDC, USDT ko WETH ga kowane Spoke ta hanyar aikin enable-debt-reserve.
DebtOracle

Tushen farashin Aave mai iya haɓakawa na kadarar bashi ɗaya da ba GHO ba a chain ɗaya, tare da hanyoyin farko, na dabam da na jiran aiki, failover, binciken yarjejeniya da yanayin Cached da Expired. Da zarar Expired yana bayar da farashinsa na ƙarshe da aka ƙara da hawan damuwa.
Gibi

Bashin da Aave ke rubutawa a matsayin mara goyon baya a Hub da ke ba da kuɗi, ga kowane reserve na bashi kuma a cikin nasa kadara, lokacin da liquidation ta bar asusu ba tare da jingina ba. Coverage Spoke na Hub da kadara ɗaya kaɗai ne ke share shi.
Ajin jinkiri

Saurin da kowane canji na musamman zai iya faruwa: ayyukan guardian nan take (dakatarwa, daskarewa, tayar da breaker, sauyawa zuwa jiran aiki, soke), gajeren jinkiri na awanni 12 ga takamaiman rukunin kira masu rage haɗari, jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5 ga duk sauran, ƙimomi marasa canzawa da gudanarwar Aave.
Ayyukan turawa

Ayyukan timelock uku da ke ƙara CDP Spoke, kasuwa da reserve na bashi: deployCdpSpoke, listCollateralMarket da enableDebtReserve. Kowanne yana gudana a jinkiri na yau da kullum kuma kunnawa ta gajeren jinkiri tana biye da shi.
Mai ajiya da ke cikin rikodi
Wallet da ya mallaki kuma ya jinginar da matsayi. Shi kaɗai ne ke karɓar matsayin a mayar masa da kuɗaɗensa da aka ware, kuma shi ne wallet da aka ɗaure da PositionProxy ɗinsa.
Binciken drift

Kwatancen Avana a kan chain na saitin Aave na yanzu da ƙimomin da girman Avana ke ɗauka, ciki har da saituna uku da ake buƙata da Collateral Factor. Rashin daidaito yana dakatar da sabon aro a kasuwar da abin ya shafa yayin da liquidation ke ci gaba.
Mai Kula da Gaggawa

Safe na 3-cikin-5 a kowace chain, tare da masu sanya hannu daban da multisig na gudanarwa da Aave Protocol Guardian. Zai iya dakatar ko daskarar da Hubs, daskarar da adireshi, tayar da sake saita breakers, sauyawa zuwa hanyoyin farashi na jiran aiki da soke ayyukan da ke cikin layi; ba zai iya haɓakawa ko canza sigogi ba.
First-Loss Reserve

Wadata da Avana ya ba da kuɗinta ta kadara ɗaya a cikin Coverage Spoke na Hub ɗaya, wanda aka ba da kuɗi kafin kowane draw cap a wannan ma'aurata ya tashi sama da 0. Shi ne kaɗai matakin asara na Avana a kan chain kuma yana rufe giɓin da aka rubuta cikin awanni 72.
Tushen flash

Kwangilar kowace chain da LPVaultSwap ke yin flash-borrow na kadarar bashi ta cikinta daga Aave V3 Pool, kadara ɗaya. Premium ɗinta dole ne ya kasance ba fiye da 10 bps ba, kuma ba ta taɓa zama Hub da ke ba da kuɗin reserve da ake yi wa liquidation ba.
Sabuntuwa
Feed sabo ne yayin da shekarunsa ba su wuce heartbeat ɗinsa tare da rarar daƙiƙa 1,800 ba. Feeds na stablecoin na Chainlink suna da heartbeats na daƙiƙa 82,800 zuwa 86,400.
Hub da ke ba da kuɗi
Hub da reserve na bashi ke ɗiba daga gare shi. Yana ɗaukar giɓin reserve ɗin, kuma dakatarwarsa tana dakatar da aron reserve ɗin.
Multisig na gudanarwa

Safe na 4-cikin-7 a kowace chain tare da masu sanya hannu na Avana Labs ba fiye da 3 ba, aƙalla ƙungiyoyi uku da yankunan shari'a uku. Tare da Aave governance executor yana gabatar da ayyukan timelock; ba shi da ikon nan take.
Grace

Na mintuna 30 bayan farashi ya murmure daga Expired, da awa 1 bayan sake farawar sequencer na Base, ana iya yi wa asusu liquidation ne kawai a ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95. Masu aro suna samun lokaci don ɗaukar mataki a kan farashin da ba su iya gani ba.
Ma'aunin lafiya (HF)

Ma'aunin Aave V4 na asusu ɗaya a Spoke ɗaya: ƙimar jingina da aka ninka da Collateral Factor, an raba da jimillar ƙimar bashi. Ƙasa da 1.00 ana iya yi wa asusun liquidation. A Avana kowace kasuwa tana da nata asusu da ma'aunin lafiya.
Hub na gida
Hub da reserves na jingina na CDP Spoke ke ciki, wanda aka rubuta lokacin da aka yi wa Spoke rajista.
Tagar lamari

Dakatarwar liquidation mafi tsawo ta awanni 48 da aka tsara iyakoki dominta: dakatar da reserve a ɓangaren Aave ko tsayar da Hub, ko dakatarwar yanayin farashin oracle. Yanayin dakatarwa na Avana na kansa, breakers da daskarewar adireshi ba sa taɓa dakatar da liquidation.
InKindEscrow

Ƙaramin payout escrow mara canzawa a kowace chain. Yana riƙe da biyan liquidation da token ya ƙi isarwa (rarar mai aro, kuɗin Avana ko ladan keeper) har sai wanda zai karɓa ya karɓe shi zuwa adireshin da ya zaɓa.
Keeper

Adireshi a jerin keepers na LPVaultSwap na chain. Kowace chain tana da aƙalla ɗaya, keeper na Avana na kansa, kuma ba fiye da 32 ba. Ana iya ƙara keeper na jiran aiki a kan wasu ababen more rayuwa daban ta hanyar timelock.
Ladan keeper
Biyan mai kiran liquidation: ribar oracle bayan kashi 20% na Avana, har zuwa abin da musayar suka samu. Ana biyan sa a cikin kadarar bashi da aka biya.
Lend Spoke

Spoke mallakar DAO, na bayarwa kaɗai, a kowace chain wanda ake bayar da layukan bashi ta cikinsa ga ma'auratan Hub da kadara, GHO da farko. Ba a bayar da ajiyar masu ba da rance na jama'a a ƙaddamarwa ba.
Lens

Kwangilar periphery ta karatu kaɗai a kowace chain, a wajen babban tsarin da aka yi wa audit, wadda ke ba da ra'ayoyi da previews: asusu, yanayin farashi, sararin iyaka, ƙididdigar aro da biyan bashi da previews na liquidation. Babu babbar kwangilar da ke kiran ta.
Karin liquidation

Ƙarin jinginar da Aave ke ƙwacewa ga kowace raka'ar bashi da aka biya, wanda Aave DAO ke tsayarwa a kowane CDP Spoke. Avana yana ba da shawarar mafi ƙarancin kari na aƙalla 2% da ma'aunin lafiya na maƙasudi na 1.10.
Lock

Kulle na reentrancy mara canzawa da kwangilolin Avana ke rabawa a chain ɗaya. Membobinsa biyu su ne AaveAdapter da LPVaultSwap; kwangilolin riƙo suna karɓar kira masu motsa ƙima ne kawai yayin da ɗaya daga cikinsu ke riƙe da shi.
LPOracle

Feed na farashi mai iya haɓakawa na kasuwa ɗaya, da decimals 8. Yana ƙimanta vault token ɗaya ta haɗuwar adalci a farashin Chainlink, yana bincika TWAP na pool da tushe na biyu, kuma ba ya taɓa revert ko mayar da 0.
LPVault

Mai riƙo mara canzawa na kowane matsayin da aka jinginar na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya a chain ɗaya. Yana tabbatar da takamaiman siffa, yana rubuta mai ajiya da ke cikin rikodi, yana warware ainihin raka'o'i kuma yana mayar da matsayi ga mai ajiyarsu kaɗai.
LPVaultSwap

Kwangilar liquidation a kowace chain kuma adireshi ɗaya tilo da vault token ke karɓar jinginar da aka ƙwace zuwa gare shi. Yana yin flash-borrow na kadarar bashi, yana kiran liquidation na Aave, yana sa a warware raka'o'in da aka ƙwace kuma yana musayar su zuwa kadarar bashi a cikin ma'amala ɗaya.
Kasuwa

Pool ɗaya na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya a chain ɗaya tare da takamaiman siffar matsayi ɗaya, tare da vault token ɗinsa da reserve na jinginarsa a CDP Spoke ɗaya. Ga concentrated liquidity siffar ita ce takamaiman kewayon tick.
MarketRegistry

Rajista mai iya haɓakawa a kowace chain ta Hubs, CDP Spokes, kasuwanni da matsayinsu, reserves na bashi, hanyoyin farashi da musaya, yanayin dakatarwar kowane Hub, yanayin breaker da rukunin adireshin da aka daskarar.
Mafi ƙarancin jinginarwa
Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar USD da jinginarwa ko ƙarin jingina za su iya ƙarawa, $10 ga kowace kasuwa a asali. Ƙarin jingina na ceto yana buƙatar $10 ko mafi ƙanƙantar kawai, duk wanda ya fi ƙasa.
Offboarding

Matsayin kasuwa da ke toshe sababbin jinginarwa da aro. Bayan kwanaki 5 na sanarwa liquidation threshold yana sauka kowace rana a cikin kwanaki 30 zuwa rabin ƙimarsa da aka jera; biyan bashi, cirewa da liquidation suna kasancewa a buɗe a duk tsawon lokacin.
Ribar oracle
Ƙimar oracle na raka'o'in da aka ƙwace a cikin liquidation, ban da bashin da aka biya da premium na flash. Kuɗin Avana kashi 20% ne nata, wanda rarar da aka samu ke iyakancewa.
ParameterStore
Ma'aji mai iya haɓakawa a kowace chain na kowane siga na haɗari tare da iyakokinsa, setter na tsaurarawa a gajeren jinkiri da setter na sassautawa a jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Cirewa ta ɓangare
Cire wani ɓangare na raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige na matsayin da aka jinginar: ana ƙona vault tokens da suka dace kuma ainihin kuɗin yana zuwa ga mai ajiya yayin da matsayin ke kasancewa a jinginar.
Ma'aunin sasantawa da ke jira

Adadin tokens da Collateralization ya cire don vault tokens da Aave ya ƙwace amma ba a taɓa sasanta su ba. Suna goyon bayan waɗannan vault tokens har sai wani ya kira sasantawa da ke jiran aiki, wanda ke aika ƙimar da aka dawo da ita zuwa Coverage Spoke.
Liquidation mara izini
Wurin shiga na liquidation da ke buɗe ga kowane adireshi, ciki har da Aave DAO. Yana amfani da hanyoyin musaya na primary-then-backup kaɗai kuma ba ya biyan mayar da kuɗin gas.
Ma'aunin haɗarin pool

Ragi ga kowane pool a cikin tsarin lissafin Collateral Factor, daga 1 zuwa 4,000 bps, wanda masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4 ke tsayarwa a cikin payload na jeri. Yana nuna kewayo, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗin liquidation.
Iyakar pool-share

Iyaka ta zaɓi a kan jimillar hannun jarin Avana na ruwan kuɗin pool a chain. A kashe take a asali kuma tana aiki ne kawai inda jerin pool ya tsayar da ita; hannun jari sama da 25% yana tayar da faɗakarwar sa ido.
Position key
Mai gano matsayi a cikin haɗin AMM ɗinsa. Tare da ID na haɗi yana ambaton matsayi a chain.
PositionProxy
Asusu mara canzawa ɗaya mara logic ga kowane wallet, CDP Spoke da kasuwa, wanda aka ƙirƙira da CREATE2. Shi ne asusun Aave na wannan kasuwa kuma yana aiwatar da kira daga AaveAdapter na chain kaɗai.
Yanayin farashi

Live, Drifting (saɓanin TWAP ko hanya), Cached (duka hanyoyi sun tsufa, har zuwa awa 1) da Expired (bayan awa 1). Suna zama ƙofa ga aro da ƙwacewa; biyan bashi da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna aiki a kowane yanayi.
ProxyManager

Kwangila mara canzawa a kowace chain da ke ƙirƙirar PositionProxies a adireshin da aka hasashe bisa buƙatar AaveAdapter. Tana ƙin wallet da aka daskarar kuma ba ta riƙe da lambar proxy da za ta iya canzawa.
Sake ƙididdigewa

Ƙididdige ruwan kuɗin da mai ajiya ya ƙara a matsayin da aka jinginar ta hanyar yarjejeniyar AMM, tare da kowane binciken ƙarin jingina. Raka'o'in da kowa ya ƙara ba a ƙirga su har sai mai ajiya ya sake ƙididdige su.
Mafi ƙarancin dawowa
Mafi ƙarancin adadin kadarar bashi da warwarewa da musayar liquidation dole ne su mayar: ƙimar oracle na raka'o'in da aka ƙwace ban da slippage da aka yarda (1% a asali) da ƙananan izinin zagayewa.
Biyan bashi da jingina

Biyan bashi daga wani ɓangare na matsayi ɗaya da aka jinginar a cikin kira ɗaya da flash ya ba da kuɗi. Babu kari ko kuɗin Avana da ke aiki, kuma ma'aunin lafiya bayan kiran ba zai iya yin ƙasa da na kafin shi ba.
Saitunan Spoke da ake buƙata

Ƙimomi uku da jeri ke tsayarwa a kowane reserve na vault-token: receive-shares a kashe, kuɗin liquidation 0 ko ana biyan sa ga mai karɓar kuɗin Avana, kuma babu reinvestment controller. Tare da ƙa'idar canja wurin vault token suna sa LPVaultSwap ya zama mai liquidation ɗaya tilo.
Ƙarin jingina na ceto

Jinginarwa cikin asusu mai bashi da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1.10, wanda aka iyakance a adadin da ke dawo da 1.10. Tana wuce iyakancewa, kuma raka'o'inta na ceto suna ƙirguwa a liquidation amma ba sa taɓa tallafa wa sabon bashi.
RiskModule

Kwangila mai iya haɓakawa da ke gudanar da binciken jinginarwa da ɓangaren aro na Avana: ma'aunin lafiya ba tare da raka'o'in ceto ba, sabuntuwa da yarjejeniyar farashi, yanayin sequencer, alamun Aave, drift da circuit breakers. Ba ta riƙe da tokens.
Grace na sequencer
A Base, lokacin awa 1 bayan sake farawar sequencer wanda a cikinsa ake ƙin aro kuma asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95 kaɗai ne za a iya yi musu liquidation.
Ƙarin kuɗi na gibi

Kadarar bashi da mai kiran liquidation ke ƙarawa daga kuɗinsa lokacin da musaya suka sauka ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin dawowa, cikin nasa iyaka. Yana kuma biyan duk wani gibin zagayewa a sasantawa ta ƙarshe.
Hanyar jiran aiki

Hanyar farashi da aka amince da ita lokacin jeri wadda guardian zai iya sauya token zuwa gare ta nan take. Aave governance executor zai iya soke sauyawar nan take; in ba haka ba komawa baya yana ɗaukar jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Ƙasan damuwa

Farashin cikakken vault token mafi ƙanƙanta da ake amfani da shi don cajin iyaka da tsara girman supply-cap na Hub, $1.00 a asali. Yana kiyaye kowace jinginarwa da Avana ke karɓa a cikin supply cap na Aave.
Ƙimantawar damuwa

Farashi mai taka tsantsan da Aave ke gani ga reserve wanda farashinsa ke gazawa: kasuwa Expired a farashi mafi ƙanƙanta, kasuwa mai saɓani a ƙaramar hanya, bashi Expired da aka ƙara da hawan damuwarsa. Babu abin da ake ƙwacewa ko biya a wannan farashi.
Hanyar musaya

Tsayayyiyar hanya da aka rubuta ga kowace kasuwa, token da kadarar bashi, tare da ta farko da ta ajiya, wadda LPVaultSwap ke amfani da ita don musayar token da aka warware zuwa kadarar bashi. Ba ta taɓa ciniki ta cikin pool na kasuwar kanta ba.
Ma'aunin lafiya na maƙasudi
Ma'aunin lafiya da Aave ke tsara girman kowace liquidation zuwa gare shi, ƙima ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke. Avana yana ba da shawarar 1.10; Aave DAO ne ke yanke shawara.
Ƙarin jingina
Yankin ƙarin jingina
Wani ɓangare na iyakar kowace kasuwa, 10% a asali, da aka keɓe don ƙarin jingina na ceto don kada kasuwa da ta cika ta taɓa hana mai aro ƙara jingina.
Vault token

ERC-20 mara canzawa, mara mai shi, na jingina kaɗai na kasuwa ɗaya. Raka'ar tushe ɗaya daidai take da raka'a ɗaya da aka ƙididdige; AaveAdapter kaɗai ne ke mint da ƙona shi, kuma yana motsawa ne kawai tsakanin proxy da aka yi wa rajista, Hub da LPVaultSwap.
Mai karɓar kuɗin vault-token
Spoke na baitulmalin Aave da aka yi wa rajista a kowace kadarar Hub ta vault-token, tare da supply da draw caps na 0 don kada ya taɓa riƙe vault tokens.
VaultTokenFactory
Kwangila mara canzawa a kowace chain da ke tura vault tokens da CREATE3 a adireshi da za a iya hasashe, timelock kaɗai ke kiran ta, kuma tana adana rajistar token da LPVault na rubutu sau ɗaya.
Borrow Spoke
Tsohon suna na CDP Spoke.
Cikakken matsayi daidaitawa
An cire. Kowace liquidation ta wani ɓangare ce: Aave yana tsayar da girman ƙwacewa, kuma mai aro yana riƙe sauran matsayin da duk kuɗaɗensa.
Sasantawa da kayan kansu
An cire. Kowace liquidation tana musayar tokens da aka warware zuwa kadarar bashi a cikin ma'amala ɗaya ko tana revert; babu keeper da ke karɓar tokens da aka warware.
SettlementBudget
An cire. Babu kwangilar Avana da ke biyan giɓin zagayewa; mai kiran liquidation yana tsara girman kuɗinsa tun farko kuma yana biyan duk wani gibin zagayewa ta ƙarin kuɗinsa na gibi.
Babu Shawarar Zuba Jari:
Avana yarjejeniya ce ta software. Wannan takaddun ba ya zama shawarar saka hannun jari ba.
Halin yanzu:
Sandbox na jama'a yana amfani da kadarorin kwaikwayo kuma ba ya yin ma'amaloli onchain.
Hadarin Asara:
Masu amfani na iya rasa kuɗi ta hanyar raunin yarjejeniyar mai hankali, canjin kasuwa, asarar ɗan lokaci, tsabtacewa, ko gazawar oracl.
Matsayin Gudanarwa:
Matsayin ka'idoji na Avana da alamun sa (idan akwai) ba su da garanti kuma yana iya bambanta ta ikon hukuma.
Babu Garanti:
Ana samar da software "kamar yadda yake" ba tare da garantin kowane nau'i ba.

strings: Muhimman Ra'ayoyi

Ra'ayoyin da ke bayan Avana: kasuwanni, vault tokens, asusu ga kowace kasuwa, Hubs da Spokes, reserves na bashi, oracles da yanayin farashi, jingina da ma'aunin lafiya, liquidation, Avana Umbrella, dakatarwa da timelock.
Farashin LP
Kasuwa
Vault Token
PositionProxy da Asusu
CDP, Lend da Coverage Spokes
Hubs
Reserves na Bashi
Oracles da Yanayin Farashi
Factorin tsaro
health factor
Hanyoyin Liquidation
Avana Umbrella
Dakatarwa da Breakers
AvanaTimelock
Gajeren sashe ɗaya ga kowane ra'ayi. Kowanne yana haɗawa zuwa shafin da ke bayani a kansa gaba ɗaya.

Jinginar token yawanci ma'aunin kadara ɗaya ne. Matsayin LP haɗuwar kadarori ce da ke canzawa: ciniki yana canza kayansa, farashi yana canza ƙimarsa, kuma kuɗaɗe suna taruwa a tsawon lokaci. Matsayin concentrated-liquidity kuma ya dogara da kewayonsa kuma yana zama gefe ɗaya yayin da farashi ke fita daga gare shi. Don haka Avana yana tsayar da sigogin haɗari ga kowace kasuwa, yana barin ruwan kuɗin a cikin pool ɗinsa, kuma yana ba kowace kasuwa nata asusun Aave ga kowane mai aro.

Kasuwa ita ce pool ɗaya na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya a chain ɗaya tare da takamaiman siffar matsayi ɗaya. Ga concentrated liquidity siffar ita ce takamaiman kewayon tick. Kowace kasuwa tana da vault token ɗaya kuma ita ce reserve na jingina ɗaya na CDP Spoke ɗaya kacal har abada.
Ana karɓar matsayi ne kawai idan kewayonsa ya yi daidai da na kasuwar daidai. Kasuwar da aka jera a [−10, 10] tana ƙin matsayi a [−9, 10], duk da cewa sun haɗu.
Pool ɗaya da aka jera da kewayo biyu kasuwanni biyu ne.
A ƙaddamarwa: pools na stablecoin na Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da pools na stablecoin na Aerodrome Slipstream da ba a yi stake ba a Base, kamar USDC/USDT da pools da ke ɗauke da GHO.
Ana jera kowace kasuwa ta hanyar AvanaTimelock a jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5 tare da payload na jeri na Aave DAO, wanda ke tsayar da Collateral Factor ɗinta, layin kari da iyakoki.

Vault token shi ne ERC-20 na jingina kaɗai mai ƙuntataccen canja wuri na kasuwa ɗaya. Raka'ar tushe ɗaya daidai take da raka'a ɗaya ta ruwan kuɗi da aka ƙididdige. Ana tsayar da decimals ɗinsa lokacin jeri tsakanin 6 da 18 don cikakken token ɗaya ya kasance yana da ƙima tsakanin $1 da $10 a farashin jeri. AaveAdapter kaɗai ne ke mint da ƙona shi, kuma zai iya motsawa ne kawai daga proxy da aka yi wa rajista zuwa Hub, daga Hub zuwa proxy, ko daga Hub zuwa LPVaultSwap a lokacin ƙwacewa. Ba shi da mai shi, admin ko fitarwa.
Cikakkun ƙa'idodin suna cikin
Tsarewa da Vault Tokens

Kowane wallet yana samun PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa, wanda aka ƙirƙira a adireshin CREATE2 da za a iya hasashe a jinginarwarsa ta farko cikin wannan kasuwa. Proxy shi ne asusun Aave: yana riƙe da vault tokens na kasuwar da bashin kowane reserve na bashi da asusun ke aro, a ƙarƙashin ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya. Ba shi da logic kuma mara canzawa ne, kuma yana aiwatar da kira daga AaveAdapter kaɗai; wallet yana aiki ta hanyar AaveAdapter.

Saboda kowace kasuwa tana da nata asusu, babu abin da aka haɗa jinginarsa. Misali daga ƙayyadaddun bayanai: Alice tana jinginar da matsayin USDC/USDT da matsayin GHO/USDC a "Uniswap v3 Stable" kuma tana samun proxies biyu. Tana aron GHO 3,000 a na farko. Idan feed na GHO/USDC ya tsufa, asusu na biyu ba zai iya aro ba, yayin da na farko ke ci gaba da aro kuma ba za a iya yi masa liquidation saboda na biyu ba.
Spoke
Abin da yake yi
CDP Spoke

Daidaitaccen Spoke na Aave V4 ɗaya ga kowace chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari. Yana jera kasuwanni da yawa a matsayin reserves na jingina da ba za a iya aro ba da reserves na bashi da aka amince da su. Ƙaddamarwa: "Uniswap v3 Stable" a Ethereum da "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" a Base.
Lend Spoke
Spoke ɗaya na bayarwa kaɗai a kowace chain wanda baitulmalin Aave DAO ke bayar da kowane layin bashi ta cikinsa. Babu ajiyar jama'a a ƙaddamarwa.
Coverage Spoke
Spoke ɗaya na bayarwa kaɗai ga kowane Hub da kadarar bashi, Avana Umbrella na wannan ma'aurata, da ke riƙe da wadatar First-Loss Reserve da Avana ya ba da kuɗi.

Aave DAO ne ke mallaka kuma ke saita kowane Spoke. Jeri yana tsayar da ƙimomi uku a kowane reserve na vault-token: receive-shares a kashe, kuɗin liquidation 0 (ko ana biyan sa ga mai karɓar kuɗin Avana) kuma babu reinvestment controller. Binciken drift na Avana yana tilasta su. Cikakkun bayanai suna cikin
Hubs da Spokes

Avana Hub daidaitaccen Hub ne na Aave V4 da Aave DAO ke mallaka wanda ke riƙe da vault tokens na kasuwanninsa da ruwan kuɗin layukan bashinsa. Akwai matakai uku: Stable LP, Correlated LP da Volatile LP. A ƙaddamarwa Ethereum da Base kowannensu yana da Avana Stable LP Hub ɗaya. Kowane CDP Spoke yana da Hub na gida ɗaya don jinginarsa, kuma kowane Hub yana da nasa yanayin dakatarwa da iyakokin token da mai ajiya na kowane Hub.

Reserve na bashi reserve ne na CDP Spoke da ake iya aro, wanda layin bashi da aka iyakance ke ba da kuɗi. GHO shi ne reserve na bashi na farko a kowane Spoke na ƙaddamarwa. Ana iya kunna USDC, USDT ko WETH ga kowane CDP Spoke ta hanyar aikin enable-debt-reserve, da zarar Aave DAO ya amince da layin bashi, iyakoki, tushen farashi da hanyoyin musaya. Kowane reserve na bashi yana rubuta Hub da ke ba shi kuɗi, tushen farashinsa da Coverage Spoke ɗinsa.

Layin bashi: supply cap na Lend Spoke daidai yake da layin, kuma jimillar draw caps na CDP Spoke a kansa ba ta wuce layin ba. Layin ƙaddamarwa: GHO 2,000,000 a Ethereum, tare da ƙimar ƙarshe da layin Base da aka tsayar a cikin ARFC na ba da kuɗi.

Kowane draw cap yana kasancewa cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na kadarorinsa a Aave V3 Pool da zurfin hanyoyin musayarsa, don haka kowane adadin da aka aro za a iya yi masa liquidation a cikin ma'amala ɗaya.
Layin bashi tsakanin Hubs, inda Hub da ke ba da kuɗi ya bambanta da Hub na gidan Spoke, an bayyana shi kuma a kashe yake a ƙaddamarwa.

Kowace kasuwa tana da LPOracle da ke ƙimanta vault token ɗaya ta haɗuwar adalci: adadin tokens da raka'o'in za su riƙe idan pool ya yi ciniki a farashin Chainlink, an ƙimanta su a waɗannan farashi. Ciniki a cikin pool ba zai iya motsa ƙimantawar ba. Kowace kadarar bashi da ba GHO ba tana da DebtOracle tare da samfurin hanya iri ɗaya; bashin GHO yana amfani da farashin tsayayye na $1 na Aave.
value = Σ amountᵢ(oracle prices) × priceᵢ

Kowane token yana da hanyar Chainlink ta farko, hanya ta dabam tare da failover ta atomatik da hanyar jiran aiki da aka amince da ita lokacin jeri. Feed sabo ne na tsawon heartbeat ɗinsa tare da daƙiƙa 1,800.
TWAP na mintuna 30 na pool binciken daidaito ne, ba farashin ba ne. Aro da cirewa tare da bashi suna kuma buƙatar tushe na biyu mai zaman kansa ya yarda.
A Base kowane farashi yana kuma karanta feed na sequencer-uptime.

Ana bayar da farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa; jinginarwa, aro da ƙwacewar wannan kasuwa suna jira

Jingina tana ƙirguwa a matsayin marar ƙima a Aave; ƙwacewa tana jiran sabon farashi ko sauyawa zuwa jiran aiki

Na mintuna 30 bayan farashi ya murmure daga Expired, asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95 kaɗai ne za a iya yi musu liquidation. Biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna aiki a kowane yanayi. Ƙarin bayani yana cikin
Yanayin Farashi
CF_LP = floor(min CFᵢ × poolRiskFactor / 10⁴)

Factor na kowane token yana fitowa daga Aave V4 Core Hub, sai dai ƙafar GHO tana amfani da factor na musamman da aka tsayar lokacin jeri. Masu ba da sabis na haɗari ne ke tsayar da ma'aunin haɗarin pool ga kowane pool kuma ba ya wuce 40%. Tare da tokens biyu a 78% da iyakar 40%, CF_LP shi ne 3,120 bps (31.2%). Collateral Risk yana tsayar da ƙarin ribar mai aro: borrowing rate = base rate × (1 + risk premium). Duba
Collateral Factor

Aave V4 yana lissafa ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya ga kowane asusu, don haka ga kowace kasuwa. Iyakar aro kaɗai a kan chain ita ce 1.00 na Aave, tare da mafi ƙarancin ma'aunin lafiya da mai aro ke wucewa da shi a kowane kira. Lens yana nuna aron da aka ba da shawara a 1.10 kusa da matsakaici a 1.00. Asusu yana riƙe da matsayi ba fiye da 16 ba ga kowace kasuwa, kuma babu mafi ƙarancin bashi. Duba

Idan ma'aunin lafiya na asusu ya yi ƙasa da 1, ana yi masa liquidation ta hanyar daidaitaccen kiran liquidation na Aave, koyaushe na wani ɓangare, ta LPVaultSwap. Vault token yana karɓar jinginar da aka ƙwace zuwa LPVaultSwap kaɗai, don haka duk wani mai kiran liquidation na Aave daban yana revert.
Hanya
Bayanai
liquidate

Kowane yanayin hanyar musaya
liquidatePermissionless
Kowane adireshi, ciki har da Aave DAO
Hanyoyin musaya na primary-then-backup kaɗai; babu mayar da kuɗin gas
repayWithCollateral
Mai aro
Yana biyan bashi daga wani ɓangare na matsayinsa; babu kari kuma babu kuɗin Avana

A cikin ma'amala ɗaya LPVaultSwap yana yin flash-borrow na kadarar bashi daga Aave V3 Pool, yana biyan bashin, yana karɓa da ƙona vault tokens da aka ƙwace, yana sa LPVault ya warware ainihin waɗannan raka'o'i, yana musayar kowane token zuwa kadarar bashi tare da mafi ƙarancin da aka samo daga oracle, yana biyan flash loan kuma yana biyan kuɗaɗe. Idan musaya ba za su iya sasantawa ba, kiran yana revert kuma babu abin da ke canzawa. Babu dakatarwa, breaker ko daskarewa ta Avana da ke dakatar da liquidation. Duba
Rufi

Avana Umbrella shi ne module na tsaron yarjejeniyar Avana, wanda aka sanya wa suna bisa Umbrella na Aave, wanda ƙirarsa ta ba shi wahayi. Kowane Hub da kadarar bashi yana da ɗaya: Coverage Spoke da Aave DAO ke sarrafawa kuma Avana Labs ke ba da kuɗi a cikin wannan kadara, wanda ke riƙe da First-Loss Reserve na ma'auratan. Idan liquidation ta zubar da asusu yayin da bashi ya rage, Aave yana rubuta gibi a Hub da ke ba da kuɗi, kuma Umbrella na Hub da kadara ɗaya yana rufe shi cikin awanni 72. Shi ne kaɗai matakin asara na Avana a kan chain. Gibi da ya fi reserve girma asara ce ga masu bayar da kadarar wannan Hub.
Kayan aikin iyakancewa na Avana suna dakatar da sabon aiki kaɗai. Biyan bashi, tattara kuɗaɗe, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba da liquidation suna kasancewa a buɗe a kowane yanayi.

Yanayin dakatarwa ga kowane Hub: None, Frozen ko Paused. Frozen yana toshe sababbin asusu da aro. Paused, da dalili General, yana kuma toshe ƙarin jingina ban da ƙarin jingina na ceto, cirewa tare da bashi da biyan bashi da jingina. Dakatarwa da dalili MintPathSuspect tana kuma ƙin kowane ƙarin jingina.

Circuit breakers ga kowace kasuwa da kowane reserve na bashi. Ƙofofin wucin gadi (farashi, pool share, zurfin pool) suna buɗewa bayan mintuna 30 na lura masu lafiya. Daskarewar tsaro (gibi da ba a biya ba sama da GHO 10,000, aikin mai fitarwa, drift na saiti, tayarwar hannu ta guardian) suna kasancewa har sai sake saitawa da aka ba da izini.
Daskarewar adireshi: daskarewa ta kowace chain ta sabon aikin wallet ɗaya, ba fiye da 20 ga kowane guardian a kowane awanni 24 masu juyawa ba, ana cire ta ne kawai ta aikin jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Emergency Guardian (Safe na 3-cikin-5 ga kowace chain) da Aave Protocol Guardian za su iya amfani da waɗannan kayan aiki nan take. Duba
Ikon Gaggawa

Kowane canji na musamman ga kwangilar Avana a chain yana aiwatarwa ta hanyar AvanaTimelock na wannan chain, ba tare da kauce masa ba. Multisig na gudanarwa (4-cikin-7) da Aave governance executor ne ke gabatarwa. Kowa yana aiwatar da aikin da ya shirya a cikin tagar grace ta kwanaki 14.
