meta.description: Abin da Avana ke yi, waɗanda ke shiga, yadda matsayin LP ke zama jinginar Aave V4, daga ina ruwan kuɗi ke fitowa, da abin da ke cikin iyaka a Ethereum da Base a ƙaddamarwa.

toc.title: Daga Ina Ruwan Kuɗi ke Fitowa

strings: Bayanin Yarjejeniya
Abin da Avana ke yi, waɗanda ke shiga, yadda matsayin LP ke zama jinginar Aave V4, daga ina ruwan kuɗi ke fitowa, da abin da ke cikin iyaka a Ethereum da Base a ƙaddamarwa.
Abin da Avana ke Yi
Mahalarta
Hanyar Jingina
Zagayowar Rayuwar Rance
Chains, Hubs da AMMs
Daga Ina Ruwan Kuɗi ke Fitowa
Faɗi
Amana da Gudanarwa
Avana yana ba mai bayar da ruwan kuɗi damar aron GHO, da daga baya sauran kadarorin da aka amince da su, a Aave V4 a kan matsayin AMM ba tare da fitar da ruwan kuɗin daga pool ba.

Matsayin da aka jinginar yana kasancewa a cikin pool ɗinsa tare da kewayonsa da aka jera a tsawon rayuwar jinginarwa kuma yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗen ciniki. Inda yarjejeniyar AMM ke ajiye kuɗaɗe daban da matsayin, kamar yadda Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream ke yi, mai ajiya yana tattara su a kowane lokaci. Avana ba ya taɓa haɗa riba, sake daidaitawa ko ta wata hanya canza ruwan kuɗin da aka jinginar, sai dai don cire ainihin raka'o'in da aka ƙwace, waɗanda mai ajiya ya cire ko waɗanda aka yi amfani da su wajen biyan bashi.

Aave V4 yana karɓar jingina ne kawai a matsayin reserves na ERC-20, yayin da matsayin AMM NFT ne ko hannun jarin pool. Avana yana raba riƙo da lissafin jingina: LPVault yana riƙe da matsayin, Collateralization yana rubuta raka'o'i nawa yake goyon baya, kuma vault token mai ƙuntataccen canja wuri yana wakiltar waɗannan raka'o'i a kan Spoke na Aave V4 da ba a gyara ba wanda Aave DAO ke mallaka. Sannan Aave yana ƙimanta jinginar, yana ba da rance, yana bin diddigin ma'aunin lafiya kuma yana yanke shawarar lokacin da yawan liquidation.
GHO ita ce kadarar bashi ta farko. Kowace wata kadara tana zama mai iya aro da zarar Aave DAO ya amince da layin bashinta, iyakoki, tushen farashi da hanyoyin musaya.
Mahalarci
Abin da suke yi
Abin da suke fuskantar haɗarinsa
Masu aro (masu bayar da ruwan kuɗi)

Suna jinginar da matsayi na kasuwar da aka jera, suna aro, biyan bashi, cirewa da tattara kuɗaɗe ta hanyar AaveAdapter. Wallet da ke jinginarwa shi ne mai ajiya da ke cikin rikodi kuma wallet da aka ɗaure da PositionProxy ɗinsa ga wannan Spoke da kasuwa.

Liquidation na wani ɓangare na asusun kasuwa ɗaya a ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1, ciki har da lokacin da farashin kadarar bashi ya tashi. Rasa maɓallin wallet yana nufin ba za a taɓa iya cire matsayin ba.
Keeper na Avana

Keeper na Avana na kansa da aka amince da shi a kowace chain yana yin liquidation ga kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1, ko yaya girmansa yake. Ana iya ƙara wasu masu aiki da keeper na jiran aiki ta hanyar timelock, har zuwa 32 ga kowace chain.
Kuɗin gas da musaya, waɗanda Avana ke biya a matsayin kuɗin aiki.
Masu liquidation marasa izini

Kowane adireshi zai iya yin liquidation ga asusu da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1 ta hanyar wurin shiga mara izini, ta amfani da hanyoyin musaya na farko da na ajiya, kuma zai iya biyan bashin kowane asusu ko sabunta yanayin oracle da breaker.
Kuɗinsa, gas da sakamakon mayarwa, waɗanda ƙarshen lokacinsa, iyakar kashewa da mafi ƙarancin biya ke iyakancewa.
Aave DAO

Yana mallaka kuma yana saita kowane Avana Hub, CDP Spoke, Lend Spoke da Coverage Spoke: Collateral Factors, iyakoki, ƙimar riba, alamu, saituna uku da ake buƙata da waɗanne reserves ake iya aro. Mai aiwatarwarsa a kowace chain zai iya gabatarwa da soke ayyukan timelock na Avana.
Mummunan bashi fiye da First-Loss Reserve da aka ba da kuɗi na kowane Hub da kadarar bashi.
Avana Labs

Yana gabatar da kasuwanni da sigogi, yana sanya hannu a multisig na gudanarwa na 4-cikin-7 tare da masu sanya hannu na waje, yana ba da kuɗi ga kowane First-Loss Reserve kuma yana gudanar da keeper na Avana.
Jarinsa na First-Loss Reserve da gas na keepers ɗinsa.
Masu bayar da layin bashi
Baitulmalin Aave DAO yana bayar da kowane layin bashi ta hanyar Lend Spoke; ga GHO mai ba da rance shi ne GHO Reserve da Aave DAO. Duk riba tana taruwa gare su.
Asara fiye da First-Loss Reserve a kadarar Hub ɗinsu.
Guardians

Emergency Guardian (3-cikin-5 ga kowace chain) da Aave Protocol Guardian suna dakatar ko daskarar da Hubs, daskarar da adireshi, tayar da breakers, sauyawa zuwa hanyoyin farashi na jiran aiki da soke ayyukan da ke cikin layi.
Ba masu bayar da jari ba ne. Ba za su iya haɓakawa, canza sigogi ko motsa kuɗi ba.
Masu bitar haɗari
Masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave V4 suna tantance kowane jeri kuma suna tsayar da ma'aunin haɗarin pool, iyakokin USD da mafi ƙarancin jinginarwa a cikin payload na jeri.
Babu a kan chain.
Matsayi → LPVault (riƙo) → rikodin Collateralization → vault token da aka mint zuwa PositionProxy → an bayar a CDP Spoke → aro
Mai aro yana amincewa da LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM ga matsayi ɗaya kuma yana kiran AaveAdapter don jinginar da shi, yana ambaton CDP Spoke, kasuwa da ƙarshen lokaci.
A jinginarwa ta farko ta wallet cikin wannan kasuwa, ProxyManager yana ƙirƙirar PositionProxy na wallet a adireshin CREATE2 da aka hasashe.
LPVault yana bincika matsayin idan aka kwatanta da kasuwar (pool ɗaya, takamaiman kewayon tick) kuma yana karɓar riƙonsa.

Collateralization yana karanta raka'o'in matsayin, yana poke LPOracle kuma yana tambayar RiskModule game da cancanta, mafi ƙarancin jinginarwa na $10, circuit breakers da cajin iyaka, sannan yana rubuta raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige.
AaveAdapter yana mint ainihin raka'o'in da aka ƙididdige a matsayin vault tokens zuwa proxy. Proxy yana ba da su ga CDP Spoke, wanda ke motsa su cikin Hub, kuma yana kunna su a matsayin jingina.
Sannan mai aro yana aro a cikin wani kira daban. Kadarar bashi tana motsawa daga Hub da ke ba da kuɗin reserve na bashi zuwa proxy sannan zuwa mai karɓar da mai aro ya ambata.
Kowane mataki na jinginarwa yana faruwa a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. An yi bayani kan riƙo a
Tsarewa da Vault Tokens
Aiki
Yadda yake aiki
Aro

RiskModule yana bincika farashi, alamu, saiti da breakers; mai aro yana wucewa da mafi ƙarancin ma'aunin lafiya, kuma Aave yana ƙin kowane aro ƙasa da 1.00. Babu mafi ƙarancin bashi. Lens yana nuna aron da aka ba da shawara a ma'aunin lafiya 1.10.
Karɓar kuɗaɗe
Mai ajiya yana tattara kuɗaɗen da aka ware a kowane lokaci. Ba a taɓa raka'o'i, vault tokens da bashi ba.
Biyan bashi
Kowane mai biya yana biyan bashin kowane asusu ta hanyar AaveAdapter. Babu dakatarwa, daskarewa, breaker ko yanayin farashi na Avana da ke toshe shi.
Cirewa
Ana ƙona vault tokens kuma matsayin gaba ɗaya yana komawa ga mai ajiya tare da kuɗaɗensa da ba a tattara ba. Cirewa ba tare da bashi ba ba ta karanta yanayin registry kuma tana aiki a kowane yanayi.
Cirewa na wani ɓangare da sake ƙididdigewa
Mai ajiya zai iya cire wani ɓangare na ruwan kuɗin matsayin da aka jinginar, ko ya ƙididdige ruwan kuɗin da ya ƙara a matsayin daga baya.
Biyan bashi da jingina
Yana biyan bashi daga wani ɓangare na matsayi ɗaya a cikin kira ɗaya da flash ya ba da kuɗi, ba tare da kari ko kuɗin Avana ba.
Rufi

Ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1, LPVaultSwap yana yin flash-borrow na kadarar bashi, yana kiran daidaitaccen liquidation na Aave, yana ƙona vault tokens da aka ƙwace, yana sa a warware ainihin waɗannan raka'o'i, yana musayar su zuwa kadarar bashi kuma yana biyan kuɗaɗe, duka a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Mai aro yana riƙe sauran matsayin da duk kuɗaɗensa.

Avana yana gudanar da kwangiloli iri ɗaya a kowace chain, tare da misali ɗaya na kowace kwangilar kowace chain kuma kowane saitin Hub, Spoke da kasuwa ana riƙe da shi a matsayin bayanai. Chain za ta iya ɗaukar kowane ɗaya daga cikin matakan Hub uku: Stable LP, Correlated LP da Volatile LP. CDP Spoke shi ne daidaitaccen Spoke na Aave V4 ɗaya ga kowace chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari, kuma yana jera kasuwanni da yawa.
Chain

Aerodrome Slipstream Stable
Aerodrome Slipstream, matsayin da ba a yi stake ba kaɗai

Kowace chain tana da nata AvanaTimelock, multisig na gudanarwa, Emergency Guardian, jerin keepers da tushen flash. Babu aikin Avana, matsayi ko kwangila a chain ɗaya da zai iya canza yanayi a wata, kuma babu asusu, iyaka ko aikin gudanarwa da ake rabawa tsakanin chains.

Kowane wallet yana samun PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa, don haka kowace kasuwa tana da nata asusun Aave da ma'aunin lafiya. Misali daga ƙayyadaddun bayanai: a Ethereum, Alice tana jinginar da matsayin USDC/USDT ɗaya (kewayo [−10, 10]) da matsayin GHO/USDC ɗaya (kewayo [−50, 50]) a "Uniswap v3 Stable" kuma tana samun proxies biyu. Idan feed na GHO/USDC ya tsufa, asusu na biyu kaɗai ne ke daina aro, kuma ba za a iya yi wa na farko liquidation saboda shi ba.

Kowace kadara da ake iya aro tana fitowa daga layin bashi da aka iyakance wanda Aave DAO ya amince da shi kuma baitulmalinsa ke bayarwa ta hanyar Lend Spoke na bayarwa kaɗai na kowace chain. Jimillar draw caps na CDP Spokes ba ta wuce layin ba, kuma kowane draw cap yana kasancewa cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na kadarar da zurfin hanyar musaya. Layin ƙaddamarwa a Ethereum shi ne GHO 2,000,000, tare da ƙimar ƙarshe da layin Base da aka tsayar a cikin ARFC na ba da kuɗi. Riba tana taruwa ga masu ba da rance, kuma Avana ba ya cajin kuɗi a kanta.

Kusa da kowane layi, Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke) na wannan Hub da kadarar bashi yana riƙe da First-Loss Reserve da Avana ya ba da kuɗi. Ana ba shi kuɗi kafin aro ya buɗe kuma yana rufe giɓin da aka rubuta a cikin kadarorinsa. Cikakkun bayanai suna cikin

Ba a haɗa ba
Babu Invest Spoke, Multiply ko zagayen leveraged-LP, kuma babu ajiyar masu ba da rance na jama'a.
Babu allowlist na masu aro, babu mafi ƙarancin bashi kuma babu iyakar aro ta kowace rana; iyakoki ne ke iyakance fallasa.
Babu aikin da ke ƙaura da asusu zuwa sabon proxy, babu hanyoyin sa hannu ko permit a wajen chain, kuma babu biyan kuɗaɗe da ETH na asali.
Avana ba ya mallaka ko saita kowane Hub ko Spoke na Aave, kuma ba mai ba da rance ba ne.

A kowace chain, AaveAdapter da aka bita, da timelock da ke haɓaka shi, ana amincewa da su da riƙon kowane matsayin proxy. PositionProxies ba sa ɗauke da logic. Riƙo da ƙa'idar cewa matsayi yana komawa ga mai ajiyarsa kaɗai suna cikin kwangiloli marasa canzawa. Kowane canji na musamman yana aiwatarwa ta hanyar AvanaTimelock na chain: kwanaki 5 ga ayyukan yau da kullum, awanni 12 ga takamaiman rukunin kira masu rage haɗari, tare da tagar aiwatarwa ta kwanaki 14. Ba a taɓa dakatar da biyan bashi da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, don haka masu aro za su iya fita kafin kowane haɓakawa ya sauka.

Yanayin dakatarwa ga kowane Hub, circuit breakers ga kowace kasuwa da kowane reserve na bashi, da daskarewar adireshi ga kowace chain suna iyakance lamura ba tare da kama mai aro ko dakatar da liquidation ba. An gabatar da kowane ra'ayi a
Muhimman Ra'ayoyi
Abin da Avana ke yi, waɗanda ke shiga, yadda matsayi ke zama jinginar Aave V4, daga ina ruwan kuɗi ke fitowa, da abin da ke cikin iyaka a Ethereum da Base a ƙaddamarwa.

text-type-accent hover:underline
Sharuɗɗan da suka shafi lokacin da ka karanta takardun bayanai, ka yi amfani da ɗakin aikin Avana, ko ka gina haɗin tsarin ƙa'ida.
Wannan shafi yana bayyana tanade-tanaden Avana's
Sharuɗɗan Sabis

waɗanda suka shafi masu haɓaka manhaja (developers). Taƙaitawa ce, ba madadin Sharuɗɗan ba ce ko gyara gare su. Samun dama ko amfani da Ayyuka yana nufin karɓar Sharuɗɗan, ciki har da gyare-gyaren da ke fara aiki da zarar an wallafa su. Cikakkun Sharuɗɗan ne ke ayyana yarjejeniyar da ke tsakaninku da Avana. Ku koma gare su don ainihin kalmomi, sharuɗɗa, da keɓewa.

Avana yana ba da ayyukan fasaha, ciki har da yanayin gwaji, manhajar yanar gizo, da kayan bayanai. Protocol ɗin ya ƙunshi kwangiloli masu wayo na buɗaɗɗen tushe (open-source) waɗanda za su iya karɓa da riƙe kadarorin crypto da ake tallafawa. Sashe na 2 yana bambanta waɗannan kwangiloli da Ayyuka (Services) kuma yana bayyana cewa amfani da kwangilolin yana kan haɗarin mai amfani. Avana ba ya sarrafa manhajojin ɓangare na uku da aka gina a kan protocol ɗin ko ayyukan masu amfani da ke mu'amala da shi.

Fuskar ba ta riƙe maɓallan masu zaman kansu, ba ta sarrafa dukiya a madadin mai amfani, kuma ba ta canza ko juyar da ma'amalolin blockchain da aka mika ba. Wannan ya bambanta da ajiyar kuɗi a cikin kwangilar tsarin, inda kwangilar ke riƙe jingina bisa ƙa'idodinta. Sashe na 3.2 kuma ya tanadar da hakkin Avana na cajin ko canza kuɗin fuska. Duba
Sashe na 2 da na 3

Takardu, koyarwa, maƙaloli, da sauran kayan aiki suna bayyana tsarin don manufar bayani da ilimi. Ba sa maye gurbin kimantawa mai zaman kanta ta haɗi ko shawarar kuɗi. Sharuɗɗan sun bayyana cewa ƙila ba su zama cikakken tushe ko tushe kaɗai na bayanai ba. Avana ba ya aiki a matsayin dillali, mai ciniki, kasuwar musaya, mai ba da shawarar zuba jari, mai riƙo, ko mai ba da sabis na kuɗi, kuma ba ya ɗaukar wani nauyin amana ga masu amfani. Sashe na 4 yana magana kan dogaro da waɗannan kayan aiki da alhakin asarar da ke da alaƙa da su.

Samun dama yana ƙarƙashin ƙa'idojin cancanta da takunkumi a Sashe na 1. Masu amfani suna da alhakin wajibai na shari'a da haraji da suka shafe su, kare maɓallan walat, da ma'amaloli da aka sa hannu da waɗannan maɓallan. Sashe na 5 da na 11 sun hana shiga ba tare da izini ba, katsalandan, yawan buƙatu na cin zarafi, da haɗe-haɗe masu ɓatarwa. Walat, protocols, da ayyuka na ɓangare na uku suna da nasu sharuɗɗa, kuɗaɗe, ayyukan sirri, da haɗari. Waɗannan suna aiki ma lokacin da aka yi amfani da su ta hanyar haɗin Avana.

Samuwar lamba ba ta ba kowane ɓangare na Ayyuka lasisi iri ɗaya ba. Sashe na 6 yana bayyana lasisin Ayyuka, hani kan alamomin Avana, da yadda ake kula da ra'ayoyi (feedback). Inda wani ɓangaren software ke da lasisi na open-source ko business-source daban, Sashe na 6.2 ya tanadi cewa lasisin wannan ɓangaren ne ke mulkinsa. Saboda haka dole ne haɗi ya yi la'akari da sharuɗɗan kowane ɓangaren da yake amfani da shi, da kuma ƙa'idojin samun damar Ayyuka.

Sharuɗɗan suna bayyana yarjejeniyar da abubuwan da ta dogara da su a matsayin fasahar gwaji. Raunin kwangila, haɓakawa, gazawar hanyar sadarwa, hare-haren intanet, da katsewar sabis na iya sa ma'amaloli su gaza ko a rasa kadarori. Kadarori da hanyoyin sadarwa masu dacewa kuma na iya canzawa. Hanyar haɗin ba ta cire waɗannan haɗari ba, kuma misali ko sakamakon gwaji a cikin takardun bai tabbatar da cewa ma'amala ta gaba za ta ba da sakamako iri ɗaya ba. Ƙayyadaddun bayanan Avana da hanyoyin haɗin kwangila sun cika kuma sun bi ta bita ta ciki da samfurin lissafi na tsari. Za a rubuta lambar kwangilar a gaba kuma ba a yi mata audit ko tura ta ba. Turawa tana buƙatar audits masu zaman kansu na kowace kwangila, gyara, da amincewar gudanarwar Aave.

Aro mai goyon bayan LP ya dogara ne da ƙimar matsayin da ke ƙasa. Motsin kasuwa, kayan pool, abubuwan shigarwa na oracle, da ruwan kuɗin liquidation na iya shafar ƙimar jingina da lafiyar asusu. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar impermanent loss, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation. Idan ma'aunin lafiya na asusu ya faɗi ƙasa da 1, za a iya ƙwace wani ɓangare na matsayin LP ɗinsa a sasanta don biyan bashi, kuma liquidations masu maimaitawa za su iya ɗaukar shi gaba ɗaya. Waɗannan hanyoyin aiki suna bayyana yadda haɗarin yarjejeniya zai iya shafar haɗi. Ba sa iyakance faɗaɗɗun haɗari da nauyin masu amfani da aka bayyana a
Sashe na 8

Testnet na wanzu ne don gwaji da inganta haɗin kai. A ƙarƙashin Sashe na 3.1, alamun gwaji ba su da ƙima a kuɗi a wajen Testnet kuma ba za a iya fansa su ko canza su zuwa kuɗi na zahiri, kadarorin crypto na samarwa, ko wasu ƙima ba. Avana na iya canza, dakatar, ko daina dukko ko wani ɓangare na Testnet ba tare da sanarwa ba. Balances ɗin gwaji da sakamako suna bayyana yanayin gwaji ne, ba iƙirarin kadarori ko tabbatar da daidaiton aikin samarwa ba. Sandbox ɗin jama'a a app.avana.cc yana amfani da kadarori na kwaikwayo, baya yin ma'amaloli a kanchain, kuma ba shaida bane na shiri don samarwa.

Sashe na 9.1 yana samar da Ayyuka bisa ga yanayin “kamar yadda yake” da “kamar yadda yake akwai,” sai dai idan an bayyana hakan a cikin Sharuɗɗan. Yana musanta garanti kai tsaye, wanda aka iya zato, da na doka, ciki har da dacewa da wani dalili na musamman, dacewar kasuwanci, rashin take hakki, da aiki ba tare da katsewa ko kuskure ba. Inda doka ta dace ta hana a cire garanti ko sharadi, Sharuɗɗan suna iyakance yaduwa da tsawon lokacin sa zuwa mafi ƙarancin iyaka da wannan doka ta yarda da shi.

Sashe na 9.2 ya keɓe wasu nau'o'in diyya da aka ƙayyade, ciki har da diyya ta sakamako, ta kaikaice, ta haɗari, da ta musamman, bayanan da suka ɓace, ribar da aka rasa, da raguwar ƙima. Ya kuma taƙaita jimillar alhakin Avana ƙarƙashin Sharuɗɗan zuwa US$100. Sashe na 9.3 ya bayyana cewa wasu keɓewa ko iyakoki ƙila ba za su yi aiki ba a yankunan shari'a da ba su ba da izinin su ba. Ku karanta waɗannan tanade-tanaden tare da sharuɗɗa da keɓewar da ke cikin Sharuɗɗan.

Sashe na 9.4 yana bayyana alhakin biya diyya, kare kai, da maido da kudi don da'awoyi da suka shafi amfani da Ayyuka ko ayyukan wasu, karya Ka'idoji, kayan da aka aika, da sauye-sauye ko amfani ba bisa ka'ida ba. Cikakken ikon, bangarorin da abin ya shafa, da hanyoyin suna bayyana a
Sashe na 9
. Wannan takaitaccen bayanin bai faɗaɗa ko maye gurbin waɗannan wajibai ba.

Sashe na 10 ya fayyace sulhu mai ɗaurewa ƙarƙashin hanyoyin JAMS da aka bayyana a cikin Sharuɗɗan, tare da sulhu a New York, New York. Ya haɗa da sanarwa akalla kwanaki 30 kafin buƙatar sulhu, tanade-tanade don magance matsaloli na ɗan lokaci, da kuma kawar da ƙarar rukuni da shari'ar alkali, bisa ga sharuɗɗan da aka bayyana da dokar da ta dace. Sashe na 12.8 ya fayyace dokar New York. Karanta cikakken

Muhimmi:
Duk wani yunƙurin shiga dandalin Avana daga Yankin Shari'a da aka Taƙaita ana tura shi nan take zuwa Sharuɗɗan Amfani, kuma ana hana samun dama.
Samun damar zuwa gidan yanar gizon Avana da ayyukan da ke da alaƙa an iyakance shi ga mutane ko ƙungiyoyi waɗanda:
Zauna a ciki
kowane daga cikin Hukunce-hukuncen Hukunce-hukunce
'Yan kasar ne
Suna cikin jiki a cikin jiki
An haɗa a ciki
Kula da ofishin rajista a ciki
An bayyana waɗannan hane-hane a cikin Avana's
Hukunce-hukuncen Takaitacce na Yanzu
A halin yanzu an taƙaita waɗannan hukunce-hukuncen samun dama ga ayyukan Avana:
Ikkokin shari'a
Dalili
Lura:

Ana iya sabunta wannan jeri daga lokaci zuwa lokaci don amsa canje-canje a cikin dokoki, ƙa'idodi, ko shirye-shiryen takunkumi. Masu amfani suna da alhakin tabbatar da ci gaba da bin waɗannan hane-hane.
Kamar yadda aka bayyana a cikin Sharuɗɗan Amfani (Sashe 1.2), ƙila ba za ku iya shiga ko amfani da Sabis ɗin ba idan kun kasance:
Batun duk wani takunkumin da Ma'aikatar Baitulmali ta Amurka ta Ofishin Kula da Kaddarorin Waje (OFAC), Ma'aikatar Harakokin Waje ta Amurka, ko duk wata hukuma ta gwamnati da ke da hurumi.
• An Gano Akan Waɗanda Aka Ƙarya, Ƙungiya, ko Lissafin da Ba a tantance ba na Ofishin Masana'antu da Tsaro na Ma'aikatar Kasuwancin Amurka
• Wuri, tsari, ko zama a ƙasa ko yanki wanda shine, ko gwamnatinsu, batun takunkumin tattalin arziki.
Masu amfani suna da alhakin kawai don tabbatar da amfani da ƙa'idar ta bi duk dokoki da ƙa'idodi a cikin ikonsu.
Dokokin masu zuwa suna bayyana cancanta, sharuɗɗan samun dama, da wajibai lokacin amfani da ayyukan Avana:
Sharuɗɗan Sabis
Cikakkun sharuɗɗan da ke tafiyar da amfani da sabis na Avana, gami da buƙatun cancanta, ayyukan da aka haramta, da warware takaddama.
Manufar Sirri
Bayani game da yadda muke tattarawa, amfani, da kare keɓaɓɓen keɓaɓɓen keɓaɓɓen keɓaɓɓen bayanin ku lokacin da kuke amfani da ayyukanmu.
Sanarwar Shari'a
Muhimman maganganu game da kasada, garanti, da iyakokin abin alhaki.
Yankunan da aka taƙaita da ƙa'idojin taƙaita samun dama ga ayyukan Avana.

strings: Misalan Liquidation

Misalan liquidations na Avana da aka warware tare da cikakkun lambobi: Uniswap v3 a Ethereum, Aerodrome Slipstream a Base tare da grace na sequencer, bambance-bambancen kuɗi da rara, gibin dust da bayani mataki-mataki na bashin GHO.
Bayani
Uniswap v3 a Ethereum
Bambance-bambancen Rara da PayoutTooLow
Slipstream a Base
Babban Lissafi: Kuɗi, Lada da Rara
Gibin Liquidation na Dust
Bashin GHO, Kira bayan Kira
Matsalolin Gefe
Misalan liquidations da aka warware tare da kowace lamba: ƙwacewa, mafi ƙarancin dawowa, musaya, biyan flash da biyan kuɗaɗe.
Ƙimomin misali; ana tsayar da sigogin kowace kasuwa lokacin jera ta.

Kowane misali yana yin liquidation ga asusu ɗaya, wanda ke riƙe da kasuwa ɗaya, a kan reserve na bashi ɗaya. Adadin suna cikin kadarar bashi da aka biya. Tsarin lissafin da aka yi amfani da su a nan suna kan shafin tsari:
Tsarin Liquidation

Alamomin gama gari: D shi ne bashin da Aave ke biya, c vault tokens da aka ƙwace, φ premium na flash, V ƙimar oracle na ƙwacewa, R kadarar bashi da aka dawo da ita, Y rarar da aka samu, A kuɗin Avana, Kr ladan keeper, B rarar mai aro kuma keeperOut biyan mai kira.
Bob yana da matsayin USDC/USDT na Uniswap v3 a Uniswap v3 Stable CDP Spoke na Ethereum Stable LP Hub kuma yana bin bashin USDC. Ma'aunin lafiyarsa yana ƙasa da 1.
Saiti
Ƙima
Farashin vault-token
$2.10 ga kowane vault token (decimals 18)
Reserve na bashi
USDC, reserve 2, wanda layin bashi na USDC na Stable LP Hub ke ba da kuɗi, USDC DebtOracle yana ƙimanta shi a $1.00
Karin Aave
10,500 bps (5%), kuɗin liquidation 0
Izinin slippage
100 bps
Izinin zagayewar ƙasa
USDC 1
Premium na flash
5 bps: ba a ba da matsayin FLASH_BORROWER ba tukuna; maxFlashFeeBps shi ne 10
Yanayin application
Frozen, wanda ke dakatar da sababbin jinginarwa da aro amma ba wannan liquidation ba
Keeper K1 na Avana yana kiran preview na Lens, wanda ke mayar da biyan bashi na USDC 1,950 da biyan kuɗi na USDC 70.02.

K1 yana kiran liquidate ta hanyar private order flow tare da debtToCover USDC 1,950, keeperFunds 0, flashAmount USDC 1,950, PrimaryThenBackup, ƙarshen lokaci 120 s a gaba, minPayout USDC 69 (fiye da 1% ƙasa da preview) da maxShortfall 0.

LPVaultSwap yana bincika ƙarshen lokaci, yana ɗaukar kulle, yana bincika cewa an amince da K1, yana tabbatar da ma'aunin lafiya yana ƙasa da 1, kuma yana poke LP Oracle da USDC DebtOracle, wanda ke Live. Ba ya karanta yanayin dakatarwa.

Binciken flash: tushen zai iya ba da rancen USDC 1,950, kuma premium na USDC 0.975 yana wucewa saboda 975,000 × 10,000 = 9,750,000,000 bai wuce 10 × 1,950,000,000 ba. Aave V3 Pool yana ba da rancen USDC 1,950.
Aave yana biyan D = USDC 1,950 kuma yana ƙwace c = 1,950 × 1.05 / 2.10 = vault tokens 975, waɗanda aka aika zuwa LPVaultSwap.

AaveAdapter yana ƙona su kuma LP Vault yana warware kusan USDC 1,030.25 da USDT 1,010. Ƙafar USDC tana shiga R kai tsaye, kuma hanyar farko ta ƙafar USDT tana mayar da USDC 1,010.05 a ko sama da mafi ƙarancinta na kowace ƙafa. R = USDC 2,040.30.

Mafi ƙanƙanta: V = 975 × 2.10 = USDC 2,047.5. Sashen slippage shi ne ⌈2,047.5 × 0.99⌉ = USDC 2,027.025, U = raka'o'in tushe 2, don haka mafi ƙanƙantar shi ne 2,027.025 − 0.000002 − 1 = USDC 2,026.024998. R yana sama da shi, kuma gibin zagayewa shi ne max(0, 1,950 + 0.975 − 0 − 2,040.30) = 0.
Tsarin rarrabawa
Lissafi
USDC
Rarar da aka samu Y
Ribar oracle G
Kuɗin Avana A
Ladan keeper Kr
Rarar mai aro B
Y − A − Kr
keeperOut

Tsarin biya: USDC 1,950.975 zuwa tushen flash, USDC 19.305 zuwa mai karɓar kuɗi, 0 zuwa Bob, da USDC 70.02 zuwa K1, wanda ya kai aƙalla minPayout. Ana kiyaye USDC: 1,950 + 2,040.30 = 3,990.30 ya shigo, kuma 1,950 + 1,950.975 + 19.305 + 0 + 70.02 ya fita. Babu GHO da ke motsawa a kowane lokaci.
Abubuwan da suka faru sun haɗa da FlashLoanServed, FlashLoanUsed, SeizedUnitsBurned, RecordDebited, SeizureSettled, UnitsUnwound da LiquidationSettled. Biya da ya kasa isarwa yana zuwa payout escrow.
Liquidation iri ɗaya da ta sama, tare da sakamakon hanyoyi daban. Ribar oracle G tana kasancewa USDC 96.525, don haka kuɗin Avana yana kasancewa USDC 19.305 yayin da rarar da aka samu ke rufe shi.
Hanyoyi suna mayar da R
Sakamako
Dawowa ta fi ƙimar oracle: USDC 4.5 yana zuwa wallet na Bob kuma K1 yana karɓar USDC 77.22.

Mai kira da ya yi sandwich ga hanyoyinsa har zuwa ɗan sama da mafi ƙanƙanta har yanzu yana biyan cikakken kuɗin. Ladansa yana faɗuwa zuwa USDC 56.72, don haka yana sasantawa ne kawai tare da minPayout a ko ƙasa da wannan.
keeperOut shi ne USDC 64.72, ƙasa da minPayout na 69, don haka kiran yana revert da PayoutTooLow.
PayoutTooLow yana ƙara revert ne kawai. Ba ya canza adadi, hanya ko mai karɓa, kuma har yanzu ana lissafa mafi ƙanƙantar daga farashin oracle kaɗai.

Kasuwa 3 kasuwar USDC/USDT ce ta Aerodrome Slipstream (tick spacing 1, takamaiman kewayo, matsayin da ba a yi stake ba) a Aerodrome Slipstream Stable CDP Spoke na Base Stable LP Hub, wadda aka ƙimanta a $2.00 ga kowane vault token. Carol tana bin bashin USDC 20,000. Karin Aave 2% ne. Matsayin FLASH_BORROWER yana jiran aiki a Base, don haka Base Pool yana cajin 5 bps idan aka kwatanta da maxFlashFeeBps na Base na 10.

Sequencer na Base yana sake farawa a 10:00:00. A 10:20:00 ma'aunin lafiyar Carol shi ne 0.9997. Kiran keeper yana revert da SequencerGrace, saboda 0.9997 ba ya ƙasa da iyakar grace ta 0.95. Feed na USDC/USD ya wallafa na ƙarshe awanni 21 da suka gabata (75,600 s, cikin 88,200 s), don haka farashin sabo ne. Ana yi wa asusu a ma'aunin lafiya 0.93 liquidation a 10:20.

A 11:00:02, block na farko na Base na 2 s bayan lokacin grace na 3,600 s, keeper K2 yana kiran preview na Lens (biyan bashi na USDC 2,000) sannan liquidate tare da debtToCover USDC 2,000, keeperFunds 0, flashAmount USDC 2,000, PrimaryThenBackup, ƙarshen lokaci 120 s (blocks 60 na Base) a gaba, minPayout USDC 25 da maxShortfall 0.
Tushen flash zai iya ba da rance fiye da USDC 2,000 sosai. Premium shi ne USDC 1, kuma 1,000,000 × 10,000 = 10,000,000,000 bai wuce 10 × 2,000,000,000 ba.

Aave yana biyan D = USDC 2,000 kuma yana ƙwace c = 2,000 × 1.02 / 2.00 = vault tokens 1,020. Slipstream LP Vault yana bincika kulle na pool ta tsarin slot na Slipstream na kansa, sannan yana warware kusan USDC 1,020 da USDT 1,020.

Mafi ƙanƙanta: costsBps = 5 da s = min(100, ⌊10,000 × 195 / 10,200⌋) = 100. V = USDC 2,040 da φD = USDC 1. Mafi ƙanƙantar shi ne 2,019.6 − 0.000002 − 1 = USDC 2,018.599998. Hanyar USDT tana mayar da USDC 1,018.50, don haka R = USDC 2,038.50.

Pool yana jawo USDC 2,001. Kiyayewa: 4,038.5 da ya shigo daidai yake da 2,000 + 2,001 + 7.8 + 29.7 da ya fita. Idan mai fitar da USDC ya sanya mai karɓar kuɗi a blocklist, USDC 7.8 zai tafi zuwa payout escrow kuma a karɓe shi daga baya da claim.

Kasuwa 1 kasuwar USDC/USDT 0.01% ce ta Uniswap v3 tare da takamaiman kewayo a Uniswap v3 Stable CDP Spoke na Ethereum Stable LP Hub. Vault token yana da decimals 6 kuma an ƙimanta shi a $2.00. Reserve na bashi shi ne USDC a $1.00 tare da izinin zagayewar ƙasa na USDC 1, izinin slippage na 100 bps da kashi 20% na Avana. Avana yana riƙe da FLASH_BORROWER a Ethereum Core Pool, don haka premium 0 ne. Karin Aave shi ne 10,200 bps tare da kuɗin liquidation na 0.
Keeper yana yin flash-borrow na USDC 9,800 tare da keeperFunds 0.
Aave yana biyan D = USDC 9,800 kuma yana ƙwace 9,800 × 1.02 / 2.00 = vault tokens 4,998.
Pool yana a tick 3 kuma oracle a tick 2. Babu binciken spot da ke aiki; tokens da aka warware suna da ƙimar aƙalla V a farashin oracle.
Mafi ƙanƙanta: s = 100 bps, V = USDC 9,996, U = raka'o'in tushe 2, mafi ƙanƙanta USDC 9,895.039998.
LP Vault yana mayar da kusan USDC 4,998 da USDT 4,998. Ƙafar USDC ba ta buƙatar musaya. Hanyar USDT tana mayar da USDC 4,952, sama da mafi ƙarancin ƙafarta na USDC 4,946.030395. R = USDC 9,950.
Yanayi
Yanayin tushe
Hanyoyi sun fi oracle
Hanyoyi masu rauni

Yanayin tushe: ribar oracle ita ce 9,996 − 9,800 = USDC 196, don haka A = min(⌊196 × 0.2⌋, 150) = 39.2 da Kr = min(110.8, 156.8) = 110.8. keeperOut = (0 + 9,800 + 9,950) − (9,800 + 9,800 + 0 + 39.2 + 0) = 110.8. Kiyayewa: 19,750 da ya shigo daidai yake da 9,800 + 9,800 + 39.2 + 110.8 da ya fita.

Hanyoyi sun fi oracle: Kr yana da iyaka a ribar oracle bayan kuɗi, 156.8, kuma USDC 14 da suka rage suna zuwa wallet na mai aro. Idan wallet yana cikin blocklist na USDC, USDC 14 suna zuwa payout escrow da aka ƙididdige ga wallet.
Hanyoyi masu rauni: tare da minPayout da aka sanya zuwa USDC 110, kiran yana revert da PayoutTooLow(95,800,000, 110,000,000). A bai canza ba a 39.2.

Kowane adireshi zai iya yi wa asusu ɗaya liquidation ta hanyar mara izini, tare da debtToCover USDC 9,800, callerFunds 0, flashAmount USDC 9,800, ƙarshen lokaci 120 s a gaba da minPayout USDC 110. Tare da R = USDC 9,950 mai kira yana karɓar USDC 110.8 kuma kuɗin Avana shi ne USDC 39.2.
Kasuwa ɗaya. Ana ƙwace vault token na ƙarshe na asusun 0.3978 (raka'a 397,800) don D = USDC 0.78.
V = USDC 0.7956 kuma sashen slippage shi ne ⌈795,600 × 0.99⌉ = raka'o'in tushe 787,644.
Mafi ƙanƙantar shi ne max(0, 787,644 − 2 − 1,000,000) = 0. Ba tare da izinin zagayewa ba, mafi ƙanƙanta na USDC 0.787644 zai sa kowane ƙoƙari ya revert kuma ba za a taɓa rubuta gibin ba.
Hanya tana mayar da R = USDC 0.77. Gibin zagayewa shi ne 0.78 − 0.77 = USDC 0.01.
Saitunan mai kira
Flash ya ba da kuɗi, maxShortfall USDC 0.02
Mai kira yana biyan USDC 0.01 ta hanyar ƙarin kuɗi. R′ = USDC 0.78, Y = 0 da keeperOut = (0 + 0.78 + 0.78) − (0.78 + 0.78) = 0.
Flash ya ba da kuɗi, maxShortfall 0
Yana revert da InsufficientProceeds: gibin ne ya gaza, ba mafi ƙanƙantar ba. Keeper yana sake gabatarwa da keeperFunds na USDC 0.01, wanda ke rufe gibin.
Mai kira ya ba da kuɗin USDC 0.78, babu flash loan
Gibin 0 ne, Y = 0 da keeperOut = (0.78 + 0.77) − 0.78 = USDC 0.77: asarar USDC 0.01 da mai kira ya karɓa ta hanyar minPayout.
A kowane yanayi mai kira ne ke biyan gibin zagayewa. Ba a ɗiba daga kowane ma'aunin yarjejeniya ba, kuma duk gibin da kiran ya rubuta ana ba da rahotonsa kamar yadda aka saba.

Kasuwa 1 ɗaya. GHO shi ne reserve na bashi 0, wanda CDP Spoke ke ɗiba daga layin bashi na GHO na Stable LP Hub a farashin tsayayye na $1 na Aave, tare da izinin zagayewar ƙasa na GHO 1. Reserve na vault-token shi ne reserve 1, tare da Collateral Factor na 2,812 bps, matsakaicin kari na 10,500, factor na kari na 4,000, ma'aunin lafiya na matsakaicin kari na 0.90 da ma'aunin lafiya na maƙasudi na 1.10. Proxy P na Alice yana riƙe da vault tokens 141,232 (282,464 USD) kuma yana bin bashin GHO 79,452.85.

Motsin USDT yana kai ma'aunin lafiya na P zuwa 282,464 × 0.2812 / 79,452.85 ≈ 0.9997. Keeper K1 yana kiran preview na Lens ga P da reserve 0: kari 10,200, bashi zuwa maƙasudi (1.10 × 79,452.85 − 79,428.88) / (1.10 − 1.02 × 0.2812) ≈ GHO 9,800.2. GHO mara aiki na Ethereum Pool yana rufe GHO 9,800, don haka preview yana sanya flashAmount zuwa GHO 9,800 da keeperFunds zuwa 0.

K1 yana kiran liquidate ga P, kasuwa 1 da reserve 0 tare da debtToCover GHO 9,800, keeperFunds 0, flashAmount GHO 9,800, PrimaryThenBackup, ƙarshen lokaci 120 s a gaba, minPayout GHO 110 da maxShortfall 0. LPVaultSwap yana bincika ƙarshen lokaci, yana ɗaukar kulle, kuma yana bincika keeper, proxy, reserve da cewa 0 + 9,800 ≥ 9,800. Ba ya karanta yanayin dakatarwa.

LPVaultSwap yana karanta registry, yana poke LP Oracle (Live; amsoshin USDC/USD da USDT/USD masu shekarun awanni 20 da awanni 3, cikin 88,200 s), ya tarar ƙofar sequencer a buɗe a Ethereum, yana karanta ma'aunin lafiya 0.9997, kari 10,200 da kuɗin liquidation na 0, kuma yana tabbatar da hannayen jarin Hub daidai suke da kadarorinsa.

LPVaultSwap yana kiran tushen flash don GHO 9,800. Tushen yana bincika cewa reserve na GHO yana aiki kuma an kunna flash a kansa, GHO mara aiki yana rufe 9,800 kuma premium 0 ne (an ba da matsayi), sannan yana kiran flashLoan na Pool. Pool yana aika GHO 9,800 zuwa tushen kuma yana sake kiran sa; tushen yana tura GHO 9,800 zuwa LPVaultSwap kuma yana kiran onFlashLoan, wanda ke gudanar da matakai biyar na gaba.
beginSeizure na Collateralization yana ɗaukar hoton hannayen jari 141,232,000,000 da P ya bayar.

LPVaultSwap yana amincewa da Spoke don GHO 9,800 kuma yana kiran liquidation ga reserve na jingina 1, reserve na bashi 0 da P, tare da receiveShares false. Aave yana mayar da D = GHO 9,800 zuwa Hub kuma Hub yana tura vault tokens 4,998 zuwa LPVaultSwap. Babu gibi.

AaveAdapter yana ƙona vault tokens 4,998. Collateralization yana bincika cewa raguwar hannun jari da raguwar wadata duka daidai suke da c, yana cire daga rikodi mafi girma na P, kuma yana sa Uniswap v3 LP Vault ya warware raka'a 4,998,000,000. LP Vault yana tattara ainihin kuɗin kaɗai, kusan USDC 4,998 da USDT 4,998, zuwa LPVaultSwap.

Mafi ƙanƙanta a GHO shi ne GHO 9,895.0399980002 (U = GHO 0.0000019998). Hanyoyin farko na USDC→GHO da USDT→GHO, ta tsayayyun pools na DEX, suna mayar da GHO 4,976 da 4,974: R = GHO 9,950 kuma gibin zagayewa 0 ne.
onFlashLoan yana mayar da GHO 9,800 zuwa tushen flash sannan ya dawo; tushen yana amincewa da Pool don GHO 9,800, wanda yake janye shi.

Tsarin rarrabawa: Y = 150, A = 39.2, Kr = 110.8, B = 0 da keeperOut = GHO 110.8, aƙalla minPayout. LPVaultSwap yana aika GHO 39.2 zuwa mai karɓar kuɗi da GHO 110.8 zuwa K1, yana fitar da LiquidationSettled kuma yana sakin kulle.

Bayan ma'amalar, P yana riƙe da vault tokens 136,234 (USD 272,468) a kan GHO 69,652.85, ma'aunin lafiya na 272,468 × 0.2812 / 69,652.85 = 1.09999. Alice tana riƙe da sauran matsayinta da dukkan kuɗaɗensa. Da K1 ya kira aikin liquidation na Spoke kai tsaye, canja wurin vault-token na Hub zuwa K1 zai revert da UnauthorizedRecipient.
Abin da ke faruwa
Kasuwar Expired

Asusu a kasuwar Expired 7 da ke riƙe da vault tokens na $20,000 kuma yana bin bashin GHO 6,400 yana da ma'aunin lafiya kusa da 0, saboda jingina ta Expired tana ƙidaya kusan 0. Kiran da ya ambaci kasuwa 7 yana revert da StalePrice har sai sabon farashi ko hanyar farashi ta jiran aiki ta iso; sannan keeper yana yin liquidation a sabon farashin.
Farashin bashi da ya tsufa

USDC da aka karɓa a 0.9999 kuma Expired, tare da hauhawar matsi ta 500 bps, yana ƙidaya a USD 1.049895. Har yanzu ana iya yi wa asusun liquidation a kan bashinsa na GHO; kiran da ke biyan USDC yana jiran sabon farashin USDC.
Pool ya motsa kafin kiran

An tura pool zuwa USDT 2 ga kowane USDC. Matsayin $10,000 yanzu yana riƙe da tokens masu ƙimar $10,606.60 a farashin oracle. Liquidation yana warwarewa a wannan farashin; kowace hanya dole ne har yanzu ta cika mafi ƙanƙantar oracle ɗinta, kuma mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa yana amfani da V = 10,000.
Kiran liquidation na ɓangare na uku

Maharin da ke riƙe da USDC 1 yana kiran liquidation na Spoke kai tsaye a kan asusu mai ma'aunin lafiya na 0.98. Aave yana auna ƙwacewar raka'o'i 510,000, kuma canja wurin Hub yana revert da UnauthorizedRecipient. Asusun bai canza ba.
Rufe dukan bashin USDC 1,950 da aka auna a USDC 2,047.5 har yanzu yana sasantawa bayan biyan 1-wei: Aave yana janye USDC 1,949.999999 kuma biyan mai kira yana ƙasa da 1 wei.
Hanyar ƙura

Bashin USDC a $0.70 da hanyar DAI ta DAI 0.000007349976535931 a $0.05000016: ƙimar hanyar ba ta kai raka'ar tushe ɗaya ta USDC ba, don haka ana aika ta ga mai kira ba tare da musanya ba, R = 0, mafi ƙanƙantar shi ne 0, kuma kiran da mai kira ya ba da kuɗinsa yana biyan bashin ƙurar.
Ƙaramin asusu a Base

Asusu da ke bin bashin USDC 40 tare da rikodi ɗaya yana amfani da gas 1,550,000. Kason keeper na ribar shi ne USDC 0.54208, kuma keeper na Avana yana yi masa liquidation ko ya rufe gas ɗin ko bai rufe ba.
Rufe dukan bashi da iyakar rikodi

Asusu da ke bin bashin USDC 320 wanda preview ɗinsa ke mayar da rufe dukan bashi na USDC 336 ana yi masa liquidation a kira ɗaya tare da debtToCover USDC 336. Asusu mai rikodi 16 yana amfani da gas 5,150,000, har yanzu ma'amala ɗaya ce.
Misalan liquidation na Avana tare da cikakkun lambobi, daga Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da Slipstream a Base zuwa bambance-bambancen kuɗi, gibin ƙura da bayani dalla-dalla na bashin GHO.

Yanayin Ƙarshe
Kowane mataki na liquidation ɗaya, bisa tsarin aiwatarwa, tare da bincike, tsarin lissafi da biyan kuɗaɗe da LPVaultSwap ke amfani da su.

Kira ɗaya yana yi wa asusu ɗaya liquidation, a kasuwar jinginarsa ɗaya, a kan reserve na bashi ɗaya, kuma yana sasanta shi a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Ana auna kowane adadi a matsayin canjin ma'auni a cikin kiran, ba a matsayin cikakken ma'auni ba kuma ba daga ƙimar da wata kwangila ta mayar ba. Idan kowane mataki ya kasa, dukan ma'amalar tana revert.

Idan kiran yana amfani da flash loan, matakan daga riƙe kadarar bashi zuwa binciken gibi suna gudana a cikin callback na flash-loan. Ba tare da flash loan ba suna gudana kai tsaye bayan an janye kuɗaɗen mai kira. Babu matakin da ke gaban warwarewa da ke taɓa pool na kasuwar.
Wanda zai iya kira, da lokacin da asusu ya cancanta, suna a shafin ƙira:
Zanen Rushewa

Kowane adadin sasantawa yana cikin raka'o'in tushe na kadarar bashin da aka biya: decimals 6 ga USDC da USDT, 18 ga GHO da WETH. Farashi USD ne mai decimals 8. Basis points suna amfani da 10,000 = 100%. ⌊·⌋ yana zagaye ƙasa kuma ⌈·⌉ yana zagaye sama.

Ƙarshen lokaci
LPVaultSwap yana revert da DeadlineExpired idan timestamp na block ya wuce ƙarshen lokaci, kafin kulle da kafin kowane kira na waje.
Kulle da binciken shigarwa

LPVaultSwap yana ɗaukar kullen yarjejeniya na chain (LockHeld idan an riga an riƙe shi), sannan yana bincika adadin (InvalidAmount), mai kira da aka daskarar (AddressIsFrozen), keeper da aka amince da shi a hanyar keeper (NotApprovedKeeper), proxy (UnknownProxy), reserve na bashi (UnknownDebtReserve) da yanayin hanya. Ba a karanta yanayin dakatarwa.
Gano kasuwar

Daga MarketRegistry: CDP Spoke, Hub na gida, reserve na jingina, vault token, haɗin AMM da LP Vault ɗinsa, pool da takamaiman kewayo, tokens na kasuwar da hanyoyin musanya; kadarar reserve na bashi, decimals, Hub mai ba da kuɗi, tushen farashi da Avana Umbrella (UnknownMarket idan ba su dace ba).
Poke oracles da bincika farashi

LPVaultSwap yana poke LP Oracle na kasuwar da DebtOracle na reserve da aka biya, sannan yana bincika ma'aunin lafiya (NotLiquidatable), farashin jingina (StalePrice), grace na dawowa (GraceHealthFactor), hannun jarin Hub a kan kadarori (SharesNotEqualAssets) da farashin bashi (DebtPriceStale).
Ƙofar sequencer
Idan ya tsaya yana revert da SequencerDown. A lokacin grace bayan sake farawa, asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na 0.95 ne kaɗai ke wucewa (SequencerGrace). Ethereum a buɗe yake koyaushe.
Karanta ribar
Ma'aunin lafiya, riba b da kuɗin liquidation lf daga Spoke, an karanta su a kira da block ɗaya da liquidation, don haka sun yi daidai da abin da Aave ke amfani da shi; farashin bashi Pdebt.
LPVaultSwap ba ya karanta farashin spot na pool. Pool da ya motsa ba ya taɓa sa kiran ya revert ko ya canza yanayin hanyarsa.
Samar da kuɗi
Yana janye K daga mai kira idan K ya wuce 0 (FundingMismatch sai dai idan K daidai ya iso). Idan F ya wuce 0, yana aron F ta tushen flash; matakan da ke biye suna gudana a cikin callback.
Riƙe kadarar bashi
LPVaultSwap yana buƙatar ma'aunin kadarar bashinsa ya ƙaru da aƙalla X (FundingMismatch). Ba a taɓa sayen kadarar bashi da wata kadara.
beginSeizure
Collateralization yana bincika kulle da mai kira, yana bincika hannun jarin Hub a kan kadarori, kuma yana adana hannun jarin da proxy ya bayar da jimillar samar da vault token a transient storage.
liquidationCall

LPVaultSwap yana amincewa da Spoke don X daidai kuma yana kiran liquidation tare da receiveShares a matsayin false, sannan yana sake saita amincewar. Aave yana tabbatarwa, yana auna biyan, yana janye D zuwa Hub mai ba da kuɗi kuma yana aika vault tokens c daga Hub na gida zuwa LPVaultSwap. Yana ba da rahoton gibi idan kiran ya kwashe jinginar.
Auna D da c

Ana auna dukansu a matsayin canjin ma'auni. Idan c 0 ne kiran yana revert da NothingSeized. X − D da ba a yi amfani da shi ba yana zama a LPVaultSwap don biyan babban kuɗin flash ko mayarwa ga mai kira; ba a taɓa musanya shi.
Buɗe tagar dawowa
LPVaultSwap yana rubuta ma'auninsa na kowane token na kasuwa da na kadarar bashi. Kuɗaɗen mai kira, babban kuɗin flash da kadarar bashi da ba a yi amfani da ita ba suna zama a wajen tagar R.
burnSeized
AaveAdapter, wanda shi kaɗai ke ƙona vault token, yana ƙona raka'o'i c daga ma'aunin LPVaultSwap (SeizedUnitsBurned).
settleSeizure

Collateralization yana bincika snapshot, kullen pool, cewa raguwar hannun jari daidai take da c kuma raguwar samarwa daidai take da c. Yana daidaita duk wata ƙwacewa ta baya ta proxy da ba a sasanta ba, yana cire raka'o'i c daga rikodin proxy, kuma yana sa LP Vault ya warware waɗannan raka'o'in daidai.
Auna warwarewar
LPVaultSwap yana auna adadin aᵢ na kowane token na kasuwa da ya karɓa. Kuɗaɗen da ba a tattara ba ba sa taɓa shiga waɗannan adadin.
LPVaultSwap yana lissafa ribar net, ingantaccen slippage, V, U da mafi ƙanƙanta minOut a kadarar bashi, da mafi ƙanƙantar kowace hanya.
Hanyoyin musanya

Ana musanya kowane token da ba kadarar bashi ba ta hanyarsa a mafi ƙanƙantarsa da aka samo daga oracle, a yanayin hanyar da mai kira ya saita. R shi ne kadarar bashi da aka karɓa daga farkon tagar zuwa ƙarshen canzawa.
Binciken gibi

Gibin shi ne max(0, minOut − R, D + φD − K − R). Gibin mafi ƙanƙanta da ya fi maxShortfall yana revert da RecoveryBelowFloor; gibin zagayewa da ya fi shi yana revert da InsufficientProceeds. In ba haka ba, ana janye gibin daga mai kira.
Tsarin rarrabawa
LPVaultSwap yana lissafa Y, A, Kr, B da keeperOut (InsufficientProceeds idan ƙasa da sifili), sannan yana bincika keeperOut a kan minPayout (PayoutTooLow).
Biyan flash loan
LPVaultSwap yana aika F + φ zuwa tushen flash, wanda ke amincewa da Pool don wannan adadin daidai; Pool yana janye shi.
Biyan kuɗaɗe
A zuwa mai karɓar kuɗi, sannan B zuwa wallet na mai aro, sannan keeperOut zuwa mai kira, duka a kadarar bashi. Ana tsallake adadin sifili. Canja wurin da aka ƙi yana zuwa payout escrow.
Event da kulle
LPVaultSwap yana fitar da LiquidationSettled kuma yana sakin kulle. Canjin ma'auninsa na net 0 ne a kowane token, kuma kowace amincewa da ya bayar 0 ce.

Kowane chain yana da kwangilar tushen flash ɗaya, wadda ake karantawa daga flashSource na MarketRegistry kuma timelock na chain zai iya maye gurbinta a jinkirin da aka saba. Aiwatarwarta ɗaya tak tana kiran flashLoan na Aave V3 Pool na chain da kadara ɗaya kuma ba tare da yanayin bashi ba: Core Pool a Ethereum, da Base Pool a 0xA238Dd80C259a72e81d7e4664a9801593F98d1c5. Aave V4 ba shi da flash loans. Aikin flash-loan mai sauƙi ba ya yafe premium ga matsayin FLASH_BORROWER, don haka ana amfani da cikakken kiran flashLoan.
Bincike kafin ba da rance

Mai ba da rancen kada ya zama Hub na gida na CDP Spoke ko Hub mai ba da kuɗi na reserve (FlashSourceIsHub). Liquidation kada ya biya Hub da ruwan kuɗin wannan Hub ɗin, wanda zai ɓoye ƙarancin ruwan kuɗi.
Ruwan kuɗin da ake da shi na tushen flash dole ya kai aƙalla F (FlashLiquidityShort).

Reserve na Pool na kadarar dole ya kasance a aiki, ba a dakatar da shi ba kuma an kunna shi don flash loans, tare da ruwan kuɗin da ba a amfani da shi na aƙalla F (FlashSourcePaused, InsufficientFlashLiquidity).
Premium dole ya cika sharaɗin iyakar da ke ƙasa (FlashFeeTooHigh).
φ × 10,000 ≤ maxFlashFeeBps × F

Kwatancen daidai ne, a raka'o'in tushe a ɓangarorin biyu. maxFlashFeeBps 10 ne a Ethereum da Base, sama da premium na Aave V3 na 5 bps. Ana yafe premium idan Pool ya ba tushen flash matsayin FLASH_BORROWER; sannan gudanarwa tana rage maxFlashFeeBps zuwa 0 da tightenMaxFlashFeeBps a gajeren jinkiri. Premium kuɗin sasantawa ne, wanda ake biya kafin kuɗin Avana.

Misali: flash loan na USDC 2,000 a 5 bps yana da premium na USDC 1. 1,000,000 × 10,000 = 10,000,000,000 bai wuce 10 × 2,000,000,000 = 20,000,000,000 ba, don haka rancen yana ci gaba. A 11 bps (USDC 2.2) binciken yana kasawa kuma kiran yana revert; mai kira yana sake turawa da cikakken kuɗinsa.
Callbacks

Pool yana kiran executeOperation na tushen flash, wanda ke karɓar Pool kaɗai a matsayin mai kira, kansa a matsayin mai farawa, kadara ɗaya, da kadarar da adadin da ya nema (InvalidFlashCallback). Yana tura adadin da ya karɓa zuwa LPVaultSwap kuma yana kiran onFlashLoan na LPVaultSwap. LPVaultSwap yana karɓar wannan callback ne kawai daga tushen flash na chain, tare da yanayin sasantawa mai aiki, kadarar bashi ta reserve, adadin da ya yi daidai da canjin ma'auninsa, da kulle a riƙe. Yanayin yana ɗauke da mai ganowa kaɗai; sigogin da aka tabbatar suna zama a transient storage.
Liquidation na Aave

Spoke na yau da kullum yana tabbatar da kiran (ba liquidation na kai ba, adadi ya wuce 0, ba a dakatar da reserves ba, an ba da jingina, an ɗauki bashi a reserve, ma'aunin lafiya ƙasa da 1), yana auna biyan a kan ma'aunin lafiya da yake nufi tare da ribarsa mai canzawa da ƙa'idar ƙura, yana janye D, kuma yana cire vault tokens c daga Hub na gida zuwa LPVaultSwap. An kashe karɓar hannun jari maimakon tokens a reserve, don haka LPVaultSwap koyaushe yana tura false.
Binciken ƙonawa da littafin lissafi

AaveAdapter yana ƙona raka'o'i c, sannan Collateralization yana bincika cewa raguwar hannun jarin da proxy ya bayar daidai take da c (DebitMismatch) kuma raguwar samar da vault token daidai take da c (SupplyDropMismatch). Collateralization yana karanta Spoke, Hub, reserve da vault token daga immutables na vault token kaɗai, ba daga mai kira ba. Haka kuma yana ƙin warwarewa yayin da pool ke cikin callback (PoolLocked), yana karanta tsarin slot na kowane AMM don wannan binciken kaɗai.
Bin rikodi

Collateralization yana cire raka'o'i c daga rikodin proxy, rikodin da aka fi sa wa kuɗi da farko, idan sun yi daidai a bi ID na rikodi mafi ƙanƙanta. Yana tsayawa a rikodin farko da ya rufe ragowar, don haka rikodi ɗaya ne kawai za a iya cire wa wani ɓangare. Rikodi a raka'a 0 yana zama a buɗe ga mai ajiyarsa. Asusu yana riƙe da rikodi 16 ne a mafi yawa ga kowace kasuwa. Kowane rikodi na kasuwa yana da takamaiman kewayon kasuwar, don haka raka'o'in suna iya maye gurbin juna kuma tsarin ba shi da tasirin tattalin arziki. Idan rikodin suna riƙe da raka'o'in da ba su kai c ba, kiran yana revert da InsufficientCredit.

Kafin cire c, Collateralization yana daidaita duk wani hannun jari da wata ƙwacewa ta baya da ba a sasanta ba ta ɗauka ba tare da cirewa ba. Yana cire waɗannan raka'o'in ma, yana warware su zuwa ma'auninsa na jiran aiki, kuma yana fitar da SeizureReconciled. Ana sasanta waɗannan tokens daga baya ta settlePending kuma ba a taɓa biyan su a cikin liquidation ba.
Warwarewa

Ga kowane rikodi da aka cire wa, LP Vault na kasuwar yana cire raka'o'in da aka cire daidai kuma yana aika babban kuɗin zuwa LPVaultSwap. Ga Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream yana kiran decreaseLiquidity da mafi ƙanƙanta sifili, sannan collect da aka iyakance a babban kuɗin, don haka kuɗaɗen da ake bin matsayin suna zama tare da shi ga mai ajiya. Collateralization yana sakin fallasar rikodin bisa tushe tsayayye: sauran caji shi ne asalin caji sau raka'o'in da suka rage bisa asalin raka'o'i, an zagaye sama.
Misali: rikodin da aka yi pledge da raka'o'i 600,000,000 da cajin USD 1,200 ana cire masa raka'o'i 200,000,000. Yana riƙe da ⌈1,200 × 400 / 600⌉ = USD 800 na caji kuma yana sakin USD 400 na iyaka.

Ga kowane token na kasuwa da kowace kadarar bashi da aka kunna, MarketRegistry yana rubuta hanyar musanya ta farko da ta ajiya. Kowace kwangilar hanya tana da tsayayyar hanya da aka saita a lokacin turawa, tana karɓar LPVaultSwap kaɗai a matsayin mai kira, kuma tana tilasta mafi ƙanƙantar fitarwa da ta karɓa (MinOutNotMet).

Nau'ikan hanya: DexPath (tsayayyun tsalle-tsallen pool a Uniswap v3, Slipstream, Curve ko Balancer), PegModule (GHO Stability Module a Ethereum, a gurbin ajiya na reserve na bashin GHO kaɗai, ko Sky LitePSM don DAI ko USDS zuwa USDC), da WrapperThenDex (mataki ɗaya na unwrap, sannan tsalle-tsallen pool).
Hanya ba ta taɓa yin ciniki ta pool na kasuwar kanta, wanda ake warwarewa a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Ana karɓar duk wani callback na pool ne kawai daga pool da aka tsayar a hanyar.
Hanyar ajiya ba ta raba kowace kwangila ta waje ko token na tsakiya, ban da kadarar bashi, da hanyar farko, don haka gazawa ɗaya ba za ta iya kashe duka biyun ba.
GHO Stability Module ba ya taɓa zama hanyar farko.
Jera kasuwa yana buƙatar duka hanyoyin biyu na kowane token su iya musanya cikakkiyar ƙimar gefe ɗaya ta matsayi mafi girma a cikin izinin slippage na kasuwar.
Mafi ƙanƙanta ga kowace hanya
Kowace hanya tana gudana da mafi ƙanƙantar fitarwa da aka samo daga farashin oracle, ta farko da ta ajiya duka. Babu musanya ta liquidation da ke gudana ba tare da shi ba.
minOutᵢ = max(1, ⌈Vlegᵢ × (10,000 − sLeg) / 10,000⌉ − Ulegᵢ − ⌊floorRoundingAllowance / k⌋)

Vlegᵢ ita ce ƙimar hanyar a kadarar bashi a farashin hanya da aka iyakance na LP Oracle, Ulegᵢ raka'a ɗaya ce ta asali ta token a kadarar bashi, k shi ne adadin hanyoyin da aka musanya, kuma sLeg shi ne slippage na hanya (ingantaccen slippage s, wanda aka faɗaɗa da izinin gibi kamar yadda aka bayyana a ƙasa).

Misali: hanyar USDT 4,998 a USD 0.9998 zuwa USDC, tare da sLeg na 100 bps, hanya ɗaya da aka musanya da izinin USDC 1: Vleg = USDC 4,997.0004, kuma mafi ƙanƙantar shi ne 4,947.030396 − 0.000001 − 1 = USDC 4,946.030395.
Hanyoyin ƙura, ragowa da hanyoyin da suka kasa

Token mai ƙimar kusan raka'a ɗaya ta asali ta kadarar bashi a mafi yawa hanyar ƙura ce. Ba a musanya shi: LPVaultSwap yana aika shi gaba ɗaya ga mai kira kuma yana ƙidaya shi a matsayin 0 a cikin R. In ba haka ba, kowace hanya za ta iya mayar da 0 gare shi kuma ba za a taɓa iya yi wa asusun liquidation ba.
Tokens na shigarwa ko na tsakiya da hanya ta mayar ba tare da canzawa ba suna ƙidaya a matsayin 0 a cikin R kuma suna zuwa ga mai kira (ResidueReturned).

Hanyar farko da ta revert tana fitar da RouteFailed, ana sake saita amincewarta zuwa 0, kuma ana kiran ta ajiya. Idan babu hanyar da za a iya amfani da ita da ta canza token, kiran yana revert da NoRouteAvailable.

Rikodin hanya suna canzawa ta timelock kaɗai: setRoute a jinkirin da aka saba (kwanaki 5), disableRoute da restoreRoute na hanyar da aka amince da ita a baya a gajeren jinkiri (awanni 12). Aiki da ke maido da hanyoyi kaɗai, executor na gudanarwar Aave ne kaɗai zai iya soke shi.
Warwarewa a kowane farashin pool

Warwarewar tana gudana da mafi ƙanƙanta sifili ga kowane token saboda LP Oracle yana ƙimanta matsayi a tsarin haɗinsa na adalci, mafi ƙanƙantar ƙimar oracle ɗinsa a dukan farashin pool. Cire ruwan kuɗin a kowane farashin pool yana mayar da tokens masu ƙimar aƙalla V a farashin oracle. Abin da pool da ya motsa zai iya gurɓatawa har yanzu shi ne musanya, kuma kowace hanyar musanya tana da mafi ƙanƙantar oracle ɗinta. Ƙofar spot ba za ta ƙara komai ba kuma za ta bar kowa ya ci gaba da rayar da asusun da ke ƙarƙashin ruwa ta hanyar motsa pool mara zurfi kafin kowane yunƙuri.

Misali: matsayin USDC/USDT mai cikakken kewayo mai ƙimar $10,000 a $1.00 kowanne yana riƙe da kusan 5,000 na kowane token. Maharin yana motsa pool zuwa USDT 2 ga kowane USDC. Matsayin yanzu yana riƙe da USDC 3,535.53 da USDT 7,071.07, masu ƙimar $10,606.60 a farashin oracle. Keeper yana ƙwace shi kuma yana warware shi a wannan farashin pool, hanyar USDT dole har yanzu ta mayar da mafi ƙanƙantar oracle ɗinta, kuma ana lissafa mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa daga V = 10,000.

Ana lissafa mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa a kadarar bashi, don haka ƙa'ida ɗaya tana aiki ga GHO, USDC, WETH ko kowane reserve na bashi. Tana ba da izinin daidai asarar musanya da ribar net ta Aave za ta iya biya bayan premium na flash.
costsBps = ⌈φ × 10,000 / F⌉ (0 idan F = 0)
s = min(slippageAllowanceBps, ⌊10,000 × (bNet − 10,000 − costsBps) / bNet⌋), ko 0 idan ba sama da sifili ba
V = ⌊c × Pc × 10^dd / (10^dv × Pdebt)⌋
U = Σᵢ ⌈pᵢ × 10^dd / (10^dᵢ × Pdebt)⌉ (token da ke kadarar bashi yana ƙidaya 1)
minOut = max(0, ⌈V × (10,000 − s) / 10,000⌉ − U − floorRoundingAllowance)
s yana warware (1 + bNet)(1 − s) ≥ 1 + costs, don haka sashen slippage shi kaɗai yana biyan bashin da premium na flash. slippageAllowanceBps 100 ne a ƙaddamarwa.
V yana amfani da farashin da Aave ya yi amfani da su don ƙwacewar, don haka mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa yana auna asarar musanya kaɗai, ba bambancin farashi tsakanin Avana da Aave ba.

U da floorRoundingAllowance suna ba da damar liquidations na ƙura su sasanta. Cire AMM da musanya suna zagaye ƙasa har zuwa raka'a ɗaya ta asali ga kowane token. Ba tare da waɗannan sassan ba, liquidation na ƙura zai revert a kowane yunƙuri, kuma ba za a taɓa rubuta gibinsa ba.
Ana saita floorRoundingAllowance ga kowane reserve na bashi lokacin da aka kunna shi: token cikakke ɗaya ga stablecoin na USD (1,000,000 ga USDC, 10^18 ga GHO) da WETH 0.0005 ga bashin WETH.
Mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa bai dogara da kowace shigarwa ta mai kira ba. V yana zagaye ƙasa kuma sashen slippage yana zagaye sama, duka biyun a kan mai kira.

Misali (Ethereum, bashin USDC): c = vault tokens 4,998 a Pc = 2.00, bNet = 10,200 kuma babu premium. s = min(100, ⌊10,000 × 200 / 10,200⌋) = 100. V = USDC 9,996. Tare da USDC a 1.0000 da USDT a 0.9998, U = raka'o'in tushe 2. minOut = 9,896.04 − 0.000002 − 1 = USDC 9,895.039998.
Bayan musanyar, LPVaultSwap yana lissafa adadin da mai kira dole ya ƙara:
shortfall = max(0, minOut − R, D + φD − K − R)
Sashe na farko shi ne dawowa da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta. Idan ya fi maxShortfall, kiran yana revert da RecoveryBelowFloor.

Sashe na biyu shi ne gibin zagayewa g: abin da kuɗaɗen mai kira na kansa suka bari ba a rufe ba na bashin da premium na flash ɗinsa. Idan ya fi maxShortfall, kiran yana revert da InsufficientProceeds.
In ba haka ba, LPVaultSwap yana janye gibin daidai daga mai kira, kuma R′ = R + shortfall.

Mai kira ne ke biyan gibin zagayewa, ba ma'aunin yarjejeniya ba, a hanyar keeper da hanyar ba tare da izini ba duka. Mai kira ne ya zaɓi girman liquidation da yadda za a ba shi kuɗi, don haka yana biyan 'yan raka'o'in tushe na zagayewa da suka biyo baya.

Mai kira da ya ba da izinin ƙarin kuɗi yana kuma bar kowace hanya ta gudana a slippage mafi faɗi, wanda ke sa liquidations su ci gaba a cikakken girma idan hanyoyi suna ciniki ƙasa da oracle a lokacin faɗuwar kasuwa:
sLeg = min(9,999, s + min(maxShortfallBps, ⌊maxShortfall × 10,000 / V⌋))
maxShortfallBps 1,000 ne. Kuɗin Avana ba ya raguwa idan an biya gibi, kuma rarar mai aro 0 ce a irin wannan yanayi, don haka ƙarin kuɗin mai kira ba ya taɓa kaiwa ga mai aro.

Misali: V = USDC 12,422.6, s = 100 bps da maxShortfall = USDC 200. Hanyoyin suna gudana a 260 bps, hanyoyin suna mayar da USDC 12,174, ana janye USDC 123.373998 daga mai kira, kuma liquidation yana sasantawa a cikakken girma.

Kafin callback ya dawo, LPVaultSwap yana canja isasshen kadarar bashi zuwa tushen flash har ma'auninsa ya ƙaru da F + φ, wanda ake bincika a matsayin canjin ma'auni. Babban kuɗin flash da ba a kashe ba da kadarar bashi da Aave bai janye ba suna biyan rancen a cikin ma'amala ɗaya. Tushen flash yana amincewa da Pool don F + φ daidai, Pool yana janye shi, kuma tushen flash yana sake saita amincewar kuma yana bincika cewa ma'auninsa bai canza ba (FlashRepayShort in ba haka ba).

Premium a kan babban kuɗin flash da bashin bai buƙata ba, φ − φD, ana biyan shi daga biyan mai kira kaɗai. Idan rarar ba za ta iya biyan sa ba, kiran yana revert da InsufficientProceeds. Kadarar bashi mai kuɗin canja wuri ana ƙara adadinta, kuma wannan kuɗin ma yana faɗawa kan biyan mai kira.
Y = max(0, R′ − D − φD)
G = max(0, V − D − φD)
A = min(⌊G × avanaFeeShareBps / 10,000⌋, Y)
Kr = min(Y − A, G − A)
B = Y − A − Kr
keeperOut = (K + F + R′) − (D + F + φ + A + B)

Kuɗin Avana A shi ne 20% (avanaFeeShareBps = 2,000) na ribar oracle G, ba ya taɓa wuce rarar da aka samu Y. Yayin da Y ke rufe shi, A ya dogara ne kawai da ƙimar oracle na ƙwacewar da bashin da aka biya, ba da yadda mai kira ya yi musanya ba. Tun da A ba ya taɓa wuce Y, kuɗin shi kaɗai ba ya taɓa sa liquidation ya revert.
Ladan keeper Kr shi ne sauran ribar oracle, wanda aka iyakance da abin da aka samu.

Rarar mai aro B ita ce dawowar da ke sama da ƙimar oracle na jinginar da aka ƙwace. Ba sifili ba ce kawai idan hanyoyin sun fi farashin oracle, don haka motsin farashi mai kyau a lokacin sasantawa yana zuwa ga mai aro.
A + Kr + B = Y daidai. A yana zagaye ƙasa, don haka ƙurar zagayewa tana zama tare da mai aro.

keeperOut daidai yake da Kr tare da kuɗaɗen mai kira da ba a kashe ba, a cire premium a kan babban kuɗin flash da ba a yi amfani da shi ba kuma a cire duk wani gibi da mai kira ya ƙara. Idan zai zama ƙasa da sifili, kiran yana revert da InsufficientProceeds.
Ana kiyaye kadarar bashi: K + F + R + shortfall = D + (F + φ) + A + B + keeperOut. LPVaultSwap ba ya taɓa riƙewa ko ƙirƙirar kadarar bashi.
Tsarin biya
Babban kuɗin flash da premium F + φ, da ake mayarwa ga tushen flash a cikin callback.
Kuɗin Avana A zuwa mai karɓar kuɗi da aka karanta daga ParameterStore. Mai karɓar kuɗi na sifili yana revert da InvalidFeeRecipient.
Rarar mai aro B zuwa wallet na mai aro, wallet da AaveAdapter ke rubutawa ga proxy (BorrowerSurplusPaid).
keeperOut zuwa mai kira.
Ba a ɗaukar mai karɓa daga calldata, babu abin da ke taruwa a LPVaultSwap, kuma ana tsallake kowane canja wuri na adadin sifili. Ana auna kowane biya a matsayin canjin ma'aunin mai karɓa.

Misali (Ethereum, bashin USDC): D = 9,800, V = 9,996, babu premium, kuma hanyoyin suna mayar da R = USDC 9,950. Y = 150, A = min(⌊196 × 0.2⌋, 150) = 39.2, Kr = min(110.8, 156.8) = 110.8, B = 0 da keeperOut = USDC 110.8. Idan R = USDC 10,010 maimakon haka: Y = 210, A = 39.2, Kr = 156.8 da B = USDC 14 ga mai aro.
Kowane biya (kuɗin Avana, rarar mai aro, biyan mai kira, ragowa ko hanyar ƙura) yana amfani da isarwa mai iyakar gas wadda ba za ta iya sa liquidation ya revert ba:
LPVaultSwap yana buƙatar isasshen gas da ya rage: ⌈100,000 × 64 / 63⌉ + 10,000 = gas 111,588, in ba haka ba InsufficientGas. Wannan yana hana mai kira hana kiran gas don tura biya zuwa escrow.
Yana kiran transfer na token da gas 100,000 daidai kuma yana karanta bytes 32 na bayanan dawowa a mafi yawa.

Idan canja wurin ya revert, ya mayar da false ko gas ya ƙare, LPVaultSwap yana amincewa da payout escrow don adadin daidai kuma yana kiran deposit ɗinsa, wanda aka sa wa mai karɓa. Liquidation yana ci gaba. Revert na deposit ɗin kansa ne kaɗai ke sa kiran ya revert.

Payout escrow yana riƙe da sunan kwangila InKindEscrow. Ba ya canzawa, ɗaya ne a kowane chain, ba shi da mai shi, matsayi ko setter, kuma riƙe biyan da aka ƙi shi ne aikinsa kaɗai. Asusun da aka sa wa kuɗin daga baya yana kiran
claim(token, recipient)
don karɓar dukan kuɗin da aka sa masa a adireshin da ya zaɓa. Deposits suna fitar da RemainderEscrowed kuma claims suna fitar da RemainderClaimed.

Misali: wallet na mai aro yana cikin blocklist na USDC kuma liquidation yana bin sa rarar USDC 14. Canja wurin yana kasawa, ana ajiye USDC 14 a escrow wanda aka sa wa wallet ɗin, kuma liquidation yana kammala.

LiquidationSettled yana ɗauke da mai kira, proxy da kasuwa, tare da reserve na bashi da kadara, bashin da aka biya, raka'o'in da aka ƙwace, adadin da aka dawo da shi, mafi ƙanƙanta, ingantaccen slippage, ribar net, kuɗaɗen mai kira, adadin flash da premium, rara, kuɗin Avana, ladan keeper, rarar mai aro, biyan mai kira, mafi ƙanƙantar biya, hanyoyin da aka yi amfani da su, ko kiran ba tare da izini ba ne, da gibin. Gibi yana bayyana a event ɗin ReportDeficit na Hub mai ba da kuɗi a cikin ma'amala ɗaya.
LPVaultSwap ba ya rubuta yanayin breaker. Sa ido yana lissafa faɗakarwarsa a wajen chain daga waɗannan events: jinginar da aka ƙwace sama da 20% na kasuwa cikin awa 1, da gazawar hanya 3 cikin awa 1.

Vault tokens da LPVaultSwap ya karɓa = waɗanda AaveAdapter ya ƙona = raguwar samar da vault-token = raguwar hannun jarin proxy a Spoke = raka'o'in da aka cire daga rikodin proxy = raka'o'in da aka cire daga waɗannan matsayi.
Ba a ɗauki kuɗaɗen masu ajiya ba: kuɗaɗen da ake bin kowane matsayi da aka cire wa har yanzu mai ajiyarsa zai iya tattara su.
Dawowar tare da duk wani ƙarin kuɗi ta cika mafi ƙanƙanta, an biya flash loan da premium gaba ɗaya, kuma biyan mai kira ya kai aƙalla minPayout.
An rubuta gibi ne kawai idan asusun ba shi da sauran jingina, kuma a lokacin bashinsa 0 ne a kowane reserve na bashi.
LPVaultSwap da tushen flash suna ƙarewa ba tare da canjin ma'auni na net a kowane token ba, babu amincewar da aka bayar a kiran da ba sifili ba, kuma kulle a sake yake.
Kadarar bashi ta zo ne daga mai kira da tushen flash kaɗai, ba a taɓa sayen ta da wata kadara ba.
Kowane mataki na liquidation na Avana bisa tsarin aiwatarwa: bincike, flash loan, ƙwacewar Aave, ƙonawa, warwarewa, hanyoyin musanya, mafi ƙarancin dawowa, gibi, biyan flash da biyan kuɗaɗe.

Yadda keepers da aka amince da su da kowane adireshi ke kiran LPVaultSwap, yadda ake auna girman kira, da ma'anar kowace gazawa.

Ana iya yi wa asusu liquidation idan ma'aunin lafiyarsa ya yi ƙasa da 1 kuma farashin kasuwarsa da na reserve na bashin da aka biya sababbi ne. Kowane liquidation yana bi ta LPVaultSwap, wanda ke da hanyoyin shiga biyu na liquidation da hanyar shiga ɗaya ta sasantawa:
liquidate
: ga keepers da aka amince da su, tare da duka yanayin hanya biyu.
liquidatePermissionless
: ga kowane adireshi, tare da yanayin hanya PrimaryThenBackup kaɗai.
settlePending
: ga kowane adireshi; yana sasanta raka'o'in da suka maƙale kuma ba ya biyan mai kira komai.

Mai kira koyaushe shi ne msg.sender a LPVaultSwap, kuma kowane biyan mai kira yana zuwa msg.sender. Ba a ɗaukar mai karɓa, hanya, tushen flash, sauya mafi ƙarancin dawowa ko calldata mai aiwatarwa daga mai kira. Kowane adadi yana cikin raka'o'in tushe na kadarar bashin da ake biya.
Ƙa'idojin cancanta da dalilan da ba a taɓa dakatar da liquidation ba suna a shafin ƙira:
Zanen Rushewa
Keepers da aka amince da su suna kiran
liquidate(LiquidationParams params)

, wanda ke mayar da LiquidationResult. Mai kira da ba ya cikin jerin keepers na LPVaultSwap yana revert da NotApprovedKeeper kafin kowane kira na waje, kuma zai iya amfani da hanya ba tare da izini ba maimakon haka. Avana ne ke gudanar da kowane keeper da aka amince da shi.

Ma'ana
Ƙa'ida

Dole ya zama ingantaccen proxy na vault token na kasuwar, in ba haka ba UnknownProxy

Dole ta zama kasuwar proxy; ana karɓar kasuwanni Registered, Active da Offboarding

Dole an kunna shi ga Spoke, in ba haka ba UnknownDebtReserve

keeperFunds tare da flashAmount dole su kai aƙalla debtToCover, in ba haka ba InvalidAmount

A mafi yawa ruwan kuɗin da ba a amfani da shi na tushen, in ba haka ba FlashLiquidityShort

Ana amfani da shi yadda aka saita shi; babu farashin pool da ke canza shi

Ana bincika shi da farko, kafin kulle da kowane kira na waje, in ba haka ba DeadlineExpired

Mafi ƙanƙantar biyan mai kira da mai kira ke karɓa
Ana bincika shi bayan tsarin rarraba biya, in ba haka ba PayoutTooLow

Mafi yawan kadarar bashin mai kira na kansa da kiran zai iya janyewa bayan musanya
Yana rufe dawowa da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta da duk wani gibin zagayewa; 0 yana kashe shi

Kowane adadi a mafi yawa 2^128 − 1 ne. Ƙarshen lokaci, minPayout da minAmounts ba sa canza adadi, hanya ko mai karɓa: za su iya sa kiran ya revert kawai. Ana lissafa mafi ƙarancin dawowa daga farashin oracle kaɗai, don haka minPayout yana kare mai kira yayin da mafi ƙarancin dawowa ke kare Avana da mai aro.

LiquidationResult yana mayar da kadarar bashi, bashin da aka biya, raka'o'in da aka ƙwace, adadin kowane token da warwarewar ta mayar, adadin da aka dawo da shi, mafi ƙarancin dawowa, premium na flash, kuɗin Avana, biyan mai kira, rarar mai aro da gibin da aka janye daga mai kira.

Kowace kasuwa tana da, ga kowane token ɗinta da kowace kadarar bashi da aka kunna, hanyar musanya ta farko da ta ajiya da aka rubuta a MarketRegistry. Ana riƙe dukansu biyu da mafi ƙarancin dawowa ɗaya da mafi ƙanƙanta iri ɗaya ga kowace hanya.
Yanayi
Halaye
Akwai ga
PrimaryThenBackup

Yana kiran hanyar farko idan za a iya amfani da ita. Idan ba za a iya amfani da hanyar farko ba ko ta revert, yana fitar da RouteFailed don revert kuma yana kiran ta ajiya idan za a iya amfani da ita.
Keepers da aka amince da su da masu kira ba tare da izini ba
BackupOnly
Yana kiran hanyar ajiya ta kowane token kaɗai.
Keepers da aka amince da su kaɗai

Idan babu hanyar da za a iya amfani da ita da ta canza token, kiran yana revert da NoRouteAvailable. Babu madadin in-kind: keeper yana jiran hanyar da aka maido ko aka maye gurbinta. Token da shi kansa kadarar bashi ne ba ya buƙatar hanya.
Kowane adireshi zai iya kiran
liquidatePermissionless(PermissionlessLiquidationParams params)
ba tare da matsayi, rajista ko yarjejeniya ba. Yana gudanar da sasantawa iri ɗaya da hanyar keeper, tare da waɗannan bambance-bambance:
Babu binciken keeper.
Sigogin ba su da filin yanayin hanya: kiran koyaushe yana gudanar da PrimaryThenBackup, don haka token da ba shi da hanyar farko ko ta ajiya mai aiki yana revert da NoRouteAvailable.
Ana tura kuɗaɗen mai kira na kansa a matsayin callerFunds maimakon keeperFunds.

Duk sauran abubuwa suna aiki ba tare da canji ba: mafi ƙarancin dawowa da ƙarin kuɗin gibi na zaɓi, mafi ƙanƙanta ga kowace hanya, ƙofofin farashi, sequencer da grace, binciken hannun jarin Hub, ƙarshen lokaci da mafi ƙanƙantar biya. Mai kira yana biyan gibin zagayewarsa daidai yadda keeper ke yi, kuma yana karɓar biyan mai kira daga tsarin rarraba biya ɗaya.
Masu kira da aka daskarar

Mai kira da ke cikin jerin daskarewa na chain yana revert da AddressIsFrozen a kowane aikin liquidation. Binciken yana gudana nan da nan bayan binciken ƙarshen lokaci. Ana ci gaba da yi wa asusun wallet da aka daskarar liquidation kamar kowane asusu.
Amincewa

Kafin kira, mai kira yana amincewa da LPVaultSwap don kadarar bashi da zai iya buƙatar bayarwa: callerFunds, da ake janyewa a shigarwa, tare da maxShortfall, da ake janyewa bayan musanya kawai idan an buƙata. Kira da aka ba da kuɗinsa ta flash kaɗai tare da maxShortfall a 0 ba ya buƙatar amincewa. LPVaultSwap yana janye adadi daidai kuma yana auna kowace karɓa a matsayin canjin ma'auni.
Aikin
settlePending(marketId, debtReserveId)

yana sasanta vault tokens da wata ƙwacewa ta baya da ba a sasanta ba ta bari a tsayayyen adireshin LPVaultSwap. Collateralization yana sa waɗannan raka'o'in su kasance da tallafin ainihin tokens na pool a ma'aunin jiran aiki, wanda ake daidaitawa daga rikodin mai aro a ƙwacewa ko cirewa ta gaba. Kowane adireshi zai iya kiran sa, ba a karanta yanayin dakatarwa, kuma ba ya taɓa gudana a cikin liquidation.

Kafin ɗaukar kulle, LPVaultSwap yana buƙatar sananniyar kasuwa da mai karɓar kuɗi da ba sifili ba. Yana sasanta mafi ƙanƙanta tsakanin ma'aunin vault-token ɗinsa da raka'o'in jiran aiki na Collateralization, kuma yana revert da NothingPending idan wannan 0 ne.
Yana karanta ƙofar sequencer (SequencerDown lokacin da ya tsaya), yana poke LP Oracle na kasuwar kuma yana amfani da ƙofar farashin jingina (StalePrice).
AaveAdapter yana ƙona raka'o'in, kuma Collateralization yana sakin tokens na pool masu dacewa zuwa LPVaultSwap.
Ana musanya kowane token zuwa kadarar sasantawa ta hanyoyin kasuwar a yanayin PrimaryThenBackup, tare da izinin slippage na mafi ƙanƙanta tsakanin izinin kasuwar da 30 bps.
Dawowar dole ta kai mafi ƙarancin sasantawa mai jiran aiki, in ba haka ba RecoveryBelowFloor.
Ana ƙara adadin da aka dawo da shi zuwa Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke) na Hub mai ba da kuɗi da kadarar reserve na sasantawa ta aikin fund ɗinsa na jama'a.
Duk wani ragowar hanya da ba a canza ba yana zuwa ga mai karɓar kuɗi, ko zuwa payout escrow idan wannan canja wurin ya kasa. Kiran yana fitar da PendingSettlementForwarded.

Mai kira ba ya karɓar komai. Ƙwacewar da ba a sasanta ba ta riga ta biya bashi kuma an riga an cire daga rikodin mai aro, don haka babu tsarin rarraba biya da ke aiki. Avana Umbrella shi ne matakin da ke ɗaukar asarar wannan lamari. Kowace kasuwa tana ambaton reserve na bashin sasantawarta a lokacin jera ta, reserve na bashi na farko da aka kunna, wanda za a iya canzawa a jinkirin da aka saba.

Ma'aunin jiran aiki ba ya taɓa toshe liquidation. Idan kiran ya revert (ƙofar farashi ko sequencer, babu hanyar da za a iya amfani da ita, mafi ƙanƙanta, ko Coverage Spoke ya ƙi kuɗaɗen), tokens suna zama a tsare suna tallafa wa raka'o'in da suka rage, kuma kowa zai iya maimaita kiran daga baya.
Masu kira suna auna girman kowane kira daga preview na Lens,
previewLiquidation(proxy, debtReserveId, deadline)
, wanda ke mayar da sigogin da za a iya aikawa ba tare da canji ba.

Saita debtToCover zuwa adadin Aave da aka yi preview: biyan zuwa ma'aunin lafiya da Aave ke nufi, ko dukan bashin da ke cikin reserve idan ƙa'idar ƙura ta Aave tana aiki. Babu mafi ƙanƙantar girma ga kowane kira.
Don rufe dukan bashi, Lens yana faɗin debtToCover tare da gefen 500 bps, an zagaye sama, ko yana zama aƙalla 500 bps ƙasa da iyakar ƙura ta Aave.
Saita flashAmount zuwa abin da tushen flash zai iya ba da rance (ruwan kuɗinsa da ba a amfani da shi) kuma ka bayar da sauran a matsayin keeperFunds ko callerFunds.
Saita minPayout aƙalla 1% ƙasa da biyan da aka yi preview.
Saita ƙarshen lokaci ɗan gajeren lokaci a gaba. 120 s blocks 10 ne na Ethereum da blocks 60 na Base.
Saita maxShortfall don rufe gibin zagayewa da preview ya bayar da rahoto, da ƙari idan kana son ƙara kuɗi ga dawowa da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta.

Shigarwar mai kira iyakoki ne, ba takamaiman ƙimomi ba. Mai aro da ya biya 1 wei, ko ya biya isasshe don barin bashin ɗan ƙasa da iyakar ƙura, yana canza adadin amma ba sakamakon ba. Kadarar bashi da Aave bai janye ba ba a musanya ta: tana biyan babban kuɗin flash ko tana komawa ga mai kira. Auna girma fiye da kima yana jawo wa mai kira premium na flash a kan ɓangaren da ba a yi amfani da shi ba kaɗai.

Misali: Lens yana preview na dukan bashi na USDC 1,950 tare da gefen 500 bps, don haka debtToCover shi ne USDC 2,047.5. Biyan 1-wei yana sauka da farko. Aave yana janye USDC 1,949.999999, USDC 97.500001 da suka rage suna biyan wani ɓangare na flash loan, kuma biyan mai kira yana ƙasa da 1 wei.

Auna girma ta kwaikwayo: sake gudanar da preview na Lens ga kowane asusu a kowane sabon block kuma ka ci gaba da sabunta kiran da aka sa hannu, tare da bincika flashAmount a kan ruwan kuɗin da ake da shi na tushen flash da kuɗaɗen mai kira a shirye don sauran.
Tura ta hanyar order flow na sirri a Ethereum, don kada a yi front-run ga kira mai jiran aiki ko a bar shi a mempool na jama'a.

Poke oracles: aikin poke na LP Oracle da DebtOracle rubutun cache ne ba tare da izini ba da keepers ke gudanarwa a kowane sabunta feed. LPVaultSwap kuma yana poke kasuwar da aka ƙwace da reserve da aka biya a cikin kowane kira. Poke yana buƙatar mafi ƙanƙantar adadin gas, kuma poke da aka hana gas yana sa dukan liquidation ya revert.
Aika asusu ɗaya a kowace ma'amala. Ma'amaloli daban-daban ba sa taɓa yin gasa don kulle, wanda ake saki a ƙarshen kowane kira.
A Base, auna flash loans na kowane block bisa kadarar bashi da ba a amfani da ita ta Base Pool kuma ka raba liquidations mafi girma a jere a blocks na 2 s.
Amsa RecoveryBelowFloor da ƙarin kuɗin gibi daga kuɗaɗen keeper ko da arbitrage bundle, ba da raba gida biyu akai-akai ba, wanda gas ɗinsa zai fi bashin da kowane kira ke biya.
Idan tushen flash ba shi da isasshe, an dakatar da shi ko yana cajin sama da iyaka, sake turawa da dukan adadin a matsayin kuɗaɗen mai kira da flashAmount a 0.

A lokacin da Aave ya dakatar da CDP Spoke, daina aika kira ga wannan kasuwa, ci gaba da sabunta kiran da aka shirya, kuma tura su bisa tsarin ma'aunin lafiya daga ƙasa zuwa sama a block na farko bayan an ɗage dakatarwar.
Yi wa asusu mai reserves na bashi da yawa liquidation da kira a jere har sai ma'aunin lafiyarsa ya kai aƙalla 1 ko an rubuta gibi. Tsallake asusun da ba su da sauran jingina.

Ba a ƙidaya gazawar mafi ƙanƙanta da gazawar hanya a kan chain. Sa ido na Avana yana rubuta kowane event na RouteFailed da kowane revert na RecoveryBelowFloor ko NoRouteAvailable, kuma yana tayar da faɗakarwa a gazawa 3 cikin awa 1 a kasuwa. Guardian yana daskarar da sabon aro a kasuwar ne kawai bayan an tabbatar cewa hanyoyin da aka amince da su ba za su iya sasanta ingantattun liquidations a girman da ake buƙata ba; liquidation, biya da fita ba tare da bashi ba suna zama a buɗe.
Liquidation da aka ba da kuɗinsa ta flash wanda ya taɓa rikodi n yana amfani da kusan wannan adadin gas, wanda aka auna a fork na kowane chain:
Rikodi ɗaya: gas 1,550,000.

Asusu yana riƙe da rikodi 16 a mafi yawa ga kowace kasuwa, don haka liquidation mafi girma yana amfani da gas 5,150,000. Wannan bai kai rabin iyakar gas ta kowace ma'amala ta 16,777,216 ba, don haka asusu mafi girma koyaushe yana dacewa a ma'amala ɗaya.
Ethereum yana ƙidaya gas na aiwatarwa. Base yana ƙidaya gas na aiwatarwa tare da kuɗin bayanan L1 na kowace ma'amala.

Avana yana tsara kasafin gas na keeper ga kowane chain a matsayin adadin liquidations da ake tsammani sau gas ga kowane liquidation sau farashin gas, tare da kuɗin bayanan L1 a Base. Babu ƙa'idar yarjejeniya da ke karanta farashin gas.

Misali (Base): asusu da ke bin bashin USDC 40 tare da rikodi ɗaya ya faɗi ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na 1. Liquidation ɗinsa yana amfani da gas 1,550,000. Tare da riba ta 2%, kuɗin musanya na 0.3% da kason Avana na 20%, kason keeper na ribar shi ne 0.8 × (0.02 − 0.003 × 1.02) × 40 = USDC 0.54208. Keeper na Avana yana yi wa asusun liquidation ko wannan ya rufe gas ɗin ko bai rufe ba.

Ƙimomin misali; ana saita sigogin kowace kasuwa a lokacin jera ta. Wannan asusun bashin USDC ne na Bob a kasuwar USDC/USDT ta Uniswap v3 a Ethereum (an yi bayaninsa dalla-dalla a shafin misalai), ba tare da wani keeper da aka amince da shi yana aiki ba.
Kowane adireshi E yana kiran preview na Lens ga proxy na Bob da reserve na bashi 2 tare da ƙarshen lokaci 120 s a gaba. Yana mayar da biyan USDC 1,950 da yanayin PrimaryThenBackup.

E yana amincewa da LPVaultSwap ya janye har zuwa USDC 5, maxShortfall ɗinsa, kuma yana kiran liquidatePermissionless tare da debtToCover USDC 1,950, callerFunds 0, flashAmount USDC 1,950, minAmounts babu komai, minPayout USDC 69 da maxShortfall USDC 5. Da an daskarar da E, kiran zai revert da AddressIsFrozen.

Sasantawar tana gudana kamar a hanyar keeper: flash loan na USDC 1,950 tare da premium na USDC 0.975, vault tokens 975 da aka ƙwace aka warware, kuma an musanya hanyar USDT zuwa USDC. Dawowar ita ce USDC 2,040.30 a kan mafi ƙanƙanta na USDC 2,026.024998.
Gibin shi ne max(0, floor − R, D + φD − K − R) = 0, don haka ba a janye komai daga E.
Ana biyan flash loan da USDC 1,950.975, kuɗin Avana na USDC 19.305 yana zuwa ga mai karɓar kuɗi, kuma E yana karɓar USDC 70.02. Ana fitar da LiquidationSettled tare da permissionless a matsayin true.
Bambanci: ƙarin kuɗi na USDC 1.774998

Da hanyar USDT ta mayar da USDC 994 maimakon haka, dawowar za ta zama USDC 2,024.25, ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta na USDC 2,026.024998. Gibin USDC 1.774998 yana cikin maxShortfall, don haka LPVaultSwap yana janye shi daga E kuma yana ci gaba da dawowa ta USDC 2,026.024998. Kuɗin Avana yana zama USDC 19.305, saboda ana auna shi a ƙimar oracle. Rarar mai aro 0 ce, kamar yadda take koyaushe idan an biya gibi.
Biyan mai kira: 75.049998 − 19.305 = USDC 55.744998, wanda USDC 1.774998 daga ciki ƙarin kuɗin E ne na kansa.
Tare da minPayout a USDC 69 wannan kiran yana revert da PayoutTooLow. Mai kira da ke son sasantawa a wannan dawowar yana saita minPayout a ko ƙasa da USDC 55.744998.

Tare da maxShortfall a USDC 5, kowace hanya tana gudana a 124 bps maimakon 100 bps (100 + ⌊5 × 10,000 / 2,047.5⌋). Hanyar da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantarta tana revert da MinOutNotMet kuma ana gwada hanyar ajiya.
Gibin da ya fi maxShortfall yana revert da RecoveryBelowFloor. Ana biyan gibin zagayewa a sasantawa ta ƙarshe ta hanya ɗaya, ko kiran yana revert da InsufficientProceeds.

Kowace gazawa tana sa dukan ma'amalar ta revert: flash loan, ƙwacewa, ƙonawa, cire rikodi, rahoton gibi, ƙarin kuɗi da biyan kuɗaɗe. Babu wanda ya dogara da yanayin dakatarwa, breaker ko dalilin drift.

Ba a Cikin Ƙirar Ba
Hanyar liquidation ɗaya a kowane chain: ƙwacewar wani ɓangare da Aave V4 ke auna, wadda LPVaultSwap ke sasantawa a kadarar bashin da aka biya.

Avana yana da hanyar liquidation ɗaya a kowane chain: ƙwacewar wani ɓangare ta LPVaultSwap, wadda ake sasantawa a kadarar bashin da aka biya. Akwai LPVaultSwap ɗaya a kowane chain, a tsayayyen adireshi, wanda ke hidima ga kowane Hub, CDP Spoke da kasuwa na wannan chain. A cikin ma'amala ɗaya yana:
aron kadarar bashin kanta ta flash ta tushen flash na chain, wanda ke kiran Aave V3 Pool, ko yin amfani da kadarar bashin mai kira na kansa idan ruwan kuɗin flash bai isa ba;
kiran liquidation na yau da kullum na Aave a CDP Spoke, wanda ke auna biyan da ƙwacewar kuma yana aika vault tokens da aka ƙwace zuwa LPVaultSwap;
sa AaveAdapter ya ƙona vault tokens da aka ƙwace, kuma Collateralization ya sa LP Vault na kasuwar ya warware raka'o'in da aka ƙwace daidai zuwa tokens na kasuwar;
musanya kowane token da ba kadarar bashi ba zuwa kadarar bashi ta tsayayyun hanyoyin musanya na kasuwar, kowace hanya da mafi ƙanƙantar fitarwa da aka samo daga farashin oracle;
biyan flash loan da premium ɗinsa, sannan biyan kuɗin Avana, ladan mai kira da duk wata rarar mai aro, duka a kadarar bashi.
Mai aro yana riƙe da sauran matsayin da dukan kuɗaɗensa. GHO yana bayyana ne kawai idan bashin da ake biya GHO ne. Idan kowane mataki ya kasa, dukan ma'amalar tana revert kuma asusun bai canza ba.
Buƙatun da suka shafi keeper suna a shafin Liquidators:
Masu liquidation
Kowane mataki na sasantawa, tare da bincikensa da tsarin lissafinsa, yana a shafin tsari:
Tsarin Liquidation

Kowane wallet yana da PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa. Kowane proxy asusun Aave ne daban wanda ke riƙe da reserve na jingina ɗaya daidai, vault token na kasuwar, kuma zai iya riƙe reserves na bashi da yawa. Wallet da ke amfani da kasuwanni biyu yana da asusu biyu, don haka faɗuwar farashi a kasuwa ɗaya ba ta taɓa sa a yi wa asusu a wata kasuwa liquidation.
PositionProxy asusu ne marar dabaru wanda ba ya canzawa. Ba shi da ikon sasantawa, kuma alaƙarsa da wallet, Spoke da kasuwa ba ta taɓa canzawa.

Ana iya yi wa asusu liquidation idan ma'aunin lafiyarsa a CDP Spoke ya yi ƙasa da 1 kuma farashin da aka yi amfani da su don kiran sababbi ne. LPVaultSwap yana bincika kowane sharaɗi da ke ƙasa kafin ya motsa kowane kuɗi.

Farashin LP Oracle na kasuwar Live ne ko Drifting, ba Cached ko Expired ba. Kowace shigarwa shekarunta ba su wuce heartbeat na feed ɗinta tare da gefen 1,800 s ba, kuma babu dakatarwar saɓani na feed da ke aiki.
