Sabuntawa tana bin heartbeat na kowane feed

Feed na Chainlink yana wallafawa a kan abin da ke jawo karkacewarsa ko bayan heartbeat ɗinsa, don haka shekaru har zuwa heartbeat al'ada ne. Feed na stablecoin na USD mai heartbeat na 86,400 s sabo ne na 88,200 s: amsar da aka wallafa awanni 23 da suka gabata tana wucewa. Feed na 3,600 s sabo ne na 5,400 s.
Kasuwanni Drifting, masu saɓani da Expired

Kasuwar da ke Drifting kawai saboda kariyar farashinta mai nauyin lokaci, gazawar lura ko keta iyakar farashi, tare da duka hanyoyin feed biyu na kowane token sababbi kuma sun yarda, har yanzu ana iya yi mata liquidation. Aave yana yanke shawarar cancanta kuma yana auna ƙwacewar a farashin da aka bayar.

Idan feed na farko da na madadin na token duka sababbi ne amma sun saɓa fiye da haƙuri, liquidation na wannan kasuwa yana dakatawa har zuwa 3,600 s daga lura ta farko da aka rubuta. Idan har yanzu suna saɓani bayan haka, ana ɗaukar kasuwar a matsayin Expired don liquidation har sai sun yarda, an canza zuwa hanyar farashi ta jiran aiki, ko gudanarwa ta amince da gyara.
Da zarar kasuwa ta zama Expired, jinginarta tana ƙidaya kusan 0, don haka ma'aunin lafiyar asusun yana faɗuwa, amma ba za a iya ƙwace asusun ba har sai sabon farashi ya dawo.
Ba a toshe sauran reserves na bashi na asusun. Farashin bashi da ke kasawa yana ƙara ƙimar bashin ne kawai, wanda ke rage ma'aunin lafiya, kuma ba a taɓa biyan bashi a farashin matsi.
An bayyana yadda LP Oracle ke samar da waɗannan yanayin farashi a shafin Price Oracles:
Oracle na Farashi
Kowane liquidation yana bi ta
liquidationCall
na yau da kullum na Aave a CDP Spoke, wanda LPVaultSwap ke kira tare da receiveShares a matsayin false. Aave yana auna biyan da ƙwacewar a cikin kiran. Mai kira yana saita iyakar sama ta biyan kaɗai.

Aave yana auna biyan don kawo asusun zuwa ma'aunin lafiya da yake nufi (1.10 ita ce ƙimar da Avana ke ba da shawara; Aave DAO ne ke saita ta), tare da ribar liquidation ɗinsa mai canzawa da ƙa'idar ƙura.
Ƙa'idar ƙura za ta iya buƙatar a biya dukan bashin da ke cikin reserve, don haka masu kira suna auna kuɗaɗensu don wannan yanayi.
LPVaultSwap yana auna bashin da aka biya da vault tokens da aka ƙwace a matsayin canjin ma'auni a cikin kiran. Ba ya taɓa karanta su daga ƙimomin da Aave ya mayar ko events.
LPVaultSwap ba ya sake aiwatar da lissafin asusu ko liquidation na Aave. Sasanta dukan matsayi babu shi, saboda Aave yana auna kowace ƙwacewa da kansa.
Liquidation da bai ƙwace komai ba yana revert, don haka ba a taɓa biyan bashi ba tare da an ɗauki jingina ba.

Bayan liquidation da ya bar jingina kuma ƙa'idar ƙura ko iyakar jingina ba ta iyakance shi ba, ma'aunin lafiyar asusun aƙalla shi ne abin da Aave ke nufi. Ƙimar da aka ƙwace a mafi yawa ita ce bashin da aka biya sau riba, tare da raka'a ɗaya ta vault-token a farashin da aka bayar.

Ƙa'idar canja wurin vault token tana karɓar motsi uku kaɗai: proxy da aka yi wa rajista zuwa Hub na gidansa (samarwa), Hub na gida zuwa proxy da aka yi wa rajista (cirewa, wanda ake ƙonawa a cikin kira ɗaya), da Hub na gida zuwa LPVaultSwap (ƙwacewa). Ana ƙin kowane mai karɓa, har da canja wurin adadin sifili.
Aave yana isar da jinginar da aka ƙwace ta canja wuri daga Hub zuwa mai liquidation. Saboda haka liquidation da wani adireshi ban da LPVaultSwap ya kira yana revert a wannan canja wurin:
tare da receiveShares a matsayin true, Spoke yana revert da CannotReceiveShares, saboda reserve ya kashe karɓar hannun jari;
tare da receiveShares a matsayin false da ƙwacewar aƙalla raka'a ɗaya, canja wurin Hub zuwa mai kira yana revert da UnauthorizedRecipient kuma dukan kiran yana revert;
kiran da aka auna har ƙwacewarsa ta zagaye zuwa raka'a 0 ba ya motsa jingina. Yana biyan bashi ga mai aro da kuɗaɗen mai kira na kansa kaɗai.

Saboda haka kowane event na LiquidationCall a CDP Spoke da ya ƙwace vault tokens yana ambaton LPVaultSwap a matsayin mai liquidation. Babu vault token da ke motsawa, kuma ba a ba da rahoton gibi, sai ta LPVaultSwap. Haɓaka LPVaultSwap yana riƙe da adireshin proxy ɗaya, don haka yana zama mai karɓar ƙwacewa ɗaya tak da aka yarda.

CDP Spoke Spoke ne na Aave V4 na yau da kullum da ba a gyara ba, kuma aikin liquidation ɗinsa ba shi da takunkumin mai kira. Keɓancewar ta fito ne daga ƙa'idar canja wurin vault token tare da saitunan Aave uku a kowane reserve na jingina na Avana:

Babu kwangilar da za ta iya motsa vault tokens na Hub, kuma hannun jarin Hub suna zama daidai da kadarori.

Saitunan jera kasuwa kuma suna sa reserve na vault-token ya zama wanda ba za a iya aro ba, ba sa jera kadarar vault-token a kowane Spoke (tare da iyakar ɗauka ta 0 a ko'ina), kuma ba sa ba da amincewar position-manager a kowane proxy.

RiskModule yana bincika waɗannan saitunan a kowane pledge na sabon asusu, aro da cirewa tare da bashi, kuma sa ido yana bincika su a kowane block. Drift a kowane saiti yana kunna breaker na CONFIG_DRIFT na kasuwar: sababbin pledges, aro da cirewa tare da bashi suna tsayawa, yayin da liquidation, biya, ƙarin jingina, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba da tattara kuɗaɗe ke ci gaba. Yarjejeniyar payload ta jera kasuwa tana ɗaure Aave DAO ya kiyaye waɗannan saitunan yayin da bashin Avana ke wanzuwa.
Wanda zai iya kira, da wane zaɓuɓɓuka, ana yanke shawara a LPVaultSwap kaɗai. Kowane kira yana yi wa asusu ɗaya liquidation, a kasuwar jinginarsa ɗaya, a kan reserve na bashi ɗaya.

Cikakkiyar hanya, tare da duka yanayin hanya biyu (PrimaryThenBackup da BackupOnly). Yana biyan ladan keeper ga mai kira.
liquidatePermissionless
Kowane adireshi, ba tare da matsayi, rajista ko yarjejeniya ba
Sasantawa iri ɗaya tare da yanayin hanya PrimaryThenBackup kaɗai. Yana biyan lada iri ɗaya ga mai kira. Yana wanzuwa ne don liquidation ya ci gaba idan babu keeper da aka amince da shi da ke aiki.
settlePending
Kowane adireshi
Yana sasanta vault tokens da wata ƙwacewa ta baya da ba a sasanta ba ta bari a LPVaultSwap. Ba ya biyan mai kira komai kuma yana aika kuɗaɗen da aka samu zuwa Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke).
Adireshin da aka daskarar ba zai iya kiran kowane aikin liquidation ba. Ana yi wa asusun mai aro da aka daskarar liquidation kamar kowane asusu.

LPVaultSwap ba ya taɓa karanta yanayin dakatarwa na MarketRegistry, dalilin dakatarwa, circuit breaker ko dalilin drift na saiti. Hanyoyin shiga uku suna gudana a kowane ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan yanayi:
yanayin dakatarwar application None, Frozen, Paused(General) da Paused(MintPathSuspect);
duk wani breaker na kasuwa, bashi ko POOL_DEPTH da aka kunna;
duk wani saitin Spoke da ya yi drift (CONFIG_DRIFT);
kasuwa a Offboarding ko a matakin rufewarta, da reserve na Aave da aka daskarar;
wallet na mai aro da aka daskarar;
farashin spot na pool a kowane nisa daga farashin oracle. Babu ƙofar spot na pool, don haka pool da ya motsa ba ya taɓa sa liquidation ya revert ko ya canza yanayin hanyarsa.

Yanayin dakatarwa, breakers da drift suna dakatar da ayyukan da ke ƙara haɗari, kamar sababbin pledges da aro. Ba sa dakatar da wani aiki da ke rage haɗari. Liquidation da ba zai iya gudana ba yana bar asarar asusu marar lafiya ta girma zuwa gibi, yayin da biya da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba ke zama a buɗe ko ta yaya.

Misali: Emergency Guardian yana saita Paused(MintPathSuspect) a Ethereum Stable LP Hub a 14:00 bayan faɗakarwa a wata kasuwa. A 14:05 keeper yana yi wa asusu a ma'aunin lafiya na 0.97 liquidation daidai yadda zai yi idan babu dakatarwa.
Farashin da suka tsufa na kasuwar da aka ƙwace ko reserve na bashin da aka biya, kamar yadda aka bayyana a sama. Ana iya biyan sauran reserves na bashi na asusun a halin yanzu.
Ƙofar sequencer na chain a Base: ya tsaya, ko lokacin grace bayan sake farawa ga asusun da ke a ko sama da ma'aunin lafiya na 0.95.

Dakatarwa daga ɓangaren Aave: CDP Spoke da aka dakatar ko aka kashe a Hub na gidansa ko Hub mai ba da kuɗi, ko reserve na vault-token ko na bashi da aka dakatar. Kurakuran Aave na kansa (SpokeHalted, SpokeNotActive, ReservePaused) suna wucewa ba tare da canji ba, kuma Avana ba zai iya ƙetare su ba.
Hanyoyin sasantawa: babu hanyar musanya da za a iya amfani da ita ga token, ko dawowa da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta da mai kira bai ƙara kuɗi ba.

Yarjejeniyar payload ta jera kasuwa tana ɗaure Aave DAO ya fara takaita CDP Spoke mai matsala da daskarar da reserve na vault-token da iyakar ɗauka ta 0, waɗanda ke barin liquidation a buɗe. A lokacin dakatarwar Aave, keepers suna ajiye liquidations ɗinsu a shirye a kowane block kuma suna tura su bisa tsarin ma'aunin lafiya daga ƙasa zuwa sama a block na farko bayan an ɗage dakatarwar.

Kowane keeper da aka amince da shi na Avana ne: keepers ɗinsa na farko da keeper na jiran aiki a kan wani tsarin daban. Avana yana ambaton kowane adireshi ga kowane chain, yana ba shi kuɗi da kadarorin bashi na wannan chain kuma yana biyan gas ɗinsa. Aikinsa shi ne yi wa kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na 1 a chains ɗinsa liquidation, ko menene girman asusun, har da asusun da ribarsu ba ta rufe gas. Avana ba shi da mafi ƙanƙantar bashi a kowane chain, kuma babu liquidation da ya dogara da keeper ya sami riba.
Abu
keeperFloor
Keeper 1 mai aiki (an amince da shi kuma ba a daskarar da shi ba) ga kowane chain, na Avana
MAX_KEEPERS
addKeeper
Aikin timelock a jinkirin da aka saba (kwanaki 5); executor na gudanarwar Aave ne kaɗai zai iya soke shi; yana revert ga adireshin da aka daskarar
removeKeeper
Aikin timelock a gajeren jinkiri (awanni 12); yana revert idan keepers masu aiki da za su rage ba za su kai keeperFloor ba

Idan keepers masu aiki 0 suka rage a chain, RiskModule yana dakatar da sabon aro da cirewa tare da bashi a kowane CDP Spoke na wannan chain (LiquidationHalted), yayin da liquidation ke zama a buɗe ga kowa ta hanya ba tare da izini ba. Yana dakatar da reserve na bashi ta hanya ɗaya idan wani token na kasuwa ba shi da hanyar musanya da za a iya amfani da ita zuwa kadararsa (DebtLiquidationHalted). Biya, tattara kuɗaɗe da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna zama a buɗe.

Misali: Ethereum yana da keepers K1 da K2. Cire K2 yana barin keeper ɗaya mai aiki kuma aro yana ci gaba. Cire K1 bayan haka yana revert, saboda zai bar ƙasa da keeperFloor. Idan an tona maɓallin K1, ana fara ƙara keeper na maye gurbi sannan a daskarar da K1.

Aave DAO yana yi wa asusun Avana liquidation ta LPVaultSwap kamar kowa: ta hanya ba tare da izini ba daga executor ɗinsa ko kowane adireshi da yake sarrafawa, nan take kuma ba tare da wani aiki na Avana ba, ko ta hanyar keeper tare da adireshin keeper da timelock ya ƙara.
Bayan an biya flash loan da premium ɗinsa, ana raba rarar da aka samu bisa tsayayyen tsari, duka a kadarar bashin da aka biya:
Kuɗin Avana: 20% na ribar ƙimar oracle ta ƙwacewar, ba ya taɓa wuce rarar da aka samu. Hanyar musanya ta mai kira ba za ta iya rage shi ba yayin da ribar da aka samu ke rufe shi.
Ladan keeper: sauran ribar ƙimar oracle, wanda aka iyakance da abin da aka samu. Yana zuwa ga mai kiran kowane aikin liquidation.
Rarar mai aro: duk wata dawowa da ke sama da ƙimar oracle na jinginar da aka ƙwace, wadda ake biya zuwa wallet na mai aro.

Wannan kuɗin shi ne kuɗin shiga ɗaya tak na Avana a kan chain. Avana ba ya cajin kuɗi a kan ribar aro. Biya da mai karɓarsa ba zai iya karɓa ba yana zuwa payout escrow (InKindEscrow), wanda aka sa wa mai karɓar, kuma ba ya taɓa sa liquidation ya revert.
Tsarin lissafi da tsarin biya suna a shafin tsari:

Aave yana ba da rahoton gibi a cikin kiran liquidation ɗinsa ne kawai idan kiran ya kwashe jinginar asusun kuma bashi ya rage. Sannan yana ba da rahoton sauran bashin kowane reserve da aka aro, kowanne a Hub mai ba shi kuɗi kuma a kadarar wannan reserve, kuma yana mayar da bashin asusun zuwa sifili. Avana yana karɓar wannan hali ba tare da canji ba. Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke) na kowane Hub da kadara da abin ya shafa yana rufe gibinsa a cikin tagar kariya, ba da kariyar wata kadara ko wani Hub ba.
Kiran da ya ba da rahoton gibi yana sasantawa kamar kowane kira. Idan mafi ƙarancin dawowa ko binciken kuɗi ya kasa, dukan ma'amalar tana revert, har da rahoton gibin.

Bayan cikakkiyar ƙwacewa, kowane rikodi na asusun yana zama a buɗe da raka'o'i 0 da aka sa masa. Mai ajiya zai iya tattara kuɗaɗe kuma ya dawo da matsayin da releaseZeroCredit na AaveAdapter, wanda ba ya buƙatar binciken bashi. Keepers suna tsallake asusun da ba su da sauran jingina, saboda Aave ya riga ya ba da rahoton gibinsu.

Ana yi wa asusu mai reserves na bashi da yawa liquidation ta kira a jere, reserve na bashi ɗaya kowanne, bisa tsarin da keeper ya zaɓa. Keepers suna ci gaba har sai ma'aunin lafiya ya kai aƙalla 1, lokacin da Aave ke ƙin ƙarin kira, ko an rubuta gibi.
Aikin Lens
previewLiquidation(proxy, debtReserveId, deadline)
ma'aunin lafiya, riba, saitin liquidation na Spoke da kowace ƙofa da aka tantance kamar yadda LPVaultSwap ke tantance ta;
bashin da Aave zai biya, wanda aka auna da tsayayyun tsarin lissafin liquidation na Aave V4, har da yanayin dukan bashi na ƙa'idar ƙura;
ƙwacewar da ake tsammani, adadin flash da aka auna bisa ruwan kuɗin da ba a amfani da shi na tushen flash, premium, da kuɗaɗen mai kira don sauran;
mafi ƙarancin dawowa, biyan da ake tsammani da gibin zagayewa da mai kira zai iya biya.

Don rufe dukan bashi Lens yana ƙara gefen 500 bps ga iyakar biya. Lens kayan gefe ne: babu kwangilar Avana da ke kiran sa, kuma ba a amfani da kowane sakamakonsa a kan chain. A aiwatarwa, Aave yana auna ƙwacewar kuma LPVaultSwap yana auna abin da aka kashe da abin da aka ƙwace.
Sigogin farko na waɗannan takardu sun bayyana tsare-tsare da ba sa cikin yarjejeniyar. Babu ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan da ke wanzuwa:
sasanta cikakken matsayi, yanayin sasantawa ga kowace kasuwa, da sasantawa in-kind;
musanya ta CoW Swap ko wata hanya a wajen chain ko wadda ake sasantawa a rukuni;
flash minting daga GHO FlashMinter, da sayen kadarar bashi da GHO;
kasafin sasantawa na yarjejeniya ko wani ma'aunin Avana da ke biyan gibin sasantawa;
ƙa'idar liquidation ta keeper kaɗai: liquidation a buɗe yake ga kowa ta hanya ba tare da izini ba;
Lokacin da za a iya yi wa asusun Avana liquidation, yadda Aave V4 ke auna ƙwacewar wani ɓangare, dalilin da ya sa LPVaultSwap shi ne mai karɓa ɗaya tak, da abin da ba ya taɓa toshe liquidation.

LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM yana ɗaukar tsarewa, amma ruwan kuɗin yana zama a pool kuma yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe, waɗanda mai aro zai iya tattarawa a kowane lokaci.

toc.title: Me yasa LP Abubuwan Haɗin Kai

strings: Barka da zuwa
Menene Avana?
Yadda Yake Aiki
Me yasa LP Abubuwan Haɗin Kai
Tsarin gini
Yi alkawarin wurin LP da aka tallafa

Mai aro yana pledge matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum ko matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream da ba a yi stake ba a Base wanda kewayon tick ɗinsa ya yi daidai da kasuwar da aka jera. LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM yana ɗaukar tsarewa, amma ruwan kuɗin yana zama a pool kuma yana ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗe, waɗanda mai aro zai iya tattarawa a kowane lokaci.
Wakilci da daraja shi

Collateralization yana rubuta ruwan kuɗin da aka sa wa matsayin. AaveAdapter yana mint daidai wannan adadin raka'o'in vault-token zuwa PositionProxy na mai aro na wannan kasuwa, wanda ke samar da su ga CDP Spoke na kasuwar. LPOracle yana ƙimanta kowane vault token a farashin Chainlink ta tsarin haɗin adalci, ba tare da ragi ba, kuma yana bincika shi a kan TWAP na pool da tushe na biyu mai zaman kansa.
A aro GHO daga Avana Hub

Ƙarfin aro shi ne ƙimar matsayin sau Collateral Factor na kasuwar, factor mafi ƙanƙanta na token sau ma'aunin haɗarin pool na 40% a mafi yawa. Mai aro yana ɗaukar GHO daga Avana Stable LP Hub, wanda layin lamuni mai iyaka na Aave DAO ke ba shi kuɗi. Ana iya kunna USDC, USDT ko WETH a matsayin kadarorin bashi ga kowane CDP Spoke da zarar Aave DAO ya amince da su.
Liquidity yana tsayawa a cikin pool
Yin pledge na matsayin LP yana mayar da tsarewa zuwa LPVault amma yana barin ruwan kuɗinsa a pool. Mai aro zai iya aron GHO ba tare da fara cire matsayin da barin kuɗaɗensa ko kewayonsa ba.
Kimantawa da iyakoki suna daban

LPOracle yana ba da rahoton ƙimar ruwan kuɗin ba tare da ragi ba. Collateral Factor na kowace kasuwa, min(token factors) × pool risk factor, yana tsayar da yawan wannan ƙimar da ke tallafa wa bashi, kuma kowace kasuwa tana da nata asusu da ma'aunin lafiya.
Liquidation yana da ƙayyadaddun ƙa'idodi

Kowane liquidation yana gudana ta LPVaultSwap tare da kiran liquidation na yau da kullum na Aave kuma koyaushe na wani ɓangare ne. LPVaultSwap yana aron kadarar bashi ta flash, yana warware raka'o'in da aka ƙwace kaɗai kuma yana musanya su a ma'amala ɗaya. Keeper na Avana yana yi wa kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 1 liquidation, kuma kowane adireshi zai iya amfani da hanyar shiga ba tare da izini ba.
Gabatarwa

Avana yana ba masu samar da ruwan kuɗi damar aron GHO a Aave V4 a kan matsayin Uniswap v3 a Ethereum da matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream a Base. Matsayin suna zama a pools ɗinsu kuma suna ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗen ciniki.
Fara da Maɓalli Maɓalli
Bincika Hubs da Spokes

Avana yana kawo matsayin ruwan kuɗi na AMM zuwa Aave V4 a matsayin jingina. Mai ajiya yana pledge matsayin kasuwar da aka jera ga LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗinsa sannan yana aron GHO daga Avana Stable LP Hub yayin da matsayin ke zama a pool.

Don aro a kan kadarorin LP a wani wuri, mai samar da ruwan kuɗi yawanci sai ya fara cirewa daga pool. Cirewa yana sa a rasa kuɗaɗen ciniki da, ga matsayi masu tattaccen ruwan kuɗi, kewayon da aka zaɓa.

Avana yana ajiye matsayin a pool ɗinsa. LPVault na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗinsa yana riƙe da matsayin, kuma vault token yana wakiltarsa a CDP Spoke. Vault token ERC-20 ne mai takunkumin canja wuri na jingina kaɗai inda raka'ar tushe ɗaya daidai take da raka'a ɗaya ta ruwan kuɗin da aka sa. A ƙaddamarwa Avana yana gudana a Ethereum tare da kasuwannin Uniswap v3 da a Base tare da kasuwannin Aerodrome Slipstream, kowace kasuwa pool ɗaya ce ta stablecoin mai takamaiman kewayon tick ɗaya.

Kowane mataki yana haɗa wani aiki na mai amfani da lissafin protocol. Jinginarwa (Pledge) tana kafa riƙo. Ƙimantawa da Collateral Factor suna tantance ƙarfin aro. Aro yana haifar da bashin GHO a kan wannan ƙarfin aro. Jagororin da ke biye suna bayyana kowane mataki dalla-dalla.

Jinginar LP tana bai wa kadarorin da aka riga aka saka a AMM damar tallafa wa bashin GHO. Amfanin shi ne sassaucin jari, ba tabbacin riba mai kyau (positive carry) ba. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar asarar wucin gadi, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation.

Hubs da Spokes na Avana kwangiloli ne na Aave V4 na yau da kullum da ba a gyara ba mallakar Aave DAO. Dabarun musamman na Avana suna cikin kwangilolin Avana na kansa: LPVault ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM, Collateralization, vault tokens, PositionProxies da ProxyManager, AaveAdapter, RiskModule, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore, LPOracle, DebtOracle, LPVaultSwap da AvanaTimelock.

Hubs suna zuwa a matakai uku: Stable LP a ƙaddamarwa a Ethereum da Base, tare da Hubs na Correlated LP da Volatile LP da za a ƙara daga baya. CDP Spoke shi ne Spoke ɗaya ga kowane chain, Hub, yarjejeniyar AMM da matakin haɗari kuma yana jera kasuwanni da yawa: "Uniswap v3 Stable" a Ethereum da "Aerodrome Slipstream Stable" a Base. Lend Spoke na samarwa kaɗai a kowane chain yana ɗauke da layukan lamuni na Aave DAO, kuma Coverage Spoke ga kowane Hub da kadarar bashi, Avana Umbrella, yana riƙe da First-Loss Reserve. Kowane wallet yana da PositionProxy ɗaya ga kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa, don haka kowane aikin mai aro yana bi ta AaveAdapter kuma kowace kasuwa tana da nata ma'aunin lafiya.
Bayani kan Avana: yin pledge na matsayin Uniswap v3 da Aerodrome Slipstream, aron GHO daga Avana Stable LP Hub, da ƙa'idojin kowace kasuwa na ƙimantawa da liquidation.

An kammala bita na cikin gida na takardar bayani. Ana rubuta lambar kwangila, kuma binciken tsaro mai zaman kansa na kowace kwangila zai biyo baya da zarar lambar ta kasance. Har yanzu babu binciken tsaro na waje.

Ana yi wa kowace sabuwar kwangilar Avana da haɗin AMM binciken tsaro kafin turawa. Ana ƙara abubuwan da masu binciken tsaro na waje suka gano zuwa rajistar hukuma a tsari ɗaya da na cikin gida, tare da ajiye rahotannin asali tare da shaidun binciken tsaro.

An Cire ko Ba a Taɓa Turawa Ba
Kowace kwangilar Avana bisa yanki, tare da matsayinta, tsari, iyaka, wanda zai iya canza ta da adireshinta a Ethereum da Base.
Matsayin aiki.

Takardar bayani da hanyoyin sadarwar kwangila sun cika, kuma hanyoyin sadarwar suna compile. Ana rubuta lambar kwangila. Ba a tura komai ba: har yanzu babu kwangilar Avana da ke da adireshi a Ethereum ko Base.

Adireshi suna bayyana a wannan shafi bayan turawa, da zarar kowace turawa ta wuce bincikenta na bytecode da na saitin kai tsaye. Binciken tsaro mai zaman kansa na kowace kwangila yana biye da lambar, kuma ana yi wa kowace sabuwar kwangilar Avana da haɗin AMM binciken tsaro kafin turawa.
An bayyana matsayin bita, iyakar binciken tsaro da rajistar abubuwan da aka gano a wannan shafi:
Binciken Tsaro

Avana yana tura rukunin kwangiloli iri ɗaya a kowane chain, kuma babu abin da ake rabawa tsakanin chains. Kwangila tana wanzuwa sau ɗaya a kowane chain sai dai idan iyakarta ta faɗi wani abu daban. Hubs, CDP Spokes da kasuwanni bayanai ne a cikin kwangilolin kowane chain, kuma kowace iyaka, dakatarwa, breaker da izinin hanya ana tsara su bisa Hub, da bisa CDP Spoke da kasuwa inda ya dace.
Tsari
Ma'ana
Ba ya canzawa
Babu admin da zai iya canza lambar ko alaƙoƙinta. Aiki mai gata, inda yake akwai, yana bincika cewa mai kira shi ne AvanaTimelock na chain.
Mai haɓakawa (UUPS) a bayan AvanaTimelock
APPLICATION_ADMIN
, wanda AvanaTimelock na chain kaɗai ke riƙe da shi. Kowane haɓakawa yana jiran jinkirin da aka saba, kuma kowane mai sokewa zai iya soke shi. Babu ProxyAdmin kuma babu wata hanyar haɓakawa.
Laburare
Lamba tsantsa da aka compile cikin wata kwangila; tana canzawa ne kawai tare da wannan kwangilar.
Kayan gefe
A wajen tsakiyar da aka yi wa binciken tsaro: babu kwangilar tsakiya da ke kiran sa kuma babu abin da yake mayarwa da ke ba da izinin aiki.
Rukunin jinkiri
Ƙima
Jinkiri na yau da kullum
Kwanaki 5 a ƙaddamarwa, ba ya taɓa ƙasa da kwanaki 4 ko sama da kwanaki 5. Haɓakawa, jera kasuwa, hanyoyi, kowane sassautawa, ƙara keepers da canjin matsayi.
Gajeren jinkiri

Awanni 12, ga kiran da ke cikin rukunin cancantar gajeren jinkiri wanda ba ya canzawa kaɗai: tsaurarawa, kashewa da maido da hanya, cire keeper, kunnawa, offboarding, daskarewa, dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, kunna breaker da hanyoyin jiran aiki.
Nan take
Daskarewa ta guardian, dakatarwa, cire dakatarwa, cire daskarewa, daskarar da adireshi, kunna da sake saita breaker, canjawa zuwa hanyar jiran aiki, da sokewa.
Lokacin grace
Aikin da ya shirya yana ƙarewa kwanaki 14 bayan ya zama mai aiwatarwa; kowa zai iya aiwatar da shi kafin lokacin.

Misali daga takardar bayani: a ƙaddamarwa, Ethereum da Base kowanne yana gudanar da yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya da kasuwanni biyu. Kowane chain yana da kwangiloli 13 na kowane chain (babu DebtOracle yayin da GHO ne kadarar bashi ɗaya tak), LPVault 1, Hub 1, CDP Spoke 1, Lend Spoke 1, Coverage Spoke 1 don GHO, vault tokens 2 da misalan LPOracle 2: turawa 26 na kowane chain, LPVaults 2 da misalan kasuwa 4 gaba ɗaya. Wallet da ke amfani da duka kasuwannin Ethereum biyu da kasuwar Base ɗaya yana da PositionProxies 3.
Tsarewa tana riƙe da matsayin da aka yi pledge da littafin tallafi. Duka kwangilolin biyu ba sa canzawa, don haka babu haɓakawa da zai iya canza wanda ke karɓar matsayi ko yadda ake ƙidaya tallafi.

Matsayi da zagayen rayuwa

Ethereum

LPVault

Tsare kowane matsayi da aka yi pledge na yarjejeniyar AMM ɗaya a chain ɗaya. Yana tabbatar da matsayi a kan pool da takamaiman siffar kasuwa, yana lissafa tsarin haɗin token ga kowace raka'a, yana warware daidai raka'o'in da Collateralization ya ambata, yana tattara kuɗaɗe ga mai ajiya kuma yana mayar da matsayi ga mai ajiyarsa da aka rubuta kaɗai.
Zagayen rayuwa:

yana ɗaure kowace kasuwa a jera ta, yana ɗaukar tsarewa a pledge, yana warware raka'o'in da aka ambata a ƙwacewa ko cirewar wani ɓangare, yana mayar da matsayin a cirewa. Ba ya taɓa riƙe vault token ko token na pool tsakanin kira: babban kuɗin da aka cire yana zuwa kai tsaye zuwa LPVaultSwap, mai ajiya ko ma'aunin sasantawa mai jiran aiki.
Ɗaya ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM a kowane chain: Uniswap v3 a Ethereum, Aerodrome Slipstream a Base
Babu kowa. Aiki ɗaya mai gata,
returnStray
, yana mayar da matsayin da bai taɓa samun rikodi ba kuma AvanaTimelock ne kaɗai zai iya kiran sa a jinkirin da aka saba.
Ba a tura ba tukuna
Collateralization

Littafin tallafi mara nuna bambanci ga AMM na chain: rikodi ɗaya ga kowane matsayi da aka yi pledge, raka'o'in da aka sa ga kowace kasuwa da asusu, jerin ƙwacewa daga mafi girma, ma'aunan fallasa bisa Hub don iyakokin token, mai ajiya da kason pool, da ma'aunin sasantawa mai jiran aiki.

yana rubuta cajin iyaka na RiskModule a pledge (rikodi 16 a buɗe a mafi yawa ga kowane asusu da kasuwa), yana cire rikodi daga mafi girma a ƙwacewa kuma yana bincika cewa raguwar hannun jarin proxy, raguwar samar da token da raka'o'in da aka cire daidai suke, yana daidaita ƙwacewar da ba a sasanta ba lokacin da mai aro ya fita, kuma yana biyan ma'aunin jiran aiki ta
settlePending
Ɗaya a kowane chain, wanda kowace yarjejeniyar AMM ke rabawa
Babu kowa.
Vault token kadarar jingina ce ta Aave ta kasuwa ɗaya. Immutables ɗinsa suna ambaton kasuwar, don haka babu haɓakawa da zai iya sake nuna tallafinsa zuwa wani wuri.
VaultToken

ERC-20 na jingina kaɗai na kasuwa ɗaya: raka'ar tushe ɗaya raka'a ɗaya ce da aka sa ta matsayin da aka yi pledge. AaveAdapter ne kaɗai ke mint da burn, kuma ma'auni suna motsawa tsakanin proxies da aka yi wa rajista, Hub na kasuwar da LPVaultSwap kaɗai; kowane canja wuri yana revert, har da adadin sifili.

ana tura shi a jera kasuwa tare da pool, siffa, LPVault, Hub, CDP Spoke, LPOracle da decimals na kasuwar da aka ɗaure a matsayin immutables; ana mint a pledge da sake sawa, ana samar da shi ga Hub, ana cire shi zuwa proxy, ana ƙwace shi zuwa LPVaultSwap, ana ƙona shi a cirewa da bayan ƙwacewa.
Ɗaya ga kowace kasuwa (decimals 6 zuwa 18)
Babu kowa: babu mai shi, setter, dakatarwa ko haɓakawa.

Yana tura kowane vault token da CREATE3 a adireshin da CDP Spoke da maɓallin kasuwa suka tsayar, kuma yana riƙe da rajistar rubutu-sau-ɗaya ta tokens da haɗin AMM, don haka kasuwa ba za ta taɓa samun tokens na jingina biyu ba.

yana gudana a cikin rukunin timelock ɗaya da jera kasuwar. Ba shi da iko a kan tokens ko LPVaults da yake rubutawa.

ta AvanaTimelock kaɗai, a jinkirin da aka saba, a rukunin jera kasuwa.
Kowace kasuwa asusun Aave ne daban mai nasa ma'aunin lafiya, don haka babu abin da aka haɗa jinginarsa tsakanin kasuwanni.
PositionProxy

Asusun Aave V4 na mai aro na kasuwa ɗaya a CDP Spoke ɗaya: jinginar vault-token ta wannan kasuwa da kowane reserve na bashi da ya aro, a ƙarƙashin ma'aunin lafiya ɗaya. Ba shi da dabaru: aikinsa ɗaya,
execute
, yana karɓar AaveAdapter na chain kaɗai, har ga wallet ɗin da aka ɗaure shi da shi.

ana ƙirƙira shi da CREATE2 a pledge na farko na wallet ga wannan kasuwa; wallet, Spoke da kasuwa an tsayar da su har abada. Ba a taɓa haɓaka shi ko maye gurbinsa; gyara ga dabarun asusu yana kaiwa kowane asusu ta haɓaka AaveAdapter ɗaya.

Babu kowa: babu proxy na haɓakawa, mai shi, matsayi, dakatarwa ko setter.

Kwangilolin manufa suna yanke shawara ko sabon haɗari zai iya buɗewa kuma suna riƙe da saiti. Suna haɓakawa a bayan timelock kuma kwangiloli marasa canzawa suna amincewa da su ne kawai don binciken eh-ko-a'a, farashi da ƙimomi a cikin iyakoki.

ana poke shi ta kiran Avana da keepers; yana riƙe da farashin cache a lokacin gajerun katsewa, yana ba da farashin matsi a wajen Live, kuma a Base yana karanta feed na sequencer-uptime.

, tare da giɓi): yawancinsu a Certora CVL a kan dukan yanayin da za a iya kaiwa, sauran a matsayin gwaje-gwajen Foundry na alama na Halmos, da hujjojin SMTChecker (injin CHC) na rashin overflow, underflow, raba da sifili da asserts da ke gazawa a cikin kwangiloli marasa canzawa da lambar oracle, sasantawa da hanya.
Matakin tsaro mai sauri (kowane push da pull request)
forge fmt
forge lint
, gini da ke ƙin gargaɗi, solhint 6.2.5, Slither 0.11.6 tare da binciken haɓakawarsa, Aderyn 0.6.8 da binciken girman fayil; yana tsara kowane merge.
Matakin tsaro mai jinkiri (kowane dare da kafin kowane saki)

Echidna 2.3.3 da Medusa 1.5.1 a kan kowane harness na kaddara, Halmos 0.3.3, hevm 0.58.0 a kan asserts na harness da runtime bytecode, da Mythril 0.24.8 a kan runtime code na kowace kwangila; yana tsara kowane tag na saki da haɓakawa da timelock ya tsara.

Ba a amfani da kayan aiki biyu da aka ambata a tsare-tsaren baya: MythX ya rufe, don haka Mythril yana gudana a cikin gida kuma babu matakin da ke aika lamba ga sabis na waje; an adana Manticore a ma'aji, don haka hevm da Halmos ke ɗaukar aiwatarwa ta alama.

yana gina matrix na buƙata, bincike da aiwatarwa. Yana gazawa idan akwai kwafin ID, haɗi zuwa ID da ba a bayyana ba, ko buƙatar da rubutunta ya canza tun lokacin da aka karɓe ta na ƙarshe; a yanayin tsauri kuma yana gazawa idan buƙata ba ta da bincike, kuma, da zarar lambar ta wanzu, idan buƙata ba ta da gwaji, kaddara ko haɗin tushe. Kowane layi na matrix yana da matsayi ɗaya:
Yanayi
Ba a tabbatar ba
An yi samfuri
Binciken matakin takardar bayani kaɗai (Z3, SymPy, Quint, Hypothesis, simulations).
An tsara (prover)
Kaddarar Certora, Halmos ko SMTChecker tana ambaton buƙatar, kuma prover bai wuce ta ba tukuna.
An tabbatar
Binciken matakin takardar bayani tare da gwajin Foundry ko kaddarar da prover ya wuce.
An canza — sake tabbatarwa
Rubutun buƙatar ya canza tun lokacin da aka karɓi binciken ta; dole a sake gudanar da binciken kuma a karɓi canjin.
Ana bin diddigin abubuwan da aka gano da matsayinsu a shafin
Binciken Tsaro
Bayanin tsaro: invariants 99 na duniya, yanayin hare-hare 197 a cikin rukunoni 16, dogaro 32 na waje, muhimman shawarwarin ƙira da tsarin tabbatarwa.

meta.title: Lambar Ladabi ga Kwari
meta.description: Iyakar bayyanawa mai alhaki ga kwangilolin Avana, ayyukan turawa da ayyukan tallafi, abin da ke wajen iyaka, da yadda ake auna abubuwan da aka gano bisa tasirin tattalin arziki.

strings: Lambar Ladabi ga Kwari
Iyakar bayyanawa mai alhaki ga kwangilolin Avana, ayyukan turawa da ayyukan tallafi, abin da ke wajen iyaka, da yadda ake auna abubuwan da aka gano bisa tasirin tattalin arziki.
Bayani
Girma & Tsarin Gine-gine
A Wajen Iyaka
Tsananin Falsafa
Shirin A - Kulawa da Aave V4 Haɗuwa

Yana rufe kwangilolin Avana da ke riƙe da matsayin LP, suna adana ledger na tallafi, suna fitar da vault tokens kuma suna haɗa su da Avana Hubs da CDP Spokes. Hubs da Spokes kansu kwangiloli ne na Aave V4 na yau da kullum mallakar Aave DAO.
LPVault, ɗaya ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM a kowane chain: tsarewa, karɓar kuɗaɗe, cire ruwan kuɗi da mayar da matsayi
Collateralization: ledger na tallafi, ƙidayoyin fallasa, da binciken raguwar hannun jari da raguwar wadata a lokacin ƙwacewa
VaultToken da VaultTokenFactory: mint, ƙonawa da ƙa'idar canja wuri da ke aika tokens da aka ƙwace zuwa LPVaultSwap kaɗai
PositionProxy da ProxyManager: ƙirƙirar proxy, ɗaurewa ga wallet, Spoke da kasuwa, da hanyar kira ta Adapter kaɗai
AaveAdapter: pledge, aro, biya, cirewa, cire wani ɓangare, sake sawa a asusu, biya da jingina da tilasta dakatarwa
Lock: makullin reentrancy na tarayya da mambobinsa biyu
Satar matsayin LP da ke cikin LPVault, ko mayar da matsayi ga wani ba mai ajiyarsa na rikodi ba
Vault-token isarwa ba tare da dacewar ruwa ba
Aro ba tare da isasshen jingina ba, ko fiye da ma'aunin lafiya na Aave ko iyakokin ɗauka
Toshe biyan bashi, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, karɓar kuɗaɗe ko liquidations
Program B - Ƙimanta LP, Binciken Haɗari da Liquidation
Yana rufe yadda Avana ke ƙimanta farashin vault tokens da kadarorin bashi, tana bincika cancanta da iyakoki, kuma tana sasanta jinginar LP yayin liquidation.
RiskModule: cancanta, iyakoki, yanki na ƙarin jingina, circuit breakers da binciken drift na saiti
LPOracle: farashi ta haɗin gaskiya daga Chainlink, binciken TWAP da tushe na biyu, da yanayin farashi
DebtOracle: tushen farashin kowane reserve na bashi da ba GHO ba
LPVaultSwap: liquidation, liquidation mara izini, biya da jingina da sasantawa mai jiran aiki
Hanyoyin musanya daga tokens da aka warware zuwa kowace kadarar bashi
Aiwatarwar IFlashSource da ke flash-borrow daga Aave V3 Pool
InKindEscrow: escrow na biya don biyan da token ya ƙi
Ƙimanta jinginar LP fiye da kima ko ƙimanta bashi ƙasa da kima
Yin amfani da Oracle yana ba da damar bashi mara kyau
Liquidation mara adalci saboda ƙimanta farashi ƙasa da kima, ko ƙwacewa daga asusu mai lafiya
Sasantawa da ke barin bashi ba a biya ba, vault tokens ba tare da tallafi ba, ko biya da aka karkatar

LP rashin dacewar farashi na iya haifar da mummunan tasirin tattalin arziki ta hanyar bai wa bashi mara kyau dama, rashin iya biyan bashi, ko rashin daidaiton kashe dukiya, ko da ba tare da sata kai tsaye daga kwangila ba.
Program C - Gudanarwa, Saiti da Haɓakawa
Yana rufe ikon gata a kan kwangilolin Avana kanta da ayyukan da ke turawa da saita su.
AvanaTimelock da AvanaRoles: jinkiri, jerin gajeren jinkiri, haƙƙin sokewa da gudanar da matsayi
MarketRegistry: kasuwanni, reserves na bashi, hanyoyi, yanayin dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, breakers da hanyoyin jiran aiki
ParameterStore: iyakokin sigogi, setters na tsaurarawa da sassautawa da matakan sassautawa
Scripts na turawa da ayyukan AvanaTimelock, har da tsarin turawa da farawa, taswirar matsayi, jerin gajeren jinkiri da batches na jera kasuwa
Saitunan ɓangaren Aave da Avana ke dogara da su a cikin payloads na turawa da jera kasuwa na Aave DAO
Kauce wa timelock ko jinkirinsa da ake buƙata
Ba da matsayi ba tare da izini ba, ko matsayi da ake riƙe da shi a wajen teburin matsayi
Lalacewar sigogi ko sassautawa fiye da matakinsa
Ikon guardian da ke kaiwa ga hanyoyin fita, liquidation ko kuɗaɗe
Program D - Wurare na Wajen Chain da Haɗawa
Yana rufe tsarin tallafi waɗanda tona su zai iya shafar abin da masu amfani ke sa hannu a kai ko yadda liquidations ke gudana. Ana bita su da bita mai sauƙi fiye da kwangiloli.
Masu gina calldata na packages/protocol: maƙasudai, amincewa, masu karɓa da adadi
Keeper na Avana
Backend na Convex
Views na karatu kaɗai na Lens
Matsalolin gaba tare da sakamakon haɗarin walat kai tsaye
Gina ma'amala ta mugunta ko ba daidai ba
Mai tsaron da aka lalata ko hanyoyin sa ido
Asarar asusun mai amfani ta hanyar haɗin gwiwar amintattu
Ma'aunin lafiya, farashi ko tallafi marasa daidai da ake nuna wa masu amfani ko keepers
Mai tsanani
Asarar jingina ko bashi mara tallafi ba tare da wani sharaɗi ba fiye da haɓakawa ko kiran jama'a.
Babba
Asara ko tsayar da dukan yarjejeniya ƙarƙashin yanayi mai yiwuwa.
Matsakaici
Asara mai iyaka, griefing ko asarar ci gaba da aiki a kasuwa ɗaya.
Asara a matakin ƙura ko ƙunƙuntaccen yanayi.
Na bayani
Yana tabbatar da shawarar ƙira; babu asara.
Fagen bayyana rauni cikin alhaki da jagorar tantance tasirin tattalin arziki don nazarin tsaro na Avana.
Wannan shafi yana bayyana iyakar bayyanawa mai alhaki a cikin kwangilolin Avana kanta, ayyukan turawa da ayyukan tallafi. Ana sanar da sharuɗɗan shirin, lada, dandali da ranar farawa daban.

Iyakar ta haɗa da raunin kwangila kai tsaye da gazawar tattalin arziki da suka shafi jinginar LP. Farashin da aka juya, ƙarancin ruwan kuɗi, ko vault tokens da ba su ƙara daidai da ruwan kuɗin da ke cikin LPVault ba za su iya shafar ƙarfin aro ko hana liquidation dawo da bashi.
Tsananin matsala ya dogara ne da tasirin tattalin arziki.

Kimantawar tana la'akari da yiwuwar cin zarafi da sakamako kamar asarar kuɗaɗe, bashi mara tallafi, rashin iya biyan bashi ko kuskuren ƙimanta jingina a matakin tsarin. Girman lambar da abin ya shafa ba ma'aunin yiwuwar asara ba ne.

Kowace kwangilar Avana da aka rubuta daga takardar bayani tana cikin iyaka, tare da scripts na turawa, ayyukan timelock da masu gina calldata. Ana haɗa rahotanni bisa ƙaramin tsarin da abin ya shafa. Haɗawar tana gano ɓangaren da abin ya shafa; tsanani ya dogara da tasirin da aka nuna.
Mafi girman hankali
Ya haɗa
Manyan hadari
Me ya sa yake da muhimmanci:

Ana tantance ƙananan tsare-tsare daban, amma har yanzu ana auna tasiri a kan iya biyan bashi, amincin kuɗaɗen masu amfani, ingancin liquidation da haɗarin yarjejeniya mai alaƙa. Iyakokin amincewa da bayyanannen iyakar tasirin kowace kwangila mai haɓakawa an bayyana su a wannan shafi:
Tsaron Kwangila

Lambar Aave V4 da ba a gyara ba tana wajen iyaka, har da kowane Avana Hub, CDP Spoke, Lend Spoke da Coverage Spoke. Binciken turawa na Avana yana tabbatar da cewa bytecode ɗinsu daidai yake da sakin Aave da aka yi wa binciken tsaro da aka ambata a cikin manifest na turawa. Saitunan ɓangaren Aave da Avana ke dogara da su, da yadda Avana ke sarrafa su, suna zama a cikin iyaka ƙarƙashin Program C.

Ana auna tsanani daga hanyar cin zarafi mai sahihanci da lalacewar tattalin arziki da take bayarwa, ba daga makin rauni na gama-gari kaɗai ba. Matakan su ne waɗanda ake amfani da su a rajistar abubuwan da aka gano na binciken tsaro na Avana:
Tsanani
Ma'ana

Gano wanda ke ba da damar LP ƙima fiye da kima ko bashi mara kyau zai iya zama mai mahimmanci ko da yake yana shafan ƙaramin lambar. Gano ba tare da sahihin hanyar yin lahani mai yawa ga tattalin arziki ba suna samun ƙimar tsanani mafi ƙasa.
Iyakar bayyanawa mai alhaki, lambar da ke wajen iyaka, da tsanani bisa tasirin tattalin arziki ga Avana.

meta.title: Tsaron Kwangila
meta.description: Waɗanne kwangilolin Avana ne masu haɓakawa a bayan AvanaTimelock da waɗanda ba sa canzawa, iyakokin amincewa tsakaninsu, da yadda haɓakawa ta mugunta za ta iya kaiwa.

toc.title: Ba a Taɓa Toshe Hanyoyin Fita

strings: Tsaron Kwangila
Waɗanne kwangilolin Avana ne masu haɓakawa a bayan AvanaTimelock da waɗanda ba sa canzawa, iyakokin amincewa tsakaninsu, da yadda haɓakawa ta mugunta za ta iya kaiwa.
Bayani
Masu Haɓakawa da Marasa Canzawa
Hanyar Haɓakawa
Matakan Amincewa
Amincewa Iyakoki
Iyakar Tasirin Haɓakawa ta Mugunta
Makullin Reentrancy
Ba a Taɓa Toshe Hanyoyin Fita
Mai aro → AaveAdapter
Muhawarar pledge, aro, cirewa, biyan duka, cire ruwan kuɗi, sake sawa a asusu da biya da jingina

Ana gano proxy daga mai kira, CDP Spoke da kasuwa, ba daga adireshin da aka tura ba; dole Spoke da kasuwa su kasance masu rajista kuma masu aiki; wa'adi, nonce na aro, mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin lafiya da iyakokin kashewa; mai karɓar aro ba zai iya zama kwangilar Avana ko Aave ba; yanayin dakatarwa da daskarar da adireshi ga sabon aiki; kowane bincike na ɓangaren aro yana gudana a cikin RiskModule.
Mai aro → LPVault da Collateralization
Matsayin da aka yi pledge da shi; karɓar kuɗaɗe da sakewa mara credit

Kowane LPVault yana karɓar mai sarrafa matsayi da factory da aka ɗaure shi da su kaɗai; ana samo pool a kan chain, ba mai kira ne ke ba da shi ba; dole matsayi ya yi daidai da ainihin pool da kewayon kasuwa da aka jera; kuɗaɗe da matsayi suna zuwa ga mai ajiya na rikodi kaɗai.
RiskModule, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore → AaveAdapter da Collateralization
Amsoshin eh-ko-a'a, cajin pledge, ma'aunin lafiya bayan aro, yanayin dakatarwa, sigogi

Ana tuntuɓar su ne kawai don cancantar pledge da binciken ɓangaren aro; tsauraran iyakoki a cikin setters suna iyakance ƙimomi; babu ɗayansu da biya, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba ko karɓar kuɗaɗe ke karantawa.
LPVaultSwap → Collateralization da AaveAdapter
Vault tokens da aka ƙwace, ƙwacewa da sasantawa masu jiran aiki, ƙona raka'o'in da aka ƙwace

Ana karɓa daga LPVaultSwap ne kawai yayin da yake riƙe da Lock; Collateralization tana bincika cewa hannun jarin samarwa na asusun da wadatar token duka sun faɗi da ainihin adadin da aka ƙwace kafin sakin ruwan kuɗi.
Avana ↔ Aave V4 Hubs da CDP Spokes
Kiran samarwa, aro, biya, cirewa da liquidation; bayanan asusu

Ana amincewa da Aave don bashi da lafiya; Avana ba ta amince cewa saitinta zai zauna kamar yadda aka jera ba, don haka binciken drift yana sake karanta saitunan reserve uku da ake buƙata da sauran ƙimomi a sabon aiki kuma yana tsayar da sabon haɗari idan sun canza.
Ɓangare na uku → Aave Spoke da Hub a kan reserves na Avana
Kiran liquidation kai tsaye da ayyukan Hub a kan reserves na vault-token

Vault token yana motsawa ne kawai a hanyoyinsa tsayayyu: mint ga proxy mai rajista, samarwa ga da cirewa daga Hub na gida, ƙwacewa zuwa LPVaultSwap; liquidation kai tsaye ta kowa yana komawa baya a canja wurin ƙwacewa.
Masu sarrafa matsayin AMM da pools → LPVaults, LPOracles, RiskModule
Bayanan matsayi, raka'o'in ruwan kuɗi, kuɗaɗe, babban kuɗi a lokacin cirewa, lura na TWAP

Mai sarrafa matsayi da factory immutables ne na kowane LPVault; kira suna komawa baya yayin da ake riƙe da makullin reentrancy na AMM; ƙimantawa tana amfani da farashin Chainlink kaɗai, TWAP na pool mai tsaro ne.
Chainlink → LPOracle da DebtOracle
Farashin USD na token da timestamps

Ga kowace hanya: amsa mai kyau, timestamp ingantacce kuma ba na gaba ba, shekaru a cikin heartbeat tare da daƙiƙa 1,800, a cikin iyakokin aggregator, decimals da aka ƙayyade a jera kasuwa; kowace gazawa tana motsa kasuwa zuwa yanayin farashi mafi tsauri.
LPOracle → Aave Spoke
Farashin vault-token da ake amfani da shi don lafiya da auna ƙwacewa

Yana mayar da decimals 8 har abada, ba ya taɓa komawa baya kuma ba ya taɓa mayar da 0, kuma yana zagaye ƙasa. Da zarar kasuwa ta zama Expired tana ba da raka'a 1 (10⁻⁸ USD ga kowane vault token), don haka Aave yana ƙidaya jinginar a matsayin mara ƙima yayin da hanyoyin fita ke ci gaba da aiki.
Tushen flash na Aave V3 Pool → LPVaultSwap
Kadarar bashi da aka flash-borrow da callback

Ana bincika ruwan kuɗi da ke akwai da premium a mafi yawa maxFlashFeeBps kafin rancen; callback yana komawa baya sai dai idan ya fito daga Aave V3 Pool na chain tare da LPVaultSwap a matsayin mai farawa.
Pools na hanyar musanya → hanyoyin musanya da LPVaultSwap
Kadarar bashi da aka mayar don tokens da aka warware

Hanyoyi tsayayyu ne ga kowace kasuwa, token da kadarar bashi, ana ƙara su a jinkiri na yau da kullum; kowace hanya tana da mafi ƙanƙantar fitarwa da aka samo daga oracle kuma dole jimilla ta kai mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa; hanyoyi ba sa taɓa ciniki ta pool da ake warwarewa.
Keepers da masu kira marasa izini → LPVaultSwap
Muhawarar liquidation: asusu, kasuwa, reserve na bashi, adadi, yanayin hanya, wa'adi, mafi ƙanƙantar biya, iyakar gibi

Keeper da aka amince da shi, wanda ba a daskarar ba ga hanyar keeper; proxy mai rajista da reserve na bashi da aka amince da shi; sabbin farashi ga kasuwar da aka ƙwace da bashin da aka biya; kowace shigarwa za ta iya rage kira ne kawai ko ta mayar da shi baya; biyan koyaushe yana zuwa ga mai kira.
Gudanarwa → AvanaTimelock → kwangilolin Avana
Haɓakawa, ayyukan turawa, hanyoyi, tushen farashi, sigogi, keepers, matsayi

Kowane kira mai gata yana aiwatarwa daga timelock na chain; ana karanta jinkirin da ake buƙata daga calldata; haƙƙin sokewa; ana sake bincika tsauraran iyakoki da matakan sassautawa a lokacin aiwatarwa.
Guardians → yanayin dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, breakers, hanyoyin jiran aiki
Daskarewa, dakatarwa, cire daskarewa, cire dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, kunna da sake saita breaker, canjin jiran aiki

Kowane iko yana tsayar da sabon aiki ko yana sa hanyar da aka bita cikin aiki; babu ɗayansu da ke kaiwa ga biya, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, karɓar kuɗaɗe ko liquidation; a mafi yawa daskarar da adireshi 20 ga kowane mai kira a kowane awanni 24 masu juyawa.
Aave DAO → saitin Aave na kasuwannin Avana
Collateral factors, iyakoki, tutoci, tsayarwa, saitunan liquidation, tushen farashi
Drift yana toshe sabon haɗari; an hana collateral factor na 0 yayin da asusu ke riƙe da reserve.
Tokens da kadarorin bashi → Avana
Canja wuri yayin karɓar kuɗaɗe, aro, biya, sasantawa da musanya
Ba a jera tokens na fee-on-transfer, rebasing da hook ba; SafeERC20 a ko'ina; ana auna adadi ta canjin ma'auni; binciken mai fitarwa don canjin dakatarwa da kuɗin canja wuri.
Gudummawa da kadarori da suka ɓace → kwangilolin Avana
Ƙura, vault tokens, tokens na pool, matsayi
Binciken canjin ma'auni yana sa gudummawa su zama marasa tasiri; matsayi da ba a sa a asusu ba yana dawowa ne kawai ta timelock.
Avana Umbrella → gibin Hub
Adadin kawar da gibi
Kowane Coverage Spoke yana rufe CDP Spokes da ke cikin jerin izini kaɗai, a cikin kadararsa kaɗai, ba ya taɓa wuce gibin da aka rubuta ko ma'aunin da aka ba shi kuɗi.
Ayyuka na wajen chain → wallets da keepers
Intents, matsayin da aka nuna, ma'aunin lafiya, jerin 'yan takara

Ana gina calldata daga manifest na turawa da aka haɗa kuma aka tabbatar kuma ba a taɓa ɗauka daga sabis da aka karɓa ba; wallet yana nuna mai karɓa da adadi kafin sa hannu; masu amfani da keepers za su iya kiran kwangiloli kai tsaye.
LPVaultSwap → escrow na biya
Biyan da token ya ƙi isarwa
Ajiya daga LPVaultSwap ne kawai ƙarƙashin Lock; mai karɓar kowane credit ne kaɗai zai iya buƙatarsa.
Waɗanne kwangiloli ne za a iya haɓakawa da waɗanda ba za a iya ba, iyakokin amincewa tsakaninsu, da yadda haɓakawa ta mugunta za ta iya kaiwa.

Avana ba ta yin fork, kwafi ko gyara lambar Aave V4. Kowane Avana Hub da CDP Spoke kwangila ce ta Aave V4 na yau da kullum mallakar Aave DAO, kuma dukan dabarun musamman na Avana suna cikin kwangilolin Avana kanta. Ana raba waɗannan kwangiloli bisa abin da ake amincewa da su a kai: tsarewa, ledger na tallafi da binciken ƙwacewa ba sa canzawa, yayin da manufa, farashi da tsara liquidation masu haɓakawa ne a bayan AvanaTimelock na kowane chain.

Rabuwar tana iyakance abin da haɓakawa mai matsala ko ta mugunta za ta iya yi. Lambar mara canzawa tana amincewa da lambar mai haɓakawa ne kawai don amsoshin eh-ko-a'a, farashi da ƙimomi a cikin iyakoki, don haka mummunar haɓakawa za ta iya toshe sabon aiki ko ta ƙimanta farashi ba daidai ba a cikin iyakoki, amma ba za ta iya aika matsayi ga kowa ba sai mai ajiyarsa, sakin ruwan kuɗin da ba ta ƙona ba, ko hana mai aro fita.
Cikakken jerin kwangiloli tare da adireshi da interfaces yana a wannan shafi:
Bayani: Kwangiloli
Tsari
Kwangiloli
Masu haɓakawa (UUPS a bayan AvanaTimelock)
AaveAdapter (ɗaya ga kowane chain), RiskModule, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore, kowane LPOracle, kowane DebtOracle, LPVaultSwap

Ayyukan mai aro, binciken cancanta, farashi, sigogi, yanayin dakatarwa da breaker, da tsara liquidation na iya buƙatar gyare-gyare ko sabbin haɗawa. Kowace haɓakawa tana jira kwanaki 5 a fili kuma kowane mai sokewa zai iya tsayar da ita.
Ba ya canzawa

Kowane LPVault (ɗaya ga kowace yarjejeniyar AMM a kowane chain), Collateralization, vault tokens da VaultTokenFactory, kowane PositionProxy da ProxyManager, Lock, sigogin hanyar musanya, aiwatarwar tushen flash, escrow na biya (InKindEscrow), AvanaTimelock, Lens

Waɗannan suna riƙe da ƙa'idojin da ke iyakance kowace haɓakawa: matsayi suna komawa ga mai ajiyarsu na rikodi kaɗai, ledger na tallafi da ƙidayoyin fallasa, binciken hannun jari da wadata a lokacin ƙwacewa, ƙa'idar cewa vault tokens da aka ƙwace suna zuwa LPVaultSwap kaɗai, binciken flash-loan, biyan da ke cikin escrow da jinkiri da matsayin timelock kansa.
Kwangilolin Aave DAO
Kowane Avana Hub, CDP Spoke, Lend Spoke da Avana Umbrella (Coverage Spoke)
Kwangiloli na Aave V4 na yau da kullum, gudanarwar Aave kaɗai ke haɓakawa da saita su. Coverage Spokes na Avana Umbrella ba masu haɓakawa ba ne.

Ana maye gurbin ɓangare mara canzawa ta hanyar tura sabon siga da nuna masa matakin mai haɓakawa ta timelock: sabuwar hanyar musanya ko tushen flash a jinkiri na yau da kullum, ko, don matsalar LPVault ko ledger, offboarding na kasuwannin da abin ya shafa da sake jera su a kan gyararrun kwangiloli. PositionProxy ba shi da dabaru, ba shi da mai nuni ga aiwatarwa kuma ba shi da hanyar haɓakawa; yana aiwatar da kiran AaveAdapter kaɗai, don haka dabarun asusu suna canzawa ne kawai tare da haɓakawar AaveAdapter.
Lens kwangila ce ta gefe ta karatu kaɗai ba tare da yanayi ko admin ba. Babu kwangilar tushe da ke kiran sa ko dogara da abin da yake mayarwa, don haka za a iya maye gurbinsa a kowane lokaci.

Kowace kwangila mai haɓakawa aiwatarwa ce ta UUPS a bayan proxy na ERC-1967. Izinin haɓakawarta yana buƙatar APPLICATION_ADMIN, wanda AvanaTimelock kaɗai ke riƙe da shi; ba da wannan matsayi ko matsayin default admin ga kowane asusu daban yana komawa baya.

Babu kwangilar Avana da ke da mai shi na Ownable, ProxyAdmin ko ikon AccessManager. Kwangiloli marasa canzawa suna karɓar 'yan kiransu masu gata ne kawai daga adireshin timelock da aka tsayar a cikin bytecode ɗinsu.

Haɓakawa aikin timelock ne a jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5, ba ya taɓa ƙasa da 4. Safe na gudanarwa, Emergency Guardian, Aave Protocol Guardian da mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kowannensu zai iya soke ta yayin jinkirin.
Ana fara kowane proxy mai haɓakawa a cikin ma'amalar turawarsa tare da matsayi ga timelock kaɗai, kuma mai turawa ba ya riƙe da wani matsayi da zarar turawa ta ƙare.
Kafin kowace shawarar haɓakawa ana sake gudanar da rukunin invariant a kan fork bayan aiwatar da haɓakawar, kuma CI yana kwatanta tsarin ajiya da sigar da aka tura.
Binciken saitin da ke aiki yana kwatanta kowane mai riƙe da matsayi, ramin proxy da saitin timelock da manifest na turawa bayan kowane lamarin gudanarwa.
An bayyana matsayi, jinkiri da ƙa'idojin sokewa a wannan shafi:
Gudanarwa da Timelock
Ɓangare zai iya dogara da ɓangare a mataki mafi girma, kuma don abin da ake amincewa da wannan matakin a kai kaɗai.
Mataki
Ɓangarori
Ana amincewa da shi don
Ba a amincewa da shi don
1. Lambar Avana mara canzawa
LPVaults, Collateralization, vault tokens, VaultTokenFactory, Lock, hanyoyin musanya, aiwatarwar tushen flash, escrow na biya, PositionProxies, ProxyManager, AvanaTimelock
Tsarewa da mayar da matsayi, ledger na tallafi, binciken ƙwacewa, ƙa'idar mai karɓar ƙwacewa, binciken flash-loan, biyan da ke cikin escrow, jinkiri da matsayin timelock
Babu wani abu fiye da lambarsu
2. Lambar tsarewa mai haɓakawa a bayan timelock na kwanaki 5
AaveAdapter
Aiwatar da ayyukan mai aro, mint na ainihin raka'o'in da aka sa a asusu da ƙona ainihin raka'o'in da aka saki ko aka ƙwace, ƙirƙira da rajistar proxy, iyakokin kira
Karɓar jinginar da aka ƙwace, canza lambar proxy, ɗaga kowace iyakar Aave, kashe Avana Umbrella, aiki a wani chain
3. Lambar manufa da sasantawa mai haɓakawa
RiskModule, MarketRegistry, ParameterStore, LPOracles, DebtOracles, LPVaultSwap
Binciken ɓangaren aro da pledge, farashi da yanayin farashi, sigogi da iyakoki, yanayin dakatarwa da breaker, kasuwanni da hanyoyi, tsara liquidation
Mint, ƙonawa, sakin jingina, rajistar proxies, aiki a madadin mai aro
4. Aave V4 da Aave DAO
Hubs, CDP Spokes, Lend Spoke, Coverage Spokes, AaveOracle, Aave V3 Pool da ke bayan tushen flash
Bashi, riba, ma'aunin lafiya, auna liquidation, lissafin gibi, farashin kadarar bashi, ruwan kuɗin flash
Kiyaye saitunan reserve na Avana ba tare da canji ba, wanda Avana ke sake bincikawa a kan chain
5. Yarjejeniyoyi na waje da ɓangarori na wajen chain
AMMs, Chainlink da tushe na biyu, feed na sequencer na Base, masu fitar da token, pools na hanyar musanya, keepers, backend da indexer, web app, masu sa hannu na Safe
Abin da kowace iyaka da ke ƙasa ta bayyana kaɗai, bayan bincikenta
Duk wani abu daban
Kowane wuri inda bayanai, kadarori ko iko ke ƙetarewa daga yankin amincewa ɗaya zuwa wani, da abin da ake bincika a wurin ƙetarewa:
Iyaka
Abin da ke ƙetarewa
Abin da ake bincika

Lokacin da dogaro na waje ya gaza, Avana tana tsayar da sabon aiki kuma tana barin hanyoyin fita a buɗe: ana maye gurbin hanyar farashi da ke gazawa da ta jiran aikinta da aka bita, hanyar musanya da ke gazawa da hanyar madadin ta kasuwar, ƙarancin tushen flash da liquidation da mai kira ke ba da kuɗinta, da katsewar backend ko app na Avana ta hanyar kiran kwangiloli kai tsaye.
Idan aiwatarwar ɓangare mai haɓakawa tana da matsala ko ta mugunta ce, matakin mara canzawa da Aave suna iyakance isarta:
Sashi
Ba zai iya ba

Aro a kan kowane proxy na chain ɗinsa har zuwa kowace iyakar ɗauka, cire vault tokens da aka samar, mint a cikin iyakar ƙari na Hub, ƙona vault tokens, rajistar proxies, kashe allowances da aka ba shi, pledge na matsayi waɗanda masu su suka amince da LPVault
Aika matsayi ga kowa ba mai ajiyarsa na rikodi ba, karɓar vault tokens da aka ƙwace, canza proxy da ke akwai, ɗaga kowace iyakar Aave, kashe Avana Umbrella, aiki a wani chain
RiskModule
Amincewa da aro da ya kamata ya ƙi, ko toshe aro da pledges
Aro fiye da ma'aunin lafiya na 1 na Aave ko iyakokin ɗauka; taɓa hanyoyin fita
LPVaultSwap
Liquidation ga asusun da Aave ya ɗauka sun cancanci liquidation, a auna ta Aave
Sakin ruwan kuɗin da bai ƙona ba, saboda Collateralization tana bincika raguwar hannun jari da wadata; ɗaukar kowane kasafin Avana, saboda babu shi
MarketRegistry da ParameterStore
Ƙimanta ƙofofi ba daidai ba a cikin iyakoki, jera mugayen hanyoyi, dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, kunna breakers ko barin su a kunne
Motsa kuɗaɗe, ko toshe biya, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba ko karɓar kuɗaɗe, waɗanda ba sa karanta ko ɗaya daga cikin kwangilolin
DebtOracle
Ƙimanta bashi fiye da kima, wanda ke sa asusu su cancanci liquidation da wuri a cikin auna da ribar Aave, ko ƙimanta shi ƙasa da kima
Bar asusu su yi aro fiye da kowace iyakar ɗauka ko ƙofofin farashin bashi na RiskModule kansa
Gwaje-gwajen abubuwa na mugunta

Gwaje-gwajen binciken tsaro da ake buƙata suna shigar da aiwatarwar AaveAdapter, LPVaultSwap, RiskModule, MarketRegistry da ParameterStore, ko PositionProxy na mugunta ta ainihin hanyar AvanaTimelock a jinkiri na yau da kullum na kwanaki 5, kuma suna nuna cewa kowane tasiri yana zama a cikin bayyanannen iyakar tasirin wannan kwangila:
LPVault mara canzawa har yanzu yana mayar da NFT ga mai ajiyarsa na rikodi kaɗai.
Collateralization har yanzu tana ƙin ƙwacewa ba tare da daidaitaccen raguwa a hannun jarin samarwa na asusun da a wadatar vault-token ba.
Aro yana zama a cikin ma'aunin lafiya na Aave da iyakokin ɗauka.

Kowane chain yana da Lock ɗaya mara canzawa da kowace kwangilar Avana da ke motsa kadarori ko canza lissafi ke rabawa. Yana da mambobi biyu daidai, AaveAdapter da LPVaultSwap. Kowace hanyar shiga ta waje mai canza yanayi ta ɗayansu tana samun sa da farko, kuma duk wani yunƙurin fara hanyar shiga ta waje ta biyu a cikin bishiyar kira ɗaya yana komawa baya.

Kowace hanyar shiga ta Collateralization da kowane aikin LPVault mai motsa ƙima ana iya kaiwa gare su ne kawai a cikin bishiyar kira da ɗaya daga cikin mambobin biyu ya buɗe, kuma daga mai kiransu da ake tsammani kaɗai. Kwangilolin tsarewa suna bincika mai riƙewa kuma ba sa taɓa samun sa.
Ana karɓar callbacks na hanyar musanya da flash ne kawai daga tsayayyen pool na hanyar ko Aave V3 Pool na chain yayin da LPVaultSwap ke riƙe da Lock.
Vault tokens ba su da hooks na canja wuri, kuma sakin matsayi yana amfani da canja wuri ba tare da callback na mai karɓa ba.
Makulli na tarayya yana maye gurbin masu tsaro na kowace kwangila: mai tsaro ga kowace kwangila ba zai iya tsayar da kiran da ke sake shiga ta wata kwangilar Avana daban ba.
Lock ba dakatarwa ko jerin damar shiga ba ne. Ba ya taɓa toshe aikin yarjejeniya a farkon ma'amala, kuma kowace kwangila har yanzu tana bin checks-effects-interactions.

Biya, karɓar kuɗaɗe, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, sakewa mara credit, sasantawa mai jiran aiki da liquidation ba sa karanta yanayin dakatarwa, breaker ko daskarar da adireshi, kuma babu kwangilar Avana da ke da dakatarwa ta dukan kwangila. Fita yana buƙatar biya ɗaya ga kowane reserve na bashi, ko repay-all-and-withdraw ɗaya, da cirewa ɗaya ga kowane matsayi da ya rage, kowanne ma'amala guda.

Kowane canji da zai iya cutar da mai aro, kamar haɓakawar AaveAdapter, RiskModule ko LPVaultSwap, sabon tushen flash, sigar da aka sassauta, sabuwar hanyar musanya ko canjin matsayi, yana jira jinkiri na yau da kullum. Mafi ƙanƙantar kwanaki 4 yana rufe lokacin amsawar mai aro na kwanaki 3 tare da waɗannan 'yan ma'amaloli; a Base kuma yana rufe jinkirin tilasta shigarwa na awanni 12 ga mai aro da dole ya aika ma'amala daga L1 yayin da sequencer ya tsaya.

Misali: an tsara haɓakawar AaveAdapter a Ethereum a t = 1,800,000,000 kuma tana shirye a 1,800,432,000. Mai aro da ke da bashin GHO da USDC a kasuwa ɗaya da matsayi uku a can yana aika kiran repay-all-and-withdraw ɗaya da cirewa biyu cikin awa ta farko, tun kafin haɓakawar ta iya aiwatarwa.

Keɓancewa ɗaya kaɗai yana ɓangaren Aave: tsayarwar Hub ta CDP Spoke ko dakatarwar Aave ta reserve tana tsayar da biya da liquidation a kansa. AIP na turawa yana roƙon Aave DAO ya takaita Spoke da daskarewar reserve da iyakokin ɗauka sifili maimakon haka, waɗanda ke barin kowace hanyar fita a buɗe.
Kwangilolin Avana masu haɓakawa da marasa canzawa, iyakokin amincewa, iyakar tasirin haɓakawa ta mugunta da amincin fita.

meta.title: Ikon Gaggawa
meta.description: Yanayin dakatarwa na kowane Hub, daskarar da adireshi, circuit breakers, faɗakarwar sa ido, hanyoyin farashi na jiran aiki da littattafan matakan gaggawa, da abin da koyaushe ke zama a buɗe.

toc.title: Abin da Koyaushe ke Zama a Buɗe

strings: Ikon Gaggawa
Yanayin dakatarwa na kowane Hub, daskarar da adireshi, circuit breakers, faɗakarwar sa ido, hanyoyin farashi na jiran aiki da littattafan matakan gaggawa, da abin da koyaushe ke zama a buɗe.
Bayani
Abin da Koyaushe ke Zama a Buɗe
Yanayin Dakatarwa
Sauye-sauye da Cire Dakatarwa
Daskarar da Adireshi
Circuit Breakers
Faɗakarwa Kaɗai
Hanyoyin Jiran Aiki
Littattafan Matakai
Misali: Circuit Breaker
Misali: Dakatarwar Guardian
Gazawar oracle, tsufa, saɓani ko juya farashi
Ƙofar ORACLE tana tsayar da aro, cirewa tare da bashi da sabbin pledges a kasuwar; feed na bashi da ke gazawa yana tsayar da aron wannan bashi.

Guardian yana canja ramin da ke gazawa zuwa hanyar jiran aikinsa; idan ta jiran aikin ma ta gaza, ana kunna breaker na kasuwa yayin da keepers ke ci gaba da liquidation na reserves da ke da sabbin farashi.
Rushewar kasuwa ko rasa peg na stablecoin
Iyakar stablecoin da binciken oracle suna tsayar da sabon aro da cirewa tare da bashi; faɗuwar farashi da hauhawar ƙwacewa faɗakarwa kaɗai suke yi.

Dakatar da kowane Hub da abin ya shafa da dalilin General idan kasuwa fiye da ɗaya ta motsa, kuma a roƙi guardians na Aave su daskarar da reserves da abin ya shafa; keepers suna ci gaba da liquidation.
Zubewar ruwan kuɗin pool ko hanya
POOL_DEPTH, da POOL_SHARE inda aka saita iyakar pool, suna tsayar da sabbin pledges da aro; gazawar hanya faɗakarwa kaɗai take yi.

Tabbatar a kan fork ko hanyoyin da aka amince da su za su iya sasantawa a girman da ake buƙata; sai dai idan ba za su iya ba, a kunna breaker na kasuwa. Keepers suna amfani da hanyar madadin kuma ana kashe hanyar da ta mutu a gajeren jinkiri.
Cin zarafi da ke gudana
Kowane breaker na yanayi da ya cika.

Cikin mintuna, dakatarwa da MintPathSuspect idan ana zargin mint, Adapter ko Collateralization, in ba haka ba General; daskarar da adireshin maharin; soke ayyukan da maharin ke amfana da su. Gyaran haɓakawa ce a jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Aikin gudanarwa na mugunta ko na kuskure
Babu; jinkirin timelock ne kariyar.
Bita calldata cikin awa 1 kuma a soke; dakatarwa da General idan ya taɓa matsayi ko haɓakawa.
Mai sa hannu ko maɓalli da aka tona
Canje-canjen mai shi da threshold na Safe na gudanarwa suna jira awanni 48.
Soke kowane aiki da ba a zata ba; mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave yana tsara janye matsayin da aka tona; ana daskarar da keeper da aka tona nan take ko a cire shi a gajeren jinkiri.
Katsewar keeper ko keeper mai ɗabi'a mara kyau
Idan babu keeper mai aiki, sabon aro a chain yana tsayawa.

Keeper na jiran aiki yana karɓar aiki kuma hanyar mara izini tana zama a buɗe; daskarar da keeper mai ɗabi'a mara kyau; kunna breaker na kasuwa a kan kowace kasuwa da aka bar ba tare da liquidation ba fiye da daƙiƙa 3,600.
Mummunan bashi
Breaker na DEFICIT yana daskarar da aron reserve da ke da sama da GHO 10,000 da ba a biya ba.
Mai kiran rufewa yana rufe gibin daga Avana Umbrella na kadarar; idan reserve ɗin bai isa ba, a kunna breaker na bashi kuma Avana Labs ta ba da kuɗinsa.
Matsin ruwan kuɗin Hub ko jerin cirewa
Babu a ɓangaren Avana; Aave yana ƙin aro fiye da ruwan kuɗin da ke akwai.
Dakatarwa da General idan dole sabon aro ya tsaya; a ci gaba da gudanar da liquidations; a cire dakatarwa da zarar amfani ya faɗi ƙasa da 90%.
Aikin mai fitar da token
Breaker na ISSUER a kan kowace kasuwa da ke riƙe da token ɗin da kowane reserve na bashi na kadarar.
Dakatarwa da General idan token ɗin yana cikin kasuwanni da yawa; a roƙi guardians na Aave su daskarar da reserves da abin ya shafa; biyan da aka ƙi suna zuwa escrow na biya.
Lamari a ɓangaren Aave
Binciken CONFIG_DRIFT yana tsayar da sabon aiki.
Bi tsarin lamari na Aave; kada a cire dakatarwa har sai Spoke ya yi daidai da manifest na turawa.
Tona frontend ko kayayyakin more rayuwa
Babu; kwangiloli ba su shafu ba.
Cire app daga intanet, gargaɗi masu amfani, juya maɓallai kuma a tabbatar da bundle; masu amfani suna fita ta ingantaccen gini da aka sani ko block explorer.
Drift na saitin Spoke
Breaker na CONFIG_DRIFT na kasuwar yana tsayar da pledges na sabon asusu, aro da cirewa tare da bashi; ƙwacewa tana zama ta LPVaultSwap kaɗai.

Roƙi Aave Protocol Guardian ya daskarar da reserve na vault-token kuma ya saita iyakokin ɗauka na Spoke zuwa 0; kunna breaker da hannu idan babu karatu da ya kunna shi tukuna; Aave DAO yana dawo da saitin.
Tushen flash da ya yi ƙaranci ko aka dakatar
Babu; kowace liquidation tana komawa baya kafin kowane canjin yanayi idan tushen ba zai iya ba da rance ba.
Keepers suna canjawa zuwa kuɗaɗensu; gazawa mai ɗorewa ana amsa ta da tushen flash na maye gurbi da aka bita a jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Tsayarwar Aave ta CDP Spoke
Ana ƙin kowane sabon aiki a kan Spoke; biya, cirewa da liquidation suna tsayawa a ɓangaren Aave.
Roƙi guardians na Aave su maye gurbin tsayarwar da daskarewar reserve da iyakokin ɗauka sifili; dakatar da Hub da General; keepers suna shirya liquidations don block na farko bayan ɗagawa.
Katsewar sequencer (Base)

Yayin da sequencer ya tsaya, aro da liquidation suna tsayawa; biya da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna gudana ta ma'amaloli da aka tilasta daga L1. Na awa 1 bayan sake farawa, asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya 0.95 kaɗai za a iya liquidation.
Babu a kan chain; keepers suna poke kowane oracle a block na farko bayan sake farawa kuma suna share tarin ayyukan bisa tsarin ma'aunin lafiya.
Gibi da ba a rufe ba
Breaker na DEFICIT yana tsayar da aron kadarar a kan Spoke da abin ya shafa.

Roƙi Aave DAO ya saita iyakar ɗauka na kowane Spoke mai ɗauka zuwa 0; wallafa adadin da ba a rufe ba da farashin hannun jari da aka daidaita; DAO yana tabbatar da asarar a kan masu samar da wannan kadara.
Kwaron LPVault ko ledger da sake jera kasuwa
Babu fiye da P-05.

Dakatar da kowane Hub na chain (MintPathSuspect idan ana zargin mint ko tsarewa); guardians na Aave suna daskarar da reserves da abin ya shafa; offboarding na kasuwannin da abin ya shafa da sake jera su a kan gyararrun kwangiloli.
An kunna kuɗin canja wuri na kadarar bashi
Breaker na ISSUER a kan kowane reserve na wannan kadara da kowace kasuwa da ke riƙe da ita; liquidation tana ci gaba.
Tabbatar cewa breakers suna nuna ISSUER kuma a kunna kowane reserve da binciken sa bai ba da rahoto ba; kuɗin canja wuri yana faɗa a kan biyan keeper.
Mai karɓar kuɗi yana cikin jerin toshewa
Babu liquidation da ke komawa baya; kuɗin Avana yana zuwa escrow na biya.
Tsara sabon mai karɓar kuɗi a jinkiri na yau da kullum; baitulmali yana buƙatar kuɗin da ke cikin escrow zuwa adireshin da ya ambata.
Yanayin dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, circuit breakers, faɗakarwa, hanyoyin jiran aiki da littattafan matakai da ke amfani da su.

Avana tana da hanyoyin tsayarwa huɗu, duka MarketRegistry na kowane chain ke riƙe da su: yanayin dakatarwa ga kowane Hub tare da dalili, daskarar da adireshi a dukan chain, circuit breakers ga kowace kasuwa da kowane reserve na bashi, da matsayin offboarding na kasuwa. Babu dakatarwa ta dukan kwangila, babu dakatarwa ga kowane aiki ko kowane keeper, kuma babu agogon lamari. Kowace hanyar tsayarwa tana toshe sabon aiki kaɗai.

Emergency Guardian (3-of-5 ga kowane chain) da Aave Protocol Guardian suna aiki nan take. Safe na gudanarwa yana kaiwa ga hanyoyin tsayarwa iri ɗaya ta AvanaTimelock a gajeren jinkiri, don haka har yanzu ana iya tsayar da sabon aiki cikin awanni 12 idan guardians biyu ba sa samuwa. Ɗage tsayarwa ta timelock yana jira jinkiri na yau da kullum.
An bayyana matsayi da jinkiri a wannan shafi:
Gudanarwa da Timelock
Babu dakatarwa, daskarewa, breaker, drift na saiti ko offboarding da zai iya tsayar da waɗannan ayyuka:
Biya ta kowa, ga kowane asusu, har da biyan komai da cirewa a kira ɗaya
Cirewa ba tare da bashi ba da cire wani ɓangare na ruwan kuɗi, da sakin matsayi mara credit
Liquidation na asusun da suka cancanta, ta hanyar shigar keeper da ta mara izini
Sasantawa mai jiran aiki da buƙatu daga escrow na biya
Ƙarin jingina na ceto: asusu mai bashi yana ƙara jingina a cikin adadin dawo da shi, sai dai ƙarƙashin Paused(MintPathSuspect)

Tsayar da liquidation zai bar asusu marasa lafiya su rasa ƙarin ƙima ba tare da wanda zai iya rufe su ba, wanda ke mayar da lamarin lamba zuwa mummunan bashi. Liquidation har yanzu tana buƙatar sabon farashi ga kasuwar da ake ƙwacewa da bashin da ake biya, cancantar Aave da hanyar musanya mai aiwatarwa. A Base kuma tana jiran binciken sequencer. Ayyukan ɓangaren Aave kaɗai, tsayarwar Hub ta CDP Spoke ko dakatarwar Aave ta reserve, za su iya toshe biya ko liquidation, kuma AIP na turawa yana roƙon Aave DAO ya yi amfani da su don cin zarafi kaɗai kuma ya ɗage su cikin awanni 48.

Kowane Hub yana da yanayi ɗaya: None, Frozen ko Paused, kuma Hub mai Paused yana ɗauke da dalili, General ko MintPathSuspect. Yanayin yana aiki ga kowace kasuwa da CDP Spoke da Hub ɗin ke zama Hub na gida gare su da kowane reserve na bashi da Hub ɗin ke ba da kuɗinsa. Aro yana karanta Hub na gida da Hub mai ba da kuɗin reserve na bashi kuma yana amfani da yanayi mafi tsauri.
Aiki
None
Frozen
Paused (General)
Paused (MintPathSuspect)
Sabon pledge ta asusun da ba shi da bashi
Ƙarin jingina ko sake sawa a asusu na asusu mai bashi
Ƙarin jingina na ceto kaɗai
Aro
Cirewa ko cire ruwan kuɗi tare da bashi; biya da jingina
Eh, tare da kowane binciken haɗari
Biya, biyan duka da cirewa
Karɓar kuɗaɗe
Cirewa da cire ruwan kuɗi ba tare da bashi ba, sakewa mara credit
Liquidation (keeper da mara izini)
Sasantawa mai jiran aiki
Kiran da aka toshe suna komawa baya da
ApplicationFrozen
ApplicationPaused
; ƙarƙashin Paused(General) ƙarin jingina da ba na ceto ba yana komawa baya da
NotRescueTopUp
Frozen yana tsayar da sabon fallasa daga sabbin asusu da sabon bashi yayin da duk abin da ke rage haɗari ke ci gaba da aiki.

Paused(General) kuma yana tsayar da cirewa tare da bashi da kowane pledge da ke ƙara fallasa. Ƙarin jingina na ceto yana zama a buɗe, saboda ƙara jingina ita ce hanya mafi arha ta fita daga liquidation. Ƙarin jingina na ceto yana dawo da asusu mai bashi da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na ceto na 1.10 zuwa gare shi, a cikin yankin ƙarin jingina na kasuwar.

Ana amfani da Paused(MintPathSuspect) idan ana zargin lambar mint, AaveAdapter ko Collateralization. Kuma yana ƙin kowane ƙarin jingina da sake sawa a asusu, har da na ceto, don haka babu vault token da ake mint.
Kira
Sauyi

None zuwa Frozen
Freeze guardian nan take; timelock a awanni 12
pause(hub, reason)
None ko Frozen zuwa Paused(reason), ko canjin dalili yayin Paused
Pause guardian nan take; timelock a awanni 12
unfreeze(hub)
Frozen zuwa None
Pause guardian nan take; timelock a kwanaki 5

Paused zuwa None
freezeAll()
Yana daskarar da kowane Hub na chain da ke cikin None
pauseAll(reason)
Yana dakatar da kowane Hub na chain da ba a riga an dakatar da shi da wannan dalili ba

Kira a kan Hub ɗaya ba ya taɓa canza wani Hub, kuma babu abin da ke kan chain ɗaya da ke canza ɗayan. Yi amfani da freezeAll ko pauseAll idan dalilin yana cikin lambar da kowane Hub na chain ke rabawa.

Cire daskarewa yayin Paused yana komawa baya da CannotUnfreezeWhilePaused, don haka ɗagawa mai rauni ba za ta iya tsallake yanayi mafi ƙarfi a ɓoye ba. Kira na dukan chain da bai canza kowane Hub ba yana komawa baya da NothingToChange.
Maɓallin da ke riƙe da matsayin daskarewa kaɗai ba zai taɓa iya warware daskarewa, daskarar da adireshi ko kunna breaker ba.

Yanayin dakatarwa ba shi da ƙarewa a kan chain. Guardian da ke barin Hub a dakatar sabanin gudanarwa yana tsayar da sabon aiki kaɗai, kuma ana iya janye matsayinsa ta aikin canjin matsayi wanda mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya soke shi. Ɗayan guardian zai iya cire dakatarwa nan take a halin yanzu.
Kowane canji yana fitar da
, kuma kowane sabon dalili yana fitar da

, don haka adireshin mai cin zarafi yana rasa sabon aiki cikin mintuna ba tare da dakatar da kowane mai amfani ba. Timelock zai iya yin haka a gajeren jinkiri.
Pledge ko sake sawa a asusu, sai dai a matsayin ƙarin jingina na ceto

Cirewa ko cire ruwan kuɗi tare da bashi, ko biya da jingina
Ƙirƙirar sabon Position Proxy

Kiran kowace hanyar shigar liquidation a matsayin mai kira
