Kowane mai kira zai iya daskarar da a mafi yawa
MAX_ADDRESS_FREEZES_PER_DAY

= adireshi 20 a kowane awanni 24 masu juyawa, ana ƙidaya su a cikin bokitin awa ɗaya, don haka guardian da aka tona ba zai iya daskarar da masu amfani da yawa a lokaci ɗaya ba kuma ɗayan guardian yana riƙe da cikakken izininsa.

Ba za a iya daskarar da adireshi masu kariya ba: timelock, mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave, kowace kwangilar Avana, vault token, LPOracle da DebtOracle, kowane Hub, Spoke da aka amince da shi da Avana Umbrella, kowace kadarar bashi, tushen flash da Aave V3 Pool, kowace hanyar musanya da aka rubuta da kowane proxy mai rajista.

Guardian zai iya daskarar da kowane keeper, har da na ƙarshe mai aiki. Yayin da babu keeper mai aiki da ya rage, sabon aro yana tsayawa a kowane Hub na chain kuma liquidation tana zama a buɗe ta hanyar shiga mara izini.

Cire daskarewar adireshi yana buƙatar aikin timelock a jinkiri na yau da kullum wanda mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya soke shi, don haka guardian da ya daskarar da shi ba zai iya barin sa a daskare ta hanyar soke kowane cire daskarewa ba. Daskarewa ba ta da ƙarewa a kan chain.

Breakers suna aiki ga kowace kasuwa da kowane (CDP Spoke, reserve na bashi). RiskModule yana tantance su kai tsaye a sabbin pledges, aro da cirewa tare da bashi, don haka yanayi yana toshewa ko da babu wanda ya rubuta shi. Keeper na Avana yana kiran aikin mara izini
pokeBreakers
a kowane block don rubuta keta a cikin MarketRegistry. LPVaultSwap ba ya taɓa karantawa ko rubuta yanayin breaker, don haka babu breaker da zai iya rage gudun liquidation ko mayar da ita baya.
Ƙofofin wucin gadi
gateRecoverySeconds
(daƙiƙa 1,800, saitin ƙaddamarwa na wucin gadi a cikin 600 zuwa 7,200) sun wuce tun keta ta ƙarshe da aka rubuta.
Ƙofa
Sharaɗi
Tana toshewa
ORACLE
Farashin jingina ba Live ba ne, stablecoin ya fita daga iyakar $0.90–$1.02, ko farashin bashi ya tsufa, ya bambanta da tushe ko yana saɓani
Sabon aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi
POOL_SHARE
Kason Avana haɗe na pool, a duk masu aro, kewayo da Spokes a chain, ya wuce iyakar pool. A kashe ta tsohuwa; tana aiki ne kawai inda jera kasuwar pool ya saita iyaka
Sabon aro da pledges da ke ƙara fallasa ga pool
POOL_DEPTH
Ruwan kuɗin pool a cikin kewayo a tagar TWAP ya faɗi ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantar zurfi na jera kasuwa
Sabbin pledges da aro a kasuwar
Daskarewar tsaro da ke kulle

Daskarewar tsaro tana zama a kunne har sai an yi sake saiti mai izini, saboda dole mutum ya tabbatar da dawowa. Breaker na kasuwa yana toshe pledges na sabon asusu, ƙarin jingina da ba na ceto ba, aro da cirewa tare da bashi a wannan kasuwa. Breaker na bashi yana toshe aron wannan reserve da cirewa tare da bashi ta asusun da ke binsa bashi.
Dalili
Yana kunna idan
DEFICIT
Gibin da ba a biya ba na reserve na bashi na CDP Spoke ya wuce breakerDeficitMax: GHO 10,000 ga reserve na GHO, matakin muhimmanci da aka saita a jera kasuwa ga sauran kadarori
ISSUER

Token na pool ko kadarar bashi tana ba da rahoton cewa an dakatar da ita ko ta kunna kuɗin canja wuri, ana karantawa ta binciken mai fitarwa da aka rubuta a jera kasuwa; binciken da ke komawa baya ana ƙidaya shi a matsayin wanda ya kunna
CONFIG_DRIFT
Saitin Aave na CDP Spoke na kasuwar ya bambanta da abin da aka jera, har da saitunan reserve uku da ake buƙata
MANUAL
Guardian ko timelock yana kunna breaker da tripMarketBreaker ko tripDebtBreaker
Kunnawa da hannu: freeze guardian nan take, ko timelock a gajeren jinkiri.
Sake saiti da
resetMarketBreaker
resetDebtBreaker
: pause guardian nan take, ko timelock a jinkiri na yau da kullum.
ConditionStillHolds
Lens yana nuna dalilan kowane breaker kuma, ga ƙofar wucin gadi da ke dawowa, lokacin da za ta sake buɗewa.

Waɗannan yanayi suna kiran ma'aikacin on-call amma ba sa kunna komai a kan chain. Liquidation da ta koma baya ba za ta iya adana ƙidayar gazawa ba, kuma mai kira zai iya ciyar da ƙidaya ta kan chain don ya kunna ta, don haka sa ido yana lissafa su daga events da simulations.
Faɗakarwa
Ƙofa
Martani
Faɗuwar farashi
Guardians suna yanke shawarar ko za su kunna breaker na kasuwa
Jinginar da aka ƙwace
Fiye da 20% na raka'o'in kasuwa da aka sa a asusu cikin awa 1
Ana ɗaukar shi a matsayin alamar cin zarafin farashi ko gazawar pool
Gazawar hanyar musanya
Kason Avana na pool
Sama da 25% a duk masu aro da Spokes a chain
Bitar jera kasuwa na iyakokin pool
Gibi da ma'aunin Umbrella
Kowane sabon gibi; Avana Umbrella da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantarsa
Rufewa cikin awanni 72; Avana Labs tana ƙara wa reserve kuɗi

Kowane token da aka jera yana rubuta hanyar farashi ta jiran aiki kusa da babbar hanyarsa da madadin hanyoyin Chainlink, ana bincika ta a jera kasuwa kamar ramin da za ta iya maye gurbinsa. Pause guardian yana kiran
useStandbyRoute(token, slot)
don sa ta cikin aiki nan take. Mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave zai iya warware wannan canji nan take da
cancelStandbySwitch
, kuma hanyoyin da aka jera suna dawowa ta aikin jinkiri na yau da kullum.

Canji ba ya taɓa tilasta farashi ya zama Live kuma ba ya taɓa kauce wa sabunta, inganci ko binciken yarjejeniya, don haka guardian zai iya zaɓa ne kawai daga hanyoyin da jera kasuwa ya bita. Kowane token da ke da tushe na biyu kuma yana da tushe na biyu na jiran aiki, wanda guardian zai iya canjawa zuwa gare shi nan take; komawa baya yana buƙatar timelock a jinkiri na yau da kullum.

Hanyar musanya da ta gaza ana kashe ta a gajeren jinkiri kuma ana dawo da ita zuwa adireshinta da aka amince da shi a baya a gajeren jinkiri, aikin da mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya soke shi. Babu toshe hanya nan take.

Kowane lamari yana bin tantancewa iri ɗaya: faɗakarwa ta tashi, injiniyan on-call yana tabbatar da ita a kan chain cikin mintuna 15, yana rarraba ta a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin littattafan matakai da ke ƙasa, yana kiran Safes biyu kuma yana buɗe rajistar lamari. Idan bai dace da littafin matakai ba tukuna kuma sabon aiki yana cikin haɗari, guardian yana fara dakatar da Hub da abin ya shafa da dalilin General (P-01), ko MintPathSuspect idan mint na iya shafuwa. Sanarwar matsayi ta jama'a tana fita cikin awa 1 na tabbatarwa da nazarin bayan lamari cikin kwanaki 7.

Kowane littafin matakai yana gudana a chain na lamarin. A Base, matakan ɓangaren Aave suna bi ta mai aiwatarwa na Base kuma za su iya jinkiri a bayan Ethereum, don haka littattafan matakai na Base suna aika buƙatar Aave a lokacin ganowa.
Littafin matakai
Amsa ta atomatik
Mataki nan take
Ana maimaita ikon guardian a kan fork tare da ainihin Safes na kowane chain kafin ƙaddamarwa da kowane kwata.
Ƙimomin misali; ana saita sigogin kowace kasuwa a jera kasuwa. Pool na kasuwa 1 yana da iyakar kowane pool ta misali ta 1,000 bps.
Mataki
Abin da ke faruwa

Keeper na Avana yana poke breakers a kowane block. A t = 1,000 kason Avana na pool na kasuwa 1 a duk Spokes 1,040 bps ne, sama da iyakar 1,000 bps; MarketRegistry yana rubuta ketar kuma yana fitar da GateBreached.

Aro a kasuwa 1 yana komawa baya da BreakerTripped(1, POOL_SHARE). Pledge da ke ɗaga fallasa ga pool yana wucewa ne kawai a matsayin ƙarin jingina na ceto. Mai aro har yanzu zai iya biya, kuma LPVaultSwap ba ya taɓa karanta breakers.
Kason ya koma ƙasa da iyakar. Tare da gateRecoverySeconds = 1,800 ƙofar tana sake buɗewa a t = 2,800; Lens yana nuna ta a matsayin mai dawowa har zuwa lokacin.

Aave yana rubuta gibin GHO 10,000 a kan reserve na GHO na CDP Spoke, daidai da breakerDeficitMax. Poke na gaba yana kulle DEFICIT (BreakerLatched) kuma aron GHO yana komawa baya da DebtBreakerTripped. Lens yana nuna adadin da ba a rufe ba.
Bayan an rufe gibin, Emergency Guardian yana kiran resetDebtBreaker ga reserve na GHO na Spoke (BreakerReset). Yayin da gibin ya kasance, kiran ɗaya ya koma baya da ConditionStillHolds.

Faɗakarwa kaɗai, ba tare da kunnawa a kan chain ba: faɗuwar farashi ta 3% cikin awanni 2, fiye da 20% na kasuwa da aka ƙwace cikin awa 1, gazawar hanyar musanya 3 cikin awa 1. Da zarar an tabbatar cewa hanyoyi ba za su iya sasantawa a girman da ake buƙata ba, guardian yana kiran tripMarketBreaker.
App yana karanta yanayin application da dalilin dakatarwa daga Lens: Paused, MintPathSuspect.
Pledge, sake sawa a asusu, aro da biya da jingina a kan AaveAdapter suna komawa baya da ApplicationPaused.
Har yanzu a buɗe: biya ta kowa, karɓar kuɗaɗe, biyan duka da cirewa, da liquidation ta LPVaultSwap.
Da zarar an share hanyar mint, guardian yana canza dalilin zuwa General: ƙarin jingina na ceto suna sake buɗewa, yayin da aro da biya da jingina ke zama a toshe har sai an cire dakatarwar Hub.

Dawowa: pause guardian yana cire dakatarwar Hub, ko AvanaTimelock yana yi a jinkiri na yau da kullum. Lamari mai sauƙi yana amfani da daskarewar Hub, wanda ke tsayar da pledges na sabon asusu da aro, da daskarar da adireshi ga wallet guda.
Yanayin dakatarwa na kowane Hub, daskarar da adireshi, circuit breakers, faɗakarwa, hanyoyin jiran aiki da littattafan matakan gaggawa.

meta.title: Gudanarwa da Timelock
meta.description: Wanda zai iya canza Avana a kowane chain, tsawon lokacin da kowane canji ke jira a cikin AvanaTimelock, wanda zai iya soke shi, da yadda Aave DAO ke amincewa da kasuwanni da layukan bashi.

strings: Gudanarwa da Timelock
Wanda zai iya canza Avana a kowane chain, tsawon lokacin da kowane canji ke jira a cikin AvanaTimelock, wanda zai iya soke shi, da yadda Aave DAO ke amincewa da kasuwanni da layukan bashi.
Bayani
Masu Iko
AvanaTimelock
Ƙa'idojin Sokewa
Guardians
Teburin Matsayi
Ajujuwan Jinkiri
Canje-canjen Sigogi
Jerin Keepers
Tsarin Aave DAO
Tsaron Maɓallan Multisig
Miƙa Aiki da Madadin
Wanda zai iya canza Avana a kowane chain, tsawon lokacin da kowane canji ke jira, wanda zai iya soke shi, da yadda Aave DAO ke amincewa da kasuwanni da layukan bashi.

Gudanarwa tana kowane chain daban. Ethereum da Base kowannensu yana da AvanaTimelock nasa, Safe na gudanarwa na 4-of-7 da Emergency Guardian Safe na 3-of-5, tare da Aave Protocol Guardian da mai aiwatarwa na Aave DAO a wannan chain. Babu matsayin Avana, Safe ko aiki a chain ɗaya da zai iya aiki a ɗayan, kuma babu kwangilar Avana da ke karɓar saƙo tsakanin chains. Canjin da dole ya yi aiki a chains biyu ana tsara shi daban a kowanne, tare da jinkirinsa da masu sokewarsa.

Aave DAO ne ke mallaka da saita kowane Avana Hub da Spoke: iyakoki, layukan bashi, collateral factors, saitunan liquidation, daskarewa da dakatar da reserve, da tsayarwar Hub. Kowane canji ga kwangilolin Avana kanta aiki ne a kan AvanaTimelock na chain, wanda Avana Labs ba za ta iya kauce masa ba. A Base Aave DAO yana aiki ta mai aiwatarwarsa na Base ta gudanarwar tsakanin chains ta Aave, don haka matakan ɓangaren Aave a Base za su iya ɗaukar lokaci fiye da a Ethereum.

Kowane canji yana jira a fili kafin ya aiwatar: kwanaki 5 ga duk abin da ke ƙara haɗari ko sabon saiti, awanni 12 ga kiran da ke rage haɗari ko tsayar da sabon aiki kaɗai. Dakatarwa, daskarewa da breakers suna tsayar da sabon aiki kaɗai. Biya, karɓar kuɗaɗe, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba da liquidation suna zama a buɗe a kowane yanayin gudanarwa.
Iko
Yana sarrafa
Jinkiri
Aave DAO (mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwa)

Avana Stable LP Hub na kowane chain da CDP, Lend da Coverage Spokes ɗinsa: turawa da haɓakawar Spoke, saitunan reserve uku da ake buƙata, collateral factors, iyakoki, tutocin reserve, lanƙwasar riba, maƙasudin ma'aunin lafiya, haɗarin jingina, ƙimar kadarar bashi, layukan bashi da iyakokin ɗauka, rabon rufewa da mafi ƙanƙantar kowane Avana Umbrella, da matsayin flash-borrower. A kan AvanaTimelock shi ne mai gabatarwa na biyu, mai sokewa, kuma asusu ɗaya tilo da zai iya soke canjin matsayi ko aikin dawo da saiti. Zai iya warware canjin hanyar farashi ta jiran aiki na guardian nan take.
Gudanarwar Aave
Safe na gudanarwa (4-of-7 ga kowane chain)

Yana gabatarwa, sokewa da aiwatarwa a kan AvanaTimelock na chain ɗinsa: haɓakawa, ayyukan turawa da kunna kasuwa, tushen farashi, hanyoyi, sigogi, keepers da canje-canjen matsayi. Ba ya riƙe da wani matsayi a kowace kwangilar Avana daban kuma ba shi da ikon nan take. Safe guard yana iyakance shi ga kira zuwa AvanaTimelock da kansa.
AvanaTimelock (ɗaya ga kowane chain)

Yana riƙe da matsayin admin a kowace kwangilar Avana mai haɓakawa kuma shi ne tsayayyen adireshin timelock na kowace mara canzawa. Yana gudanar da kowane aiki da ke shirye na kwanaki 14 bayan ya zama shirye.
Kamar yadda aka tsara
Emergency Guardian (3-of-5 ga kowane chain)

Yana daskarewa da dakatar da Hubs, daskarar da adireshi, kunna da sake saita circuit breakers, canja token zuwa hanyar farashinsa ta jiran aiki da aka bita ko tushe na biyu na jiran aiki, kuma yana soke ayyukan da ke cikin layi.
Nan take
Aave Protocol Guardian
Matsayin guardian na Avana iri ɗaya da na Emergency Guardian. A ɓangaren Aave, daskarewa da dakatar da reserves ta hanya ɗaya, don haka ana iya tsayar da kasuwannin Avana ba tare da Avana Labs ba.
Masu ba da sabis na haɗari (Aave V4)

Suna saita ma'aunin haɗarin pool, iyakokin USD, mafi ƙanƙantar pledge da kowace iyakar kason pool a cikin kowane kunshin jera kasuwa, kowanne tare da lissafin auna iyakarsa, kuma tare da Aave DAO layukan bashi, iyakokin ɗauka da rabon rufewa da mafi ƙanƙantar kowane Umbrella. Ba sa riƙe da wani matsayin Avana a kan chain kuma suna gabatar da canje-canje ta Safe na gudanarwa.
Ta Safe na gudanarwa

Avana Labs tana gabatar da kasuwanni da canje-canjen sigogi don tantancewa ta mai bitar haɗari da aka naɗa. Saitin masu sa hannu na Safe na gudanarwa, Emergency Guardian da Aave Protocol Guardian ba sa haɗuwa bibbiyu, don haka babu rukunin masu sa hannu guda da ke gabatar da canji kuma yana sarrafa amsar guardian a kansa.

AvanaTimelock ƙari ne mara haɓakawa na TimelockController na OpenZeppelin. Yana riƙe da matsayin admin nasa kuma ba shi da wani admin, don haka masu gabatarwarsa, masu sokewa, jinkiri da saitunansa suna canzawa ne kawai ta ayyukan da ke jiran jinkirinsa. A kowace kwangilar Avana mai haɓakawa yana riƙe da matsayin admin biyu, kuma ba da ɗayan matsayin ga kowane asusu daban yana komawa baya. Kwangiloli marasa canzawa da ke da aiki mai gata suna karɓar wannan kiran ne kawai daga adireshin timelock da aka tsayar a cikin bytecode ɗinsu. Mai turawa ba ya riƙe da wani matsayi da zarar turawa ta ƙare.
Saita
Ƙima
Ƙa'ida
normalDelay
432,000 s (kwanaki 5)
Koyaushe tsakanin kwanaki 4 da 5. Ana canza shi ne kawai ta aikin jinkiri na yau da kullum a kan timelock kansa.
MIN_NORMAL_DELAY
345,600 s (kwanaki 4)
Mafi ƙanƙanta mara canzawa na jinkiri na yau da kullum.
MAX_DELAY
Rufi mara canzawa na jinkiri na yau da kullum.
SHORT_DELAY
43,200 s (awanni 12)
Yana aiki ne kawai idan kowane kira a cikin aikin yana cikin jerin gajeren jinkiri.
SHORT_ELIGIBLE
Tsayayyen saiti
Kiran da jerin gajeren jinkiri zai iya riƙewa kaɗai, an tsayar da su a lokacin gini. Kowanne yana rage haɗari, tsayar da sabon aiki ko dawo da saitin da aka riga aka bita a jinkiri na yau da kullum.
GRACE_PERIOD
Ana iya aiwatar da aikin da ke shirye na kwanaki 14, sannan ya ƙare kuma za a iya share shi kawai.
publicExecution
true
Kowa zai iya aiwatar da aikin da ke shirye, don haka mai gabatarwa ba zai iya riƙe canjin da aka amince da shi don zaɓar lokacinsa ba.
Jinkirin da ake buƙata

Ana karanta jinkirin aiki daga calldata ɗinsa, ba mai gabatarwa ke zaɓa ba. Idan kowane kira yana cikin jerin gajeren jinkiri aikin yana buƙatar awanni 12; kira ɗaya a wajensa yana sa dukan batch ya jira jinkiri na yau da kullum. Tsarawa da gajeren jinkiri yana komawa baya da wannan kuskure:
DelayBelowRequired(delay, required)
Misali, batch da ke tsaurara iyakar kasuwa kawai kuma yana kashe hanyar musanya yana buƙatar 43,200 s. Ƙara kiran sassautawa ɗaya ga batch ɗin yana ɗaga jinkirin da ake buƙata zuwa 432,000 s.
Misalin jadawalin lokaci

Haɓakawa da aka tsara a t = 1,780,000,000 tare da jinkiri na yau da kullum tana shirye a 1,780,432,000. Kowa zai iya aiwatar da ita daga lokacin har zuwa 1,781,641,599. Daga 1,781,641,600 ta ƙare kuma aiwatarwa tana komawa baya. A cikin waɗannan kwanaki 5 sa ido yana faɗakarwa a kan kiran da aka tsara, kowane mai sokewa zai iya soke shi, kuma mai aro zai iya fita da biya ɗaya da cirewa ɗaya ga kowane matsayi.

Gajarta jinkiri na yau da kullum shi kansa aikin jinkiri na yau da kullum ne, kuma sabuwar ƙimar tana aiki ne kawai ga ayyukan da aka tsara bayan ta aiwatar. Don haka ragewa daga kwanaki 5 zuwa 4 ba ta taimaka wa kowane aiki har sai kwanaki 9 bayan an wallafa ragewar.

Asusu huɗu suna riƙe da matsayin mai sokewa a kowane chain: Safe na gudanarwa, Emergency Guardian, Aave Protocol Guardian da mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave. Kowannensu zai iya soke aikin da ke cikin layi yayin jinkirinsa, tare da keɓancewa biyu da mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya soke su:
Aikin canjin matsayi: kowane kira ba da matsayi ne, janyewa ko watsi a kan kwangilar Avana ko timelock.

Aikin dawo da saiti: kowane kira yana mayar da saitin da aka riga aka bita, wato dawo da hanyar musanya da aka amince da ita a baya, canjawa zuwa hanyar farashi ta jiran aiki da aka jera, ƙara keeper ko cire daskarewar adireshi.

Wannan yana hana guardian ko Safe na gudanarwa toshe cire shi kansa, naɗin wanda zai maye gurbinsa, ko gyaran da ke dawo da liquidation ko adireshi. Alamar tana buƙatar kowane kira a cikin batch ya cancanta: batch da ke haɗa haɓakawa da kiran matsayi yana zama mai sokewa ga kowane mai sokewa, don haka mai gabatarwa ba zai iya kare kira mai cutarwa ta hanyar ƙara masa kiran matsayi ba.

Misali: batch da ke janye matsayin dakatarwa na Emergency Guardian kuma yana cire dakatarwar Hub ba canjin matsayi ba ne, don haka Emergency Guardian zai iya soke shi. Sannan gudanarwa tana tsara janyewar ita kaɗai. Soke wannan aiki da Emergency Guardian ya yi yana komawa baya, kuma mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya tsayar da shi. Don haka cire guardian yana ɗaukar jinkiri na yau da kullum ɗaya a mafi yawa.

Guardians biyu, Emergency Guardian (3-of-5 ga kowane chain) da Aave Protocol Guardian, suna riƙe da matsayin Avana biyu iri ɗaya a kan MarketRegistry na chain da matsayin mai sokewa a kan timelock. Ikonsu nan take ne kuma ko dai yana tsayar da sabon aiki ko yana sa hanyar da aka bita a jera kasuwa cikin aiki.

Daskarewa da dakatar da reserve na ɓangaren Aave da Aave Protocol Guardian ke yi ba matsayin Avana ba ne kuma suna ɗorewa har sai Aave DAO ya juya su. AIP na turawa yana roƙon DAO ya dakatar da reserves na Avana don cin zarafi kaɗai kuma ya cire dakatarwa cikin tagar lamari ta awanni 48 da aka auna iyakoki don ita.

Avana ba ta riƙe da wani matsayi a kan kowace kwangilar Aave. Waɗannan matsayin Aave suna iyakance abin da ke faruwa ga reserves na Avana:

Sabon tushen farashi ko hanyar jiran aiki, dawo da hanyoyin farashi da aka jera bayan canjin jiran aiki, sabuwar hanyar musanya ko wadda aka canza, tushen flash, layukan tsakanin Hubs, kason kuɗi ko mai karɓar kuɗi

Tsaurara siga, kashe hanyar musanya, dawo da hanyar da aka amince da ita a baya, cire keeper har zuwa mafi ƙanƙantar keeper na 1
Daskarewa, dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, kunna breaker ko canjin jiran aiki ta timelock, don Safe na gudanarwa ya iya tsayar da sabon aiki idan guardians biyu ba sa samuwa

Daskarewa ta guardian, dakatarwa, cire daskarewa, cire dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, kunna da sake saita breaker, canje-canjen jiran aiki; warware canjin jiran aiki na mai aiwatarwa na Aave; sokewa
Saitin Hub da Spoke, layukan bashi, saitunan Avana Umbrella

Ana jera sabuwar kasuwa da batch ɗaya na jinkiri na yau da kullum, don haka jinkirin kwanaki 5 shi ne bitarta ta jama'a, da ake tilastawa a kan chain. Batch ɗin yana tura vault token, yana yi wa kasuwa rajista tare da ainihin pool da kewayonta, yana saita sigoginta na farko da iyakoki, kuma yana rubuta hanyoyin farashinta da musanya. Kunnawa tana biyo baya a gajeren jinkiri kuma tana komawa baya sai dai idan jera kasuwa na ɓangaren Aave ya yi daidai.
Kowace sigar haɗari ta ɓangaren Avana tana canzawa ta tsari ɗaya:
Wallafawa: masu ba da sabis na haɗari suna wallafa canjin tare da lissafin auna iyakarsa, wanda ke rufe sharaɗin lamari na awanni 48 da sharaɗin wutsiya na token ɗaya na pool da ke zuwa sifili.
Gini: Safe na gudanarwa yana gina aikin kuma kowane mai sa hannu yana bin tsarin sa hannu da ke ƙasa.
Tsarawa: gajeren jinkiri yana aiki ne kawai idan kowane kira tsaurarawa ne; kiran sassautawa ɗaya yana sa dukan batch ya jira kwanaki 5.
Bita: sa ido yana faɗakarwa a kan kiran da aka tsara, kuma kowane mai sokewa zai iya sokewa yayin jinkiri.

Aiwatarwa: kowa yana aiwatar da shi cikin kwanaki 14 na lokacin shiryensa. Kowane setter yana sake bincika iyakokinsa a lokacin aiwatarwa, don haka ƙimar da ta zama mara aminci yayin da take cikin layi tana komawa baya.
Tabbatarwa: binciken saitin da ke aiki da sarari a iyaka na Lens suna tabbatar da sakamakon.
Iyakokin sassautawa

Kowace siga tana da setters daban na tsaurarawa da sassautawa. Dole tsaurarawa ta zama mafi aminci a zahiri kuma tana zama a cikin tsauraran iyakoki da na ci gaba da aiki, ba tare da iyakar mataki ba. Sassautawa tana da iyaka a girma da yawan lokuta:
Siga
Babban matakin sassautawa
Kowace iyakar USD (kasuwa, token, mai ajiya, yankin ƙarin jingina)
slippageAllowanceBps
+25 bps
Tsayayyen mafi ƙanƙantar lafiya na zaɓi na kowace kasuwa (a kashe a lokacin ƙaddamarwa)
Kowace siga mai iyakar mataki

Misali, daga iyakar kasuwa ta $2,000,000 sassautawa ɗaya tana kaiwa $3,000,000 a mafi yawa, kuma sassautawa ta gaba ta wannan iyaka ba ta aiwatarwa kafin kwanaki 5 daga baya, kowanne tare da bitarsa ta jama'a. Mataki mafi girma yana komawa baya da
LoosenStepTooLarge
, kuma na da wuri da
LoosenTooSoon
. Iyakokin iyakar stablecoin, tsawon alheri da ma'aunin lafiya na alheri suna canzawa ne kawai a jinkiri na yau da kullum a duka hanyoyi biyu.
Canje-canjen collateral factor

Collateral factor kansa ƙimar Aave ce da ake canzawa ta AIP. Don ragewa, Avana tana fara tsaurara ma'aunin haɗarin pool a gajeren jinkiri, don haka binciken drift yana tsayar da sabon aro yayin da factor na Aave ke sama da sabon wanda ake tsammani, sannan payload na Aave yana rage shi. Don ɗagawa, canjin Avana a jinkiri na yau da kullum yana aiwatarwa da farko. Ƙimomin ɓangaren Aave kamar lanƙwasar riba, maƙasudin ma'aunin lafiya, iyakoki, layukan bashi da saitunan Umbrella suna canzawa ne kawai ta gudanarwar Aave.

Keepers ba sa riƙe da matsayi: LPVaultSwap yana riƙe da jerin adireshi da aka amince da su. Avana tana gudanar da keeper nata a kowane chain kuma tana biyan gas ɗinsa. Jerin yana canzawa ne kawai ta timelock:
Ƙara keeper yana jira kwanaki 5 kuma mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya soke shi, don haka babu guardian da zai iya toshe maye gurbi.
Cire keeper yana jira awanni 12 kuma yana komawa baya idan zai bar keepers masu aiki ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantar keeper na 1.

Guardian zai iya daskarar da adireshin keeper mai ɗabi'a mara kyau nan take, har da na ƙarshe mai aiki. Yayin da babu keeper mai aiki da ya rage, sabon aro a chain yana tsayawa, kuma kowa har yanzu zai iya yin liquidation ta hanyar shiga mara izini.
Ana juya maɓallan keeper ta hanyar ƙara sabon maɓalli da farko (kwanaki 5) da cire tsohon daga baya (awanni 12).
Avana tana kaiwa ga Aave DAO ta hanyar gudanarwa ta yau da kullum:
Mataki
Abin da yake yanke shawara a kai
ARFC
Goyon bayan al'umma ga tantancewar fasaha da haɗari na Avana tare da masu ba da sabis na Aave DAO a Ethereum da Base, da shirya buƙatar layin bashin GHO mai iyaka
Snapshot
Yana tabbatar da goyon baya ga tantancewar
ARFC na turawa da Snapshot

Yana jera kowane CDP Spoke a matsayin Aave V4 Spoke na yau da kullum tare da saitunan reserve uku da ake buƙata, yana ba da matsayin flash-borrower a kan Aave V3 Pool na kowane chain, yana saita saitunan liquidation na kowane Spoke, yana yi wa Avana Umbrella na GHO rajista a kowane Stable LP Hub, kuma yana ƙara mai aiwatarwa na Aave da Aave Protocol Guardian ga kowane AvanaTimelock
ARFC na kuɗi da Snapshot
Yana saita layin bashin GHO da iyakokin ɗauka ga kowane chain, rabon rufewa da mafi ƙanƙantar kowane Avana Umbrella, da ƙimar GHO tsayayya a ko sama da ƙimar tushe ta GHO na Core Hub
AIPs
Saka duka shawarwarin biyu da aka amince da su a kan chain; a Base ta mai aiwatarwa na Base na DAO

Babu ɗaya daga cikin ARFCs na biyo baya da ke kunna aro shi kaɗai: ƙaddamarwa tana buƙatar duka biyu, tare da kowane sharaɗin tsaro da haɗari. Kowane chain bayan Ethereum da Base yana zuwa ta ARFC nasa.
Buƙatar layin bashi

Buƙatar layin bashi na farko ne na GHO 2,000,000 a kan Ethereum Stable LP Hub. Ana saita layin Base a cikin ARFC na kuɗi, a cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na GHO na Aave V3 Base Pool da zurfin hanyoyin musanya na Base. Ƙarfi yana girma zuwa GHO 10,000,000 ne kawai yayin da aka cika ma'aunin aiki na zahiri, kuma kowane ƙari yana buƙatar amincewar gudanarwa. Iyakar ɗauka na kowane CDP Spoke tana zama a cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na chain ɗinsa, zurfin hanyar musanya da iyakar rufewar Umbrella.
Avana tana ba da shawarar maƙasudin ma'aunin lafiya na 1.10 da mafi ƙanƙantar ribar liquidation aƙalla 2% ga kowane CDP Spoke. Aave DAO yana yanke shawarar duka biyu a cikin AIP na jera kasuwa.
Wannan ma'auni yana aiki a kowane chain ga Safe na gudanarwa, Emergency Guardian, Safe na baitulmalin Avana da masu gudanar da keeper.

Kowane maɓallin mai sa hannu na Safe yana kan hardware wallet na musamman da ke nuna bayanan EIP-712 masu nau'i a kan na'urar. Babu maɓallan zafi, maɓallan browser-extension ko na'urori na tarayya. Masu gudanar da keeper suna ajiye maɓallai a cikin HSM ko KMS nasu.
A mafi yawa 3 daga cikin masu sa hannu 7 na Safe na gudanarwa na Avana Labs ne, kuma masu sa hannun sun fito daga aƙalla ƙungiyoyi masu zaman kansu 3 da yankunan shari'a 3.
Emergency Guardian yana da mutane 5 daban-daban a cikin aƙalla yankunan lokaci 3.
Babu mutumin da ke sa hannu a Safes biyu na chain ɗaya, kuma masu sa hannu na Aave Protocol Guardian sun bambanta da na duka biyun.

Ga kowace ma'amala kowane mai sa hannu yana fassara calldata daga ɗanyen ma'amala, yana sake lissafa hash na ma'amalar Safe a kan na'urar, yana yin simulation a kan fork kuma yana bincika cewa jinkirinsa da ake buƙata ya yi daidai da ajin da aka nufa. Masu sa hannu biyu kuma suna bincika kowane maƙasudi a kan manifest na turawa.
Kowane mai sa hannu yana aika saƙon ci gaba da aiki da aka sa wa hannu kowane wata, kuma sa ido yana faɗakarwa idan masu sa hannu ƙasa da threshold + 1 suka amsa cikin awanni 72.
Ana maye gurbin mai sa hannu da ke barin aiki ko ake zargi cikin awanni 72, kuma ana juya kowane maɓalli aƙalla kowane wata 24.
Delay module yana sa kowane canjin mai shi da threshold na Safe na gudanarwa ya jira awanni 48.
Kowane kwata Safes na chains biyu suna maimaitawa a kan fork: dakatarwa da cire dakatarwa, daskarar da adireshi, canjin jiran aiki, kunna da sake saita breaker, da atisayen tsarawa da sokewa.

Mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave mai gabatarwa ne na biyu kusa da Safe na gudanarwa a kowane chain. Idan Safe ya rasa quorum ɗinsa ko ya yi watsi da matsayinsa bisa kuskure, gyare-gyare har yanzu suna kaiwa ga timelock ta gudanarwar Aave, wadda kowane mai sokewa ke sa ido a kai. Idan Safe na gudanarwa ya daina aiki, kowace kwangila tana ci gaba da gudana a kan saitinta na yanzu, ayyukan da ke cikin layi suna zama masu aiwatarwa a cikin tagar alherinsu, guardians suna riƙe da ikonsu na nan take kuma Aave DAO yana riƙe da kowane iko na ɓangaren Aave.

Miƙa aiki ga Aave DAO aikin canjin matsayi ɗaya ne ga kowane chain: yana ba da matsayin mai aiwatarwa ga mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave, yana ba da matsayin mai gabatarwa da mai aiwatarwa ga mai riƙewa na biyu da DAO ya ambata, kuma yana janye matsayin Safe na gudanarwa a ƙarshe, don haka saitin masu gabatarwa ba ya taɓa faɗuwa ƙasa da biyu. Matsayin guardian da mai sokewa ba su canza ba, kuma matsayin admin suna zama tare da timelock.
AvanaTimelock na kowane chain, masu gabatarwa, masu sokewa, guardians, matsayi, ajujuwan jinkiri da tsarin amincewar Aave DAO.

First-Loss Reserve: Coverage Spoke ɗaya ga kowane Hub da kadarar bashi, wanda Avana Labs ke ba da kuɗinsa kuma Aave DAO ke sarrafawa.

Avana Umbrella shi ne safety module na yarjejeniyar Avana, an sa masa suna bayan Umbrella na Aave, wanda ƙirarsa ta ba shi wahayi. Shi ne First-Loss Reserve: Coverage Spoke ɗaya ga kowane (Hub, kadarar bashi), wanda Avana Labs ke ba da kuɗinsa a cikin wannan kadara kuma Aave DAO ke sarrafawa. Kowanne yana rufe gibin da Aave ke rubutawa ga Avana CDP Spokes da aka amince da su a cikin kadararsa, a Hub nasa, kuma babu wani abu daban.

A lokacin ƙaddamarwa akwai biyu: GHO a kan Ethereum Stable LP Hub da GHO a kan Base Stable LP Hub. Kowace ƙarin kadarar bashi da aka kunna a kan CDP Spoke, kamar USDC, USDT ko WETH, tana samun Coverage Spoke nata, wanda ake ba wa kuɗi har zuwa mafi ƙanƙantarsa kafin kowace iyakar ɗauka a kan wannan kadara ta tashi sama da 0.

Coverage Spokes su ne kaɗai matakin asara na Avana a kan chain. Avana ba ta ƙidaya rufewa daga kuɗin shiga na kuɗaɗe da aka ƙulla, daga Umbrella na Aave kansa ko daga matakan DAO. Iyakokin jingina da liquidation suna zama farkon ikon sarrafawa a kan asara.

Coverage Spoke Spoke ne na samarwa kaɗai da aka yi wa rajista a kan kadararsa ta Hub ɗinsa tare da iyakar ɗauka ta 0. Kuɗaɗensa ruwan kuɗin Hub ne na wannan kadara kamar kowace samarwa, ana riƙe da su a matsayin hannun jari, kuma suna tara ribar samarwa ta kadarar.

Ba mai haɓakawa ba ne kuma ba shi da mai shi ban da access manager na Aave DAO. Avana Labs da kwangilolin Avana ba sa riƙe da wani matsayi a kansa. Maye gurbi sabon turawa ne, wanda ake ba wa kuɗi ta hanyar cirewar tsohon.
Coverage Spokes ne kaɗai masu riƙe da matsayin mai kawar da gibi na Hub, kuma kowanne yana kashe hannun jarinsa ne kawai ta hanyar kawar da gibi na Hub a kan kadararsa.
Aave DAO yana saita jerin izinin CDP Spokes na kowanne, mafi ƙanƙantar ma'auninsa da cirewarsa. Mai kira da DAO ya wakilta wanda ke riƙe da matsayin rufewa yana kunna rufewa.

Kowane asusu Position Proxy ɗaya ne ga kowane (wallet, CDP Spoke, kasuwa), don haka yana riƙe da reserve ɗaya daidai na jingina. Gibi yana tasowa ne kawai idan liquidation ta LPVaultSwap ta zubar da wannan reserve yayin da bashi ya rage. A cikin liquidation, CDP Spoke yana ba da rahoton ragowar bashin kowane reserve na bashi ga Hub mai ba da kuɗin wannan reserve, a cikin kadarar wannan reserve, kuma bashin asusun a cikinsa yana zama 0.

Liquidation da ta koma baya ba ta rubuta komai. Ana ci gaba da ƙidaya gibin a kan iyakar ɗauka na CDP Spoke a kan wannan kadara har sai an kawar da shi, don haka yana amfani da sarari a iyakar ɗauka. Sa ido yana gargaɗi a kan kowane gibi da ba sifili ba nan take kuma yana kiran ma'aikaci idan har yanzu ba a rufe ɗaya ba bayan awanni 24.
Mai kiran rufewa yana rufe kowane gibi da aka rubuta cikin
deficitCoverageWindow

, awanni 72 daga lokacin da aka rubuta gibin. A Base tagar ta haɗa da lokacin isar da gudanarwar tsakanin chains ta Aave ga mai aiwatarwa na Base, don haka littafin aiki na Base yana fara kiran a kiran farko.
Mai kira yana kiran
coverDeficit(borrowSpoke, maxAmount)
a kan Coverage Spoke na Hub da kadarar gibin.
Kiran yana komawa baya sai dai idan mai kira yana riƙe da matsayin rufewa, CDP Spoke yana cikin jerin izini kuma an rubuta gibi.
Coverage Spoke yana kiran
eliminateDeficit
a kan Hub ɗinsa don kadararsa. Hub yana ƙona daidaitattun hannun jari, da aka zagaye sama don kada farashin hannun jarin sauran masu samarwa ya faɗi, kuma yana rage gibin da aka rubuta.
Gibi a cikin kadarori biyu yana buƙatar kira biyu, ɗaya a kan Coverage Spoke na kowace kadara. Ba a taɓa cike gibi a cikin reserve na kadara ɗaya daga wata kadara, Hub ko chain ba.
Adadin da aka rufe a kira ɗaya:
amount = min(maxAmount, recorded deficit rounded up, fundedBalance())

Rufewa ba ta taɓa wuce abin da mai kira ya nema, abin da Aave ya rubuta a matsayin asara, ko abin da reserve ke riƙe da shi ba. Tana ci gaba da aiki yayin da aka tsayar da Coverage Spoke ko CDP Spoke da aka rufe a kan Hub.

ARFC na kuɗi yana saita rabon rufewa da mafi ƙanƙantar ma'aunin kowane reserve tare da masu ba da sabis na haɗari na Aave. Dole ma'aunin da aka ba da kuɗi ya rufe tsayayyen kaso na kowace iyakar ɗauka a kan (Hub, kadara) ɗinsa, da aka tara a kan kowane CDP Spoke da ke ɗaukar wannan kadara daga wannan Hub:
fundedBalance × 10⁴ ≥ coverageRatioBps × Σ drawCap
Ana bincika ƙa'idar lokacin da aka kunna reserve na bashi da kowane ɗaga iyakar ɗauka da Avana ke rubutawa. Ɗagawa da za ta karya ta tana komawa baya da
CoverageBelowRatio

Ƙimomin misali; ARFC na kuɗi ne ke saita na gaske. A rabo na misali na 20% (2,000 bps), layin bashin GHO 2,000,000 a kan Ethereum Stable LP Hub yana buƙatar aƙalla GHO 400,000 a cikin Umbrella ɗinsa. Ɗaga iyakar ɗauka na Spoke ɗaya daga GHO 1,200,000 zuwa 1,250,000, ta yadda jimillar iyakoki ta kai GHO 2,050,000, yana buƙatar aƙalla GHO 410,000; har sai Avana Labs ta ƙara GHO 10,000, ɗagawar tana komawa baya.

Bayan rabon, ana auna iyakoki ta yadda kowane reserve zai rufe asara biyu da aka yi samfuri ga kowane (Hub, kadarar bashi): sharaɗin lamari a tagar awanni 48, wanda ya haɗa da hauhawar farashin kadarar bashi, da sharaɗin wutsiya na token ɗaya na pool da ke zuwa sifili. Lens yana ba da rahoton rufewar wutsiya bisa iyaka, kuma sa ido yana gargaɗi ƙasa da 150% na mafi ƙanƙanta kuma yana kiran ma'aikaci ƙasa da 100%.
Lokacin da gibin da ba a biya ba na reserve na GHO na CDP Spoke ya wuce
breakerDeficitMax

, GHO 10,000, breaker na DEFICIT yana daskarar da sabon aro a kan wannan reserve na bashi kai tsaye. Sauran kadarorin bashi suna saita matakin muhimmancinsu a jera kasuwa. Ƙananan gibi ba sa kunna komai a kan chain; kowane sabon gibi yana tayar da faɗakarwa kuma ana rufe shi cikin awanni 72.
Breaker yana kulle. Yana zama a kunne bayan rufewa har sai pause guardian ya kira
resetDebtBreaker
, ko timelock ya yi a jinkiri na yau da kullum, don a bita tushen dalilin kafin aro ya ci gaba. Sake saitin yana komawa baya da
ConditionStillHolds

Reserve da ke ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantarsa yana tayar da faɗakarwar sa ido kuma ba ya kunna breaker. Emergency Guardian ko Aave Protocol Guardian yana yanke shawarar ko zai kunna breaker na bashi da hannu ko ya daskarar da Hub, kuma Avana Labs tana ƙara wa reserve kuɗi. Biya, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, liquidation da aron sauran kadarori suna ci gaba a duk lokacin.

Avana Labs tana ba wa kowane reserve kuɗi aƙalla zuwa mafi ƙanƙantarsa kafin kowace iyakar ɗauka a kan (Hub, kadara) ɗinsa ta tashi sama da 0, kuma tana sake cika shi bayan kowace rufewa. Kiran kuɗi yana motsa kadarar kai tsaye zuwa Hub kuma yana sa ta a asusu a matsayin hannun jarin Coverage Spoke; kuɗaɗen da aka ƙara ba sa ba wa mai bayarwa wani haƙƙi.
Kason kuɗin Avana da aka ƙulla yana ƙidaya zuwa mafi ƙanƙanta ne kawai da zarar an karɓe shi a cikin wannan kadara ta kiran kuɗi.
Abin da aka samu daga sasantawa mai jiran aiki yana zuwa Umbrella. Lokacin da kowa ya kira
settlePending

don share vault tokens da ƙwacewar da ba a taɓa sasantawa ba ta bari, LPVaultSwap yana mayar da tokens da aka saki zuwa kadarar bashi ta sasantawa ta kasuwar (GHO a lokacin ƙaddamarwa) kuma yana ba wa Umbrella da ya dace kuɗi da adadin da aka dawo da shi.
Kuɗaɗe suna fita ne kawai ta kawar da gibi ko cirewa ta DAO: Aave DAO yana buƙatar ta, kuma tana aiwatarwa bayan
reserveWithdrawalDelay
, kwanaki 14, da aka tsayar a cikin kwangila.

Kafin layin bashi ya rufe, DAO yana amincewa da cirewa ne kawai idan ma'aunin da ya rage har yanzu ya cika mafi ƙanƙanta. Jarin da ba a yi amfani da shi ba yana komawa ga Avana Labs ne kawai bayan layin bashi na wannan (Hub, kadara) ya rufe kuma kowane CDP Spoke da ke cikin jerin izini ba shi da bashi kuma ba shi da gibi a cikin wannan kadara.

Gibi da ya fi ma'aunin da aka ba wa reserve kuɗi girma yana zama a rubuce a kan Hub mai ba da kuɗi. Ɓangaren da ba a rufe ba asara ce ta masu samar da wannan kadarar Hub, bisa kason hannun jarinsu, har da masu samarwa ta Lend Spoke na chain.

Lissafin hannun jari na Aave yana ƙidaya gibin a cikin kadarar har sai an tabbatar da asarar, don haka mai samarwa da ya cire kafin tabbatarwa zai fita da cikakkiyar ƙima. Avana tana cire wannan fifikon bayani. Da zarar gibi da ba a rufe ba ya bayyana, Emergency Guardian yana gudanar da littafin matakai P-18:
Ana saita iyakar ɗauka na kowane Spoke mai ɗauka a kan wannan (Hub, kadara) zuwa 0 ta Aave Guardian.
Sa ido yana tayar da ƙararrawar
UncoveredDeficit(hub, asset, amount)
, wadda ke zuwa ga masu ba da rance ta app.
Lens yana wallafa adadin da ba a rufe ba da farashin hannun jari da aka daidaita bisa gibi, don kowane mai ba da rance ya ga asarar kafin cirewa.
Aave DAO yana tabbatar da adadin da ba a rufe ba a kan hannun jarin masu samarwa. Ƙarin kuɗi daga Avana Labs ko DAO kafin tabbatarwa yana bar mai kiran rufewa ya kawar da ragowar maimakon haka.
priceAdj = (A − uncovered) / Sh

Ƙimomin misali (Ethereum, GHO): GHO na Hub yana da A = GHO 2,000,000 da Sh = hannun jari 1,950,000. Gibin GHO 130,000 ya haɗu da reserve da ke riƙe da GHO 100,000, saboda rufewar baya ta rage shi ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantarsa na GHO 400,000. Bayan rufewa GHO 30,000 suna zama ba a rufe ba. Lens yana nuna farashin da aka daidaita na (2,000,000 − 100,000 − 30,000) / (1,950,000 − 97,500) ≈ 1.00944 GHO ga kowane hannun jari, idan aka kwatanta da 1.02564 da ba a daidaita ba. Mai ba da rance da ke riƙe da hannun jari 18,525, 1% na ragowar hannun jari, yana ɗaukar GHO 300 na asarar da zarar an tabbatar da ita.

Ƙimomin misali; ana saita sigogin kowace kasuwa a jera kasuwa. Kasuwa 1 ita ce kasuwar USDC/USDT 0.01% ta Uniswap v3 a kan Uniswap v3 Stable CDP Spoke na Ethereum Stable LP Hub, tare da collateral factor na 28.12% da mafi yawan ribar liquidation ta 5%. Proxy na Dan yana riƙe da vault tokens 20,000 a $2.00 ($40,000) kuma yana bin bashin GHO 10,000, ma'aunin lafiya na 1.1248. Umbrella na GHO yana riƙe da GHO 400,000 na misali, mafi ƙanƙantarsa. GHO na Hub yana da A = GHO 2,050,000 da Sh = hannun jari 2,000,000, kuma jimillar iyakokin ɗauka na GHO GHO 2,000,000 ce.
Mataki
Abin da ke faruwa
1. Rushewa

USDT ya rushe cikin mintuna kuma LPOracle yana ba da $0.50 ga kowane vault token. Jinginar Dan ta kai $10,000 kuma ma'aunin lafiyarsa 0.2812 ne. USDT ya fita daga iyakar stablecoin ta $0.90–$1.02, don haka sabon aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi suna tsayawa a kasuwa 1; faɗakarwar faɗuwar farashi tana tashi. Liquidation tana ci gaba.
2. Hasashe
Keeper na Avana yana hasashen liquidation ta Lens: ribar ita ce mafi yawa 5%, kuma jinginar tana rufe bashin GHO 10,000 / 1.05 = 9,523.81 kaɗai, don haka hasashen yana nuna gibi.
3. Liquidation

Ta LPVaultSwap, Aave yana ƙwace dukan vault tokens 20,000 kuma yana dawo da GHO 9,523.81. Reserve ɗaya tilo na jinginar Dan yanzu babu komai a ciki, don haka Spoke yana ba da rahoton gibin GHO 476.19. Bashin Dan 0 ne.
4. Sasantawa
Warwarewa da musanya suna mayar da GHO 9,950, sama da mafi ƙanƙantar GHO 9,899. Daga ribar GHO 426.19, kuɗin Avana GHO 95.24 ne (20% na ribar oracle ta GHO 476.19) kuma keeper yana karɓar GHO 330.95.
5. Faɗakarwa
Sa ido yana ganin gibin kuma yana gargaɗi nan take. Yana ƙasa da GHO 10,000, don haka breaker na DEFICIT ba ya kunna kuma aron GHO a sauran kasuwanni yana ci gaba.
6. Rufewa
Cikin awanni 72 mai kiran rufewa yana kiran coverDeficit tare da iyakar GHO 1,000. Adadin shi ne min(1,000, 476.19, 400,000) = GHO 476.19.
7. Kawarwa
Hub yana ƙona hannun jari 464.576 daga Coverage Spoke, da aka zagaye sama, kuma gibin Spoke 0 ne.
8. Ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta

Reserve yanzu yana riƙe da kusan GHO 399,523.81, ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantarsa na GHO 400,000. Kwangilar tana fitar da ReserveBelowMinimum kuma sa ido yana faɗakarwa. Biya, liquidation da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna gudana kamar yadda aka saba.
9. Ƙarin kuɗi
Avana Labs tana ba da GHO 477 kuma reserve ya koma sama da mafi ƙanƙantarsa.

Gibi a cikin liquidation. Liquidation da ba za ta iya kaiwa mafi ƙanƙantar dawowarta ba tana komawa baya ba tare da wani canji ba, ko mai kiranta yana biyan gibin ta ƙarin kuɗin gibi. Keeper mai yin liquidation ne ke biyan gibin zagayewa daga ƙa'idar ƙura ta Aave.
Gas na keeper da asarar keeper, waɗanda Avana ke biya daga kasafin keeper nata.
Asarar masu aro kansu. Masu aro har yanzu suna ɗaukar impermanent loss, haɗarin farashi da haɗarin liquidation; reserve ba ya ɗaga ƙarfin aro.
Wata kadara, Hub ko chain. Ana auna instances na kowane chain bisa iyakokin wannan chain kaɗai.
An bayyana ikon sarrafawa da ke aiki kafin gibi, da littattafan matakai da ke amsa wa ɗaya, a nan:
Ikon Gaggawa
Avana Umbrella: First-Loss Reserve ga kowane Hub da kadarar bashi, ƙa'idar rufewa, breaker na gibi da asarar da ta wuce reserve.

Matakan haɗari a cikin ƙirar Avana: asusu ga kowace kasuwa, collateral factors, iyakoki, yanayin oracle, circuit breakers, dakatarwa da daskarewa, liquidation, Avana Umbrella da iyakokin gudanarwa.

Matakan da ke iyakance asara a kasuwannin Aave V4 na Avana, daga keɓe asusu da iyakoki zuwa liquidation, Avana Umbrella da iyakokin gudanarwa.

Avana tana jera matsayin ruwan kuɗi na AMM a matsayin jingina a kan Aave V4 Spokes na yau da kullum, da ba a gyara ba, mallakar Aave DAO. Kowace kwangilar Aave tana zama ba a gyara ba; tsarewa, ƙimantawa da liquidation suna cikin kwangilolin Avana kanta. Ana iyakance haɗari a matakai, kowanne tare da mai shi da sigoginsa, kuma kowace kasuwa tana saita ƙimominta a jera kasuwa.

Aave DAO ne ke mallaka da saita kowane Avana Hub da Spoke kuma zai iya tsayar da kasuwannin Avana ba tare da Avana Labs ba. Kowane canji ga kwangilolin Avana kanta yana jira a cikin AvanaTimelock, wanda Avana Labs ba za ta iya kauce masa ba. Babu dakatarwa, daskarewa ko breaker da ke tsayar da biya, cirewa ba tare da bashi ba, karɓar kuɗaɗe ko liquidation mai cancanta.

Kasuwa pool ɗaya ce tare da ainihin kewayon tick ɗaya, da aka jera a matsayin reserve ɗaya na jingina a kan CDP Spoke ɗaya. Kowane wallet yana samun Position Proxy ɗaya ga kowane (CDP Spoke, kasuwa): asusun Aave mara dabaru, mara canzawa da aka ɗaure ga wannan wallet, Spoke da kasuwa. Don haka kowace kasuwa tana da ma'aunin lafiyarta, kuma babu abin da aka haɗa jingina a cikin kasuwanni.
Asusu yana riƙe da matsayi 16 a mafi yawa a kasuwa ɗaya, don haka liquidation na ɓangarensa na ƙarshe koyaushe tana dacewa a cikin ma'amala ɗaya.
Dole kowane matsayi da aka yi pledge da shi ya yi daidai da ainihin pool da kewayon kasuwa da aka jera, tare da mafi ƙanƙantar ƙima ta $10. Dole a cire matsayin Aerodrome Slipstream daga stake.
Babu jerin izinin masu aro kuma babu mafi ƙanƙantar bashi.
Masu aro a kasuwa ɗaya har yanzu suna raba fallasa ga oracle, kwangiloli da ruwan kuɗin pool ɗinta.

Ƙimantawa da iyakokin aro sun bambanta. LPOracle yana ƙimanta vault token a haɗin gaskiyarsa a farashin Chainlink, ba tare da ragi ba. Sannan collateral factor na reserve yana saita yawan wannan ƙima da zai iya tallafa wa bashi. Yana farawa daga collateral factor mafi ƙanƙanta na Aave V4 Core Hub a cikin tokens na pool kuma yana amfani da ma'aunin haɗarin pool sau ɗaya, yana zagaye ƙasa:
LP Collateral Factor = min(CF₁, …, CFₙ) × Pool Risk Factor

Ma'aunin haɗarin pool yana 40% a mafi yawa kuma yana nuna kewayon matsayi, tasirin canjin farashi, zurfin pool da kuɗaɗen liquidation da ake tsammani. Hanyar GHO tana amfani da bayyanannen factor da aka saita a jera kasuwa. Aave DAO yana saita factor na reserve a ko ƙasa da wannan ƙima kuma ba ya taɓa saita shi a 0 yayin da asusu ke riƙe da reserve; binciken drift na Avana yana tsayar da sabon aro idan an saita factor na Aave sama da haka. Nazarin Gauntlet na jinginar LP yana ba da shawarar factors na farawa masu taka-tsantsan, kuma ana daidaita factors na ƙarshe ga kowace kasuwa tare da masu ba da sabis.
Ƙimomin misali; ana saita sigogin kowace kasuwa a jera kasuwa. Ana ɗauka cewa GHO, USDC da USDT suna tsayawa a $1.
Abu
Sakamako
Ƙimar matsayin USDC/USDT (ainihin kewayo)

Ƙa'idar Aave ita ce kaɗai iyakar aro a kan chain: asusu zai iya aro har zuwa ma'aunin lafiya na 1.00. Lens yana nuna aron da aka ba da shawara a 1.10 kusa da wannan mafi yawa, saboda rancen da aka buɗe a cikakken ƙarfi ba shi da tazara. Akwai tsayayyen mafi ƙanƙantar lafiya na zaɓi na kowace kasuwa, a kashe a lokacin ƙaddamarwa, kuma ana saita shi ne kawai idan gwaje-gwajen matsi sun tabbatar da buƙatarsa.

Masu ba da sabis na haɗari suna saita kowace iyaka a cikin kunshin jera kasuwa na kowace kasuwa, tare da lissafin auna iyakarta. Ana cajin iyakoki a ƙimar USD a lokacin pledge, ana rubuta su ba ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙantar matsi na $1.00 ga kowane cikakken vault token ba.
Faɗi
Ƙa'ida
marketUsdCap
Ga kowace kasuwa
Kasafin pledge na yau da kullum na kasuwar
tokenUsdCap
Ga kowane token na ƙasa, ga kowane Hub
Fallasa ga token ɗaya a kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa na Hub; kowane pledge yana cajin cikakken ƙimarsa ga ƙidayoyin tokens biyu
depositorUsdCap
Ga kowane mai ajiya, ga kowane Hub
Fallasar mai ajiya ɗaya a kowane CDP Spoke da kasuwa na Hub
topUpSliceUsd

Kasafi da aka keɓe, 10% na iyakar kasuwa ta tsohuwa, da ake amfani da shi ne kawai don ƙarin jingina na ceto da ke dawo da asusu mai bashi zuwa ma'aunin lafiya na 1.10; an keɓe shi daga iyakokin token da mai ajiya
poolShareMaxBps
Ga kowane pool, ga kowane chain
A kashe ta tsohuwa. Inda jera kasuwar pool ya saita ɗaya, kason Avana haɗe na pool sama da ita yana toshe sabon aro da pledges da ke ƙara fallasa ga pool. Kaso sama da 25% yana tayar da faɗakarwa
Layin bashi da iyakokin ɗauka
Ga kowane (Hub, kadarar bashi) da kowane CDP Spoke
Aave DAO ne ke saita su; kowace iyakar ɗauka tana zama a cikin ruwan kuɗin flash na chain, zurfin hanyar musanya da ƙa'idar rufewa ta Avana Umbrella

Iyakokin token da kasuwa da bitar jera kasuwa ne ke rufe taruwa maimakon tsohuwar iyakar kason pool: cire ruwan kuɗi ba shi da tasiri a kan farashi, kuma ana iya sayar da abin da aka samu daga liquidation ta kowace hanya da aka amince da ita. Ana auna iyakoki ta yadda kowane Avana Umbrella zai rufe asara biyu da aka yi samfuri: sharaɗin lamari na awanni 48, wanda ya haɗa da faɗuwar LP mafi muni a tarihin kowane pool da hauhawar farashin kadarar bashi, da sharaɗin wutsiya na token ɗaya na pool da ke zuwa sifili. Tsaurara iyaka yana ɗaukar awanni 12; ɗaga ɗaya yana ɗaukar kwanaki 5 kuma a mafi yawa +50% a kowane mataki.

Kowane token yana da babbar hanyar Chainlink, madadin hanya tare da canjawa ta atomatik idan ta gaza da hanyar jiran aiki da aka amince da ita a jera kasuwa. Ana ƙidaya feed a matsayin sabo na tsawon heartbeat ɗinsa tare da daƙiƙa 1,800, kuma ba a taɓa ƙimanta stablecoins sama da $1 ba. TWAP na pool na mintuna 30 binciken daidaito ne, ba tushen farashi ba, kuma aro kuma yana buƙatar farashin kowane token ya yarda da tushe na biyu mai zaman kansa.
Sharaɗi
Amsar kasuwa
Live, tushe na biyu ya yarda
Aiki na yau da kullum
Live, tushe na biyu bai yarda ba ko ba ya samuwa
An toshe aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi. Pledges, biya da liquidation suna ci gaba.
Drifting: binciken daidaiton TWAP ya gaza

An toshe sabbin pledges, aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi. Aave yana ƙimanta jinginar a mafi ƙanƙanta tsakanin sabon farashi da na ƙarshe da aka karɓa. Liquidation tana ci gaba yayin da shigarwar Chainlink sababbi ne.
Drifting: babbar hanya da madadin hanya ba su yarda ba

An toshe aro kuma ana ƙimanta jinginar a hanya mafi ƙanƙanta. Liquidation ta kasuwar tana jira har sai hanyoyin sun yarda, guardian ya canja hanyar da ke da matsala zuwa ta jiran aikinta, ko gyaran timelock ya aiwatar.
Cached: duk hanyoyin biyu na token sun tsufa ko ba su da inganci, har zuwa awa 1
An toshe pledges, ƙarin jingina da aro. Aave yana ƙimanta jinginar a farashin ƙarshe da aka karɓa. Liquidation ta kasuwar tana jiran sabon farashi ko canjin jiran aiki.
Expired: bayan awa 1 na Cached

Ana ƙidaya jinginar a matsayin mara ƙima a ma'aunin lafiya na Aave. Liquidation ta kasuwar tana jiran sabon farashi ko canjin jiran aiki, don haka ba a taɓa ƙwace jingina a farashin da Avana ba za ta iya amincewa da shi ba.
Mintuna 30 na farko bayan dawowa daga Expired
Asusun da ke ƙasa da ma'aunin lafiya na 0.95 kaɗai za a iya liquidation.
Sequencer na Base ya tsaya, ko cikin awa 1 na sake farawarsa
An toshe aro. Liquidation tana dakatawa yayin da sequencer ya tsaya; na awa 1 bayan sake farawa asusun da ke ƙasa da 0.95 kaɗai za a iya liquidation.

A kowane layi, biya, karɓar kuɗaɗe da cirewa ba tare da bashi ba suna zama a buɗe. Stablecoin a wajen iyakar $0.90–$1.02 kuma yana toshe sabon aro da cirewa da ke barin bashi. Kadarar bashi da ba GHO ba tana bin yanayi iri ɗaya ta DebtOracle ɗinta, sai dai da zarar ta zama Expired tana ba da farashin matsi da aka ɗaga, don haka ba a taɓa ƙimanta bashi ƙasa da kima ba.
Ƙofofin wucin gadi (ORACLE, POOL_SHARE, POOL_DEPTH) suna tsayar da sabon aiki a kasuwa yayin da yanayinsu ke nan kuma suna sake buɗewa bayan mintuna 30 na lura masu lafiya.

Daskarewa da ke kulle (DEFICIT, ISSUER, CONFIG_DRIFT, MANUAL) suna zama a kunne har sai pause guardian ko timelock ya sake saita su. Daskarewar gibi tana kunna lokacin da gibin GHO da ba a biya ba na CDP Spoke ya wuce GHO 10,000.
Kowane Hub yana da yanayin dakatarwa: None, Frozen, Paused(General) ko Paused(MintPathSuspect). Guardians kuma za su iya daskarewa ko dakatar da kowane Hub na chain a lokaci ɗaya.
Guardian zai iya daskarar da wallets har zuwa 20 a kowane awanni 24 masu juyawa; wallet da aka daskarar yana rasa sabon aiki, ba hanyoyin fitarsa ba.
Faɗuwar farashi, hauhawar ƙwacewa, gazawar hanyar musanya da taruwar pool sama da 25% faɗakarwa ne, ba kunnawa a kan chain ba.
An bayyana abin da kowane yanayi ke toshewa, littattafan matakai da misalai a wannan shafi:
Ikon Gaggawa
Asusu yana cancantar liquidation lokacin da ma'aunin lafiyarsa ya faɗi ƙasa da 1. Kowace liquidation tana gudana ta LPVaultSwap a cikin ma'amala ɗaya mara rabuwa kuma koyaushe ta wani ɓangare ce:
LPVaultSwap yana flash-borrow kadarar bashi daga Aave V3 Pool, ko mai kira yana ba da kuɗinta.

Yana kiran liquidation ta yau da kullum ta CDP Spoke, wadda ke auna biyan zuwa maƙasudin ma'aunin lafiya na Spoke (Avana tana ba da shawarar 1.10) tare da riba mai canzawa ta Aave, kuma yana karɓar vault tokens da aka ƙwace.
Ana ƙona tokens da aka ƙwace kuma ana warware ainihin wannan kaso na matsayin; mai aro yana riƙe da ragowar matsayin da dukan kuɗaɗensa.

Ana musanya kowane token da aka warware zuwa kadarar bashi ta babbar hanya ko hanyar madadin ta kasuwar, tare da mafi ƙanƙantar fitarwa da aka samo daga oracle, kuma dole abin da aka samu ya kai mafi ƙanƙantar dawowa. Keeper zai iya cike ƙaramin gibi daga kuɗaɗensa; in ba haka ba ma'amalar tana komawa baya kuma babu abin da ke canzawa.
Kuɗin Avana 20% ne na ribar oracle; keeper yana karɓar ragowar ribar da aka samu kuma duk wani ƙarin rara yana zuwa ga mai aro. Biyan da token ya ƙi yana zuwa escrow na biya.

Avana tana gudanar da keeper nata a kowane chain kuma tana biyan gas ɗinsa, tana yin liquidation ga kowane asusu da ke ƙasa da 1 ko menene girmansa. Kowane adireshi kuma zai iya yin liquidation ta hanyar shiga mara izini. Liquidation kai tsaye daga kowace kwangila daban tana gazawa, saboda vault token yana karɓar jinginar da aka ƙwace zuwa LPVaultSwap kaɗai kuma kowane reserve na Avana yana da saituna uku da ake buƙata: ba a karɓar hannun jari, babu kuɗin liquidation na Aave kuma babu mai sarrafa sake saka jari.

Babu dakatarwar Avana, breaker, drift na saiti ko daskarar da adireshi da ke tsayar da liquidation. Tana jiran sabon farashin kasuwar da aka ƙwace da bashin da aka biya kaɗai, binciken sequencer na Base, da tsayarwar ɓangaren Aave ko dakatarwar reserve. Cikakken tsarin da misalai suna a wannan shafi:
Tsarin Liquidation

Lokacin da liquidation ta zubar da jinginar asusu yayin da bashi ya rage, Aave yana rubuta gibi a kan Hub mai ba da kuɗi a cikin wannan kadarar bashi. Kowane (Hub, kadarar bashi) yana da Avana Umbrella nasa, Coverage Spoke da Avana Labs ke ba da kuɗinsa kuma Aave DAO ke sarrafawa, wanda ke kawar da gibin da aka rubuta cikin awanni 72. A lokacin ƙaddamarwa akwai biyu, GHO a kan Stable LP Hub na kowane chain. Asara mafi girma fiye da reserve tana faɗa a kan masu samar da wannan kadarar Hub, bisa kaso, bayan Aave DAO ya tabbatar da ita.
Ƙa'idar rufewa, breaker na gibi da misalai suna a wannan shafi:
Kowane chain yana da AvanaTimelock nasa, Safe na gudanarwa na 4-of-7 da Emergency Guardian na 3-of-5; babu abin da ke kan chain ɗaya da ke aiki a ɗayan.

Kowace haɓakawa, canjin siga, jera kasuwa da canjin matsayi yana jira kwanaki 5, ba ya taɓa ƙasa da 4. Kiran da ke rage haɗari ko tsayar da sabon aiki kaɗai suna jira awanni 12. Kowa zai iya aiwatar da aikin da ke shirye cikin kwanaki 14.

Safe na gudanarwa da mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave suna gabatarwa. Safe na gudanarwa, guardians biyu da mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave za su iya sokewa; mai aiwatarwa na gudanarwar Aave kaɗai zai iya soke canjin matsayi ko aikin dawo da saiti.
Sassautawa tana da iyaka: iyakar USD tana tashi 50% a mafi yawa kuma izinin slippage 25 bps a mafi yawa a kowane mataki, sau ɗaya a kowane jinkiri na yau da kullum.
Guardians ba za su iya haɓakawa, canza sigogi, zaɓar sabon tushen farashi, cire daskarewar adireshi ko motsa kuɗaɗe ba.

Avana Labs tana gabatar da kasuwanni da canje-canjen sigogi don tantancewa ta mai bitar haɗari da aka naɗa, kuma ana jera sabbin kasuwanni a jinkiri na yau da kullum, bitar jama'a ta kwanaki 5 da ake tilastawa a kan chain.
Cikakken teburin matsayi da ajujuwan jinkiri suna a wannan shafi:
Gudanarwa da Timelock
